rows.source: Vibrato is a small bend and release, repeated quickly on a held note. Keep it narrow and even so the note stays in tune.
rows.translation: Vibrato je majhen bend in popustitev, hitro ponavljana na zadržanem tonu. Naj bo ozek in enakomeren, da ton ostane uglašen.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: The same five notes repeat up the neck. Box 2 starts where box 1 ends: finger 1 at fret 7 on strings 5, 4 and 3, finger 2 at fret 8 on strings 6, 2 and 1.
rows.translation: Istih pet tonov se ponavlja po vratu navzgor. Vzorec 2 se začne, kjer se vzorec 1 konča: prst 1 pri prečki 7 na strunah 5, 4 in 3, prst 2 pri prečki 8 na strunah 6, 2 in 1.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: String 6: frets 8 and 10. String 5: frets 7 and 10.
rows.translation: Struna 6: prečki 8 in 10. Struna 5: prečki 7 in 10.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: The same five notes as box 1, A C D E G, in a new place on the neck.
rows.translation: Istih pet tonov kot v vzorcu 1, A C D E G, na novem mestu na vratu.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: To travel from box 1 to box 2, slide finger 3 from fret 7 to fret 9 on string 3. You arrive in box 2 with your hand already in place.
rows.translation: Iz vzorca 1 v vzorec 2 preideš tako, da s prstom 3 zdrsneš od prečke 7 do prečke 9 na struni 3. V vzorec 2 prispeš z roko že na pravem mestu.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: Saltwater Sunday is a Timbre Original: laid-back reggae in A minor, where Am7 and D7 trade bars. Both pentatonic boxes fit over them. Hammer, pull and slide, and land on a chord note as each bar begins. The whole song is in Songs, under Originals.
rows.translation: Nedelja ob morju je izvirna pesem Timbre: sproščen reggae v A-molu, kjer Am7 in D7 izmenjujeta takte. Oba pentatonična vzorca se prilegata. Uporabi hammer-on, pull-off in slide ter vsak takt začni na akordnem tonu. Celotna pesem je v razdelku Pesmi pod Izvirne pesmi.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: Over D7, which of these box notes belongs to the chord?
rows.translation: Kateri od teh tonov vzorca pripada akordu D7?
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: D7 is D, F sharp, A and C. C, its seventh, sounds settled; E and G only pass through.
rows.translation: D7 sestavljajo D, F z višajem, A in C. Njegova septima C zveni umirjeno; E in G sta le prehodna tona.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: Your break over Am7 and D7
rows.translation: Tvoj solo ob Am7 in D7
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: No new ideas: hammer-ons, pull-offs, slides, bend targets, vibrato and both boxes. Play each phrase cleanly, then make it sing.
rows.translation: Brez novosti: hammer-on, pull-off, slide, ciljni toni bendov, vibrato in oba vzorca. Vsako frazo zaigraj čisto, nato naj zapoje.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: A whole-step bend from fret 7 should match…
rows.translation: Celotonski bend s prečke 7 se mora ujemati s tonom pri…
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: Target, then a bend. Same note or different?
rows.translation: Ciljni ton, nato bend. Isti ton ali različen?
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.translation: Iz vzorca 1 v vzorec 2, z občutkom
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: E and A shapes up the neck, major and minor, the closer shape, and a progression in A.
rows.translation: Durovi in molovi prijemi E in A po vratu, izbira bližjega prijema in zaporedje v A.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: Your F barre is an E shape with a barre at fret 1. Slide the whole thing up and the name follows the root on string 6: at fret 3 it's G, at fret 5 it's A.
rows.translation: Tvoj barré F je prijem E z barréjem pri prečki 1. Cel prijem podrsaj višje in ime sledi osnovnemu tonu na struni 6: pri prečki 3 je G, pri prečki 5 pa A.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: An E-shape barre at fret 5. Which chord?
rows.translation: Barré s prijemom E pri prečki 5. Kateri akord?
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: String 6 counts up from E: F at 1, G at 3, A at 5. The barre's fret names the chord.
rows.translation: Struna 6 se vzpenja od E: F pri 1, G pri 3, A pri 5. Prečka barréja poimenuje akord.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: Lift finger 2 and let the barre cover string 3. That's the E minor shape, and it moves the same way: F sharp minor at fret 2, A minor at fret 5.
rows.translation: Dvigni prst 2 in prepusti struno 3 barréju. To je prijem E-mola in premika se enako: mol na F z višajem pri prečki 2, A-mol pri prečki 5.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.translation: Prijem A, osnovni ton na struni 5
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: B minor was an A minor shape with a barre. The major A shape moves too: barre strings 1 to 5, then lay finger 3 flat across strings 4, 3 and 2, two frets higher.
rows.translation: B-mol je bil prijem A-mola z barréjem. Premika se tudi durovi prijem A: naredi barré čez strune 1 do 5, nato prst 3 plosko položi čez strune 4, 3 in 2 dve prečki višje.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: An A-shape barre at fret 3. Which chord?
rows.translation: Barré s prijemom A pri prečki 3. Kateri akord?
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: String 5 counts up from A: B at 2, C at 3, D at 5.
rows.translation: Struna 5 se vzpenja od A: B pri 2, C pri 3, D pri 5.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: The minor A shape moves too
rows.translation: Tudi molov prijem A se premika
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: For minor, use your B minor fingers: 2, 3 and 4 build the A minor pattern in front of the barre. At fret 3 that's C minor.
rows.translation: Za mol uporabi prste kot pri B-molu: 2, 3 in 4 pred barréjem tvorijo prijem A-mola. Pri prečki 3 je to C-mol.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: Most chords can be an E shape, root on string 6, or an A shape, root on string 5. Pick whichever sits closer to where your hand already is.
rows.translation: Večino akordov lahko igraš s prijemom E, z osnovnim tonom na struni 6, ali s prijemom A, z osnovnim tonom na struni 5. Izberi tistega, ki je bližje tvoji roki.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: You're playing G at fret 3. Where's the closest C?
rows.translation: Igraš G pri prečki 3. Kje je najbližji C?
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: C's root is on string 5, fret 3. Stay at fret 3 and switch to the A shape.
rows.translation: Osnovni ton C je na struni 5 pri prečki 3. Ostani pri prečki 3 in preidi na prijem A.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: Keep the barre, swap the shape
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: From G to C at fret 3, finger 1 stays on the barre. Only the fingers in front of it change. It's the smoothest barre change there is.
rows.translation: Iz G v C pri prečki 3 prst 1 ostane na barréju. Zamenjajo se le prsti pred njim. To je najgladkejša menjava barré akordov.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: D as an A shape sits at which fret?
rows.translation: Pri kateri prečki je D s prijemom A?
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: String 5: A open, B at 2, C at 3, D at 5.
rows.translation: Struna 5: prazni A, B pri 2, C pri 3, D pri 5.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: F sharp minor, D, A, E
rows.translation: Mol na F z višajem, D, A, E
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: F sharp minor, D, A and E all live in the key of A. Start with F sharp minor as a barre and the other three open.
rows.translation: Mol na F z višajem, D, A in E pripadajo tonaliteti A. Začni z barréjem za mol na F z višajem, druge tri pa igraj odprte.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: F sharp minor as an E-shape barre sits at…
rows.translation: Barré s prijemom E za mol na F z višajem je pri…
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: String 6: F at fret 1, F sharp at fret 2.
rows.translation: Struna 6: F pri prečki 1, F z višajem pri prečki 2.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: Play it up the neck: F sharp minor at fret 2, D as an A shape at fret 5, A as an E shape at fret 5, and E as an A shape at fret 7.
rows.translation: Igraj višje po vratu: mol na F z višajem pri prečki 2, D s prijemom A pri prečki 5, A s prijemom E pri prečki 5 in E s prijemom A pri prečki 7.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: Let the barre go soft for an instant as you move, then squeeze as you land. Gripping hard all the way tires your hand and slows the change.
rows.translation: Med premikom za hip popusti barré, nato ob pristanku pritisni. Če ves čas močno stiskaš, se roka utrudi in menjava upočasni.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: When should your fretting hand squeeze?
rows.translation: Kdaj naj roka na vratu pritisne?
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: Squeeze to land, relax to move. Constant force wears out your hand in minutes.
rows.translation: Za pristanek pritisni, za premik popusti. Stalen napor v nekaj minutah izčrpa roko.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: On the last up strum before a change, lift the barre and keep strumming. The open strings sound for a moment, the rhythm never stops, and you land on time.
rows.translation: Pri zadnjem potegu navzgor pred menjavo dvigni barré in nadaljuj poteg. Za hip zazvenijo prazne strune, ritem se ne ustavi in ti pristaneš pravočasno.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: Spray Paint Sunrise is a Timbre Original: indie pop in E on E, B, C sharp minor and A. B and C sharp minor are both A-shape barres, two frets apart, so one hand shape does most of the work. The whole song is in Songs, under Originals.
rows.translation: Zora iz spreja je izvirna pesem Timbre: indie pop v E na E, B, molu na C z višajem in A. B in mol na C z višajem sta barréja s prijemom A, dve prečki narazen, zato en prijem opravi večino dela. Celotna pesem je v razdelku Pesmi pod Izvirne pesmi.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: C sharp minor as an A minor shape barre sits at…
rows.translation: Barré s prijemom A-mola za mol na C z višajem je pri…
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: String 5 counts up from A: B at 2, C at 3, C sharp at 4.
rows.translation: Struna 5 se vzpenja od A: B pri 2, C pri 3, C z višajem pri 4.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: No new ideas: E and A shapes, major and minor, choosing the closer shape and smooth changes. Relax between chords and land on beat one.
rows.translation: Brez novosti: durovi in molovi prijemi E in A, izbira bližjega prijema in gladke menjave. Med akordi se sprosti in pristani na prvo dobo.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: An E-shape barre at fret 3 is…
rows.translation: Barré s prijemom E pri prečki 3 je…
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: Root on string 5 means which shape?
rows.translation: Kateri prijem ima osnovni ton na struni 5?
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: Funk sixteenths and scratches, the reggae chop, country boom-chick and a syncopated pop strum.
rows.translation: Funkovske šestnajstinke in dušeni udarci, reggae udarec, country bum-čik in sinkopirani pop potegi.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: Sixteenth notes split each beat in four: one-e-and-a, two-e-and-a. Your strumming hand doubles its speed, down-up-down-up inside every beat.
rows.translation: Šestnajstinke razdelijo vsako dobo na štiri: en-e-in-a, dva-e-in-a. Roka za poteg podvoji hitrost: dol-gor-dol-gor v vsaki dobi.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: How many sixteenth notes fill one beat?
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: One-e-and-a: four even slices of every beat.
rows.translation: En-e-in-a: štirje enaki deli vsake dobe.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: Funk loves the ninth chord. Finger 2 on string 5, fret 7, finger 1 on string 4, fret 6, and finger 3 flat across strings 3, 2 and 1 at fret 7.
rows.translation: Funk obožuje nonakord. Prst 2 na struno 5 pri prečki 7, prst 1 na struno 4 pri prečki 6, prst 3 pa plosko čez strune 3, 2 in 1 pri prečki 7.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: Keep your hand moving in sixteenths, but relax your fretting fingers so most strums are dead, scratchy clicks. Press down only for the hits.
rows.translation: Roka naj se giblje v šestnajstinkah, prsti na vratu pa naj bodo sproščeni, da je večina potegov suhih, praskajočih klikov. Pritisni le za zveneče udarce.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: Fretting fingers resting lightly on the strings
rows.translation: Prsti na vratu se rahlo dotikajo strun
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: Touching without pressing stops the strings from ringing. The strum turns into a crisp, percussive click.
rows.translation: Dotik brez pritiska ustavi zvenenje strun. Poteg se spremeni v jasen, udaren klik.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: Squeeze for each hit, then relax right away so it stays short. Slide the whole E9 shape down two frets and you have D9.
rows.translation: Za vsak udarec pritisni, nato takoj popusti, da ostane kratek. Celoten prijem E9 podrsaj dve prečki nižje in dobiš D9.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.translation: Reggae: kratek udarec na šibko dobo
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: Reggae guitar answers the drums with short, bright chords on beats two and four. Strum just the thin strings and cut each chord off right away.
rows.translation: Reggae kitara odgovarja bobnom s kratkimi, svetlimi akordi na drugi in četrti dobi. Potegni le po tankih strunah in vsak akord takoj prekini.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: Use the top four strings only. This A minor is the top of your A minor barre at fret 5: finger 3 on string 4, fret 7, finger 1 barring the rest.
rows.translation: Uporabi le zgornje štiri strune. Ta A-mol je vrh tvojega barréja A-mola pri prečki 5: prst 3 na struni 4 pri prečki 7, prst 1 pa naredi barré čez preostale.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: How long should a reggae chop ring?
rows.translation: Kako dolgo naj zveni kratek reggae udarec?
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: Squeeze, strum, release. The chop is a short bark, and the space after it is the groove.
rows.translation: Pritisni, potegni, popusti. Udarec je kot kratek lajež, prostor za njim pa daje ritmu občutek.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: Now the top of your D barre: finger 3 flat across strings 4, 3 and 2 at fret 7, finger 1 on string 1 at fret 5.
rows.translation: Zdaj vrh tvojega barréja D: prst 3 plosko čez strune 4, 3 in 2 pri prečki 7, prst 1 na struni 1 pri prečki 5.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: Country rhythm splits the bar: a single bass note on beats one and three, a quick strum of the thin strings on two and four. Boom, chick, boom, chick.
rows.translation: Country ritem razdeli takt: en basovski ton na prvo in tretjo dobo, hiter poteg po tankih strunah na drugo in četrto. Bum, čik, bum, čik.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: In boom-chick, what happens on beats two and four?
rows.translation: Kaj se pri bum-čiku zgodi na drugo in četrto dobo?
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: A short strum of the thin strings
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: Move the second boom to another string: in G, string 6 then string 4. In C, string 5 then 4. In D, string 4 then open string 5.
rows.translation: Drugi bum prestavi na drugo struno: v G struna 6, nato struna 4. V C struna 5, nato 4. V D struna 4, nato prazna struna 5.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: Booms in G, C and D
rows.translation: Basovski udarci v G, C in D
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: Syncopation puts the strum where you don't expect it. Down on one, up on the and of two, up on the and of three, then down-up on four.
rows.translation: Sinkopa postavi poteg tja, kjer ga ne pričakuješ. Navzdol na ena, navzgor na »in« po dve, navzgor na »in« po tri, nato dol-gor na štiri.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: In this pattern, what does your hand do on beat two?
rows.translation: Kaj v tem vzorcu roka naredi na drugo dobo?
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: The pendulum never stops. On two the hand swings down without touching, ready for the up strum.
rows.translation: Nihalo se nikoli ne ustavi. Na dve roka zamahne navzdol brez dotika strun, pripravljena na poteg navzgor.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: Pop players often change chords on the last up strum, the and of four, so the new chord arrives a hair early. It pushes the song forward.
rows.translation: Pop glasbeniki pogosto menjajo akorde na zadnji poteg navzgor, na »in« po štiri, da novi akord prispe za las prej. To pesem potisne naprej.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: The pop strum on four chords
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: Sparkler Season is a Timbre Original: a summer anthem in C on C, G, A minor and F. Give it the syncopated pop strum, and change a hair early, on the and of four. The whole song is in Songs, under Originals.
rows.translation: Čas iskric je izvirna pesem Timbre: poletna himna v C na C, G, A-molu in F. Igraj sinkopirane pop potege in menjaj za las prej, na »in« po štiri. Celotna pesem je v razdelku Pesmi pod Izvirne pesmi.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: Open E and D at fret 3 on string 2, twice, then G at fret 3 on string 1, and back down to D.
rows.translation: Prazni E in D pri prečki 3 na struni 2, dvakrat, nato G pri prečki 3 na struni 1 in nazaj navzdol na D.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: Why change chords on the and of four?
rows.translation: Zakaj akord zamenjaš na »in« po štiri?
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: So the new chord rings on beat one
rows.translation: Da novi akord zveni na prvo dobo
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: Moving on the last up strum gets your hand there a hair early, so the new chord is ready for beat one.
rows.translation: Premik na zadnji poteg navzgor pripelje roko na mesto za las prej, zato je novi akord pripravljen na prvo dobo.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: No new ideas: funk sixteenths, the reggae chop, boom-chick and the syncopated pop strum. Keep the hand swinging and change only what it hits.
rows.translation: Brez novosti: funkovske šestnajstinke, kratki reggae udarci, bum-čik in sinkopirani pop potegi. Roka naj niha; spreminjaj le, kaj zadene.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: Reggae chops land on which beats?
rows.translation: Na katere dobe padejo kratki reggae udarci?
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: A capo, G and D shapes on capo 2, and Oh! Susanna arranged with a verse and a chorus.
rows.translation: Kapodaster, prijema G in D pri kapodastru na 2 ter Oh! Susanna, prirejena s kitico in refrenom.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: A capo clamps every string at one fret. On fret 2, each open string sounds two frets higher, and your open chord shapes all move up with it.
rows.translation: Kapodaster stisne vse strune pri eni prečki. Pri prečki 2 vsaka prazna struna zveni dve prečki višje, z njim pa se zvišajo vsi odprti prijemi akordov.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: Before the capo: pluck strings 1 and 2 open. That's E and B.
rows.translation: Pred kapodastrom: uberi prazni struni 1 in 2. To sta E in B.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: Now clamp the capo just behind fret 2 and pluck them again: F sharp and C sharp.
rows.translation: Zdaj pripni kapodaster tik za prečko 2 in ju spet uberi: F z višajem in C z višajem.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: Capo on fret 2. You play a G shape. Which chord sounds?
rows.translation: Kapodaster pri prečki 2. Igraš prijem G. Kateri akord zveni?
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: Two frets up from G is A. The shape stays G; the sound moves up with the capo.
rows.translation: Dve prečki nad G je A. Prijem ostane G, zvok pa se s kapodastrom zviša.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: With a capo you still think G, C and D, the shapes you know. The diagrams here name the chord you actually hear, so a G shape on capo 2 reads A.
rows.translation: S kapodastrom še vedno misliš G, C in D, znane prijeme. Tukajšnji diagrami poimenujejo akord, ki ga res slišiš, zato je prijem G pri kapodastru na 2 označen A.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: G and D shapes on capo 2
rows.translation: Prijema G in D, kapodaster na 2
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: The G family, two frets up
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: On capo 2, G, C, D and E minor shapes sound as A, D, E and F sharp minor. Same fingers, new key: A major.
rows.translation: Pri kapodastru na 2 prijemi G, C, D in E-mol zvenijo kot A, D, E in mol na F z višajem. Isti prsti, nova tonaliteta: A-dur.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: Capo on fret 2. A D shape sounds as…
rows.translation: Kapodaster pri prečki 2. Prijem D zveni kot…
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: Two frets above D is E.
rows.translation: Dve prečki nad D je E.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: D shapes work the same way. On capo 2, D, G and A shapes sound as E, A and B: the key of E with easy open fingerings.
rows.translation: Prijemi D delujejo enako. Pri kapodastru na 2 prijemi D, G in A zvenijo kot E, A in B: tonaliteta E z lahkimi odprtimi prijemi.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: Most songs alternate two sections. The verse tells the story; the chorus repeats the hook. Stephen Foster's Oh! Susanna (1848) has both. Capo off: it's in G.
rows.translation: Večina pesmi izmenjuje dva dela. Kitica pripoveduje zgodbo, refren ponavlja značilni motiv. Oh! Susanna (1848) Stephena Fosterja ima oba. Snemi kapodaster: pesem je v G.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: The pickup and first bar: open G, A at fret 2, then open B, D at fret 3 twice, and open E.
rows.translation: Predtakt in prvi takt: prazni G, A pri prečki 2, nato prazni B, dvakrat D pri prečki 3 in prazni E.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: Which section usually comes back with the same words?
rows.translation: Kateri del se običajno vrne z istim besedilom?
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: Verses change their words as the story moves on. The chorus returns unchanged, and that's what people sing along to.
rows.translation: Kitice spreminjajo besedilo, ko zgodba napreduje. Refren se vrne nespremenjen in prav tega ljudje pojejo zraven.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: Back the verse with G and D7, boom-chick style: bass on one, strum on two. Three bars of G, one of D7, two of G, then D7 and G.
rows.translation: Kitico spremljaj z G in D7 v slogu bum-čik: bas na ena, poteg na dve. Trije takti G, en D7, dva G, nato D7 in G.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: The chorus opens on C, string 2, fret 1, then jumps to open E. Its chords are C, G and D7, and its second half matches the verse's ending.
rows.translation: Refren se začne na C, struna 2, prečka 1, nato skoči na prazni E. Njegovi akordi so C, G in D7, druga polovica pa je enaka koncu kitice.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: The opening: C twice on string 2, fret 1, then open E three times.
rows.translation: Začetek: dvakrat C na struni 2 pri prečki 1, nato trikrat prazni E.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: Then down: D twice, open B, open G, and A at fret 2.
rows.translation: Nato navzdol: dvakrat D, prazni B, prazni G in A pri prečki 2.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: The three E's go short, long, short. Where does the long one start?
rows.translation: Trije E gredo kratko, dolgo, kratko. Kje se začne dolgi?
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: It starts on the and and rings across the next beat. That push is syncopation, like your pop strum.
rows.translation: Začne se na »in« in zveni čez naslednjo dobo. Ta potisk je sinkopa, kot pri tvojih pop potegih.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: An arrangement decides what you play, and when. Yours: a Travis-picked intro, the verse as melody, the chorus strummed boom-chick, then the chorus melody to finish.
rows.translation: Priredba določi, kaj igraš in kdaj. Tvoja: uvod s Travisovim ubiranjem, melodija kitice, refren s potegi bum-čik in na koncu melodija refrena.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: Sets the key and tempo before the melody
rows.translation: Pred melodijo postavi tonaliteto in tempo
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: A few bars of chords tell everyone where home is and how fast to go.
rows.translation: Nekaj taktov akordov vsem pove, kje je dom in kako hitro naj gredo.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: Finish with the chorus melody and let the last G ring. Ending on the tune everyone just heard feels complete.
rows.translation: Končaj z melodijo refrena in pusti zadnji G zveneti. Zaključek z melodijo, ki so jo pravkar vsi slišali, deluje celovito.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: Gravel Road Two-Step is a Timbre Original: dance-hall country in A, on A, D and E. Clamp the capo on fret 2 and play it with G, C and D shapes, the ones you know best. The whole song is in Songs, under Originals.
rows.translation: Two-step po makadamu je izvirna pesem Timbre: plesni country v A na A, D in E. Kapodaster pripni pri prečki 2 in igraj s prijemi G, C in D, ki jih najbolje poznaš. Celotna pesem je v razdelku Pesmi pod Izvirne pesmi.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: Capo on fret 2. Which shape sounds as E?
rows.translation: Kapodaster pri prečki 2. Kateri prijem zveni kot E?
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: Two frets above D is E. On capo 2 the G shape gives A, and the C shape gives D.
rows.translation: Dve prečki nad D je E. Pri kapodastru na 2 prijem G da A, prijem C pa D.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: Pick the chord's root on beats one and three, and strum on two and four, each with a quick up after it. Boom, chick-a, boom, chick-a: the dancers' steps.
rows.translation: Osnovni ton akorda uberi na prvo in tretjo dobo, na drugo in četrto pa potegni, vsakič s hitrim potegom navzgor za njim. Bum, čik-a, bum, čik-a: plesni koraki.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: No new ideas: the capo, G and D shapes, and your Oh! Susanna arrangement. Play it as if someone's listening. Maybe someone is.
rows.translation: Brez novosti: kapodaster, prijema G in D ter tvoja priredba Oh! Susanna. Igraj, kot da te kdo posluša. Morda te res.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: Capo on fret 2. A C shape sounds as…
rows.translation: Kapodaster pri prečki 2. Prijem C zveni kot…
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: Five open shapes become five places to play G, and chords that stay near your hand.
rows.translation: Pet odprtih prijemov postane pet mest za G in akordi, ki ostanejo blizu tvoje roke.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: Every major chord can borrow the shape of open C, A, G, E or D, moved up the neck. Climbing from any one, the shapes come in that order, C A G E D, and each locks onto the next.
rows.translation: Vsak durov akord si lahko izposodi prijem odprtega C, A, G, E ali D, premaknjen višje po vratu. Od kateregakoli naprej si prijemi sledijo v vrstnem redu C A G E D in vsak se poveže z naslednjim.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: C, A, G, E and D: the five open shapes that every major chord can borrow, anywhere on the neck.
rows.translation: C, A, G, E in D: pet odprtih prijemov, ki si jih lahko izposodi vsak durov akord kjerkoli na vratu.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: Climb from open G and the next shape is the E shape: your G barre at fret 3. Its root on string 6 is the same G as in the open chord.
rows.translation: Vzpenjaj se od odprtega G in sledi prijem E: tvoj barré G pri prečki 3. Njegov osnovni ton na struni 6 je isti G kot v odprtem akordu.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: Open D moved up five frets is G. Finger 1 holds string 4 at fret 5, where the nut used to be. Fingers 2, 4 and 3 rebuild the D triangle above it.
rows.translation: Odprti D, premaknjen pet prečk višje, je G. Prst 1 drži struno 4 pri prečki 5 in nadomesti zgornje sedlo. Prsti 2, 4 in 3 nad njim znova oblikujejo trikotnik D.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: The D shape, string by string
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: Where is the D shape's root?
rows.translation: Kje je osnovni ton prijema D?
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: Open D's root is open string 4. Moved up, finger 1 holds it: G at fret 5. String 2, fret 8 is a G too.
rows.translation: Osnovni ton odprtega D je prazna struna 4. Višje ga drži prst 1: G pri prečki 5. Tudi struna 2 pri prečki 8 je G.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: The E shape at fret 3 and the D shape at fret 5 share one note: G on string 4, fret 5. Keep your eyes on it as you move between them.
rows.translation: Prijem E pri prečki 3 in prijem D pri prečki 5 imata skupni ton: G na struni 4 pri prečki 5. Med prehodom ga spremljaj z očmi.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: Open C moved up seven frets is G. Finger 1 lies across strings 3, 2 and 1 at fret 7, finger 2 takes string 2 at fret 8, and fingers 3 and 4 stretch to strings 4 and 5.
rows.translation: Odprti C, premaknjen sedem prečk višje, je G. Prst 1 leži čez strune 3, 2 in 1 pri prečki 7, prst 2 prevzame struno 2 pri prečki 8, prsta 3 in 4 pa se raztegneta do strun 4 in 5.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: The C shape, string by string
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: Like open C, the C shape's root is on…
rows.translation: Kot pri odprtem C je osnovni ton prijema C na…
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: Open C's root is string 5, fret 3. Here your little finger holds it: G at fret 10.
rows.translation: Osnovni ton odprtega C je struna 5 pri prečki 3. Tukaj ga drži mezinec: G pri prečki 10.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: Slide the C shape down to fret 2 and it's D, with its root on string 5, fret 5. The name always follows the root.
rows.translation: Prijem C podrsaj navzdol do prečke 2 in dobiš D, z osnovnim tonom na struni 5 pri prečki 5. Ime vedno sledi osnovnemu tonu.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: The A shape, and around again
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: Barre strings 5 to 1 at fret 10 and lay finger 3 across strings 4, 3 and 2 at fret 12. It's your A-shape barre, and it's G again.
rows.translation: Naredi barré čez strune 5 do 1 pri prečki 10 in položi prst 3 čez strune 4, 3 in 2 pri prečki 12. To je tvoj barré s prijemom A in spet je G.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: Past the A shape, the G shape comes back at fret 12: open G, one octave higher. From there the five shapes repeat in the same order.
rows.translation: Za prijemom A se pri prečki 12 vrne prijem G: odprti G, oktavo višje. Od tam se pet prijemov ponavlja v istem vrstnem redu.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: Going up the neck, which shape comes after A?
rows.translation: Kateri prijem po vratu navzgor sledi prijemu A?
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: The order loops: C, A, G, E, D, then C again. After A comes G.
rows.translation: Vrstni red se ponavlja: C, A, G, E, D, nato spet C. Za A pride G.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: With CAGED you rarely have to jump. Around fret 5, G is the D shape, C is the G shape and D is the A shape. Three chords, one spot.
rows.translation: S sistemom CAGED redko potrebuješ skok. Okoli prečke 5 je G prijem D, C prijem G, D pa prijem A. Trije akordi, eno mesto.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: Which shape plays C right beside the D-shape G?
rows.translation: S katerim prijemom igraš C tik ob G s prijemom D?
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: C's G shape uses frets 5 and 8, right where your hand already is.
rows.translation: Prijem G za akord C uporablja prečki 5 in 8, prav tam, kjer je že tvoja roka.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: The same idea works lower: G as the E shape at fret 3, C as the A shape at fret 3, and D as the C shape at fret 2.
rows.translation: Ista zamisel deluje nižje: G s prijemom E pri prečki 3, C s prijemom A pri prečki 3 in D s prijemom C pri prečki 2.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: Lantern Hill is a Timbre Original: a campfire sing-along on G, C and D. Play its chorus open, then near fret 5, then near fret 3, and the same song moves around the neck. The whole song is in Songs, under Originals.
rows.translation: Grič svetilk je izvirna pesem Timbre za skupno petje ob ognju na G, C in D. Refren igraj odprto, nato blizu prečke 5, nato blizu prečke 3 in ista pesem potuje po vratu. Celotna pesem je v razdelku Pesmi pod Izvirne pesmi.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: Near fret 5, which shape plays C?
rows.translation: S katerim prijemom igraš C blizu prečke 5?
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: C's G shape uses frets 5 and 8, right beside the D-shape G and the A-shape D.
rows.translation: Prijem G za C uporablja prečki 5 in 8, tik ob G s prijemom D in D s prijemom A.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: No new ideas: G in all five shapes, and G, C and D near fret 3 and fret 5. Name each shape as you land it.
rows.translation: Brez novosti: G v vseh petih prijemih ter G, C in D blizu prečke 3 in prečke 5. Vsak prijem ob pristanku poimenuj.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: G with the D shape sits at…
rows.translation: G s prijemom D je pri…
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: Three-note chords on the top strings: major and minor, every inversion, and progressions that barely move.
rows.translation: Tritonski akordi na zgornjih strunah: dur in mol, vsi obrati ter zaporedja s komaj opaznimi premiki.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: A triad is the smallest full chord: a root, a third and a fifth. On strings 3, 2 and 1, triads ring clear and bright, and they work anywhere on the neck.
rows.translation: Trozvok je najmanjši popolni akord: osnovni ton, terca in kvinta. Na strunah 3, 2 in 1 trozvoki zvenijo jasno in svetlo ter delujejo kjerkoli na vratu.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: Which notes make a C major triad?
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: Root, third, fifth: from C, skip a letter to E, then skip another to G.
rows.translation: Osnovni ton, terca, kvinta: od C preskoči črko do E, nato še eno do G.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: Move the lowest note to the top and you get an inversion. With E at the bottom, C sits at frets 9, 8 and 8. With G at the bottom, it's the top of your open C.
rows.translation: Najnižji ton prestavi na vrh in dobiš obrat. Z E spodaj je C pri prečkah 9, 8 in 8. Z G spodaj je to vrh tvojega odprtega C.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: Every major triad on these strings uses one of three shapes, one per inversion. Learn them on G and D and you can find any major chord.
rows.translation: Vsak durov trozvok na teh strunah uporablja enega od treh prijemov, po enega na obrat. Nauči se jih na G in D in našel boš vsak durov akord.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: G at frets 4, 3 and 3 has the same shape as…
rows.translation: G pri prečkah 4, 3 in 3 ima isti prijem kot…
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: Both put the third at the bottom: one fret up on string 3, the other two level. Same shape, five frets apart.
rows.translation: Oba imata terco spodaj: na struni 3 eno prečko višje, drugi dve sta poravnani. Isti prijem, pet prečk narazen.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: D at frets 7, 7 and 5 has the root-position shape of your C at fret 5. Lower down, frets 2, 3 and 2 are the top of your open D.
rows.translation: D pri prečkah 7, 7 in 5 ima prijem osnovne lege tvojega C pri prečki 5. Nižje so prečke 2, 3 in 2 vrh tvojega odprtega D.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: A minor triad is a major triad with its third one fret lower. On these strings, A minor at frets 2, 1 and 0 is the top of your open A minor.
rows.translation: Molov trozvok je durov trozvok s terco eno prečko nižje. Na teh strunah je A-mol pri prečkah 2, 1 in 0 vrh tvojega odprtega A-mola.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: Barre fret 5 across strings 3, 2 and 1 and you have A minor with C at the bottom. One finger, three notes.
rows.translation: Z barréjem pri prečki 5 čez strune 3, 2 in 1 dobiš A-mol s C spodaj. En prst, trije toni.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: E minor at frets 4, 5 and 3 puts B at the bottom. It sits right beside A minor at fret 5, so the change is tiny.
rows.translation: E-mol pri prečkah 4, 5 in 3 postavi B na dno. Leži tik ob A-molu pri prečki 5, zato je menjava drobna.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: Pick the inversion closest to your hand and a progression barely moves. G, E minor, C and D all live between frets 2 and 5.
rows.translation: Izberi obrat, ki je najbližje roki, in zaporedje se komaj premika. G, E-mol, C in D so vsi med prečkama 2 in 5.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: From G at frets 4, 3, 3 to E minor at 4, 5, 3, which notes stay?
rows.translation: Katera tona ostaneta pri prehodu iz G na prečkah 4, 3, 3 v E-mol na 4, 5, 3?
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: B on string 3 and G on string 1 stay put. Only string 2 moves, from D up to E.
rows.translation: B na struni 3 in G na struni 1 ostaneta na mestu. Premakne se le struna 2, iz D navzgor v E.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: The same four chords sit higher too: G at frets 7, 8 and 7, E minor at 9, 8 and 7, C at 9, 8 and 8, and D at 7, 7 and 5.
rows.translation: Isti štirje akordi so tudi višje: G pri prečkah 7, 8 in 7, E-mol pri 9, 8 in 7, C pri 9, 8 in 8 ter D pri 7, 7 in 5.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: Play a triad's notes one at a time and you have an arpeggio. Through a progression, the notes make a melody of their own.
rows.translation: Tone trozvoka igraj posamično in dobiš arpeggio. Skozi zaporedje toni ustvarijo svojo melodijo.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: A chord played one note at a time
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: The top notes here run G, G, G, F sharp: almost still while the chords change under them. A note that two chords share is a common tone, and it's why triads sound so smooth.
rows.translation: Zgornji toni so tukaj G, G, G, F z višajem: skoraj mirujejo, medtem ko se akordi pod njimi menjajo. Ton, ki si ga delita dva akorda, je skupni ton; zato trozvoki zvenijo tako gladko.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: Did the top note go up or down?
rows.translation: Je šel zgornji ton navzgor ali navzdol?
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: Roller Rink is a Timbre Original: retro dance pop on G, E minor, C and D, your four triads between frets 2 and 5. Small shapes on the top strings sound bright and tight, like a second guitar. The whole song is in Songs, under Originals.
rows.translation: Kotalkališče je izvirna pesem Timbre: retro plesni pop na G, E-molu, C in D, tvojih štirih trozvokih med prečkama 2 in 5. Majhni prijemi na zgornjih strunah zvenijo svetlo in zgoščeno, kot druga kitara. Celotna pesem je v razdelku Pesmi pod Izvirne pesmi.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: Roller Rink's loop is the one, six, four and five of G. Which chord is the six?
rows.translation: Zanka pesmi Kotalkališče je ena, šest, štiri in pet v G. Kateri akord je šest?
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: Count up G major: G 1, A 2, B 3, C 4, D 5, E 6. The chord on 6 is minor: E minor.
rows.translation: Štej navzgor po G-duru: G 1, A 2, B 3, C 4, D 5, E 6. Akord na 6 je molov: E-mol.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: No new ideas: major and minor triads, their inversions, G, E minor, C and D in two places, and the arpeggios. Keep every move small.
rows.translation: Brez novosti: durovi in molovi trozvoki, njihovi obrati, G, E-mol, C in D na dveh mestih ter arpeggii. Vsak premik naj bo majhen.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: A minor triad is a major triad with…
rows.translation: Molov trozvok je durov trozvok, ki ima…
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: Major, minor and dominant sevenths, open and barred, the ii–V–I, and swing comping.
rows.translation: Veliki durovi, mali molovi in dominantni septakordi, odprti in barré, ii–V–I ter swingovska spremljava.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: A major seventh chord adds the note one fret below the root's octave. It turns a plain major chord soft and dreamy. Open Cmaj7 is C with finger 1 lifted.
rows.translation: Veliki durov septakord doda ton eno prečko pod oktavo osnovnega tona. Navaden durov akord postane mehak in sanjav. Odprti Cmaj7 je C z dvignjenim prstom 1.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: Cmaj7 is C plus which note?
rows.translation: Kateri ton dodamo C, da dobimo Cmaj7?
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: The major seventh sits one fret below the root's octave: B, just under C.
rows.translation: Velika septima je eno prečko pod oktavo osnovnega tona: B, tik pod C.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: Play the mini F, but let finger 1 press string 2 only. Open string 1, E, is the major seventh of F.
rows.translation: Zaigraj mali F, a naj prst 1 pritiska le struno 2. Prazna struna 1, E, je velika septima od F.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: A minor seventh chord adds the note two frets below the root's octave. It sounds mellow, between dark and bright. Am7 is A minor with finger 3 lifted.
rows.translation: Mali molov septakord doda ton dve prečki pod oktavo osnovnega tona. Zveni mehko, med temnim in svetlim. Am7 je A-mol z dvignjenim prstom 3.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: Dm7: finger 2 on string 3, fret 2, and finger 1 flat across strings 2 and 1 at fret 1. Em7: just finger 2 on string 5, fret 2.
rows.translation: Dm7: prst 2 na struni 3 pri prečki 2, prst 1 plosko čez struni 2 in 1 pri prečki 1. Em7: samo prst 2 na struni 5 pri prečki 2.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: Am7 is A minor plus which note?
rows.translation: Kateri ton dodamo A-molu, da dobimo Am7?
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: The minor seventh sits two frets below the root's octave: G, two frets under A.
rows.translation: Mala septima je dve prečki pod oktavo osnovnega tona: G, dve prečki pod A.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: Sevenths with the root on string 5
rows.translation: Septakordi z osnovnim tonom na struni 5
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: Finger 1 holds string 5 at fret 3 and lies across to string 1. Finger 3 takes string 4, finger 2 string 3 and finger 4 string 2.
rows.translation: Prst 1 drži struno 5 pri prečki 3 in leži čez strune do strune 1. Prst 3 prevzame struno 4, prst 2 struno 3, prst 4 pa struno 2.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: Dm7 is your A minor barre with the little finger lifted. D7 is the A-shape barre with fingers 3 and 4 on strings 4 and 2. Both are named after string 5.
rows.translation: Dm7 je tvoj barré A-mola z dvignjenim mezincem. D7 je barré s prijemom A, s prstoma 3 in 4 na strunah 4 in 2. Oba imata ime po struni 5.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: Dm7 at fret 5. Where is its root?
rows.translation: Dm7 pri prečki 5. Kje je njegov osnovni ton?
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: Like every A-shape chord, it's named after its note on string 5.
rows.translation: Kot vsak akord s prijemom A se imenuje po svojem tonu na struni 5.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: Jazz's favorite move: the chord on the second note of the key, then the fifth, then home. In C that's Dm7, G7 and Cmaj7.
rows.translation: Najljubši jazzovski prehod: akord na drugem tonu tonalitete, nato na petem, nato domov. V C so to Dm7, G7 in Cmaj7.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: Play the E7 shape as a barre at fret 3: finger 1 across all six strings, finger 3 on string 5 and finger 2 on string 3. Its root is on string 6.
rows.translation: Prijem E7 igraj kot barré pri prečki 3: prst 1 čez vseh šest strun, prst 3 na struno 5 in prst 2 na struno 3. Osnovni ton je na struni 6.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: In the key of C, which chord is the ii?
rows.translation: Kateri akord je ii v tonaliteti C?
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: Count up from C: C is one, D is two. The seventh chord built on D is D minor seven.
rows.translation: Štej od C navzgor: C je ena, D je dve. Septakord, zgrajen na D, je mali molov septakord na D.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: Jazz players often let each chord ring for just a moment. Squeeze as you strum, ease off right after, and the chords start to swing.
rows.translation: Jazz glasbeniki vsak akord pogosto pustijo zveneti le za hip. Ob potegu pritisni, takoj nato popusti in akordi začnejo swingati.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: Swing guitarists comp: short chords that answer the band. The Charleston rhythm hits beat one and the swung and of two, then leaves space.
rows.translation: Swing kitaristi spremljajo s kratkimi akordi, ki odgovarjajo skupini. Ritem charleston udari na prvo dobo in na swingovski »in« po dve, nato pusti prostor.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: In G, the two, five, one is Am7, D7 and Gmaj7. Am7 is the E minor seven barre at fret 5; Gmaj7 skips string 5, with its root on string 6, fret 3.
rows.translation: V G so dve, pet, ena Am7, D7 in Gmaj7. Am7 je barré s prijemom malega molovega septakorda na E pri prečki 5; Gmaj7 izpusti struno 5, osnovni ton pa ima na struni 6 pri prečki 3.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: Late Checkout is a Timbre Original: lo-fi in C on Dm7, G7, Cmaj7 and Am7. That's a ii–V–I, plus the six chord to start it over. Comp it with your barred sevenths and the Charleston. The whole song is in Songs, under Originals.
rows.translation: Pozna odjava je izvirna pesem Timbre: lo-fi v C na Dm7, G7, Cmaj7 in Am7. To je ii–V–I z akordom šeste stopnje za nov začetek. Spremljaj jo z barré septakordi in charlestonom. Celotna pesem je v razdelku Pesmi pod Izvirne pesmi.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: In Late Checkout, which chord is the V?
rows.translation: Kateri akord je V v pesmi Pozna odjava?
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: Count up C major: C 1, D 2, E 3, F 4, G 5. The seventh chord on G is G7.
rows.translation: Štej navzgor po C-duru: C 1, D 2, E 3, F 4, G 5. Septakord na G je G7.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: No new ideas: major, minor and dominant sevenths, open and barred, and the ii–V–I in C and G. Keep the chords short and the swing steady.
rows.translation: Brez novosti: veliki durovi, mali molovi in dominantni septakordi, odprti in barré, ter ii–V–I v C in G. Akordi naj bodo kratki, swing pa enakomeren.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: Which seventh sits one fret below the root's octave?
rows.translation: Katera septima je eno prečko pod oktavo osnovnega tona?
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: G major in two octaves at fret 2, scale degrees and chords, and the Dorian and Mixolydian modes.
rows.translation: G-dur v dveh oktavah pri prečki 2, lestvične stopnje in akordi ter dorski in miksolidijski modus.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: A half step is one fret, a whole step two. Every major scale climbs whole, whole, half, whole, whole, whole, half. That pattern gives major its sound.
rows.translation: Polton je ena prečka, cel ton pa dve. Vsaka durova lestvica se vzpenja: cel ton, cel ton, polton, cel ton, cel ton, cel ton, polton. Ta vzorec daje duru njegov zvok.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: Put finger 1 at fret 2 and give each finger its own fret, up to fret 5. From G on string 6, fret 3, the scale climbs across strings 6, 5 and 4.
rows.translation: Prst 1 postavi pri prečki 2 in vsakemu prstu dodeli svojo prečko do prečke 5. Od G na struni 6 pri prečki 3 se lestvica vzpenja prek strun 6, 5 in 4.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: String 6: frets 3 and 5, fingers 2 and 4. String 5: frets 2 and 3, fingers 1 and 2.
rows.translation: Struna 6: prečki 3 in 5, prsta 2 in 4. Struna 5: prečki 2 in 3, prsta 1 in 2.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: String 5, fret 5, then string 4: frets 2, 4 and 5. Home on G.
rows.translation: Struna 5, prečka 5, nato struna 4: prečke 2, 4 in 5. Domov na G.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: Where do the half steps fall in a major scale?
rows.translation: Kje sta poltona v durovi lestvici?
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: Whole, whole, half: the first half step is from 3 to 4. Whole, whole, whole, half: the second is from 7 to 8.
rows.translation: Cel ton, cel ton, polton: prvi polton je od 3 do 4. Cel ton, cel ton, cel ton, polton: drugi je od 7 do 8.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: The same position carries on: A, B and C on string 3, D and E on string 2, F sharp and G on string 1. Your hand never moves.
rows.translation: Ista lega se nadaljuje: A, B in C na struni 3, D in E na struni 2, F z višajem in G na struni 1. Roka se ne premakne.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: String 3: frets 2, 4, 5. String 2: frets 3, 5. String 1: frets 2, 3.
rows.translation: Struna 3: prečke 2, 4, 5. Struna 2: prečki 3, 5. Struna 1: prečki 2, 3.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: In this position, which finger plays fret 5?
rows.translation: Kateri prst v tej legi igra pri prečki 5?
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: Finger 1 sits at fret 2, so fret 5 belongs to finger 4, your little finger.
rows.translation: Prst 1 je pri prečki 2, zato prečka 5 pripada prstu 4, mezincu.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.translation: Dve oktavi, od G do G
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: A carol built on the scale
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: Joy to the World, arranged by Lowell Mason in 1839, opens with the G major scale straight down from the top. You know every note already.
rows.translation: Joy to the World v priredbi Lowella Masona iz leta 1839 se začne s spustom po G-durovi lestvici od vrha. Vse tone že poznaš.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: Joy to the World, in position
rows.translation: Joy to the World v legi
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: Number the scale from G: G is 1, A is 2, and so on up to F sharp, 7. Musicians use these numbers to talk about melodies and chords in any key.
rows.translation: Lestvico oštevilči od G: G je 1, A je 2 in tako naprej do F z višajem, 7. Glasbeniki s temi številkami govorijo o melodijah in akordih v katerikoli tonaliteti.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: In G major, which note is 5?
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: Count up from G: G 1, A 2, B 3, C 4, D 5.
rows.translation: Štej od G navzgor: G 1, A 2, B 3, C 4, D 5.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: Stack every other scale note on each degree and you get the key's chords. Chords on 1, 4 and 5 are major; on 2, 3 and 6 they're minor. In G: G, C and D, then A minor, B minor and E minor.
rows.translation: Na vsaki stopnji zloži vsak drugi ton lestvice in dobiš akorde tonalitete. Akordi na 1, 4 in 5 so durovi, na 2, 3 in 6 pa molovi. V G: G, C in D ter A-mol, B-mol in E-mol.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: In G major, which chord is built on 6?
rows.translation: Kateri akord je v G-duru zgrajen na 6?
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: The sixth note is E, and chords on 2, 3 and 6 are minor. Stack E, G and B: E minor.
rows.translation: Šesti ton je E, akordi na 2, 3 in 6 pa so molovi. Zloži E, G in B: E-mol.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: Play G major's notes but treat A as home, and the scale turns minor. This sound is A Dorian, a mode of G major: same position, new starting note.
rows.translation: Igraj tone G-dura, a naj bo A domači ton, in lestvica dobi molov značaj. To je dorski modus na A, modus G-dura: ista lega, nov začetni ton.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: Start on A, string 6, fret 5, with finger 4, and climb the same frets to A on string 3.
rows.translation: Začni na A, struna 6, prečka 5, s prstom 4 in se po istih prečkah vzpni do A na struni 3.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: Which note makes A Dorian brighter than plain A minor?
rows.translation: Kateri ton naredi dorski modus na A svetlejši od naravnega A-mola?
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: Plain A minor has F. Dorian keeps G major's F sharp: a bright spot in a minor scale.
rows.translation: Naravni A-mol ima F. Dorski modus ohrani F z višajem iz G-dura: svetlo točko v molovi lestvici.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.translation: Melodija v dorskem modusu na A
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: Now treat D as home. G major's notes from D to D make D Mixolydian: a major scale with its seventh one fret lower. It's all over folk, rock and fiddle tunes.
rows.translation: Zdaj naj bo D domači ton. Toni G-dura od D do D dajo miksolidijski modus na D: durovo lestvico s septimo eno prečko nižje. Pogost je v folku, rocku in ljudskih violinskih melodijah.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: From D on string 5, fret 5, up the same position to D on string 2, fret 3.
rows.translation: Od D na struni 5 pri prečki 5 po isti legi navzgor do D na struni 2 pri prečki 3.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: D major has C sharp. D Mixolydian has…
rows.translation: D-dur ima C z višajem. Miksolidijski modus na D ima…
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: Mixolydian lowers the seventh by one fret, so G major's C becomes its flavor note.
rows.translation: Miksolidijski modus zniža septimo za eno prečko, zato C iz G-dura postane njegov značilni ton.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.translation: Melodija v miksolidijskem modusu na D
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: Any note of the major scale can be home. From G it's major, from A Dorian, from D Mixolydian, from E plain minor. Same frets, different moods.
rows.translation: Vsak ton durove lestvice je lahko dom. Od G je dur, od A dorski modus, od D miksolidijski, od E naravni mol. Iste prečke, različna razpoloženja.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: Market Day is a Timbre Original: sunny pop in G with a highlife bounce, the bright guitar music of West Africa. Its hook uses only G major's notes, so it sits inside your second-position scale. The whole song is in Songs, under Originals.
rows.translation: Tržni dan je izvirna pesem Timbre: sončen pop v G z zibanjem highlifa, svetle kitarske glasbe Zahodne Afrike. Značilni motiv uporablja le tone G-dura, zato leži v tvoji lestvici v drugi legi. Celotna pesem je v razdelku Pesmi pod Izvirne pesmi.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: Market Day's chords are G, B minor, C and D. Which scale degrees are they on?
rows.translation: Akordi pesmi Tržni dan so G, B-mol, C in D. Na katerih lestvičnih stopnjah so?
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: G is 1, B is 3, C is 4 and D is 5. The chord on 3 is minor in every major key: B minor.
rows.translation: G je 1, B je 3, C je 4 in D je 5. Akord na 3 je v vsaki durovi tonaliteti molov: B-mol.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: D at fret 3 on string 2, B at fret 4 on string 3, D again, E at fret 5 with finger 4, then D and B.
rows.translation: D pri prečki 3 na struni 2, B pri prečki 4 na struni 3, spet D, E pri prečki 5 s prstom 4, nato D in B.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: No new ideas: G major in two octaves, the scale in thirds, A Dorian and D Mixolydian. Keep one finger per fret.
rows.translation: Brez novosti: G-dur v dveh oktavah, lestvica v tercah, dorski modus na A in miksolidijski na D. Ohrani en prst na prečko.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: Whole, whole, half, whole, whole, whole, half spells…
rows.translation: Katera lestvica ima zaporedje cel ton, cel ton, polton, cel ton, cel ton, cel ton, polton?
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: Which mode starts on the second note of G major?
rows.translation: Kateri modus se začne na drugem tonu G-dura?
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: The major pentatonic, country hammer-ons and slides, trills, phrasing, and sweet and sour over the blues.
rows.translation: Durova pentatonika, country hammer-oni in slidi, trilčki, fraziranje ter sladko in trpko v bluesu.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: Move your minor pentatonic box from fret 5 down to fret 2 and treat A as home: it turns sweet and major. That's A major pentatonic: A, B, C sharp, E and F sharp.
rows.translation: Molov pentatonični vzorec prestavi s prečke 5 na prečko 2 in naj bo A domači ton: zvok postane sladek in durov. To je A-durova pentatonika: A, B, C z višajem, E in F z višajem.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: From A on string 6, fret 5, then frets 2 and 4 on strings 5 and 4, and A at fret 2 on string 3.
rows.translation: Od A na struni 6 pri prečki 5, nato prečki 2 in 4 na strunah 5 in 4 ter A pri prečki 2 na struni 3.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: Which notes are in A major pentatonic?
rows.translation: Kateri toni so v A-durovi pentatoniki?
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: A, B, C sharp, E, F sharp
rows.translation: A, B, C z višajem, E, F z višajem
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: Five notes of the A major scale, its two half steps left out. The minor box at fret 5 holds A, C, D, E and G.
rows.translation: Pet tonov A-durove lestvice, brez njenih dveh poltonov. Molov vzorec pri prečki 5 vsebuje A, C, D, E in G.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: A major pentatonic, up and down
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: This box at fret 2 is also F sharp minor pentatonic, from its F sharp. The note you treat as home decides which one you're playing.
rows.translation: Ta vzorec pri prečki 2 je tudi molova pentatonika na F z višajem, če začneš na F z višajem. Domači ton določi, katero igraš.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: Country players love hammer-ons inside this box: E to F sharp on string 4, A to B on string 3. Pick the first note, then hammer the second.
rows.translation: Country glasbeniki radi uporabljajo hammer-one v tem vzorcu: iz E v F z višajem na struni 4, iz A v B na struni 3. Uberi prvi ton, drugi pa naj zazveni s hammer-onom.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: String 4: pick fret 2, then hammer finger 3 onto fret 4.
rows.translation: Struna 4: uberi pri prečki 2, nato s prstom 3 udari na prečko 4.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.translation: S slidom navzgor do C z višajem
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: Now slide finger 3 on string 3 from fret 4 to fret 6, B up to C sharp, then glide back into the box.
rows.translation: Zdaj s prstom 3 zdrsni po struni 3 od prečke 4 do prečke 6, iz B navzgor v C z višajem, nato zdrsni nazaj v vzorec.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: Finger 3 on string 3, fret 4. Pick, then slide to fret 6 without lifting.
rows.translation: Prst 3 na struni 3 pri prečki 4. Uberi, nato brez dviga zdrsni do prečke 6.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: A trill flutters between two notes: one pick, then hammer-on, pull-off, over and over. Keep it even before you make it fast.
rows.translation: Trilček trepeta med dvema tonoma: en brenk, nato hammer-on, pull-off, znova in znova. Najprej naj bo enakomeren, šele nato hiter.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: String 3: frets 2 and 4. Pick once, then hammer and pull with finger 3.
rows.translation: Struna 3: prečki 2 in 4. Uberi enkrat, nato s prstom 3 izmenjuj hammer-on in pull-off.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: Start one fret below the note you want and slide up into it as you pick. The target is what counts: land it right on the beat.
rows.translation: Začni eno prečko pod želenim tonom in ob ubiranju zdrsni navzgor vanj. Šteje cilj: pristani točno na dobo.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: When you slide into a note, which one lands on the beat?
rows.translation: Ko zdrsneš v ton, kateri pristane na dobo?
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: The slide starts just before the beat, so the note you're aiming for arrives right on it.
rows.translation: Slide se začne tik pred dobo, da ciljni ton prispe točno nanjo.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.translation: V vsako frazo vstopi s slidom
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: Over a blues in A, both boxes work. Major pentatonic at fret 2 sounds sweet; minor at fret 5 sounds tough. Good players move between them.
rows.translation: Ob bluesu v A delujeta oba vzorca. Durova pentatonika pri prečki 2 zveni sladko, molova pri prečki 5 pa trdo. Dobri glasbeniki prehajajo med njima.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: Which box sounds sweeter over A7?
rows.translation: Kateri vzorec ob A7 zveni slajše?
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: The major pentatonic holds C sharp, the third of A7. The minor box's C rubs against it, and that rub is the blues.
rows.translation: Durova pentatonika vsebuje C z višajem, terco A7. C iz molovega vzorca se tare obnjo in to trenje je blues.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: Ask a tough question at fret 5, then answer it sweetly at fret 2. Shift your hand on the long note, and land both phrases on A.
rows.translation: Pri prečki 5 postavi trdo vprašanje, nato pri prečki 2 sladko odgovori. Roko premakni med dolgim tonom in obe frazi končaj na A.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: Great solos breathe. Play a short phrase, rest about as long as it lasted, then answer. The silence makes the next notes count.
rows.translation: Odlični soli dihajo. Zaigraj kratko frazo, počivaj približno toliko časa, kot je trajala, nato odgovori. Tišina da naslednjim tonom težo.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: After a two-beat phrase, how long might you rest?
rows.translation: Kako dolgo bi lahko počival po dvodobni frazi?
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: Play a phrase twice the same way, then change only its ending. Listeners hear the repeat and lean in for the twist.
rows.translation: Frazo dvakrat zaigraj enako, nato spremeni le konec. Poslušalci slišijo ponovitev in prisluhnejo preobratu.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: Hold each long note and rock it with a small, even push and release. Keep it narrow: the pitch should waver, never wander off.
rows.translation: Vsak dolgi ton zadrži in ga zazibaj z majhnim, enakomernim potiskom in popustitvijo. Naj bo ozko: višina naj valuje, ne odplava.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: Slow Motion Strobe is a Timbre Original: synth-pop in A on F sharp minor, D, A and E. Your box at fret 2 fits the whole loop: A major pentatonic, which is F sharp minor pentatonic too. The whole song is in Songs, under Originals.
rows.translation: Stroboskop v počasnem posnetku je izvirna pesem Timbre: synth-pop v A na molu na F z višajem, D, A in E. Vzorec pri prečki 2 ustreza celi zanki: A-durova pentatonika, ki je tudi molova pentatonika na F z višajem. Celotna pesem je v razdelku Pesmi pod Izvirne pesmi.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: Listen to the first chord. Major or minor?
rows.translation: Poslušaj prvi akord. Dur ali mol?
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: Over F sharp minor and D
rows.translation: Ob molu na F z višajem in D
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: Which box notes belong to the E chord?
rows.translation: Katera tona vzorca pripadata akordu E?
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.translation: C z višajem in F z višajem
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: E is E, G sharp and B. The box holds E and B but no G sharp, so lean on those two over E.
rows.translation: E sestavljajo E, G z višajem in B. Vzorec vsebuje E in B, ne pa G z višajem, zato se ob E opri na ta dva tona.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: No new ideas: the major pentatonic, hammer-ons, slides, trills and both boxes over the blues. Leave space, and finish on A.
rows.translation: Brez novosti: durova pentatonika, hammer-oni, slidi, trilčki in oba vzorca ob bluesu. Pusti prostor in končaj na A.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: Slide the minor box from fret 5 to fret 2 and it plays…
rows.translation: Molov vzorec podrsaj s prečke 5 na prečko 2. Katero lestvico dobiš?
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: Verse, chorus and AABA, intros and tags, texture and fills, and your own arrangement of Down by the Riverside.
rows.translation: Kitica, refren in AABA, uvodi in dodatki, zvočna tekstura, vmesne fraze in tvoja priredba Down by the Riverside.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: Most songs are built from a few sections: verses that tell the story, a chorus that repeats the hook, and sometimes a bridge for contrast. Knowing the plan keeps you from getting lost.
rows.translation: Večino pesmi sestavlja nekaj delov: kitice, ki pripovedujejo zgodbo, refren, ki ponavlja značilni motiv, in včasih most za kontrast. Če poznaš načrt, se ne izgubiš.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: What does a chorus usually carry?
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.translation: Značilni motiv, ki ga vsi pojejo
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: The chorus returns with the same words and tune. It's the part people remember and sing along to.
rows.translation: Refren se vrne z istim besedilom in melodijo. To je del, ki si ga ljudje zapomnijo in pojejo zraven.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: Many older songs use AABA: a tune, the same tune again, a contrasting bridge, then the tune once more. Each section often runs eight bars; here they run four.
rows.translation: Veliko starejših pesmi uporablja AABA: melodija, ista melodija znova, kontrastni most in še enkrat melodija. Vsak del pogosto traja osem taktov; tukaj trajajo štiri.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: In AABA form, which section is the bridge?
rows.translation: Kateri del v obliki AABA je most?
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: The easiest intro is the song's last line, played before the first verse. It sets the key, the tempo and the mood, and the singer knows exactly where to come in.
rows.translation: Najlažji uvod je zadnja vrstica pesmi, zaigrana pred prvo kitico. Postavi tonaliteto, tempo in razpoloženje, pevec pa točno ve, kdaj vstopiti.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: An intro from the last line
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: Why start with the song's last line?
rows.translation: Zakaj začeti z zadnjo vrstico pesmi?
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: It sets the key and tempo
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: To end, repeat the last line, often twice more, and let the final chord ring. A tag tells everyone the song is closing.
rows.translation: Za konec ponovi zadnjo vrstico, pogosto še dvakrat, in pusti zadnji akord zveneti. Dodatek vsem pove, da se pesem končuje.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: Arrangers lift a chorus by changing what the guitar does. Fingerpick the verse softly, then strum the chorus, and the same chords suddenly sound bigger.
rows.translation: Aranžerji okrepijo refren tako, da spremenijo igro kitare. Kitico nežno ubiraj s prsti, refren pa igraj s potegi in isti akordi nenadoma zvenijo večje.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: Verse: Travis on G and D7
rows.translation: Kitica: Travisovo ubiranje na G in D7
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: Each section can add a little: a picked verse, a strummed chorus, then triads up the neck for the last chorus. Save your biggest sound for the end.
rows.translation: Vsak del lahko nekaj doda: ubrana kitica, refren s potegi, nato trozvoki višje po vratu za zadnji refren. Največji zvok prihrani za konec.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: When the melody holds a long note, a solo guitarist fills the space: a bass note or two from the chord, then back to the tune in time.
rows.translation: Ko melodija drži dolg ton, solistični kitarist zapolni prostor: basovski ton ali dva iz akorda, nato se pravočasno vrne k melodiji.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: On top of every melody note
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: Fill with notes of the chord under the long note. Over G: G, B and D. Over D7: D, F sharp, A and C. They can't clash with the band.
rows.translation: Uporabi tone akorda pod dolgim tonom. Ob G: G, B in D. Ob D7: D, F z višajem, A in C. Tako se ne morejo spopasti s skupino.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: Down by the Riverside: your arrangement
rows.translation: Down by the Riverside: tvoja priredba
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: Down by the Riverside, a spiritual first printed in 1918, gets the full treatment: a Travis-picked intro, two verses and choruses, a pentatonic solo, and a tag.
rows.translation: Down by the Riverside, duhovna pesem, prvič natisnjena leta 1918, dobi celotno priredbo: uvod s Travisovim ubiranjem, dve kitici in refrena, pentatonični solo in dodatek.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: Intro: Travis on G and D7
rows.translation: Uvod: Travisovo ubiranje na G in D7
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: A solo in G major pentatonic
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: The solo uses G major pentatonic in open position: G, A, B, D and E. It follows the verse's chords and ends a beat early, so the singer can come back in.
rows.translation: Solo uporablja G-durovo pentatoniko v odprti legi: G, A, B, D in E. Sledi akordom kitice in se konča eno dobo prej, da lahko pevec znova vstopi.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: Which parts of this arrangement have no words?
rows.translation: Kateri deli te priredbe nimajo besedila?
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: Jukebox Moon is a Timbre Original: a fifties slow dance in AABA form, a verse, the verse again, a bridge on F, then the verse once more. Strum every beat, with a quick swung up into each new bar. The whole song is in Songs, under Originals.
rows.translation: Luna iz džuboksa je izvirna pesem Timbre: počasen ples iz petdesetih v obliki AABA, kitica, znova kitica, most na F in še enkrat kitica. Potegni na vsako dobo, s hitrim swingovskim potegom navzgor pred novim taktom. Celotna pesem je v razdelku Pesmi pod Izvirne pesmi.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: In Jukebox Moon, which section is the B?
rows.translation: Kateri del je B v pesmi Luna iz džuboksa?
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: The verses share one tune: A, A. The bridge brings new chords and a new tune, B, then the verse returns.
rows.translation: Kitici imata isto melodijo: A, A. Most prinese nove akorde in novo melodijo, B, nato se kitica vrne.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.translation: Tvoja priredba od začetka do konca
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: No new ideas: form, intros, tags, texture, fills and your Down by the Riverside. Play it straight through, like a set.
rows.translation: Brez novosti: oblika, uvodi, dodatki, zvočna tekstura, vmesne fraze in tvoja Down by the Riverside. Odigraj jo v celoti, kot nastop.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: In AABA, how many times does the A tune come?
rows.translation: Kolikokrat se v AABA pojavi melodija A?
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: From G C E A to new keys, fingerpicking and a stage set
rows.translation: Od G C E A do novih tonalitet, ubiranja s prsti in odrskega nastopa
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: Hold it, meet G C E A, play your first notes, your first chord and a song.
rows.translation: Primi jo, spoznaj G C E A, zaigraj prve tone, prvi akord in pesem.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: Rest the body against your chest with the neck pointing left. The string nearest the floor is string 1. It plays the highest open note.
rows.translation: Trup nasloni na prsni koš, vrat pa naj kaže levo. Struna najbližje tlom je struna 1. Igra najvišji prazni ton.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: Strings count up from the floor side: 1, 2, 3, 4.
rows.translation: Strune štejemo od spodnje strani navzgor: 1, 2, 3, 4.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: Pluck string 1 with your thumb and let it ring.
rows.translation: S palcem uberi struno 1 in jo pusti zveneti.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: Now string 2, the next one up.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: G C E A, the open strings
rows.translation: G C E A, prazne strune
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: From string 4 down to string 1, the open strings are G, C, E, A. Try: Good Cooks Eat Apples.
rows.translation: Od strune 4 do strune 1 so prazne strune G, C, E, A. Za pomnjenje: Gospa Cvetka elegantno aplavdira.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: Play strings 4 and 3, one at a time.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: On most instruments the strings get lower as you go up. On ukulele, string 4 (G) is higher than string 3 (C). This is called re-entrant tuning.
rows.translation: Pri večini glasbil so strune nižje, ko greš navzgor. Pri ukulele je struna 4 (G) višja od strune 3 (C). Temu pravimo povratna uglasitev.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: The high G keeps every chord close together and bright. It is the sweet, ringing sound people know as ukulele.
rows.translation: Visoki G ohrani tone vsakega akorda blizu skupaj in svetle. To je sladek, zveneč zvok, ki ga ljudje poznajo kot ukulele.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: String 3, then string 4. Hear the jump up?
rows.translation: Struna 3, nato struna 4. Slišiš skok navzgor?
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: Which open string plays the lowest note?
rows.translation: Katera prazna struna igra najnižji ton?
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: With re-entrant tuning, C on string 3 is the lowest note on the ukulele.
rows.translation: Pri povratni uglasitvi je C na struni 3 najnižji ton ukulele.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: Open, fret 2, fret 3: A, B, C.
rows.translation: Prazna struna, prečka 2, prečka 3: A, B, C.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: Fret 2 on string 3 is D. Fret 1 on string 2 is F. Fret 3 on string 2 is G, the same note as open string 4.
rows.translation: Prečka 2 na struni 3 je D. Prečka 1 na struni 2 je F. Prečka 3 na struni 2 je G, isti ton kot prazna struna 4.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: Fret 3 on string 2 matches which open string?
rows.translation: S katero prazno struno se ujema prečka 3 na struni 2?
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: Both are G. Two places, one note.
rows.translation: Oba sta G. Dve mesti, en ton.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: Open strings, the high G and your first fretted notes. Take it slowly and let each note ring.
rows.translation: Prazne strune, visoki G in tvoji prvi toni s prijemom. Igraj počasi in pusti vsak ton zveneti.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: Name the open strings from 4 to 1.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: Which one is the open G string?
rows.translation: Kateri primer je prazna struna G?
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.translation: Vse štiri prazne strune, od 4 do 1.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: Your fretted notes: D, F, B, C.
rows.translation: Tvoji toni s prijemom: D, F, B, C.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: C uses your third finger on fret 3 of string 1. The other three strings ring open.
rows.translation: C uporablja tretji prst pri prečki 3 na struni 1. Druge tri strune zvenijo prazne.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: Brush down across all four strings with the pad of your thumb, from string 4 to string 1. Keep your wrist loose.
rows.translation: Z blazinico palca potegni navzdol čez vse štiri strune, od strune 4 do strune 1. Zapestje naj bo sproščeno.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: Which finger plays the C chord?
rows.translation: S katerim prstom igraš akord C?
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: Your third finger reaches fret 3 without a stretch.
rows.translation: Tretji prst doseže prečko 3 brez raztezanja.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: Row, Row, Row Your Boat needs only C. Strum it on the two big beats of every bar, then play the tune on strings 1 to 3.
rows.translation: Row, Row, Row Your Boat potrebuje le C. Potegni na dve veliki dobi vsakega takta, nato melodijo zaigraj na strunah 1 do 3.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: The tune's five notes: C and D on string 3, E, F and G on string 2.
rows.translation: Pet tonov melodije: C in D na struni 3, E, F in G na struni 2.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: A minor, F, G7 and G: with C, the chords behind countless songs.
rows.translation: A-mol, F, G7 in G: skupaj s C akordi neštetih pesmi.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: A minor and your first change
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: Put your second finger on fret 2 of string 4 and strum all four strings. A minor sounds darker than C.
rows.translation: Drugi prst položi pri prečki 2 na struni 4 in potegni po vseh štirih strunah. A-mol zveni temneje kot C.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: Lift the finger you don't need and place the new one while the last strum still rings. Look ahead to the next chord.
rows.translation: Dvigni prst, ki ga ne potrebuješ, in postavi novega, medtem ko zadnji poteg še zveni. Vnaprej poglej naslednji akord.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: First finger on fret 1 of string 2, second finger on fret 2 of string 4. Strings 3 and 1 ring open.
rows.translation: Prvi prst pri prečki 1 na struni 2, drugi prst pri prečki 2 na struni 4. Struni 3 in 1 zvenita prazni.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: Which chord shares a finger with F?
rows.translation: Kateri akord si s F deli položaj prsta?
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: Your second finger sits on fret 2 of string 4 for both. Keep it down when you change.
rows.translation: Pri obeh je drugi prst pri prečki 2 na struni 4. Med menjavo ga pusti na mestu.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: G7, the chord that leads home
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: First finger on fret 1 of string 2, second on fret 2 of string 3, third on fret 2 of string 1. Strum all four.
rows.translation: Prvi prst pri prečki 1 na struni 2, drugi pri prečki 2 na struni 3, tretji pri prečki 2 na struni 1. Potegni po vseh štirih.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: A chord that wants to go home
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: G7 sounds unfinished. Play C after it and the tension lets go. That pull is why so many songs put G7 before C.
rows.translation: G7 zveni nedokončano. Za njim zaigraj C in napetost popusti. Zaradi tega vleka toliko pesmi postavi G7 pred C.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: Does this end at home or leave you hanging?
rows.translation: Se to konča doma ali pusti pričakovanje?
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: First finger on fret 2 of string 3, second on fret 2 of string 1, third on fret 3 of string 2. Arch your fingers so string 4 rings.
rows.translation: Prvi prst pri prečki 2 na struni 3, drugi pri prečki 2 na struni 1, tretji pri prečki 3 na struni 2. Prste ukrivi, da struna 4 zveni.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: G and G7 both press which spot?
rows.translation: Na katerem mestu pritiskata tako G kot G7?
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: Both chords put a finger on fret 2 of string 3. Use it as your anchor.
rows.translation: Oba akorda imata prst pri prečki 2 na struni 3. Uporabi ga kot oporo.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: Which one is G7, the one with more tension?
rows.translation: Kateri primer je G7, tisti z več napetosti?
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: C, A minor, F, G7 and G cover hundreds of songs. Make each shape clean, then keep the beat as you change.
rows.translation: C, A-mol, F, G7 in G pokrijejo stotine pesmi. Vsak prijem naj bo čist, nato med menjavami ohrani ritem.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: Which chord uses only one finger?
