rows.translation: Kateri akord uporablja samo en prst?
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: Steady downs, down-ups and the island strum.
rows.translation: Enakomerni potegi navzdol, dol-gor in otoški vzorec.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: Strum down on every beat: 1, 2, 3, 4. Use the nail of your index finger. When you change chords, your hand keeps moving.
rows.translation: Na vsako dobo potegni navzdol: 1, 2, 3, 4. Uporabi noht kazalca. Med menjavo akordov se roka še naprej giblje.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: What should your hand do while you change chords?
rows.translation: Kaj naj roka počne med menjavo akordov?
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: A late chord is better than a broken beat. Keep strumming, even if a string buzzes.
rows.translation: Pozen akord je boljši kot prekinjen ritem. Poteguj naprej, tudi če struna brenči.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: Count 1 and 2 and 3 and 4 and. Strum down on the numbers, up on each and. Your hand never stops moving.
rows.translation: Štej 1 in 2 in 3 in 4 in. Na številke potegni navzdol, na vsak »in« navzgor. Roka se nikoli ne ustavi.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: Up strums mostly catch strings 1 and 2. Brush them with the pad of your finger, a little softer than the downs.
rows.translation: Potegi navzgor večinoma ujamejo struni 1 in 2. Z blazinico prsta potegni po njiju malo nežneje kot navzdol.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: Only at the end of a bar
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: Down on 1, down-up on 2, down on 3, down-up on 4. Your hand still swings up after 1 and 3; it just misses the strings.
rows.translation: Dol na 1, dol-gor na 2, dol na 3, dol-gor na 4. Roka po 1 in 3 še vedno zaniha navzgor, le strun se ne dotakne.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: What does your hand do on the and of 1?
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: A silent up stroke keeps your hand in time for the next down.
rows.translation: Tihi zamah navzgor ohrani roko v ritmu za naslednji poteg navzdol.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: Down on 1, down-up on 2, skip the down on 3, then up, down-up. The missing down gives it a lilt.
rows.translation: Dol na 1, dol-gor na 2, izpusti dol na 3, nato gor, dol-gor. Manjkajoči poteg navzdol da vzorcu zibanje.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: Which strum do you skip in the island strum?
rows.translation: Kateri poteg izpustiš v otoškem vzorcu?
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: Your hand still moves down on 3, it just misses the strings. That keeps the up after it in time.
rows.translation: Roka se na 3 še vedno premakne navzdol, le strune zgreši. Tako naslednji poteg navzgor ostane v ritmu.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: The last up strum of a bar can be loose or open. Use it to move to the next chord, so beat 1 lands clean.
rows.translation: Zadnji poteg navzgor v taktu je lahko sproščen ali po praznih strunah. Izkoristi ga za premik v naslednji akord, da doba 1 zazveni čisto.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: Downs, down-ups and the island strum. Keep your hand moving and let the chords come to you.
rows.translation: Potegi navzdol, dol-gor in otoški vzorec. Roka naj se giblje, akordi pa naj pridejo k tebi.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: Which pattern is the island strum?
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: Play tunes note by note on strings 1 to 3.
rows.translation: Melodije igraj ton za tonom na strunah 1 do 3.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: C D E F G A B C. Start on open string 3 and climb across strings 2 and 1. Every note sits in the first three frets.
rows.translation: C D E F G A B C. Začni na prazni struni 3 in se vzpenjaj prek strun 2 in 1. Vsi toni so pri prvih treh prečkah.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: String 3 open and fret 2, then string 2 open and fret 1.
rows.translation: Struna 3 prazna in pri prečki 2, nato struna 2 prazna in pri prečki 1.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: String 2 fret 3, then string 1: open, fret 2, fret 3.
rows.translation: Struna 2, prečka 3, nato struna 1: prazna, prečka 2, prečka 3.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: How many different note names are in the scale?
rows.translation: Koliko različnih imen tonov ima lestvica?
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: C to C is eight notes, but the top C repeats the first. Seven names, then they start again.
rows.translation: Od C do C je osem tonov, a zgornji C ponovi prvega. Sedem imen, nato se začnejo znova.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: Beethoven wrote this tune in 1824. It moves mostly by step, from one note to the next, on strings 2 and 3.
rows.translation: Beethoven je to melodijo napisal leta 1824. Večinoma se premika po korakih, iz tona v naslednji ton, na strunah 2 in 3.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: The opening: E E F G, G F E D.
rows.translation: Začetek: E E F G, G F E D.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: The first line ends on D. Where does the second line end?
rows.translation: Prva vrstica se konča na D. Kje se konča druga?
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: Same start, different finish. The second line comes home to C.
rows.translation: Isti začetek, drugačen konec. Druga vrstica se vrne domov na C.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: This traditional tune leaps from C up to G, then walks back down one note at a time. Every line ends on a longer note.
rows.translation: Ta tradicionalna melodija skoči iz C navzgor v G, nato se vrača navzdol ton za tonom. Vsaka vrstica se konča z daljšim tonom.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: Open string 3, string 2 fret 3, open string 1.
rows.translation: Prazna struna 3, struna 2 pri prečki 3, prazna struna 1.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: Does this phrase go up or down?
rows.translation: Gre ta fraza navzgor ali navzdol?
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: A quarter note lasts one beat, a half note two, a whole note four. Hold each one until the next note starts.
rows.translation: Četrtinka traja eno dobo, polovinka dve, celinka štiri. Vsak ton drži do začetka naslednjega.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: A dot adds half the note's length. A dotted half note lasts three beats; a dotted quarter lasts one and a half.
rows.translation: Pika doda polovico trajanja note. Polovinka s piko traja tri dobe, četrtinka s piko pa eno in pol.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: How many beats does a dotted half note last?
rows.translation: Koliko dob traja polovinka s piko?
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: "Aura Lee" was published in 1861, with music by George R. Poulton. Play it slowly and let each note ring into the next.
rows.translation: »Aura Lee« je izšla leta 1861, z glasbo Georgea R. Poultona. Igraj jo počasi in pusti vsak ton zveneti v naslednjega.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: Fret 2 on string 2 is F sharp, one fret above F. A sharp raises a note by one fret.
rows.translation: Prečka 2 na struni 2 je F z višajem, eno prečko nad F. Višaj zviša ton za eno prečko.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: A sharp sign raises a note by how much?
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: Watch the note highway and keep your place, even if you miss a note. The beat goes on, so you do too.
rows.translation: Spremljaj pot not in ohrani svoje mesto, tudi če kak ton zgrešiš. Ritem gre naprej, zato pojdi tudi ti.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: Where is F sharp on string 2?
rows.translation: Kje je F z višajem na struni 2?
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: D minor, E minor, D, A and E7, then the four-chord song.
rows.translation: D-mol, E-mol, D, A in E7, nato pesem s štirimi akordi.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.translation: Dm: F in še en prst
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: Second finger on fret 2 of string 4, third on fret 2 of string 3, first on fret 1 of string 2. String 1 rings open.
rows.translation: Drugi prst pri prečki 2 na struni 4, tretji pri prečki 2 na struni 3, prvi pri prečki 1 na struni 2. Struna 1 zveni prazna.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: Which chord is D minor closest to?
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: D minor is F with one more finger, on fret 2 of string 3.
rows.translation: D-mol je F z dodatnim prstom pri prečki 2 na struni 3.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: First finger on fret 2 of string 1, second on fret 3 of string 2, third on fret 4 of string 3. String 4 rings open.
rows.translation: Prvi prst pri prečki 2 na struni 1, drugi pri prečki 3 na struni 2, tretji pri prečki 4 na struni 3. Struna 4 zveni prazna.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: E minor and G both leave which string open?
rows.translation: Katero struno pustita prazno tako E-mol kot G?
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: Put fingers 1, 2 and 3 side by side on fret 2 of strings 4, 3 and 2. String 1 rings open.
rows.translation: Prste 1, 2 in 3 postavi drug ob drugem pri prečki 2 na strunah 4, 3 in 2. Struna 1 zveni prazna.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: Second finger on fret 2 of string 4, first finger on fret 1 of string 3. Strings 2 and 1 ring open.
rows.translation: Drugi prst pri prečki 2 na struni 4, prvi prst pri prečki 1 na struni 3. Struni 2 in 1 zvenita prazni.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: Which chord has three fingers on the same fret?
rows.translation: Kateri akord ima tri prste pri isti prečki?
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: First finger on fret 1 of string 4, second on fret 2 of string 3, third on fret 2 of string 1. String 2 rings open.
rows.translation: Prvi prst pri prečki 1 na struni 4, drugi pri prečki 2 na struni 3, tretji pri prečki 2 na struni 1. Struna 2 zveni prazna.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: G7 pulls toward C. In the same way, E7 pulls toward A minor. Play them back to back and listen for the release.
rows.translation: G7 vleče proti C. Enako E7 vleče proti A-molu. Zaigraj ju zapored in prisluhni razrešitvi.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: Number the notes of the C scale and you can name chords by number: C is I, G is V, A minor is vi, F is IV. This order runs through countless songs.
rows.translation: Oštevilči tone C-durove lestvice in akorde lahko imenuješ po številkah: C je I, G je V, A-mol je vi, F je IV. To zaporedje najdeš v neštetih pesmih.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: In the key of C, which chord is IV?
rows.translation: Kateri akord je IV v tonaliteti C?
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: Count up the scale from C: C, D, E, F. F is the fourth note, so F is the IV chord.
rows.translation: Štej po lestvici od C: C, D, E, F. F je četrti ton, zato je F akord IV.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: Which chord is vi in C?
rows.translation: Kateri akord je vi v C?
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: Lowercase numbers mean minor chords. The sixth note of C major is A.
rows.translation: Rimske številke z malimi črkami pomenijo molove akorde. Šesti ton C-dura je A.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: C, A minor, F, G, G7, D minor, E minor, D, A and E7. Clean shapes first, then steady strums.
rows.translation: C, A-mol, F, G, G7, D-mol, E-mol, D, A in E7. Najprej čisti prijemi, nato enakomerni potegi.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: In the key of C, which chord is V?
rows.translation: Kateri akord je V v tonaliteti C?
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: Four public-domain songs with melody and chords.
rows.translation: Štiri pesmi v javni domeni z melodijo in akordi.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: Stephen Foster wrote this song in 1848. It counts in two: 1 and 2 and. Most notes are quick eighth notes.
rows.translation: Stephen Foster je to pesem napisal leta 1848. Štejemo v dvoje: 1 in 2 in. Večina not so hitre osminke.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: The opening: C D E G, G A G E.
rows.translation: Začetek: C D E G, G A G E.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: Another Foster song, from 1850. The melody bounces between G and E, and a short two-note call answers each line.
rows.translation: Še ena Fosterjeva pesem, iz leta 1850. Melodija poskakuje med G in E, kratek dvotonski klic pa odgovarja na vsako vrstico.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: G G E G A G E.
rows.translation: G G E G A G E.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: Like most songs in C, it comes home to C.
rows.translation: Kot večina pesmi v C se vrne domov na C.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: Count 1 2 3, 1 2 3, with the weight on 1. This is waltz time. "Clementine", first printed in 1884, sways in three.
rows.translation: Štej 1 2 3, 1 2 3 s poudarkom na 1. To je valčkov takt. »Clementine«, prvič natisnjena leta 1884, se ziblje v troje.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: String 2 fret 1, open 3, open 1, then string 1 frets 3 and 1.
rows.translation: Struna 2, prečka 1, prazna 3, prazna 1, nato struna 1 pri prečkah 3 in 1.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: First finger on fret 1 of string 1. With F, it carries the whole song.
rows.translation: Prvi prst pri prečki 1 na struni 1. Skupaj s F nosi celo pesem.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: This traditional tune was in print by 1896. Each line ends on a long note, so count it out before the next one.
rows.translation: Ta tradicionalna melodija je bila natisnjena najpozneje leta 1896. Vsaka vrstica se konča z dolgim tonom; odštej ga do konca pred naslednjim.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: Open 3, string 2 fret 1, open 1, string 2 fret 3, string 1 frets 1 and 3.
rows.translation: Prazna 3, struna 2 pri prečki 1, prazna 1, struna 2 pri prečki 3, struna 1 pri prečkah 1 in 3.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: The last line starts D, C sharp, C. How do those notes move?
rows.translation: Zadnja vrstica se začne D, C z višajem, C. Kako se ti toni premikajo?
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: Down one fret at a time
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: Each note is one fret lower on string 3: fret 2, fret 1, open.
rows.translation: Vsak ton je eno prečko nižje na struni 3: prečka 2, prečka 1, prazna.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: When you strum a song, the melody lives in your head or in a friend's voice. Change chords where the tune leans, and keep the strum steady.
rows.translation: Ko pesem igraš s potegi, melodija živi v tvoji glavi ali prijateljevem glasu. Akorde menjaj tam, kjer se melodija nagne, potegi pa naj bodo enakomerni.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: A song in F usually ends on which chord?
rows.translation: Na katerem akordu se običajno konča pesem v F?
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: Songs come home to their key chord. In F, that's F.
rows.translation: Pesmi se vrnejo domov k akordu svoje tonalitete. V F je to F.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: Four songs, a handful of chords and three strums. Play them like a small concert: count in, keep going, finish strong.
rows.translation: Štiri pesmi, peščica akordov in trije vzorci potegov. Igraj jih kot majhen koncert: odštej začetek, nadaljuj in odločno končaj.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: B flat, D7, B minor and G minor, the keys of G, F and D, and moving a song to any key.
rows.translation: B z nižajem, D7, B-mol in G-mol, tonalitete G, F in D ter prenos pesmi v katerokoli tonaliteto.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: Lay finger 1 across strings 2 and 1 at fret 1. Finger 2 goes on string 3, fret 2, and finger 3 on string 4, fret 3.
rows.translation: Prst 1 položi čez struni 2 in 1 pri prečki 1. Prst 2 gre na struno 3 pri prečki 2, prst 3 pa na struno 4 pri prečki 3.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: Which chord shares finger 1's spot on string 2 with B flat?
rows.translation: Kateri akord ima prst 1 na struni 2 na istem mestu kot B z nižajem?
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: F also puts finger 1 on string 2, fret 1. Keep it there as you change.
rows.translation: Tudi F postavi prst 1 na struno 2 pri prečki 1. Med menjavo ga pusti tam.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: D7 and the key of G
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: D7: a barre and one finger
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: Lay finger 1 across strings 4, 3 and 2 at fret 2, and put finger 2 on string 1, fret 3.
rows.translation: Prst 1 položi čez strune 4, 3 in 2 pri prečki 2, prst 2 pa na struno 1 pri prečki 3.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: In G, the chords G, C and D7 do most of the work, with E minor for a darker color. D7 pulls back to G the way G7 pulls to C.
rows.translation: V G večino dela opravijo G, C in D7, E-mol pa doda temnejšo barvo. D7 vleče nazaj v G, kot G7 vleče v C.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: B minor and the key of D
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: Lay finger 1 across strings 3, 2 and 1 at fret 2, then reach finger 3 to string 4, fret 4.
rows.translation: Prst 1 položi čez strune 3, 2 in 1 pri prečki 2, nato s prstom 3 sezi do strune 4 pri prečki 4.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: D and B minor both press fret 2 on which strings?
rows.translation: Na katerih strunah D in B-mol oba pritiskata pri prečki 2?
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: Both chords hold fret 2 on strings 3 and 2. Only the outer strings change.
rows.translation: Oba akorda držita prečko 2 na strunah 3 in 2. Spremenita se le zunanji struni.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: In D, the chords D, G and A7 carry the song, and B minor adds a sad one. A7 is a single finger: string 3, fret 1.
rows.translation: V D pesem nosijo akordi D, G in A7, B-mol pa doda žalosten akord. A7 potrebuje en prst: struna 3, prečka 1.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: A song's chords are steps of its key: I, IV and V. Change key and the numbers stay. In C that's C, F and G7; in G, it's G, C and D7; in F, F, B flat and C7.
rows.translation: Akordi pesmi so stopnje njene tonalitete: I, IV in V. Zamenjaj tonaliteto in številke ostanejo. V C so to C, F in G7; v G so G, C in D7; v F pa F, B z nižajem in C7.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: In the key of F, which chord is IV?
rows.translation: Kateri akord je IV v tonaliteti F?
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: Count up from F: F, G, A, B flat. The fourth note is B flat.
rows.translation: Štej od F navzgor: F, G, A, B z nižajem. Četrti ton je B z nižajem.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: If a song sits too high or too low to sing, move it to another key. Same numbers, same song, just a better fit for the voice.
rows.translation: Če je pesem za petje previsoka ali prenizka, jo prestavi v drugo tonaliteto. Iste številke, ista pesem, le bolje prilagojena glasu.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: In the key of D, which chord is V?
rows.translation: Kateri akord je V v tonaliteti D?
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: Count up from D: D, E, F sharp, G, A. A is the fifth note, so A7 is the V chord.
rows.translation: Štej od D navzgor: D, E, F z višajem, G, A. A je peti ton, zato je A7 akord V.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: Finger 2 on string 3, fret 2, finger 3 on string 2, fret 3, and finger 1 on string 1, fret 1. String 4 rings open.
rows.translation: Prst 2 na struno 3 pri prečki 2, prst 3 na struno 2 pri prečki 3, prst 1 pa na struno 1 pri prečki 1. Struna 4 zveni prazna.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: D minor's family is D minor, G minor and A7. A7 pulls home to D minor, the way E7 pulls to A minor.
rows.translation: Družino D-mola sestavljajo D-mol, G-mol in A7. A7 vleče domov v D-mol, kot E7 vleče v A-mol.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: No new ideas: B flat, D7, B minor and G minor, and the keys of C, G, F and D. Clean shapes first, then a steady strum.
rows.translation: Brez novosti: B z nižajem, D7, B-mol in G-mol ter tonalitete C, G, F in D. Najprej čisti prijemi, nato enakomeren poteg.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: In the key of G, which chord is V?
rows.translation: Kateri akord je V v tonaliteti G?
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: The chunk, the island strum with a backbeat, swing and the ragtime chords, accents in 3-3-2, and the waltz.
rows.translation: Dušeni udarec, otoški vzorec s poudarkom na šibkih dobah, swing in ragtime akordi, poudarki 3-3-2 ter valček.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: A chunk is a strum that stops dead. Strum down and let the side of your palm land on the strings at the same moment: a short, dry click, like a snare drum.
rows.translation: Dušeni udarec je poteg, ki se takoj ustavi. Potegni navzdol in hkrati nasloni rob dlani na strune: kratek, suh klik, kot mali boben.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: Strum down on 1, chunk on 2, down-up on 3, chunk on 4. The chunks fall where a drummer hits the snare.
rows.translation: Potegni navzdol na 1, dušeno udari na 2, dol-gor na 3 in dušeno na 4. Dušeni udarci padejo tja, kjer bobnar udari mali boben.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: Two and four are the backbeat, where the snare drum plays. A chunk there gives the strum a drummer's punch.
rows.translation: Dve in štiri sta poudarjeni šibki dobi, kjer igra mali boben. Dušeni udarec tam da potegom bobnarsko udarnost.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: Swap one down for a chunk
rows.translation: En poteg navzdol zamenjaj z dušenim
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: Take the island strum, D, DU, UDU, and turn the down on 2 into a chunk. The rhythm stays the same; the groove gets a backbeat.
rows.translation: Vzemi otoški vzorec D, DU, UDU in poteg navzdol na 2 spremeni v dušeni udarec. Ritem ostane isti, dobi pa poudarek na šibki dobi.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: In this strum, which stroke becomes the chunk?
rows.translation: Kateri poteg v tem vzorcu postane dušeni udarec?
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: Beat 1 rings out, beat 2 clicks. Everything else stays where the island strum had it.
rows.translation: Doba 1 zveni, doba 2 klikne. Vse drugo ostane tam, kjer je bilo v otoškem vzorcu.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: Swing splits each beat unevenly: a long down, then a short up. Say hum-pty, dum-pty as you strum. It's the bounce of old ukulele tunes.
rows.translation: Swing vsako dobo razdeli neenakomerno: dolg poteg navzdol, nato kratek navzgor. Med potegi izgovarjaj dum-da, dum-da. To je zibanje starih melodij za ukulele.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: C, A7, D7, G7, then home to C. Each seventh chord pulls to the next, a little chain of tension. It powered countless songs a century ago.
rows.translation: C, A7, D7, G7, nato domov v C. Vsak septakord vleče k naslednjemu, majhna veriga napetosti. Pred stoletjem je poganjala nešteto pesmi.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: Which chord does D7 pull toward here?
rows.translation: Proti kateremu akordu tukaj vleče D7?
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: D7 leads to G, and G7 leads home to C. Each chord sets up the next.
rows.translation: D7 vodi v G, G7 pa domov v C. Vsak akord pripravi naslednjega.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: Strum steady down-up eighths, but hit three of them harder: 1, the and of 2, and 4. The accents fall 3, 3 and 2 eighths apart.
rows.translation: Igraj enakomerne osminke dol-gor, a tri udari močneje: 1, »in« po 2 in 4. Med poudarki je 3, 3 in 2 osminki.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: Count 1 2 3, 1 2 3, 1 2 across the bar's eight eighths. Each 1 is an accent.
rows.translation: Čez osem osmink takta štej 1 2 3, 1 2 3, 1 2. Vsaka 1 je poudarek.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: George Formby's split stroke on the banjo ukulele puts its big strums in the same three places, with single strings in between. Master the accents first.
rows.translation: Deljeni poteg Georgea Formbyja na banjo ukulele postavi močne potege na ista tri mesta, vmes pa posamezne strune. Najprej osvoji poudarke.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: In three, strum down on 1, then down-up on 2 and on 3: D, DU, DU. Lean on 1 so the sway is clear.
rows.translation: V tridobnem taktu potegni dol na 1, nato dol-gor na 2 in na 3: D, DU, DU. Poudari 1, da bo zibanje jasno.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: How many strums fill this bar of three?
rows.translation: Koliko potegov zapolni ta tridobni takt?
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: Down on 1, then down-up on 2 and on 3: one plus two plus two.
rows.translation: Dol na 1, nato dol-gor na 2 in na 3: ena plus dve plus dve.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: No new ideas: chunks, the island strum with a chunk, swing, the 3-3-2 accents and the waltz. Keep the hand moving and let the accents speak.
rows.translation: Brez novosti: dušeni udarci, otoški vzorec z dušenim udarcem, swing, poudarki 3-3-2 in valček. Roka naj se giblje in poudarki naj govorijo.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: In a swing strum, each beat splits into…
rows.translation: Pri swingovskem potegu se vsaka doba razdeli na…
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.translation: Ubiranje s prsti in akordna melodija
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: One finger per string, rolling patterns, the alternating thumb, and a tune picked from inside its chords.
rows.translation: En prst na struno, tekoči vzorci, izmenični palec in melodija, ubrana iz svojih akordov.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: Rest your thumb on string 4, index on string 3, middle on string 2 and ring finger on string 1. Each one plucks only its own string.
rows.translation: Palec nasloni na struno 4, kazalec na struno 3, sredinec na struno 2 in prstanec na struno 1. Vsak ubira le svojo struno.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: Thumb, index, middle, ring: strings 4, 3, 2 and 1.
rows.translation: Palec, kazalec, sredinec, prstanec: strune 4, 3, 2 in 1.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: Thumb on 4, index on 3, middle on 2, ring on 1: one finger per string.
rows.translation: Palec na 4, kazalec na 3, sredinec na 2, prstanec na 1: en prst na struno.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: Because string 4 is a high G, the pattern zigzags: high, low, then climbing. That sparkle is the sound of fingerpicked ukulele.
rows.translation: Ker je struna 4 visoki G, gre vzorec cikcak: visoko, nizko, nato navzgor. Ta lesk je zvok ukulele, ubrane s prsti.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: A minor, F, C, G7, in eighths
rows.translation: A-mol, F, C, G7 v osminkah
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: Pluck strings 4, 3, 2 and 1, then come back on 2 and 3: thumb, index, middle, ring, middle, index. Six notes fill a bar of three.
rows.translation: Uberi strune 4, 3, 2 in 1, nato se vrni po 2 in 3: palec, kazalec, sredinec, prstanec, sredinec, kazalec. Šest tonov zapolni tridobni takt.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: After the ring finger plucks string 1, which finger comes next?
rows.translation: Kateri prst sledi, ko prstanec ubere struno 1?
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: The roll turns around at the top: ring on string 1, then middle on 2 and index on 3.
rows.translation: Vzorec se na vrhu obrne: prstanec na struni 1, nato sredinec na 2 in kazalec na 3.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: Land the new chord as the thumb starts the next bar. The fingers keep rolling; only the shape under them changes.
rows.translation: Novi akord postavi, ko palec začne naslednji takt. Prsti še naprej tekoče ubirajo; spremeni se le prijem pod njimi.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: C, A minor, D minor, G7
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: Now the thumb rocks between strings 3 and 4 on the beats while your fingers pluck strings 2 and 1 in between. It's the ukulele's version of Travis picking.
rows.translation: Zdaj palec na dobe izmenjuje struni 3 in 4, drugi prsti pa vmes ubirajo struni 2 in 1. To je različica Travisovega ubiranja za ukulele.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: In this pattern, what does the thumb do?
rows.translation: Kaj v tem vzorcu počne palec?
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: The thumb keeps the pulse, a note on every beat, while the fingers fill the gaps.
rows.translation: Palec drži utrip, po en ton na vsako dobo, drugi prsti pa zapolnijo vrzeli.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: Hold the chord, pick the tune
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: In chord melody, your fretting hand holds the chord and you pick the tune from inside it. Hold F, and C, F and A are already under your fingers.
rows.translation: Pri akordni melodiji roka na vratu drži akord, ti pa iz njega ubiraš melodijo. Drži F in C, F ter A so že pod tvojimi prsti.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: Hold F: open string 3, string 2 at fret 1, open string 1. That's how Amazing Grace begins.
rows.translation: Drži F: prazna struna 3, struna 2 pri prečki 1, prazna struna 1. Tako se začne Amazing Grace.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: When the tune leaves the chord, reach with a free finger. Over F, finger 3 takes G on string 2, fret 3, then lifts as the tune comes back.
rows.translation: Ko melodija zapusti akord, sezi s prostim prstom. Ob F prst 3 zaigra G na struni 2 pri prečki 3, nato se dvigne, ko se melodija vrne.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: Over B flat, where is the tune's D?
rows.translation: Kje je D iz melodije ob akordu B z nižajem?
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: B flat's finger 2 already holds D on string 3, fret 2. The tune walks right through the chord.
rows.translation: Pri B z nižajem prst 2 že drži D na struni 3 pri prečki 2. Melodija gre naravnost skozi akord.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: Rolled chords between the verses and the melody inside the chords. The tune is the hymn New Britain, printed in 1829, with John Newton's words.
rows.translation: Tekoče ubrani akordi med kiticami in melodija znotraj akordov. Melodija je himna New Britain, natisnjena leta 1829, z besedilom Johna Newtona.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: Why does the intro's last bar end on a long note?
rows.translation: Zakaj se zadnji takt uvoda konča z dolgim tonom?
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: To leave room for the pickup
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: The verse starts a beat early, on its pickup. A long last note keeps that beat clear.
rows.translation: Kitica se začne dobo prej, s predtaktom. Dolg zadnji ton pusti to dobo prosto.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: No new ideas: one finger per string, the out-and-back roll, the alternating thumb and the melody inside the chord.
rows.translation: Brez novosti: en prst na struno, tekoči vzorec naprej in nazaj, izmenični palec in melodija znotraj akorda.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: Thumb, index, middle, ring play which strings?
rows.translation: Katere strune igrajo palec, kazalec, sredinec in prstanec?
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: Four public-domain songs arranged for ukulele, and how to lead a room through them.
rows.translation: Štiri pesmi v javni domeni, prirejene za ukulele, in kako skozi njih voditi zbrano družbo.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: Down by the Riverside, first printed in 1918, is made for singing together. On ukulele it sits in G, with G, C and D7, and a gospel A sharp on string 1, fret 1.
rows.translation: Down by the Riverside, prvič natisnjena leta 1918, je ustvarjena za skupno petje. Na ukulele je v G, z G, C in D7 ter gospelovskim A z višajem na struni 1 pri prečki 1.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: Down by the riverside: B, B, A sharp, B, then A and G.
rows.translation: Down by the riverside: B, B, A z višajem, B, nato A in G.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: Cecil Sharp printed this English ballad in 1906. In F it uses F, B flat, C and C7, G minor and D minor, often two to a bar. Pick the chords between verses and let them ring.
rows.translation: Cecil Sharp je to angleško balado natisnil leta 1906. V F uporablja F, B z nižajem, C in C7, G-mol in D-mol, pogosto dva na takt. Med kiticami ubiraj akorde in jih pusti zveneti.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: The water is wide: open string 3, F at fret 1 twice, G at fret 3, then open A.
rows.translation: The water is wide: prazna struna 3, dvakrat F pri prečki 1, G pri prečki 3, nato prazni A.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: Many bars here change halfway. Count the verse in two-beat halves, one chord each, and change on every other click.
rows.translation: Številni takti se tukaj zamenjajo na polovici. Kitico štej v dvodobnih polovicah, po en akord na vsako, in menjaj na vsak drugi klik.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: Before the first strum, count out loud at the song's tempo: one, two, three, four. Everyone starts together, at the speed you set.
rows.translation: Pred prvim potegom glasno odštej v tempu pesmi: ena, dve, tri, štiri. Vsi začnejo skupaj, s hitrostjo, ki jo določiš.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: Miss a chord? Keep strumming and catch the next one. A singing room follows the beat, not every note.
rows.translation: Zgrešiš akord? Poteguj naprej in ujemi naslednjega. Pojoča družba sledi ritmu, ne vsakemu tonu.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: You fumble a change mid-song. What now?
rows.translation: Sredi pesmi se zaplete pri menjavi. Kaj zdaj?
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: Keep strumming and catch the next chord
rows.translation: Poteguj naprej in ujemi naslednji akord
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: The beat carries everyone. Drop a chord if you must, never the rhythm.
rows.translation: Ritem nosi vse. Če moraš, izpusti akord, nikoli ritma.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: Before the last line, nod or call out last time. Slow the final line a touch and let the last chord ring.
rows.translation: Pred zadnjo vrstico prikimaj ali zakliči »zadnjič«. Zadnjo vrstico malo upočasni in pusti zadnji akord zveneti.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: Molly Malone was printed in 1876. It's a waltz: lean on beat 1 and let the tune sway. In F it uses F, G minor, C7, D minor and G7.
rows.translation: Molly Malone je bila natisnjena leta 1876. Je valček: poudari dobo 1 in pusti melodiji, da se ziblje. V F uporablja F, G-mol, C7, D-mol in G7.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: In Dublin's fair city: open string 3, F at fret 1 four times, open A, back to F.
rows.translation: In Dublin's fair city: prazna struna 3, štirikrat F pri prečki 1, prazni A, nazaj na F.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: Which chord pulls hardest back to F?
rows.translation: Kateri akord najmočneje vleče nazaj proti F?
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: C7 is the V chord in F. Its seventh leans straight back home.
rows.translation: C7 je akord V v F. Njegova septima teži naravnost domov.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: This rowing song is in six-eight: six quick counts to a bar, felt as two big sways. Count 1 2 3, 4 5 6, and lean on 1 and 4.
rows.translation: Ta veslaška pesem je v šestosminskem taktu: šest hitrih štetij na takt, ki jih občutiš kot dva velika zamaha. Štej 1 2 3, 4 5 6 in poudari 1 ter 4.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: In six-eight, where do the big beats fall?
rows.translation: Kam v šestosminskem taktu padeta veliki dobi?
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: Six eighths group in two threes: 1 2 3, 4 5 6. The first of each three carries the sway.
rows.translation: Šest osmink se združi v dve trojici: 1 2 3, 4 5 6. Prva v vsaki trojici nosi zamah.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: No new ideas: four songs, counted in, kept going and finished clean. Play them back to back like a short concert.
rows.translation: Brez novosti: štiri pesmi, jasen začetek, tekoča igra in čist konec. Zaigraj jih zapored kot kratek koncert.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: From open strings to walking lines and grooves
rows.translation: Od praznih strun do hodečega basa in ritmičnih vzorcev
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: Meet E A D G, pluck with two fingers, play your first notes and a song.
rows.translation: Spoznaj E A D G, ubiraj z dvema prstoma, zaigraj prve tone in pesem.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: The thickest string is the lowest. It sits nearest your face when you play. We call it string 4.
rows.translation: Najdebelejša struna zveni najnižje. Med igranjem je najbližje tvojemu obrazu. Imenujemo jo struna 4.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: Strings count from the thinnest (1) to the thickest (4).
rows.translation: Strune štejemo od najtanjše (1) do najdebelejše (4).
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: From thick to thin: E, A, D, G. They match the four lowest guitar strings, an octave down. Try: Every Amp Drives Grooves.
rows.translation: Od debele do tanke: E, A, D, G. Ujemajo se s štirimi najnižjimi kitarskimi strunami, oktavo nižje. Za pomnjenje: Eva aranžira dobro glasbo.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: Pluck with the pads of your index and middle fingers, taking turns. Rest your thumb on the pickup or on string 4.
rows.translation: Izmenično ubiraj z blazinicama kazalca in sredinca. Palec nasloni na magnetni odjemnik ali na struno 4.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: Pluck across the string, not up and away. Your finger comes to rest on the next thicker string. This rest stroke sounds full and strong.
rows.translation: Ubiraj čez struno, ne navzgor in stran. Prst se ustavi na naslednji debelejši struni. Tak udarec z naslonom zveni polno in močno.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: Where does your finger stop after a rest stroke?
rows.translation: Kje se prst ustavi po udarcu z naslonom?
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: In the air above the strings
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: Pulling through to the next string keeps the motion small and the tone strong.
rows.translation: Poteg do naslednje strune ohrani gib majhen, ton pa močan.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: Open E, fret 3, open A, fret 3.
rows.translation: Prazni E, prečka 3, prazni A, prečka 3.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: Open strings, two-finger plucking and your first fretted notes. Keep your fingers taking turns and let each note ring.
rows.translation: Prazne strune, ubiranje z dvema prstoma in prvi prijeti toni. Prsta izmenjuj in pusti, da vsak ton zazveni.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: Which one is the open E string?
rows.translation: Kateri primer je prazna struna E?
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: Mary Had a Little Lamb needs three notes: B at fret 2 on string 3, open A, and G at fret 3 on string 4. Second finger for B, third for G.
rows.translation: Za Mary Had a Little Lamb potrebuješ tri tone: B pri prečki 2 na struni 3, prazni A in G pri prečki 3 na struni 4. Za B uporabi drugi prst, za G tretjega.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: String 3, fret 2, second finger. That's B.
rows.translation: Struna 3, prečka 2, drugi prst. To je B.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: B A G A B B B: string 3, then G on string 4.
rows.translation: B A G A B B B: struna 3, nato G na struni 4.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: Play the root of each chord and lock in with the beat.
rows.translation: Igraj osnovni ton vsakega akorda in se ujemi z dobo.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: Every chord is built on one note, its root. The root of an A chord is A. Bass players play roots so the band knows where home is.
rows.translation: Vsak akord temelji na enem tonu, svojem osnovnem tonu. Osnovni ton akorda A je A. Basisti igrajo osnovne tone, da skupina ve, kje je doma.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: What is the root of a D chord?
rows.translation: Kateri je osnovni ton akorda D?
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: Root or not? Listen to the lowest note.
rows.translation: Osnovni ton ali ne? Poslušaj najnižji ton.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: Roots of A, D and E: all open strings.
rows.translation: Osnovni toni akordov A, D in E: same prazne strune.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: Roots of A, D and E
rows.translation: Osnovni toni akordov A, D in E
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: Bass and kick drum land together. Aim for the exact moment of the click, not just near it. Timbre shows if you're early or late.
rows.translation: Bas in basovski boben zazvenita skupaj. Meri na točen trenutek klika, ne le blizu njega. Timbre pokaže, ali igraš prezgodaj ali prepozno.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: You keep landing a little after the click. What helps?
rows.translation: Vedno zaigraš malo za klikom. Kaj pomaga?
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: Feel the beat coming and pluck a touch earlier
rows.translation: Začuti prihajajočo dobo in uberi malce prej
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: Your finger needs a moment to move. Start the pluck slightly earlier so the note speaks right on the beat.
rows.translation: Prst potrebuje trenutek za premik. Gib začni malo prej, da ton zazveni točno na dobo.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: A rest is a beat of silence. Stop the string by touching it lightly with a free finger, so the rest is as clean as the note.
rows.translation: Pavza je doba tišine. Struno ustavi z rahlim dotikom prostega prsta, da bo pavza tako čista kot ton.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: How do you stop a ringing string?
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: Touch it lightly with a free finger
rows.translation: Rahlo se je dotakni s prostim prstom
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: Muting is half of bass playing. Rest a finger lightly on the string to silence it.
rows.translation: Dušenje je polovica igranja basa. Prst narahlo položi na struno, da jo utišaš.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: A chord chart tells you which chord is coming. Play its root on every beat until the chart changes.
rows.translation: Akordni zapis pove, kateri akord prihaja. Njegov osnovni ton igraj na vsako dobo, dokler se akord ne zamenja.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: G on string 4 fret 3, C on string 3 fret 3, then open D.
rows.translation: G na struni 4 pri prečki 3, C na struni 3 pri prečki 3, nato prazni D.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: The chart says C. Which note do you play?
rows.translation: V zapisu je C. Kateri ton igraš?
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: Roots on the beat, clean rests and changes right on time. Keep your plucking fingers taking turns the whole way.
rows.translation: Osnovni toni na dobo, čiste pavze in pravočasne menjave. Prsta za ubiranje izmenjuj od začetka do konca.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: What is the root of an E chord?
rows.translation: Kateri je osnovni ton akorda E?
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: Every note from fret 0 to 5 on strings 4 and 3, and the major scale shape.
rows.translation: Vsi toni od prečke 0 do 5 na strunah 4 in 3 ter prijem durove lestvice.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: E to A on one string
rows.translation: Od E do A na eni struni
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: On string 4, each fret is one note higher: E, F, F sharp, G, G sharp, then A at fret 5. Fret 5 sounds the same as open string 3.
rows.translation: Na struni 4 je vsaka prečka za en ton višje: E, F, F z višajem, G, G z višajem in nato A pri prečki 5. Prečka 5 zveni enako kot prazna struna 3.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: Which fret on string 4 matches open string 3?
rows.translation: Katera prečka na struni 4 se ujema s prazno struno 3?
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: Both are A. Each string is tuned to fret 5 of the string below it.
rows.translation: Oba tona sta A. Vsaka struna je uglašena na ton pri prečki 5 nižje strune.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.translation: Od A do D na struni 3
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: String 3 works the same way: A, B flat, B, C, C sharp, then D at fret 5. Fret 5 matches open string 2.
rows.translation: Struna 3 deluje enako: A, B z nižajem, B, C, C z višajem in nato D pri prečki 5. Prečka 5 se ujema s prazno struno 2.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.translation: Kateri ton je pri prečki 3 na struni 3?
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: A on fret 5 of string 4 sounds the same as open string 3. Open strings ring longer; fretted notes are easier to stop and shape.
rows.translation: A pri prečki 5 na struni 4 zveni enako kot prazna struna 3. Prazne strune zvenijo dlje; prijete tone lažje ustaviš in oblikuješ.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: Fret 5 on string 4, then open string 3.
rows.translation: Prečka 5 na struni 4, nato prazna struna 3.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: Fret 5 on string 3, then open string 2.
rows.translation: Prečka 5 na struni 3, nato prazna struna 2.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: Which fret on string 3 matches open string 2?
rows.translation: Katera prečka na struni 3 se ujema s prazno struno 2?
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: Both are D. Each string is tuned to fret 5 of the string below it.
rows.translation: Oba tona sta D. Vsaka struna je uglašena na ton pri prečki 5 nižje strune.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: Let each finger cover one fret: index on fret 2, middle on 3, ring on 4, little on 5. Your thumb rests behind the neck, across from your middle finger.
rows.translation: Vsak prst naj pokriva eno prečko: kazalec prečko 2, sredinec 3, prstanec 4 in mezinec 5. Palec počiva za vratom, nasproti sredinca.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: Start on G, fret 3 of string 4, with your middle finger. Climb across three strings: G A B C D E F sharp G. The same shape works from any root.
rows.translation: Začni s sredincem na G pri prečki 3 na struni 4. Vzpenjaj se čez tri strune: G A B C D E F z višajem G. Isti prijem deluje od vsakega osnovnega tona.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: Middle, little; then index, middle on string 3.
rows.translation: Sredinec, mezinec; nato kazalec in sredinec na struni 3.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: Little finger; then index, ring, little on string 2.
rows.translation: Mezinec; nato kazalec, prstanec in mezinec na struni 2.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: You move the shape so it starts on fret 5 of string 4. Which scale is it now?
rows.translation: Prijem premakneš tako, da se začne pri prečki 5 na struni 4. Katera lestvica je to zdaj?
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: Fret 5 on string 4 is A, so the same shape plays A major.
rows.translation: Prečka 5 na struni 4 je A, zato isti prijem zaigra A-dur.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: Ode to Joy works on bass too. Play it in G on strings 4 and 3, with your hand in the scale shape: index on fret 2.
rows.translation: Oda radosti deluje tudi na basu. Igraj jo v G-duru na strunah 4 in 3, z roko v prijemu lestvice: kazalec pri prečki 2.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: The first line ends on A. Where does the second line end?
rows.translation: Prva vrstica se konča na A. Kje se konča druga?
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: Same start, different finish. The second line comes home to G.
rows.translation: Enak začetek, drugačen konec. Druga vrstica se vrne domov na G.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: Name it, find it, play it
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: Frets 0 to 5 on strings 4 and 3 give you every note from E up to D. Say each note's name as you play it.
rows.translation: Prečke od 0 do 5 na strunah 4 in 3 ti dajo vse tone od E do D. Ob igranju vsak ton poimenuj.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.translation: Kateri ton je pri prečki 3 na struni 4?
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: F, A, B, D on strings 4 and 3.
rows.translation: F, A, B, D na strunah 4 in 3.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: Outline chords with the root, its fifth and its octave.
rows.translation: Oriši akorde z osnovnim tonom, njegovo kvinto in oktavo.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: One string over, two frets up
rows.translation: Eno struno naprej, dve prečki višje
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: The fifth of a chord sits on the next thinner string, two frets higher than the root. For open A, that's fret 2 of string 2: E.
rows.translation: Kvinta akorda je na naslednji tanjši struni, dve prečki višje od osnovnega tona. Za prazni A je to prečka 2 na struni 2: E.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.translation: Prazna struna 3, nato struna 2 pri prečki 2.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.translation: Prazna struna 4, nato struna 3 pri prečki 2.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: What is the fifth of D?
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: Count up the D major scale: D, E, F sharp, G, A. A is the fifth note.
rows.translation: Štej navzgor po D-durovi lestvici: D, E, F z višajem, G, A. A je peti ton.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.translation: Prazna struna 2, nato struna 1 pri prečki 2.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.translation: Osnovni ton in kvinta ob akordih
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: Play the root on beat 1 and the fifth on beat 3. Two notes per bar outline the whole chord and leave room for the drums.
rows.translation: Osnovni ton zaigraj na dobo 1, kvinto pa na dobo 3. Dva tona na takt orišeta ves akord in pustita prostor bobnom.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: In a root-fifth pattern, which note lands on beat 1?
rows.translation: Kateri ton v vzorcu osnovni ton–kvinta pade na dobo 1?
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: The root on beat 1 tells everyone which chord they're in.
rows.translation: Osnovni ton na dobo 1 vsem pove, kateri akord igrajo.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.translation: Osnovni ton, osnovni ton, kvinta, kvinta
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: Two strings over, two frets up
rows.translation: Dve struni naprej, dve prečki višje
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: The octave is the same note name, higher. From a root on string 4 or 3, go two strings thinner and two frets up. Open A becomes fret 2 of string 1.
rows.translation: Oktava je višji ton z istim imenom. Od osnovnega tona na struni 4 ali 3 pojdi za dve struni proti tanjšim in dve prečki višje. Prazni A postane prečka 2 na struni 1.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.translation: Prazna struna 3, nato struna 1 pri prečki 2.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.translation: Prazna struna 4, nato struna 2 pri prečki 2.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: G is on fret 3 of string 4. Where is the G an octave higher?
rows.translation: G je pri prečki 3 na struni 4. Kje je G oktavo višje?
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: Two strings thinner, two frets up: fret 5 of string 2. Open string 1 is the same G.
rows.translation: Za dve struni proti tanjšim, dve prečki višje: prečka 5 na struni 2. Prazna struna 1 je isti G.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: Root, fifth, octave, then back to the fifth. Over A: open string 3, fret 2 of string 2, fret 2 of string 1. It fits any major or minor chord.
rows.translation: Osnovni ton, kvinta, oktava in nazaj na kvinto. Ob A: prazna struna 3, prečka 2 na struni 2, prečka 2 na struni 1. Prilega se vsakemu durovemu ali molovemu akordu.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: Open 3, string 2 fret 2, string 1 fret 2, back to string 2.
rows.translation: Prazna 3, struna 2 prečka 2, struna 1 prečka 2, nazaj na struno 2.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: Move it to a fretted root
rows.translation: Premakni ga na prijeti osnovni ton
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: From G on fret 3 of string 4, use your index finger for the root and your ring finger for the fifth and octave, both on fret 5.
rows.translation: Od G pri prečki 3 na struni 4 uporabi kazalec za osnovni ton in prstanec za kvinto in oktavo, obe pri prečki 5.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: Index on the root, ring finger on fret 5 for the fifth and the octave.
rows.translation: Kazalec na osnovnem tonu, prstanec pri prečki 5 za kvinto in oktavo.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: You slide the shape so the root is fret 3 of string 3. Which chord is it now?
rows.translation: Prijem premakneš tako, da je osnovni ton pri prečki 3 na struni 3. Kateri akord je to zdaj?
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: Fret 3 of string 3 is C. Same shape, new root.
rows.translation: Prečka 3 na struni 3 je C. Isti prijem, nov osnovni ton.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: Root on the beat, fifth and octave to fill the bar. Keep the root strong and the other notes even.
rows.translation: Osnovni ton na dobo, kvinta in oktava pa zapolnita takt. Osnovni ton naj bo močan, drugi toni enakomerni.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: What is the fifth of E?
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: The 12-bar blues, walking lines and chromatic approach notes.
rows.translation: 12-taktni blues, hodeče basovske linije in kromatični pristopni toni.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: The blues repeats a 12-bar loop: four bars of A, two of D, two of A, then E, D, A, E. Count the bars and you always know where you are.
rows.translation: Blues ponavlja 12-taktni krog: štirje takti A, dva D, dva A, nato E, D, A, E. Štej takte in vedno boš vedel, kje si.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: How many bars of A open the 12-bar blues?
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.translation: Osnovni toni v 12 taktih v A
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: Bars 9 to 12 go E, D, A, E. The E in bar 12 turns the loop around.
rows.translation: Takti od 9 do 12 gredo E, D, A, E. E v taktu 12 obrne krog nazaj.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.translation: Osnovni ton in kvinta v 12 taktih
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: A new note on every beat
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: A walking bass line plays a new note on every beat. Start with root, third, fifth, sixth: over A that's A, C sharp, E, F sharp.
rows.translation: Hodeča basovska linija igra nov ton na vsako dobo. Začni z osnovnim tonom, terco, kvinto in seksto: ob A so to A, C z višajem, E, F z višajem.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: Open 3, fret 4; then string 2, frets 2 and 4.
rows.translation: Prazna 3, prečka 4; nato struna 2, prečki 2 in 4.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: What makes a bass line walk?
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: Open 2, fret 4; then string 1, frets 2 and 4.
rows.translation: Prazna 2, prečka 4; nato struna 1, prečki 2 in 4.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.translation: Hodeči bas v D in E
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: On beat 4, play a note one fret away from the next root. It pulls the ear forward, so the change feels like it arrives.
rows.translation: Na dobo 4 zaigraj ton, ki je eno prečko od naslednjega osnovnega tona. Uho povleče naprej, zato menjavo začutiš kot prihod na cilj.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: String 3 fret 4, then open string 2: one fret up into D.
rows.translation: Struna 3 prečka 4, nato prazna struna 2: eno prečko navzgor v D.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: You're heading to D in the next bar. Which note on beat 4 pulls best?
rows.translation: V naslednjem taktu greš na D. Kateri ton na dobo 4 najbolje vodi tja?
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: C sharp is one fret below D. A half step slides right into the new root.
rows.translation: C z višajem je eno prečko pod D. Polton te popelje naravnost v novi osnovni ton.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.translation: S hodečim basom v D in nazaj
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: Put the walk on the form
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: Same 12 bars, now with a walking line. Bars that lead into a new chord end on an approach note.
rows.translation: Istih 12 taktov, zdaj s hodečo linijo. Takti, ki vodijo v nov akord, se končajo s pristopnim tonom.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: Why does bar 12 end on G sharp?
rows.translation: Zakaj se takt 12 konča na G z višajem?
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.translation: To je osnovni ton akorda E
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: It leads back to A at the top
rows.translation: Vodi nazaj na A na začetku
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: Bar 12 turns the form around. G sharp sits one fret below A, the chord that starts the next time through.
rows.translation: Takt 12 obrne obliko nazaj na začetek. G z višajem je eno prečko pod A, akordom, ki začne naslednji krog.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.translation: Blues s hodečim basom v A
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: The 12-bar blues works in any key. In E the chords are E, A and B. Walk with roots, thirds, fifths and sixths, and approach each change.
rows.translation: 12-taktni blues deluje v vsaki tonaliteti. V E so akordi E, A in B. Hodi z osnovnimi toni, tercami, kvintami in sekstami ter s pristopnim tonom napovej vsako menjavo.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: In the key of E, which chord comes in bar 9?
rows.translation: Kateri akord v tonaliteti E pride v taktu 9?
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: String 3 fret 2; string 2 frets 1 and 4; string 1 fret 1.
rows.translation: Struna 3 prečka 2; struna 2 prečki 1 in 4; struna 1 prečka 1.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.translation: Blues s hodečim basom v E
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: Eighth-note rock, dotted rhythms, space, and a Motown-style line.
rows.translation: Rock v osminkah, punktirani ritmi, prostor in linija v slogu Motowna.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: Count 1 and 2 and 3 and 4 and. Play a note on every count with your fingers taking turns. Even volume is the goal.
rows.translation: Štej 1 in 2 in 3 in 4 in. Na vsak zlog zaigraj ton in izmenjuj prsta. Cilj je enakomerna glasnost.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: Your eighth notes start to rush. What helps?
rows.translation: Tvoje osminke začnejo prehitevati. Kaj pomaga?
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: Lock to the click and relax your hand
rows.translation: Ujemi se s klikom in sprosti roko
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: A dotted quarter lasts one and a half beats. Play on 1, hold through 2, then play on the and of 2, then on 3 and 4.
rows.translation: Četrtinka s piko traja dobo in pol. Igraj na 1, drži do 2, nato igraj na in za 2, potem na 3 in 4.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: Long-short on A, D and E
rows.translation: Dolgo-kratko na A, D in E
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: How long does a dotted quarter note last?
rows.translation: Kako dolgo traja četrtinka s piko?
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: Silence is part of the groove
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: Short notes with clean rests make a line bounce. Ease off the fretting finger, still touching the string, to stop each note right on time.
rows.translation: Kratki toni s čistimi pavzami dajo liniji poskočnost. Popusti pritisk prsta, a se še dotikaj strune, da vsak ton ustaviš ob pravem času.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: How do you stop a fretted note cleanly?
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: Ease off but keep touching it
rows.translation: Popusti pritisk, a se je še dotikaj
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: Release the pressure while your finger stays on the string. The note stops without a buzz.
rows.translation: Popusti pritisk, prst pa naj ostane na struni. Ton se ustavi brez brenčanja.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: Busy, but always in the pocket
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: Motown-era bass lines moved a lot: chord tones, notes that lean into the next chord, and pushes off the beat. This line is new, written in that spirit.
rows.translation: Basovske linije iz obdobja Motowna so se veliko gibale: akordni toni, toni, ki vodijo v naslednji akord, in poudarki med dobami. Ta linija je nova, napisana v tem duhu.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: The first bar: C, E, G, then B flat leaning into A.
rows.translation: Prvi takt: C, E, G, nato B z nižajem, ki vodi v A.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: What does B flat do at the end of bar 1?
rows.translation: Kaj naredi B z nižajem na koncu takta 1?
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: Leads down a fret into A
rows.translation: Vodi eno prečko navzdol v A
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: It's an approach note, one fret above A, the root of the next chord. It slides you into the next bar.
rows.translation: To je pristopni ton, eno prečko nad A, osnovnim tonom naslednjega akorda. Popelje te v naslednji takt.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: Eighth notes, dotted rhythms and a moving line. Stay with the click, keep your fingers taking turns and enjoy the groove.
rows.translation: Osminke, punktirani ritmi in gibljiva linija. Ostani s klikom, izmenjuj prsta in uživaj v groovu.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: In an eighth-note groove, which counts get a note?
rows.translation: Na katere zloge štetja igraš ton v groovu z osminkami?
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.translation: Na vsako številko in vsak in
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: Bow, finger and play in tune, from open strings to fiddle tunes
rows.translation: Vleci lok, postavljaj prste in igraj čisto, od praznih strun do ljudskih viž
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: Hold it, bow it, tune it, play the open strings and your first song.
rows.translation: Drži jo, vodi lok, uglasi jo ter igraj prazne strune in svojo prvo pesem.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.translation: Štiri strune, od nizke do visoke
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: With the violin under your chin, the strings run G, D, A, E from left to right. G is the thickest and lowest. E is the thinnest and highest, and we call it string 1.
rows.translation: Ko imaš violino pod brado, gredo strune od leve proti desni G, D, A, E. G je najdebelejša in najnižja. E je najtanjša in najvišja, pravimo ji struna 1.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: The bridge is the thin wooden arch that holds the strings up. String pressure alone keeps it standing. If it starts to lean, ask a teacher or shop to set it straight.
rows.translation: Kobilica je tanek lesen lok, ki dviguje strune. Pokonci jo drži samo pritisk strun. Če se začne nagibati, prosi učitelja ali v trgovini, naj jo poravnajo.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: E is the thinnest string and the highest. Strings count from E (1) to G (4).
rows.translation: E je najtanjša in najvišja struna. Strune štejemo od E (1) do G (4).
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: Before you use the bow, pluck. Rest your right thumb against the side of the fingerboard and pull the string with your first finger. Players call this pizzicato.
rows.translation: Preden uporabiš lok, ubiraj. Desni palec nasloni ob stran ubiralke in povleci struno s prvim prstom. Glasbeniki temu pravijo pizzicato.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: Rest the violin on your lap like a small guitar. Pluck string 2, the A, and let it ring.
rows.translation: Violino položi v naročje kot majhno kitaro. Uberi struno 2, A, in pusti, da zazveni.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: Now the thickest string, the G.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: Set the violin's lower edge on your left collarbone and turn your head to rest your jaw on the chin rest. The weight of your head holds it. No clamping.
rows.translation: Spodnji rob violine položi na levo ključnico in obrni glavo, da čeljust počiva na podbradniku. Drži jo teža tvoje glave. Ne stiskaj.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: Point the scroll forward and to your left, about level with the floor. Your left hand cradles the neck, thumb across from your first finger. Keep the wrist straight and soft.
rows.translation: Polž naj kaže naprej in v levo, približno vzporedno s tlemi. Leva roka podpira vrat, palec je nasproti prvega prsta. Zapestje naj bo ravno in sproščeno.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: Your collarbone and the weight of your head
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: Let your head rest on the chin rest. A squeezing hand or a raised shoulder makes you tense, and tension pulls notes out of tune.
rows.translation: Glava naj počiva na podbradniku. Stiskanje z roko ali dvignjena rama povzročata napetost, napetost pa pokvari intonacijo.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: Hold the violin in place and pluck the D string, string 3.
rows.translation: Drži violino v položaju in uberi struno D, struno 3.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: The wooden stick runs from the frog, where you hold it, to the tip. Horsehair stretches between them. Tighten the screw until a pencil just fits between hair and stick.
rows.translation: Lesena palica sega od žabice, kjer držiš lok, do konice. Med njima je napeta konjska žima. Vijak zategni toliko, da gre med žimo in palico ravno svinčnik.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: Bend your thumb and set its tip where the frog meets the stick. Drape your fingers over the stick, with your little finger standing curved on top. Keep the whole hand soft.
rows.translation: Upogni palec in konico položi tja, kjer se žabica stika s palico. Prste položi čez palico, ukrivljen mezinec pa naj stoji na vrhu. Vsa roka naj bo sproščena.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: Bent, where the frog meets the stick
rows.translation: Upognjenega tja, kjer se žabica stika s palico
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: Flat on top of the stick
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: A bent thumb at the frog lets the hand stay soft and balance the bow.
rows.translation: Upognjen palec pri žabici ohranja roko sproščeno in uravnoveša lok.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: Bare hair slides over the string without a sound. Rub the cake of rosin along the hair a few times before you play. A light coat is enough.
rows.translation: Žima brez kolofonije drsi po struni brez zvoka. Pred igranjem nekajkrat potegni kos kolofonije po žimi. Dovolj je tanek nanos.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: Set the bow on the A string, halfway between bridge and fingerboard. Pull it slowly to the right.
rows.translation: Lok položi na struno A, na sredino med kobilico in ubiralko. Počasi ga vleci v desno.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: Now the D string. Lift your elbow a little, then pull slowly.
rows.translation: Zdaj struna D. Malce dvigni komolec, nato počasi vleci.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: From low to high: G, D, A, E. Each string is five letter names above the last, an interval called a fifth. Try: Good Dogs Always Eat.
rows.translation: Od nizke do visoke: G, D, A, E. Vsaka struna je pet črkovnih imen nad prejšnjo; temu intervalu pravimo kvinta. Poskusi: Goran danes aranžira etudo.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: Your right elbow sets which string the bow plays. Raise it for G, lower it for E. Each string has its own level, like the steps of a stair.
rows.translation: Desni komolec določa, po kateri struni igra lok. Za G ga dvigni, za E spusti. Vsaka struna ima svojo višino, kot stopnice.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: Bow the G string, then D. Your elbow is highest for G.
rows.translation: Z lokom igraj struno G, nato D. Pri G je komolec najvišje.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: Now A, then E. Lower your elbow one step for each.
rows.translation: Zdaj A, nato E. Za vsako spusti komolec za eno stopnjo.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: Which string needs the highest elbow?
rows.translation: Pri kateri struni mora biti komolec najvišje?
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: The G string sits farthest to the left, so your arm lifts to reach it. E needs the lowest arm.
rows.translation: Struna G je najbolj levo, zato dvigneš roko, da jo dosežeš. Pri E je roka najnižje.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: Orchestras tune to A. Timbre shows how far each string is from its note in cents; 100 cents make a half step, the smallest step on a piano. Tune A, then D, G and E.
rows.translation: Orkestri se uglašujejo na A. Timbre v centih kaže, koliko je vsaka struna oddaljena od svojega tona; 100 centov je polton, najmanjši korak na klavirju. Uglasi A, nato D, G in E.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: The small screws on the tailpiece are fine tuners. Turn one clockwise to raise the pitch, counterclockwise to lower it. Quarter turns are plenty.
rows.translation: Majhni vijaki na struniku so fini uglaševalci. Obrni ga v smeri urnega kazalca, da zvišaš ton, v nasprotni smeri, da ga znižaš. Četrt obrata je dovolj.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: A string is a little flat. What do you do?
rows.translation: Struna je malo prenizka. Kaj narediš?
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.translation: Fini vijak obrneš v smeri urnega kazalca
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.translation: Fini vijak obrneš proti smeri urnega kazalca
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: Flat means too low. Clockwise tightens the string and raises the pitch.
rows.translation: Prenizko pomeni pod pravim tonom. Obračanje v smeri urnega kazalca napne struno in zviša ton.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: If a fine tuner runs out of room, use the peg. Turn it a little while pushing it inward so it holds. If a string is far off, ask a teacher; pegs can slip.
rows.translation: Če finemu uglaševalcu zmanjka hoda, uporabi ključ. Malo ga obrni in obenem potiskaj navznoter, da drži. Če je struna zelo razglašena, prosi učitelja; ključi lahko zdrsnejo.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: Tune your A string, then bow it and hold it steady.
rows.translation: Uglasi struno A, nato jo zaigraj z lokom in drži ton enakomerno.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: Now D, G and E. Tune each one, then bow it and hold it.
rows.translation: Zdaj D, G in E. Vsako uglasi, nato zaigraj z lokom in drži ton.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: Violin on your collarbone, soft bow hold, bow halfway between bridge and fingerboard. Now play everything from this unit.
rows.translation: Violina na ključnici, mehak prijem loka, lok na sredini med kobilico in ubiralko. Zdaj zaigraj vse iz te enote.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: Bow each open string from high to low. Hold each one steady.
rows.translation: Z lokom igraj vsako prazno struno od visoke do nizke. Vsak ton drži enakomerno.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: Which string do you tune first?
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: Orchestras tune to A, so start there and tune the others after it.
rows.translation: Orkestri se uglašujejo na A, zato začni tam in nato uglasi druge.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: Mary Had a Little Lamb lives on the A string: open A, first finger a whole step up for B, second finger another whole step up for C sharp. Pluck it first, then bow it.
rows.translation: Mary Had a Little Lamb igraš na struni A: prazni A, prvi prst cel ton višje za B, drugi prst še cel ton višje za C z višajem. Najprej ubiraj, nato igraj z lokom.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: First finger on the A string, a whole step up. That's B.
rows.translation: Prvi prst na struni A, cel ton višje. To je B.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: Second finger a whole step above your first. That's C sharp.
rows.translation: Drugi prst cel ton nad prvim. To je C z višajem.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: C sharp, B, A, B, then C sharp three times.
rows.translation: C z višajem, B, A, B, nato trikrat C z višajem.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: Long, even bows, clean string crossings and your first rhythms.
rows.translation: Dolgi, enakomerni potegi loka, čisti prehodi med strunami in prvi ritmi.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: A down-bow pulls the bow to the right, from frog to tip. An up-bow pushes it back to the left. In music, a down-bow mark looks like a little table and an up-bow like a V.
rows.translation: Pri potegu navzdol vlečeš lok v desno, od žabice proti konici. Pri potegu navzgor ga potiskaš nazaj v levo. V notah je oznaka za lok navzdol kot mizica, za lok navzgor pa kot V.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: Which way does a down-bow move?
rows.translation: V katero smer se premika lok pri potegu navzdol?
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: Play halfway between the bridge and the end of the fingerboard. Keep the bow parallel to the bridge, like a train on its track.
rows.translation: Igraj na sredini med kobilico in koncem ubiralke. Lok naj bo vzporeden s kobilico, kot vlak na tiru.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: One slow down-bow, then one slow up-bow on A. Keep the sound even to the end.
rows.translation: En počasen poteg navzdol, nato en navzgor na A. Zvok naj bo enakomeren do konca.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.translation: S celim lokom po vsaki struni
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: A quarter note lasts one beat. Quick notes need less bow, so use the middle half of the bow and keep every stroke the same length.
rows.translation: Četrtinka traja eno dobo. Hitri toni potrebujejo manj loka, zato uporabi srednjo polovico loka in naj bo vsak poteg enako dolg.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: A half note lasts two beats. Use a longer, slower bow so the sound doesn't fade on the second beat.
rows.translation: Polovinka traja dve dobi. Uporabi daljši, počasnejši poteg, da zvok na drugi dobi ne zamre.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: A half note lasts twice as long, so it gets a longer, slower stroke.
rows.translation: Polovinka traja dvakrat dlje, zato potrebuje daljši, počasnejši poteg.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: To cross strings, change levels with your elbow, not your wrist. Arrive at the new level just before the bow changes direction.
rows.translation: Med strunami prehajaj s spremembo višine komolca, ne zapestja. Novo višino dosezi tik preden lok spremeni smer.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: A, E, A, E. Let your elbow rock between the two levels.
rows.translation: A, E, A, E. Komolec naj se ziblje med obema višinama.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: What moves the bow to a new string?
rows.translation: Kaj premakne lok na novo struno?
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: Going from G to A skips the D string, so your elbow makes a bigger move. Travel smoothly and don't let the middle string sound.
rows.translation: Pri prehodu z G na A preskočiš struno D, zato komolec naredi večji premik. Premikaj se gladko in ne pusti, da zazveni vmesna struna.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: An eighth note lasts half a beat, so two fit in each beat. Use small, quick bows near the middle of the bow.
rows.translation: Osminka traja pol dobe, zato gresta dve v vsako dobo. Uporabi kratke, hitre potege blizu sredine loka.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: How many eighth notes fit in one beat?
rows.translation: Koliko osmink gre v eno dobo?
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: Now mix them: a quarter, two eighths, then two quarters. Fiddlers lean on this rhythm. Say it first: long, short-short, long, long.
rows.translation: Zdaj jih zmešaj: četrtinka, dve osminki, nato dve četrtinki. Ljudski violinisti se pogosto opirajo na ta ritem. Najprej ga izgovori: dolgo, kratko-kratko, dolgo, dolgo.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: Straight bows at the contact point, crossings led by the elbow, and steady rhythms. Here's a mix of all three.
rows.translation: Ravni potegi na stični točki, prehodi, ki jih vodi komolec, in enakomerni ritmi. Tukaj so vsi trije skupaj.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.translation: Na sredini med kobilico in ubiralko
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: Right on top of the bridge
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: Over the end of the fingerboard
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: Place fingers 1, 2 and 3, play the A major scale and your first song.
rows.translation: Postavi prste 1, 2 in 3, igraj A-durovo lestvico in svojo prvo pesem.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: Your instrument has no frets, so your ear places every note. Many players stick thin tapes on the fingerboard as a guide while they learn.
rows.translation: Tvoje glasbilo nima prečk, zato uho postavi vsak ton. Mnogi med učenjem na ubiralko nalepijo tanke trakove za orientacijo.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: Put your first fingertip on the A string at the first tape. That's B, a whole step above A; a whole step is two half steps. Press until the string meets the fingerboard.
rows.translation: Konico prvega prsta položi na struno A pri prvem traku. To je B, cel ton nad A; cel ton sta dva poltona. Pritisni, da se struna dotakne ubiralke.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: Open A, then B with your first finger. Hold B until it settles in tune.
rows.translation: Prazni A, nato B s prvim prstom. Drži B, dokler ne zazveni čisto.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: Timbre accepts a note within 30 cents, about a third of a half step. If you're sharp, nudge the finger toward the scroll. If you're flat, nudge it toward the bridge.
rows.translation: Timbre sprejme ton z odmikom do 30 centov, približno tretjine poltona. Če si previsoko, prst pomakni proti polžu. Če si prenizko, ga pomakni proti kobilici.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: B, open A, B. Lift the finger and set it down in the same spot.
rows.translation: B, prazni A, B. Dvigni prst in ga položi na isto mesto.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: Open A, then B. How far apart?
rows.translation: Prazni A, nato B. Kolikšna je razdalja?
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: Second finger plays C sharp, a whole step above B, so leave a gap after first finger. This spot is called high 2, because it sits close to where third finger will go.
rows.translation: Drugi prst igra C z višajem, cel ton nad B, zato za prvim prstom pusti razmik. Temu mestu pravimo visoki 2, saj je blizu mesta za tretji prst.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: A, B, C sharp. Keep first finger down while second plays.
rows.translation: A, B, C z višajem. Prvi prst naj ostane spodaj, medtem ko igra drugi.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: From B to the next note: what kind of step?
rows.translation: Od B do naslednjega tona: kakšen korak je to?
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: How far is C sharp above B?
rows.translation: Kako visoko nad B je C z višajem?
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: B to C sharp is two half steps, so second finger leaves a gap after first.
rows.translation: Od B do C z višajem sta dva poltona, zato drugi prst pusti razmik za prvim.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: B, C sharp, B, A. Land each note in tune before you move on.
rows.translation: B, C z višajem, B, A. Vsak ton naj bo čist, preden nadaljuješ.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: Third finger plays D, a half step above C sharp, so it sits right against second finger. On the A string the pattern is 1, then 2 and 3 together.
rows.translation: Tretji prst igra D, polton nad C z višajem, zato leži tik ob drugem prstu. Na struni A je vzorec 1, nato 2 in 3 skupaj.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1
