rows.source: A, B, C sharp, D. Leave each finger down as you add the next.
rows.translation: A, B, C z višajem, D. Vsak prst pusti spodaj, ko dodaš naslednjega.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: When your D is in tune, the open D string vibrates along with it. The two share a letter name, eight notes apart: an octave. Listen for the violin sounding fuller.
rows.translation: Ko je tvoj D čist, prazna struna D zavibrira z njim. Imata isto črkovno ime, osem tonov narazen: oktavo. Prisluhni polnejšemu zvoku violine.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: Third-finger D, open D, then third-finger D again. Listen for the ring.
rows.translation: D s tretjim prstom, prazni D, nato spet D s tretjim prstom. Poslušaj sozvenenje.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: Which fingers touch on the A string?
rows.translation: Katera prsta se dotikata na struni A?
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: B to C sharp is a whole step, so 1 and 2 have a gap. C sharp to D is a half step, so 2 and 3 touch.
rows.translation: Od B do C z višajem je cel ton, zato je med 1 in 2 razmik. Od C z višajem do D je polton, zato se 2 in 3 dotikata.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: On the E string, first finger plays F sharp, high second G sharp, and third A. It's the A-string shape, one string higher. Lower your bow arm to the E level.
rows.translation: Na struni E prvi prst igra F z višajem, visoki drugi G z višajem, tretji pa A. To je prijem s strune A, eno struno višje. Roko z lokom spusti na višino E.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: E, F sharp, G sharp, A. Same shape as on the A string.
rows.translation: E, F z višajem, G z višajem, A. Isti prijem kot na struni A.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: Your third finger on E plays A. What can you check it against?
rows.translation: Tretji prst na E igra A. S čim ga lahko preveriš?
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: The open A string is an octave below, so it rings along when your A is in tune.
rows.translation: Prazna struna A je oktavo nižje, zato sozveni, ko je tvoj A čist.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: Join the halves: A, B, C sharp, D on the A string, then E, F sharp, G sharp, A on the E string. Eight notes, A to A, one shape played twice.
rows.translation: Združi polovici: A, B, C z višajem, D na struni A, nato E, F z višajem, G z višajem, A na struni E. Osem tonov, od A do A, en prijem dvakrat.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: Up the A major scale, slowly. Cross to E for the top four notes.
rows.translation: Počasi navzgor po A-durovi lestvici. Za zgornje štiri tone preidi na E.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: This French melody from the 1700s uses only notes you've learned: A, B, C sharp, D on the A string, and E and F sharp on the E string.
rows.translation: Ta francoska melodija iz stoletja, ki se začne z letom 1700, uporablja le že znane tone: A, B, C z višajem, D na struni A ter E in F z višajem na struni E.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: Which finger plays F sharp on the E string?
rows.translation: Kateri prst igra F z višajem na struni E?
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: Whole step, whole step, half step: that's the pattern on A and E. Land each note in tune and let the open strings ring with you.
rows.translation: Cel ton, cel ton, polton: to je vzorec na A in E. Vsak ton postavi čisto in pusti praznim strunam, da sozvenijo s tabo.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: Second finger to third: what kind of step?
rows.translation: Od drugega prsta do tretjega: kakšen korak je to?
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: B, C sharp, D, then open D. Listen for the ring.
rows.translation: B, C z višajem, D, nato prazni D. Poslušaj sozvenenje.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: Which note does high 2 play on the E string?
rows.translation: Kateri ton igra visoki 2 na struni E?
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: F sharp, G sharp, A on the E string, then open A an octave lower.
rows.translation: F z višajem, G z višajem, A na struni E, nato prazni A oktavo nižje.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: The same finger pattern on two lower strings, D major and three tunes.
rows.translation: Isti prstni vzorec na dveh nižjih strunah, D-dur in tri melodije.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: On the D string, first finger plays E, high second F sharp, and third G. It's the A-string pattern, one string lower. Raise your bow arm a step.
rows.translation: Na struni D prvi prst igra E, visoki drugi F z višajem, tretji pa G. To je vzorec s strune A, eno struno nižje. Roko z lokom dvigni za eno stopnjo.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: D, E, F sharp, G. Second and third fingers touch.
rows.translation: D, E, F z višajem, G. Drugi in tretji prst se dotikata.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: Third-finger G on the D string is an octave above the open G string. When it's in tune, the G string hums along.
rows.translation: G s tretjim prstom na struni D je oktavo nad prazno struno G. Ko je čist, struna G zabrni z njim.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: Third-finger G, open G, third-finger G. Listen for the ring.
rows.translation: G s tretjim prstom, prazni G, G s tretjim prstom. Poslušaj sozvenenje.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: On the D string, which fingers touch?
rows.translation: Katera prsta se dotikata na struni D?
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: It's the A-string pattern again: whole step, whole step, half step. The half step is between 2 and 3.
rows.translation: Spet je vzorec s strune A: cel ton, cel ton, polton. Polton je med 2 in 3.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: Play D, E, F sharp, G on the D string, then A, B, C sharp, D on the A string. The D major scale is one finger shape played twice.
rows.translation: Igraj D, E, F z višajem, G na struni D, nato A, B, C z višajem, D na struni A. D-durova lestvica je en prstni prijem, zaigran dvakrat.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: Up the D major scale. Cross to the A string on the fifth note.
rows.translation: Navzgor po D-durovi lestvici. Pri petem tonu preidi na struno A.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: Which notes are sharp in D major?
rows.translation: Katera tona imata višaj v D-duru?
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: D major has two sharps, F sharp and C sharp. Both are high 2.
rows.translation: D-dur ima dva višaja, F z višajem in C z višajem. Oba sta visoki 2.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: Lightly Row is an old German children's song. It walks up and down the D major scale on the D and A strings.
rows.translation: Lightly Row je stara nemška otroška pesem. Hodi gor in dol po D-durovi lestvici na strunah D in A.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: Which finger plays the F sharps?
rows.translation: Kateri prst igra tone F z višajem?
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: First finger on the A string
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: Third finger on the D string
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: On the G string, first finger plays A, high second B, and third C. Same shape again. Raise your bow arm to its highest level.
rows.translation: Na struni G prvi prst igra A, visoki drugi B, tretji pa C. Spet isti prijem. Roko z lokom dvigni na najvišjo višino.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: G, A, B, C. Swing your left elbow a little under the violin to reach.
rows.translation: G, A, B, C. Levi komolec pomakni malo pod violino, da dosežeš struno.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: First-finger A on the G string, then the open A string. Same letter, an octave apart.
rows.translation: A s prvim prstom na struni G, nato prazna struna A. Ista črka, oktavo narazen.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: G, A, B, C on the G string plus D, E, F sharp, G on the D string make G major. It's the first octave of a two-octave scale you'll finish in the next unit.
rows.translation: G, A, B, C na struni G ter D, E, F z višajem, G na struni D sestavljajo G-dur. To je prva oktava dvooktavne lestvice, ki jo dokončaš v naslednji enoti.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: Up the G major scale. Same shape on both strings.
rows.translation: Navzgor po G-durovi lestvici. Isti prijem na obeh strunah.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: Beethoven wrote this tune for his Ninth Symphony in 1824. It moves mostly by step, so your fingers walk.
rows.translation: Beethoven je to melodijo leta 1824 napisal za svojo Deveto simfonijo. Večinoma se premika po korakih, zato tvoji prsti hodijo.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: Each line ends long, short, long: a dotted quarter, an eighth and a half note. A dot after a note adds half its length.
rows.translation: Vsaka vrstica se konča dolgo, kratko, dolgo: četrtinka s piko, osminka in polovinka. Pika za noto ji doda polovico njene dolžine.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: This old American fiddle tune rides the rhythm you bowed on open strings: long, short-short, long, long. Fiddlers play it at jams everywhere.
rows.translation: Ta stara ameriška violinska viža sledi ritmu, ki si ga igral z lokom na praznih strunah: dolgo, kratko-kratko, dolgo, dolgo. Ljudski violinisti jo igrajo na skupnih igranjih vsepovsod.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: Which string does this tune never use?
rows.translation: Katere strune ta melodija nikoli ne uporabi?
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: It lives on the D, A and E strings.
rows.translation: Igra se na strunah D, A in E.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: Whole step, whole step, half step works on every string so far. Raise your bow arm for the low strings and let the octaves ring.
rows.translation: Cel ton, cel ton, polton doslej deluje na vsaki struni. Za nizke strune dvigni roko z lokom in pusti oktavam sozveneti.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: Two octave checks: G with open G, then A with open A.
rows.translation: Dve preverjanji oktave: G s praznim G, nato A s praznim A.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: In D major, which finger plays C sharp?
rows.translation: Kateri prst v D-duru igra C z višajem?
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: Move second finger to change keys: G major in two octaves, A minor and fiddle tunes.
rows.translation: Premakni drugi prst za menjavo tonalitet: G-dur v dveh oktavah, A-mol in ljudske viže.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: Slide second finger back until it touches first. On the A string that's C natural, a half step below C sharp. Players call it low 2.
rows.translation: Drugi prst pomakni nazaj, da se dotakne prvega. Na struni A je to C brez predznaka, polton pod C z višajem. Temu pravimo nizki 2.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: A, B, C, D. Second finger touches first; leave a gap before third.
rows.translation: A, B, C, D. Drugi prst se dotika prvega; pred tretjim pusti razmik.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: High 2, low 2, high 2, low 2. Move only your second finger.
rows.translation: Visoki 2, nizki 2, visoki 2, nizki 2. Premikaj samo drugi prst.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: G major needs C natural on the A string and G natural on the E string, so second finger sits low there. On the G and D strings it stays high.
rows.translation: G-dur potrebuje C brez predznaka na struni A in G brez predznaka na struni E, zato je tam drugi prst nizko. Na strunah G in D ostane visoko.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: The A string in G major: second finger low, touching first.
rows.translation: Struna A v G-duru: drugi prst nizko, ob prvem.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: Now E, F sharp, G on the E string. Low 2 again.
rows.translation: Zdaj E, F z višajem, G na struni E. Spet nizki 2.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: Where does second finger go on the E string in G major?
rows.translation: Kam postaviš drugi prst na struni E v G-duru?
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: G natural is a half step above F sharp, so second finger tucks right against first.
rows.translation: G brez predznaka je polton nad F z višajem, zato drugi prst postaviš tik ob prvega.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: Start on open G and climb to G on the E string: fifteen notes, two octaves. High 2 on the low strings, low 2 on the high ones.
rows.translation: Začni na praznem G in se povzpni do G na struni E: petnajst tonov, dve oktavi. Visoki 2 na nizkih strunah, nizki 2 na visokih.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: A minor starts with first-finger A on the G string. Second finger is high on the G string for B, then low on the D string for F natural.
rows.translation: A-mol se začne z A s prvim prstom na struni G. Drugi prst je visoko na struni G za B, nato nizko na struni D za F brez predznaka.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: A minor, up. High 2 on the G string, low 2 on the D string.
rows.translation: A-mol navzgor. Visoki 2 na struni G, nizki 2 na struni D.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: Its third note is a half step lower
rows.translation: Njen tretji ton je polton nižji
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: It starts on a lower string
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: A to C sounds dark; A to C sharp sounds bright. One half step changes the whole mood.
rows.translation: Od A do C zveni temno; od A do C z višajem svetlo. En polton spremeni vse razpoloženje.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: This minuet comes from the notebook Bach gave his wife Anna Magdalena in 1725. It's now credited to Christian Petzold. Count three beats to a bar.
rows.translation: Ta menuet je iz zvezka, ki ga je Bach leta 1725 podaril ženi Anni Magdaleni. Danes ga pripisujemo Christianu Petzoldu. Štej tri dobe na takt.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: Which C does the minuet use?
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: The minuet is in G major, so C is natural and second finger sits low on the A string.
rows.translation: Menuet je v G-duru, zato je C brez predznaka in drugi prst leži nizko na struni A.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: F sharp is high 2 on the D string: low on A, high on D.
rows.translation: F z višajem je visoki 2 na struni D: nizko na A, visoko na D.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: The second half starts high: fourth finger reaches B on the E string. Then third, then low 2.
rows.translation: Druga polovica se začne visoko: četrti prst doseže B na struni E. Nato tretji, nato nizki 2.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: Old Joe Clark is an Appalachian fiddle tune. It's in A but uses G natural: high 2 for C sharp on the A string, low 2 for G on the E string.
rows.translation: Old Joe Clark je apalaška violinska viža. Je v A, a uporablja G brez predznaka: visoki 2 za C z višajem na struni A, nizki 2 za G na struni E.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: E, F sharp, G, F sharp. Keep second finger low, touching first.
rows.translation: E, F z višajem, G, F z višajem. Drugi prst naj ostane nizko, ob prvem.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: Which G does this tune use on the E string?
rows.translation: Kateri G uporablja ta viža na struni E?
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: G natural instead of G sharp gives Old Joe Clark its old-time sound.
rows.translation: G brez predznaka namesto G z višajem daje viži Old Joe Clark starinski zvok.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.translation: Viža iz stoletja z začetkom leta 1700
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: Soldier's Joy was printed in Scotland in the 1700s and is still played at dances across America. Its first part rocks on A, F sharp and D, the notes of a D major chord.
rows.translation: Soldier's Joy je bila na Škotskem natisnjena v stoletju z začetkom leta 1700 in jo še vedno igrajo na plesih po Ameriki. Prvi del se ziblje na A, F z višajem in D, tonih D-durovega akorda.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: Open A, high-2 F sharp on D, open D, F sharp. Rock your elbow between strings.
rows.translation: Prazni A, F z višajem z visokim 2 na D, prazni D, F z višajem. Zibaj komolec med strunami.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: Which finger plays G on the E string?
rows.translation: Kateri prst igra G na struni E?
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: Soldier's Joy is in D major, so G is natural: high 2 for F sharp on D, low 2 for G on E.
rows.translation: Soldier's Joy je v D-duru, zato je G brez predznaka: visoki 2 za F z višajem na D, nizki 2 za G na E.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: Every key sets your second finger. Before you play, ask: high 2 or low 2, and on which string?
rows.translation: Vsaka tonaliteta določi položaj drugega prsta. Pred igranjem se vprašaj: visoki 2 ali nizki 2 in na kateri struni?
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: F sharp, then high 2 or low 2?
rows.translation: F z višajem, nato visoki 2 ali nizki 2?
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: Low 2 and high 2 on the A string, then low 2 and high 2 on the E string.
rows.translation: Nizki 2 in visoki 2 na struni A, nato nizki 2 in visoki 2 na struni E.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: In A major, where does second finger sit on the A and E strings?
rows.translation: Kje v A-duru leži drugi prst na strunah A in E?
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: Low on A, high on E
rows.translation: Nizko na A, visoko na E
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: Loud and soft, slurs, your fourth finger, a first step toward vibrato, and Ode to Joy complete.
rows.translation: Glasno in tiho, legatni loki, četrti prst, prvi korak k vibratu in celotna Oda radosti.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: Add arm weight, use more bow speed, and move the contact point closer to the bridge. Use all three together. For soft, do the opposite.
rows.translation: Dodaj težo roke, povečaj hitrost loka in premakni stično točko bližje kobilici. Uporabi vse tri skupaj. Za tiho igranje naredi nasprotno.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: Music marks loud with f, for forte, and soft with p, for piano. Growing louder is a crescendo; fading away is a diminuendo.
rows.translation: Glasno je v glasbi označeno s f za forte, tiho pa s p za piano. Postopno naraščanje glasnosti je crescendo; postopno pojemanje je diminuendo.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: To play forte, where does the bow move?
rows.translation: Kam premakneš lok za igranje forte?
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: Near the bridge the string takes more weight and speed, so it sounds louder without scratching.
rows.translation: Blizu kobilice struna prenese več teže in hitrosti, zato zveni glasneje brez praskanja.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: Each note twice: forte, then piano. Stay in tune while the volume changes.
rows.translation: Vsak ton dvakrat: forte, nato piano. Ohrani čisto intonacijo, ko se glasnost spreminja.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.translation: Lightly Row, tiho in nato glasno
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: A curved line over notes is a slur: play them all in one bow. Your left hand changes notes while the bow keeps moving.
rows.translation: Ukrivljena črta nad notami je legatni lok: vse zaigraj v enem potegu. Leva roka menja tone, lok pa se ves čas premika.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: Slur A to B in one down-bow, then B to A in one up-bow.
rows.translation: Poveži A z B v enem potegu navzdol, nato B z A v enem potegu navzgor.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: Two notes in one bow means each gets half of it. Plan ahead and start a slur with enough bow left for both notes.
rows.translation: Dva tona v enem potegu pomenita, da vsak dobi polovico loka. Načrtuj vnaprej in začni vezavo z dovolj loka za oba tona.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: What does a slur tell you?
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: Play the notes in one bow
rows.translation: Zaigraj tone v enem potegu loka
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: Fourth finger reaches a whole step above third. On the D string that's A, the same note as the open A string. Keep the finger curved and let your hand lean toward it.
rows.translation: Četrti prst doseže cel ton nad tretjim. Na struni D je to A, isti ton kot prazna struna A. Prst naj bo ukrivljen, roka pa naj se nagne proti njemu.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: Fourth-finger A on the D string, open A, then fourth finger again. Match them exactly.
rows.translation: A s četrtim prstom na struni D, prazni A, nato spet četrti prst. Točno ju uskladi.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: Why use fourth finger instead of an open string?
rows.translation: Zakaj uporabiti četrti prst namesto prazne strune?
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: It avoids a string crossing and sounds warmer
rows.translation: Izogneš se prehodu med strunami in zveni topleje
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: Open strings are out of tune
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: A fingered note keeps the line on one string and blends with the notes around it. Open strings ring brighter.
rows.translation: Prijeti ton ohrani linijo na eni struni in se zlije s sosednjimi toni. Prazne strune zvenijo svetleje.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: Third-finger D, fourth-finger E on the A string, then open E. Listen for the match.
rows.translation: D s tretjim prstom, E s četrtim na struni A, nato prazni E. Poslušaj ujemanje.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: D to A on one string
rows.translation: Od D do A na eni struni
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: Amazing Grace is sung to an early American tune called New Britain. Its pairs of quick notes are slurs. Let the long notes sing with full, slow bows.
rows.translation: Amazing Grace se poje na zgodnjo ameriško melodijo New Britain. Njeni pari hitrih not so vezani. Dolgi toni naj pojejo s celimi, počasnimi potegi loka.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: G to B and back crosses strings. Rock smoothly from the elbow.
rows.translation: Od G do B in nazaj prehajaš med strunami. Gladko se zibaj iz komolca.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: How do you bow a quick pair, like B to G?
rows.translation: Kako z lokom igraš hiter par, na primer B in G?
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.translation: Oba tona v enem potegu loka
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: They're slurred, so they share one bow.
rows.translation: Tona sta vezana, zato si delita en poteg loka.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: Vibrato is a small, even wave in pitch that makes long notes glow. The fingertip rolls slightly back from the note and returns, again and again, moved by the hand and arm.
rows.translation: Vibrato je majhno, enakomerno valovanje višine, ki poživi dolge tone. Konica prsta se malce zavalja nazaj od tona in vrača, vedno znova, z gibanjem dlani in roke.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: Vibrato can't rescue a note that's out of tune; it only colors one that's centered. Most players add it once their fingers land in tune without searching.
rows.translation: Vibrato ne more rešiti nečistega tona; le obarva ton, ki je na pravem mestu. Večina ga doda, ko prsti brez iskanja zadenejo čiste tone.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: When is a note ready for vibrato?
rows.translation: Kdaj je ton pripravljen na vibrato?
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: Set second finger on the A string. Keep the fingertip in place, soften the knuckle, and slowly rock your hand toward the scroll and back. Small and even. A teacher's eye helps here.
rows.translation: Drugi prst položi na struno A. Konica naj ostane na mestu, sprosti členek in počasi zibaj dlan proti polžu in nazaj. Majhno in enakomerno. Tu pomaga učiteljevo oko.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: Now bow these without vibrato and center each one. That center is where vibrato starts.
rows.translation: Zdaj te tone igraj brez vibrata in vsakega postavi čisto. Tam se vibrato začne.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: Arkansas Traveler was in print by 1847. Fiddlers slur its quickest notes in pairs, which gives the tune its skip. Start slow and keep the pairs even.
rows.translation: Arkansas Traveler je bila natisnjena že leta 1847. Violinisti najhitrejše note vežejo v pare, kar ji daje poskočnost. Začni počasi in ohrani pare enakomerne.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: Why do fiddlers slur quick pairs?
rows.translation: Zakaj ljudski violinisti vežejo hitre pare?
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: It saves bow and adds a lilt
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: It keeps the strings in tune
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: A, G, F sharp, A on the E string: third finger, low 2, first, third.
rows.translation: A, G, F z višajem, A na struni E: tretji prst, nizki 2, prvi, tretji.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: Put it all together: in-tune fingers, straight bows, slurs and dynamics. Start piano, grow through the middle, and finish forte.
rows.translation: Združi vse: čisto postavljene prste, ravne potege, vezave in dinamiko. Začni piano, skozi sredino naraščaj in končaj forte.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: Warm up: fourth finger against the open strings, A and then E.
rows.translation: Ogrevanje: četrti prst primerjaj s praznimi strunami, najprej A in nato E.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: Sit, bow and play in tune, from open strings to The Swan
rows.translation: Sedi, vodi lok in igraj čisto, od praznih strun do Laboda
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: Sit, set the endpin, hold the bow, play the open strings and your first song.
rows.translation: Sedi, nastavi nogo, primi lok ter zaigraj prazne strune in svojo prvo pesem.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: From low to high the strings are C, G, D and A. C is the thickest and lowest. A is the thinnest and highest, and we call it string 1.
rows.translation: Od nizke do visoke so strune C, G, D in A. C je najdebelejša in najnižja. A je najtanjša in najvišja, pravimo ji struna 1.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: C is the thickest string and the lowest. Strings count from A (1) to C (4).
rows.translation: C je najdebelejša in najnižja struna. Strune štejemo od A (1) do C (4).
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: Pluck string 1, the A, and let it ring.
rows.translation: Uberi struno 1, A, in pusti, da zazveni.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: Now the thickest string, the C. Let it rumble.
rows.translation: Zdaj najdebelejša struna, C. Naj zadoni.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: Sit near the front edge of a chair, feet flat and knees apart, as if you could stand up easily. The cello rests between your knees.
rows.translation: Sedi blizu sprednjega roba stola, s stopali plosko na tleh in koleni narazen, kot da bi zlahka vstal. Violončelo počiva med koleni.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: Pull out the endpin until the cello's top edge meets your chest at the breastbone and the C peg sits near your left ear. Tighten the screw. A rest or strap keeps it from sliding.
rows.translation: Izvleci nogo, da se zgornji rob violončela dotika prsnice, ključ za C pa je blizu levega ušesa. Zategni vijak. Podstavek ali trak prepreči drsenje.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: Where does the top edge of the cello touch you?
rows.translation: Kje se te dotika zgornji rob violončela?
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: The cello leans back against your chest, and your knees steady it lightly from the sides.
rows.translation: Violončelo se naslanja nazaj na prsi, kolena pa ga rahlo podpirajo s strani.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: Sitting tall, pluck D, then G. Keep your shoulders loose.
rows.translation: Sedi vzravnano in uberi D, nato G. Ramena naj bodo sproščena.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: Bend your thumb and set its tip where the frog meets the stick, across from your middle finger. Drape all four fingers over the stick and let the hand hang heavy.
rows.translation: Upogni palec in konico položi tja, kjer se žabica stika s palico, nasproti sredinca. Vse štiri prste položi čez palico in pusti roko težko viseti.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: Set the bow on the D string, halfway between bridge and fingerboard. Pull it slowly to the right.
rows.translation: Lok položi na struno D, na sredino med kobilico in ubiralko. Počasi ga vleci v desno.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: Now the A string. Move your whole arm to its level, then pull slowly.
rows.translation: Zdaj struna A. Vso roko premakni na njeno višino, nato počasi vleci.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: From low to high: C, G, D, A. Each string is five letter names above the last, an interval called a fifth. Try: Cats Go Dancing Around.
rows.translation: Od nizke do visoke: C, G, D, A. Vsaka struna je pet črkovnih imen nad prejšnjo; temu intervalu pravimo kvinta. Poskusi: Cvetka gleda domači album.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: Your right arm sets which string the bow plays. Each string has its own arm level, like the steps of a stair. Move the whole arm, not just the hand.
rows.translation: Desna roka določa, po kateri struni igra lok. Vsaka struna ima svojo višino roke, kot stopnice. Premikaj vso roko, ne le dlani.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: Bow the C string, then G. Let your arm settle at each level.
rows.translation: Z lokom igraj struno C, nato G. Roka naj se ustali na vsaki višini.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: Orchestras tune to A. Timbre shows how far each string is from its note in cents; 100 cents make a half step, the smallest step on a piano. Tune A, then D, G and C.
rows.translation: Orkestri se uglašujejo na A. Timbre v centih kaže, koliko je vsaka struna oddaljena od svojega tona; 100 centov je polton, najmanjši korak na klavirju. Uglasi A, nato D, G in C.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: Now D, G and C. Tune each one, then bow it and hold it.
rows.translation: Zdaj D, G in C. Vsako uglasi, nato zaigraj z lokom in drži ton.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: Sit tall with the endpin set, soft bow hold, bow halfway between bridge and fingerboard. Now play everything from this unit.
rows.translation: Sedi vzravnano z nastavljeno nogo, mehkim prijemom loka in lokom na sredini med kobilico in ubiralko. Zdaj zaigraj vse iz te enote.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: Mary Had a Little Lamb lives on the D string: open D, first finger a whole step up for E, third finger two whole steps up for F sharp. Pluck it first, then bow it.
rows.translation: Mary Had a Little Lamb igraš na struni D: prazni D, prvi prst cel ton višje za E, tretji prst dva cela tona višje za F z višajem. Najprej ubiraj, nato igraj z lokom.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: First finger on the D string, a whole step up. That's E.
rows.translation: Prvi prst na struni D, cel ton višje. To je E.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: Third finger, a whole step above your first. That's F sharp.
rows.translation: Tretji prst cel ton nad prvim. To je F z višajem.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: F sharp, E, D, E, then F sharp three times.
rows.translation: F z višajem, E, D, E, nato trikrat F z višajem.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: One slow down-bow, then one slow up-bow on D. Keep the sound even to the end.
rows.translation: En počasen poteg navzdol, nato en navzgor na D. Zvok naj bo enakomeren do konca.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: D, A, D, A. Let your arm rock between the two levels.
rows.translation: D, A, D, A. Roka naj se ziblje med obema višinama.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: Going from C to D skips the G string, so your arm makes a bigger move. Travel smoothly and don't let the middle string sound.
rows.translation: Pri prehodu s C na D preskočiš struno G, zato roka naredi večji premik. Premikaj se gladko in ne pusti, da zazveni vmesna struna.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: One finger per half step: play D major and your first melodies.
rows.translation: En prst za vsak polton: igraj D-dur in svoje prve melodije.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: A half step is the smallest step in music. In first position your fingers sit a half step apart, starting a whole step (two half steps) above the open string. Thumb behind the neck, across from second finger.
rows.translation: Polton je najmanjši korak v glasbi. V prvi legi so prsti polton narazen, začenši cel ton (dva poltona) nad prazno struno. Palec je za vratom, nasproti drugega prsta.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: Open D, then E with your first finger. Hold E until it settles in tune.
rows.translation: Prazni D, nato E s prvim prstom. Drži E, dokler ne zazveni čisto.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: Same finger on the A string: open A, then B.
rows.translation: Isti prst na struni A: prazni A, nato B.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: Open D, then E. How far apart?
rows.translation: Prazni D, nato E. Kolikšna je razdalja?
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: First finger on D and A
rows.translation: Prvi prst na D in A
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: Third finger plays F sharp, a whole step above E. Let second finger hover over its spot between 1 and 3, so your hand keeps its shape.
rows.translation: Tretji prst igra F z višajem, cel ton nad E. Drugi prst naj lebdi nad svojim mestom med 1 in 3, da roka ohrani obliko.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: D, E, F sharp. Keep first finger down while third plays.
rows.translation: D, E, F z višajem. Prvi prst naj ostane spodaj, medtem ko igra tretji.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: From E to the next note: what kind of step?
rows.translation: Od E do naslednjega tona: kakšen korak je to?
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: Why does second finger stay over its spot?
rows.translation: Zakaj drugi prst ostane nad svojim mestom?
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: Each finger owns a half step. Keeping all four in place makes every note land in the same spot each time.
rows.translation: Vsak prst ima svoj polton. Če vsi štirje ostanejo na mestu, vsak ton vsakič pristane na istem mestu.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: Same fingers on the A string: open A, B, C sharp.
rows.translation: Isti prsti na struni A: prazni A, B, C z višajem.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: Fourth finger plays G, a half step above F sharp. D, E, F sharp, G is the first half of the D major scale: open, 1, 3, 4.
rows.translation: Četrti prst igra G, polton nad F z višajem. D, E, F z višajem, G je prva polovica D-durove lestvice: prazna, 1, 3, 4.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: D, E, F sharp, G: open, 1, 3, 4.
rows.translation: D, E, F z višajem, G: prazna, 1, 3, 4.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: Fourth-finger G on the D string is an octave above the open G string: the same letter, eight notes higher. When it's in tune, the G string hums along.
rows.translation: G s četrtim prstom na struni D je oktavo nad prazno struno G: ista črka, osem tonov višje. Ko je čist, struna G zabrni z njim.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: Fourth-finger G, open G, then fourth-finger G again. Listen for the ring.
rows.translation: G s četrtim prstom, prazni G, nato spet G s četrtim prstom. Poslušaj sozvenenje.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: Play D, E, F sharp, G on the D string, then A, B, C sharp, D on the A string. The same fingers twice: open, 1, 3, 4.
rows.translation: Igraj D, E, F z višajem, G na struni D, nato A, B, C z višajem, D na struni A. Isti prsti dvakrat: prazna, 1, 3, 4.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: Which fingers play D major on each string?
rows.translation: S katerimi prsti igraš D-dur na vsaki struni?
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: This French melody from the 1700s uses only notes you've learned: D, E, F sharp, G on the D string, and A and B on the A string.
rows.translation: Ta francoska melodija iz stoletja z začetkom leta 1700 uporablja le že znane tone: D, E, F z višajem, G na struni D ter A in B na struni A.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: Which finger plays B on the A string?
rows.translation: Kateri prst igra B na struni A?
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: Open, 1, 3, 4 on the D and A strings. Keep the hand's shape, land each note in tune, and let the octaves ring.
rows.translation: Prazna, 1, 3, 4 na strunah D in A. Ohrani obliko roke, vsak ton postavi čisto in pusti oktavam sozveneti.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: Third finger to fourth: what kind of step?
rows.translation: Od tretjega prsta do četrtega: kakšen korak je to?
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: Two octave checks: G with open G, then fourth-finger D with open D.
rows.translation: Dve preverjanji oktave: G s praznim G, nato D s četrtim prstom s praznim D.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: Which finger plays C sharp on the A string?
rows.translation: Kateri prst igra C z višajem na struni A?
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: Two low strings, C major and G major scales, and three classic melodies.
rows.translation: Dve nizki struni, lestvici C-dur in G-dur ter tri klasične melodije.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: On the G string, first finger plays A, third finger B, and fourth finger C. Same spacing as on D. Let your arm settle at the G string level.
rows.translation: Na struni G prvi prst igra A, tretji B, četrti pa C. Isti razmiki kot na D. Roka naj se ustali na višini strune G.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: G, A, B, C on the G string plus D, E, F sharp, G on the D string make the G major scale. Same fingers on both strings.
rows.translation: G, A, B, C na struni G ter D, E, F z višajem, G na struni D sestavljajo G-durovo lestvico. Isti prsti na obeh strunah.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: Which finger plays C on the G string?
rows.translation: Kateri prst igra C na struni G?
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: On the C string, first finger plays D, third finger E, and fourth finger F. The thick string needs a slow, heavy bow to speak.
rows.translation: Na struni C prvi prst igra D, tretji E, četrti pa F. Debela struna potrebuje počasen, težek lok, da zazveni.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: C, D, E, F: open, 1, 3, 4. Give each note time to speak.
rows.translation: C, D, E, F: prazna, 1, 3, 4. Vsakemu tonu daj čas, da zazveni.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: C, D, E, F on the C string plus G, A, B, C on the G string is the C major scale. It has no sharps at all.
rows.translation: C, D, E, F na struni C ter G, A, B, C na struni G sestavljajo C-durovo lestvico. Nima nobenega višaja.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: Up the C major scale. At the top, listen for C ringing with the open C string.
rows.translation: Navzgor po C-durovi lestvici. Na vrhu prisluhni sozvenenju C s prazno struno C.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: Second finger plays F natural on the D string, a half step below F sharp, and C natural on the A string. C major needs both.
rows.translation: Drugi prst igra F brez predznaka na struni D, polton pod F z višajem, in C brez predznaka na struni A. C-dur potrebuje oba.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: D, E, F, G: open, 1, 2, 4. Second finger sits right next to first.
rows.translation: D, E, F, G: prazna, 1, 2, 4. Drugi prst leži tik ob prvem.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: E, then second finger or third?
rows.translation: E, nato drugi prst ali tretji?
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: Cellists give each finger its own half step, so F takes second finger and F sharp takes third. A note just past the hand, like F sharp on the C string, needs an extension, a wider hand. This course picks keys that avoid it.
rows.translation: Violončelisti vsakemu prstu namenijo svoj polton, zato F igra drugi prst, F z višajem pa tretji. Ton tik zunaj dosega roke, na primer F z višajem na struni C, zahteva razširjeno lego, širšo roko. Ta tečaj izbira tonalitete, ki se temu izognejo.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: C major, second octave: second finger for F and for the top C.
rows.translation: C-dur, druga oktava: drugi prst za F in za zgornji C.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: Ode to Joy, an octave up
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: Brahms wrote this lullaby in 1868. It rocks in three on the G and D strings. Use long, slow bows and let each phrase breathe.
rows.translation: Brahms je to uspavanko napisal leta 1868. Ziblje se v treh dobah na strunah G in D. Uporabi dolge, počasne potege loka in pusti vsaki frazi dihati.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: G, F sharp, E: fingers 4, 3, 1. This is the lullaby's high point.
rows.translation: G, F z višajem, E: prsti 4, 3, 1. To je vrh uspavanke.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: Au clair de la lune is a French folk song from the 1700s. It lives on the G and D strings, with C under your fourth finger.
rows.translation: Au clair de la lune je francoska ljudska pesem iz stoletja z začetkom leta 1700. Igra se na strunah G in D, s C pod četrtim prstom.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: D, C, B, A, G: open D, then fingers 4, 3, 1 and open G.
rows.translation: D, C, B, A, G: prazni D, nato prsti 4, 3, 1 in prazni G.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: Which notes in this tune are open strings?
rows.translation: Kateri toni v tej melodiji so prazne strune?
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: Open, 1, 3, 4 on every string, with second finger for F and C natural. Slow, heavy bows on the low strings.
rows.translation: Prazna, 1, 3, 4 na vsaki struni, z drugim prstom za F in C brez predznaka. Počasni, težki potegi loka na nizkih strunah.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: Two octave checks: C with open C, then G with open G.
rows.translation: Dve preverjanji oktave: C s praznim C, nato G s praznim G.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: Which of these keys has no sharps?
rows.translation: Katera od teh tonalitet nima višajev?
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: Slide to fourth position, check it by ear, and play The Swan and Amazing Grace.
rows.translation: Zdrsni v četrto lego, jo preveri po posluhu ter igraj Laboda in Amazing Grace.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: A shift moves your whole hand to a new place on the string. Lighten the finger, slide it along the string without lifting, and let your thumb travel with the hand.
rows.translation: Pri menjavi lege vso roko premakneš na novo mesto na struni. Popusti pritisk prsta, drsi z njim po struni brez dvigovanja, palec pa naj potuje z roko.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: In fourth position, first finger plays D on the A string, the note fourth finger played in first position. Your thumb settles where the neck curves into the body.
rows.translation: V četrti legi prvi prst igra D na struni A, ton, ki ga je v prvi legi igral četrti prst. Palec se ustali tam, kjer vrat prehaja v trup.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: B with first finger, then slide that finger up to D. Keep it light on the way.
rows.translation: B s prvim prstom, nato s tem prstom zdrsni navzgor do D. Med potjo pritiskaj rahlo.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.translation: Kaj se premika pri menjavi lege?
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: Moving the hand as one unit keeps your finger spacing, so the next notes land in tune too.
rows.translation: Premik roke kot celote ohranja razmike med prsti, zato tudi naslednji toni pristanejo čisto.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: Shift up, back, and up again on first finger. Land each note in tune.
rows.translation: S prvim prstom menjaj lego navzgor, nazaj in spet navzgor. Vsak ton postavi čisto.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: In fourth position on the A string, first finger plays D, third finger E, and fourth finger F. Same frame as first position: one finger per half step.
rows.translation: V četrti legi na struni A prvi prst igra D, tretji E, četrti pa F. Isti razpored kot v prvi legi: en prst za vsak polton.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: D, E, F: fingers 1, 3, 4. Up here the notes sit a little closer together.
rows.translation: D, E, F: prsti 1, 3, 4. Tu zgoraj so toni malo bližje skupaj.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: Open A, B, shift on first finger to D, then E with third.
rows.translation: Prazni A, B, s prvim prstom premakni lego na D, nato E s tretjim.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: In fourth position on the A string, which finger plays E?
rows.translation: Kateri prst v četrti legi na struni A igra E?
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: Up to fourth position and back
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: Check it with the open A
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: In fourth position on the D string, first finger plays G and third plays A, the same note as the open A string. Play them one after the other and match them.
rows.translation: V četrti legi na struni D prvi prst igra G, tretji pa A, isti ton kot prazna struna A. Igraj ju enega za drugim in ju uskladi.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: First-finger G, then third-finger A, both on the D string.
rows.translation: G s prvim prstom, nato A s tretjim, oba na struni D.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: Fourth-position A, open A, fourth-position A. Make them one sound.
rows.translation: A v četrti legi, prazni A, A v četrti legi. Naj zvenijo enako.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: Play E with first finger in first position, then slide that finger up to G. That's three half steps, the same distance as B to D on the A string.
rows.translation: Igraj E s prvim prstom v prvi legi, nato s tem prstom zdrsni navzgor do G. To so trije poltoni, enaka razdalja kot od B do D na struni A.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: First-finger E, then slide to first-finger G. Let the thumb travel too.
rows.translation: E s prvim prstom, nato zdrsni do G s prvim prstom. Tudi palec naj potuje.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: The Swan comes from The Carnival of the Animals, written by Camille Saint-Saëns in 1886. This is its opening phrase, an octave lower and simplified.
rows.translation: Labod je iz Živalskega karnevala, ki ga je Camille Saint-Saëns napisal leta 1886. To je njegova uvodna fraza, oktavo nižje in poenostavljena.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: Long notes need slow bows. Keep the bow close to the bridge and spread it evenly, so each note lasts to its very end without fading.
rows.translation: Dolgi toni potrebujejo počasne potege. Lok ohrani blizu kobilice in ga enakomerno razporedi, da vsak ton traja do konca brez pojemanja.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: G, F sharp, B: fourth and third finger on D, then third finger on G.
rows.translation: G, F z višajem, B: četrti in tretji prst na D, nato tretji prst na G.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: How do you keep a long note from fading?
rows.translation: Kako preprečiš, da dolg ton zamre?
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: In Amazing Grace, the high D comes right after open A. While the A rings, slide your hand up to fourth position and land on D with first finger.
rows.translation: V Amazing Grace visoki D pride takoj za praznim A. Medtem ko A zveni, roko pomakni v četrto lego in s prvim prstom pristani na D.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: B, open A, then first-finger D in fourth position. Move while the A sounds.
rows.translation: B, prazni A, nato D s prvim prstom v četrti legi. Premakni se, medtem ko A zveni.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: When is the easiest moment to shift?
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: In the middle of a long note
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: While an open string sounds, your left hand is free, so the shift can't be heard.
rows.translation: Ko zveni prazna struna, je leva roka prosta, zato se menjava lege ne sliši.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: Lighten the finger, move hand and thumb together, and check where you land. The open strings will tell you if you're right.
rows.translation: Popusti pritisk prsta, roko in palec premakni skupaj ter preveri, kje pristaneš. Prazne strune ti povedo, ali si na pravem mestu.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: Fourth-position A on the D string, then open A. Match them.
rows.translation: A v četrti legi na struni D, nato prazni A. Uskladi ju.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: In fourth position, which note does first finger play on the A string?
rows.translation: Kateri ton v četrti legi igra prvi prst na struni A?
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: From paired strings to fiddle tunes and the bluegrass chop
rows.translation: Od parov strun do ljudskih viž in kratkega dušenega udarca v bluegrassu
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: Meet the paired strings, tune them and play all four open notes.
rows.translation: Spoznaj pare strun, jih uglasi in igraj vse štiri prazne tone.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: A mandolin has eight strings in four pairs, called courses. The two strings of a pair are tuned to the same note and played together, so you treat each pair as one string.
rows.translation: Mandolina ima osem strun v štirih parih. Struni v paru sta uglašeni na isti ton in se igrata skupaj, zato vsak par obravnavaš kot eno struno.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: The pair nearest your face is the lowest, pair 4. The pair nearest the floor is the highest, pair 1. When a lesson says string 3, it means the third pair.
rows.translation: Par, ki je najbližje obrazu, je najnižji, par 4. Par, ki je najbližje tlom, je najvišji, par 1. Ko lekcija reče struna 3, pomeni tretji par.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: How do you play a pair?
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: Both strings at once, as one note
rows.translation: Obe struni hkrati, kot en ton
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: The two strings sit close together, so one pick stroke catches both. Together they ring as one fuller note.
rows.translation: Struni sta blizu skupaj, zato en udarec trzalice zajame obe. Skupaj zazvenita kot en polnejši ton.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: Pick the lowest pair, pair 4, and let it ring.
rows.translation: S trzalico zaigraj najnižji par, par 4, in pusti, da zazveni.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: Each pair has to match the tuner and match itself. If its two strings disagree, you hear a slow wobble. Tune one string, then bring its partner to the same note.
rows.translation: Vsak par se mora ujemati z uglaševalcem in sam s sabo. Če se struni ne ujemata, slišiš počasno nihanje. Uglasi eno struno, nato drugo pripelji na isti ton.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: Pair 3, the D pair. Tune both strings until the wobble stops.
rows.translation: Par 3, par D. Uglasi obe struni, dokler nihanje ne preneha.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: One pair has a slow wobble. What is wrong?
rows.translation: En par počasi niha. Kaj je narobe?
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: That wobble is called beating: the two strings are slightly apart. Tune them until it smooths out.
rows.translation: Temu nihanju pravimo utripanje: višini strun sta malo narazen. Uglašuj ju, dokler se zvok ne umiri.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: Loosen a little below the note, then tighten up to it. Approaching from below keeps the string from slipping flat later.
rows.translation: Struno popusti malo pod ton, nato jo napni do njega. Približevanje od spodaj prepreči, da bi struna pozneje zdrsnila prenizko.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: Pair 4, then pair 1. Bring each string up to the note from below.
rows.translation: Par 4, nato par 1. Vsako struno pripelji do tona od spodaj.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: Hold the pick between the pad of your thumb and the side of your curled index finger. Let only the tip show. Keep your wrist loose, as if shaking water off your hand.
rows.translation: Trzalico drži med blazinico palca in stranjo upognjenega kazalca. Ven naj gleda le konica. Zapestje naj bo sproščeno, kot da bi otresal vodo z roke.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: How much of the pick should show?
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: A short tip gives you control and a clean sound. Too much pick snags on the paired strings.
rows.translation: Kratka konica daje nadzor in čist zvok. Preveč izpostavljene trzalice se zatika ob pare strun.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: Push the pick down through both strings of a pair in one small motion and stop just past them. Rest the heel of your hand lightly near the bridge.
rows.translation: Trzalico z majhnim gibom potisni navzdol skozi obe struni para in se ustavi tik za njima. Spodnji del dlani rahlo nasloni blizu kobilice.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: From low to high, the pairs are G, D, A and E. Try: Good Dogs Always Eat. A violin is tuned the same way, so fiddle tunes sit naturally on a mandolin.
rows.translation: Od nizkega do visokega so pari G, D, A in E. Poskusi: Goran danes aranžira etudo. Violina je uglašena enako, zato se ljudske viže naravno prilegajo mandolini.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: Low to high: G, D, A, E.
rows.translation: Od nizkega do visokega: G, D, A, E.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: Now high to low: E, A, D, G.
rows.translation: Zdaj od visokega do nizkega: E, A, D, G.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: Tuned pairs, a relaxed pick and four open notes. Play each one cleanly, with both strings of the pair ringing.
rows.translation: Uglašeni pari, sproščena trzalica in štirje prazni toni. Vsakega zaigraj čisto, da zvenita obe struni para.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: Which pair is the highest in pitch?
rows.translation: Kateri par je najvišji po tonu?
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: Pairs count from the highest, pair 1, to the lowest, pair 4.
rows.translation: Pare štejemo od najvišjega, para 1, do najnižjega, para 4.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: A, G, E, D. Find each pair by its name.
rows.translation: A, G, E, D. Vsak par poišči po imenu.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: Mary Had a Little Lamb lives on the D pair: open D, E at fret 2 with your first finger, and F sharp at fret 4 with your second.
rows.translation: Mary Had a Little Lamb igraš na paru D: prazni D, E pri prečki 2 s prvim prstom in F z višajem pri prečki 4 z drugim.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: Pair 3, fret 2, first finger. That's E.
rows.translation: Par 3, prečka 2, prvi prst. To je E.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: Pair 3, fret 4, second finger. That's F sharp.
rows.translation: Par 3, prečka 4, drugi prst. To je F z višajem.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: Fret notes cleanly, learn two frets per finger and play the D major scale.
rows.translation: Čisto prijemaj tone, spoznaj dve prečki na prst in igraj D-durovo lestvico.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: Press both strings of a pair with one fingertip, just behind the metal fret. Mandolin strings are tight, so use the very tip and press only as hard as a clean note needs.
rows.translation: Obe struni para pritisni z eno konico prsta tik za kovinsko prečko. Strune mandoline so napete, zato uporabi sam vrh prsta in pritisni le toliko, da je ton čist.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: Right behind the fret takes the least pressure and gives the cleanest note.
rows.translation: Tik za prečko potrebuješ najmanj pritiska in dobiš najčistejši ton.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: Open, fret 2, fret 4: D, E, F♯.
rows.translation: Prazna, prečka 2, prečka 4: D, E, F♯.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: Mandolin frets are close together, so each finger covers two. First finger plays frets 1 and 2, second finger 3 and 4, third finger 5 and 6, little finger 7.
rows.translation: Prečke mandoline so blizu skupaj, zato vsak prst pokriva dve. Prvi prst igra prečki 1 in 2, drugi 3 in 4, tretji 5 in 6, mezinec pa 7.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: Each finger covers two frets on mandolin, so the second finger handles frets 3 and 4.
rows.translation: Vsak prst na mandolini pokriva dve prečki, zato drugi skrbi za prečki 3 in 4.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: The A pair works the same way: open is A, fret 2 is B, fret 4 is C♯ and fret 5 is D. Your hand stays where it is.
rows.translation: Par A deluje enako: prazni je A, prečka 2 je B, prečka 4 je C♯ in prečka 5 je D. Roka ostane, kjer je.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: Open, then first, second and third fingers on pair 2.
rows.translation: Prazni par, nato prvi, drugi in tretji prst na paru 2.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: Join the two shapes and you have the D major scale: D, E, F♯, G on pair 3, then A, B, C♯, D on pair 2. It is home for a great many fiddle tunes.
rows.translation: Združi prijema in dobiš D-durovo lestvico: D, E, F♯, G na paru 3, nato A, B, C♯, D na paru 2. V njej domujejo številne ljudske viže.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: What comes after G in the D major scale?
rows.translation: Kaj sledi G v D-durovi lestvici?
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: After G on pair 3 comes A. Play it on the open A pair rather than reaching for fret 7.
rows.translation: Za G na paru 3 pride A. Igraj ga na praznem paru A, namesto da segaš do prečke 7.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: Beethoven's melody uses only the first five notes of D major, on pairs 3 and 2. Keep your fingers hovering close to the strings between notes.
rows.translation: Beethovnova melodija uporablja le prvih pet tonov D-dura na parih 3 in 2. Prsti naj med toni lebdijo blizu strun.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: F♯ and G on pair 3, then the open A pair.
rows.translation: F♯ in G na paru 3, nato prazni par A.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: Where does the second phrase land?
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: The first phrase stops on E and sounds unfinished. The second lands on D and sounds like home.
rows.translation: Prva fraza se ustavi na E in zveni nedokončano. Druga pristane na D in zveni kot prihod domov.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: On the E pair, fret 2 is F♯, fret 3 is G and fret 5 is A. First, second and third fingers, just as before.
rows.translation: Na paru E je prečka 2 F♯, prečka 3 G in prečka 5 A. Prvi, drugi in tretji prst, tako kot prej.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: Fret 3 sits in the second finger's zone, frets 3 and 4.
rows.translation: Prečka 3 je v območju drugega prsta, ki pokriva prečki 3 in 4.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: A to A over two pairs
rows.translation: Od A do A čez dva para
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: Fingers one, two and three on frets 2, 4 and 5, with open pairs in between. Play smoothly and let each note ring until the next.
rows.translation: Prvi, drugi in tretji prst na prečkah 2, 4 in 5, vmes prazni pari. Igraj gladko in pusti vsakemu tonu zveneti do naslednjega.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: Every other note of the scale: D, F♯, A, D.
rows.translation: Vsak drugi ton lestvice: D, F♯, A, D.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: You need C♯ on pair 2. Which fret?
rows.translation: Potrebuješ C♯ na paru 2. Katera prečka?
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: On pair 2, fret 2 is B, fret 3 is C and fret 4 is C♯.
rows.translation: Na paru 2 je prečka 2 B, prečka 3 C in prečka 4 C♯.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: Does the tune go up or down?
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: D all the way up to A
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: Ode to Joy, up to speed
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: Alternate your pick in eighth notes and make long notes sing with tremolo.
rows.translation: Izmenjuj trzalico v osminkah in s tremolom daj dolgim tonom pevski zven.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: Down on the beat, up between
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: Pick down on each beat and up on the and in between. Your hand swings like a pendulum, down, up, down, up, even when a note waits.
rows.translation: S trzalico igraj dol na vsako dobo in gor na vmesni in. Roka niha kot nihalo: dol, gor, dol, gor, tudi ko ton čaka.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: Which stroke lands on the beat?
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: Down on the beat and up in between keeps your hand in time, like a drummer's sticks.
rows.translation: Dol na dobo in gor vmes ohranja roko v ritmu, kot bobnarski palici.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: When you move to another pair, your hand keeps its down-up swing. The forearm carries you across; the wrist keeps the beat.
rows.translation: Ko preideš na drug par, roka nadaljuje nihanje dol-gor. Podlaket te prenese čez; zapestje ohranja dobo.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: You cross to a new pair on an and. Which stroke?
rows.translation: Na nov par preideš na in. Kateri udarec?
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: Every and gets an up stroke. Let the pendulum decide, not the string.
rows.translation: Vsak in dobi udarec navzgor. Naj odloči nihalo, ne struna.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: A mandolin note fades quickly. Tremolo keeps it singing: pick down and up fast and evenly on one pair, so the note sounds unbroken.
rows.translation: Ton mandoline hitro zamre. Tremolo ga ohranja pojočega: po enem paru igraj hitro in enakomerno dol in gor, da ton zveni neprekinjeno.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: Keep the pick close to the strings and the strokes even. Speed comes later, once the motion is relaxed.
rows.translation: Trzalico ohranjaj blizu strun, udarce pa enakomerne. Hitrost pride pozneje, ko je gib sproščen.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: Start by counting four strokes to each beat. As it gets easier, stop counting and keep the motion quick and steady. The beat lives in your foot, not in your pick.
rows.translation: Začni s štetjem štirih udarcev na dobo. Ko postane lažje, nehaj šteti in ohrani gib hiter ter enakomeren. Doba živi v stopalu, ne v trzalici.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: Amazing Grace moves in three beats to the bar. Tremolo through each long note and change notes right on the beat. Two notes are new: A and B on the G pair.
rows.translation: Amazing Grace ima tri dobe na takt. Vsak dolg ton igraj s tremolom in tone menjaj točno na dobo. Dva tona sta nova: A in B na paru G.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: Pair 4, fret 2 with your first finger, then fret 4 with your second.
rows.translation: Par 4, prečka 2 s prvim prstom, nato prečka 4 z drugim.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: How do you hold the long A at the end?
rows.translation: Kako na koncu držiš dolgi A?
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.translation: Enkrat udari s trzalico in počakaj
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: A single pick fades long before three beats are up. Tremolo keeps it ringing to the end of the bar.
rows.translation: En udarec zamre dolgo pred koncem treh dob. Tremolo ohranja ton do konca takta.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: Down on the beat, up in between, and tremolo whenever a note needs to last. Keep every stroke small.
rows.translation: Dol na dobo, gor vmes in tremolo, kadar mora ton trajati. Vsak udarec naj bo majhen.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: Which stroke plays the and of beat 2?
rows.translation: Kateri udarec igra in za dobo 2?
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: Every and gets an up stroke, wherever the note is.
rows.translation: Vsak in dobi udarec navzgor, ne glede na mesto tona.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: G, D, C, E minor and A, then the short, choked chord that drives bluegrass.
rows.translation: G, D, C, E-mol in A, nato kratek, zadušen akord, ki poganja bluegrass.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: First finger on fret 2 of pair 2, second finger on fret 3 of pair 1. Pairs 4 and 3 ring open.
rows.translation: Prvi prst na prečki 2 para 2, drugi prst na prečki 3 para 1. Para 4 in 3 zvenita prazna.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: Brush the pick down across all four pairs in one smooth motion, low to high. Small and light is enough; mandolin chords are bright.
rows.translation: S trzalico gladko potegni navzdol čez vse štiri pare, od nizkega do visokega. Majhno in lahkotno je dovolj; akordi mandoline so svetli.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: First finger on fret 2 of pair 4, second finger on fret 2 of pair 1. Pairs 3 and 2 ring open.
rows.translation: Prvi prst na prečki 2 para 4, drugi prst na prečki 2 para 1. Para 3 in 2 zvenita prazna.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: First finger on fret 2 of pair 3, second finger on fret 3 of pair 2. Pairs 4 and 1 ring open.
rows.translation: Prvi prst na prečki 2 para 3, drugi prst na prečki 3 para 2. Para 4 in 1 zvenita prazna.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: From C, slide your second finger back to fret 2. The chord turns darker, though only one finger moved.
rows.translation: Iz C pomakni drugi prst nazaj na prečko 2. Akord postane temnejši, čeprav se premakne le en prst.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: Fret 2 on pairs 4 and 3, fret 4 on pair 2, fret 5 on pair 1: fingers one, two, three and four. No pair rings open.
rows.translation: Prečka 2 na parih 4 in 3, prečka 4 na paru 2, prečka 5 na paru 1: prvi, drugi, tretji in četrti prst. Noben par ne zveni prazen.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: Why does it matter that no pair rings open?
rows.translation: Zakaj je pomembno, da noben par ne zveni prazen?
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: You can silence it by easing off
rows.translation: Utišaš ga lahko s popuščanjem pritiska
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: It keeps the chord in tune
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: With every pair held down, relaxing your fingers stops the sound at once. That is the secret of the chop.
rows.translation: Ko so vsi pari prijeti, sprostitev prstov takoj ustavi zvok. To je skrivnost kratkega dušenega udarca.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: The chop is a short chord on beats 2 and 4. Strum down, then ease your fretting fingers off the strings without lifting them, so the sound stops right away.
rows.translation: Kratki dušeni udarec je kratek akord na dobah 2 in 4. Potegni navzdol, nato popusti pritisk prstov na strune brez dvigovanja, da zvok takoj preneha.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.translation: Na katere dobe pride kratki dušeni udarec?
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: Bass and guitar take beats 1 and 3. The mandolin answers on 2 and 4, like a snare drum.
rows.translation: Bas in kitara prevzameta dobi 1 in 3. Mandolina odgovori na 2 in 4, kot mali boben.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: Let the chord sound for only a moment. If it hangs on, relax your fingers sooner. Your fingertips stay touching the strings the whole time.
rows.translation: Akord naj zveni le trenutek. Če vztraja, prej sprosti prste. Konice naj se ves čas dotikajo strun.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: Chops in G, C and D
rows.translation: Kratki dušeni udarci v G, C in D
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: Your A shape works anywhere on the neck. Slide it up three frets for C and five frets for D. Keep all four fingers in place as you move.
rows.translation: Tvoj prijem A deluje kjer koli na vratu. Za C ga pomakni tri prečke višje, za D pa pet. Med premikom ohrani vse štiri prste na mestu.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: G needs a new stretch: first finger fret 2 on pair 2, second finger fret 3 on pair 1, third finger fret 5 on pair 3, little finger fret 7 on pair 4.
rows.translation: G zahteva nov razteg: prvi prst prečka 2 na paru 2, drugi prečka 3 na paru 1, tretji prečka 5 na paru 3, mezinec prečka 7 na paru 4.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: Strum open chords to learn the sound, then chop on 2 and 4 to drive the band. Keep the beat steady through every change.
rows.translation: Brenkaj odprte akorde, da spoznaš zvok, nato s kratkimi dušenimi udarci na 2 in 4 poganjaj skupino. Ohrani enakomerno dobo skozi vsako menjavo.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: Your chop keeps ringing. What fixes it?
rows.translation: Tvoj kratki dušeni udarec še naprej zveni. Kaj ga popravi?
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: Lift your fingers off the neck
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: Ease off with your fretting fingers sooner
rows.translation: Prej popusti pritisk prstov, ki prijemajo akord
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: The chop is choked by the fretting hand. Relax the pressure but keep your fingertips on the strings.
rows.translation: Kratki udarec zaduši roka na ubiralki. Sprosti pritisk, konice prstov pa ohrani na strunah.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: Five traditional jam tunes, simplified, from Boil Them Cabbage Down to Old Joe Clark.
rows.translation: Pet poenostavljenih tradicionalnih viž za skupno igranje, od Boil Them Cabbage Down do Old Joe Clark.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: This one lives on the E and A pairs and keeps coming back to F♯. Pick down on the beat and up in between, just like your eighth-note drills.
rows.translation: Ta viža se igra na parih E in A ter se vedno znova vrača na F♯. Igraj dol na dobo in gor vmes, kot pri vajah z osminkami.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: F♯, G and A on pair 1 at frets 2, 3 and 5, then D on pair 2, fret 5.
rows.translation: F♯, G in A na paru 1 pri prečkah 2, 3 in 5, nato D na paru 2 pri prečki 5.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: Where does the tune come to rest?
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: Like most tunes in D, it ends on D, the home note.
rows.translation: Kot večina viž v D-duru se konča na D, domačem tonu.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: The low part of Angeline the Baker uses only D, E, F♯, A and B. Both parts end on A instead of D, which sends the tune around again.
rows.translation: Nizki del viže Angeline the Baker uporablja le D, E, F♯, A in B. Oba dela se končata na A namesto na D, kar vižo požene v nov krog.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: Which note do both parts end on?
rows.translation: Na katerem tonu se končata oba dela?
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: Ending on A instead of D leaves the tune hanging, so it rolls straight into the next time through.
rows.translation: Konec na A namesto na D pusti vižo odprto, zato se prelije naravnost v naslednji krog.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: Soldier's Joy was in print in Scotland by 1780 and has filled American jams ever since. Its first part bounces between D, F♯ and A.
rows.translation: Soldier's Joy je bila na Škotskem natisnjena že do leta 1780 in odtlej spremlja ameriška skupna igranja. Njen prvi del poskakuje med D, F♯ in A.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: Open A pair, pair 3 fret 4, open D, then fret 4 again.
rows.translation: Prazni par A, par 3 prečka 4, prazni D, nato spet prečka 4.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: D, F♯ and A together spell which chord?
rows.translation: Kateri akord skupaj sestavljajo D, F♯ in A?
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: D, F♯ and A are the three notes of D major. Fiddle tunes often trace their chords like this.
rows.translation: D, F♯ in A so trije toni D-durovega akorda. Ljudske viže pogosto tako orisujejo svoje akorde.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: Arkansas Traveler starts low, down on the G pair, then jumps up to the E pair for a part that tumbles down the scale. It was in print by the 1840s.
rows.translation: Arkansas Traveler se začne nizko, na paru G, nato skoči na par E za del, ki se spušča po lestvici. Natisnjena je bila že v desetletju z začetkom leta 1840.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: Pair 4, frets 2 and 4, then the open D pair.
rows.translation: Par 4, prečki 2 in 4, nato prazni par D.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: Where does the high part begin?
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: On A, fret 5 of the E pair
rows.translation: Na A pri prečki 5 para E
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: It opens on A at fret 5 of pair 1, then walks down through G, F♯ and E.
rows.translation: Začne se na A pri prečki 5 para 1, nato se spusti skozi G, F♯ in E.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: A new key and a twist
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: Old Joe Clark is in A, so you use C♯ and G♯. In the second part, G♯ drops to plain G on fret 3 of the E pair. That one note gives the tune its old-time sound.
rows.translation: Old Joe Clark je v A, zato uporabljaš C♯ in G♯. V drugem delu G♯ pade na G brez predznaka pri prečki 3 para E. Ta ton daje viži starinski zvok.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: G♯ on pair 3, fret 6; the open A pair; then G on pair 1, fret 3.
rows.translation: G♯ na paru 3 pri prečki 6; prazni par A; nato G na paru 1 pri prečki 3.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: Which note gives the second part its old-time sound?
rows.translation: Kateri ton daje drugemu delu starinski zvok?
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: A major uses G♯. Lowering it to G gives the mixolydian sound that runs through old-time and bluegrass music.
rows.translation: A-dur uporablja G♯. Znižanje na G da miksolidijski zvok, značilen za starinsko ameriško glasbo in bluegrass.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: Play each tune through at a steady tempo. If a note slips, keep your picking hand moving and catch the next beat. That is how real jams work.
rows.translation: Vsako vižo zaigraj do konca v enakomernem tempu. Če se kak ton izmuzne, naj roka za ubiranje nadaljuje gib in ujemi naslednjo dobo. Tako poteka pravo skupno igranje.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: Which tune swaps G♯ for G?
rows.translation: Katera viža zamenja G♯ z G?
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: Old Joe Clark is in A but uses G in its second part. That lowered note is its signature.
rows.translation: Old Joe Clark je v A, a v drugem delu uporablja G. Ta znižani ton je njen zaščitni znak.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: Add the left-hand moves and rolling right hand that make a tune sound like bluegrass.
rows.translation: Dodaj gibe leve roke in tekoče ubiranje desne, ki dajo viži zvok bluegrassa.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: Pick a note, then keep pressing as you glide the same finger up to a higher fret. The new note sounds without a second pick stroke. Light, steady pressure is the trick.
rows.translation: S trzalico zaigraj ton, nato še naprej pritiskaj in z istim prstom zdrsni na višjo prečko. Novi ton zazveni brez drugega udarca trzalice. Ključ je rahel, enakomeren pritisk.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: What sounds the second note in a slide?
rows.translation: Kaj pri slidu ustvari drugi ton?
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: Your finger pressing as it moves
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: Only the first note is picked. Keep pressure on the string as you slide, or the note dies on the way.
rows.translation: S trzalico zaigraš le prvi ton. Med drsenjem ohrani pritisk na struno, sicer ton med potjo zamre.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: Pick an open pair, then snap a fingertip down just behind fret 2. The new note sounds from the tap alone, with no second pick stroke.
rows.translation: S trzalico zaigraj prazni par, nato hitro spusti konico prsta tik za prečko 2. Novi ton zazveni samo od udarca prsta, brez drugega udarca trzalice.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: The reverse: with a finger on fret 2, pick, then pull the finger slightly sideways as you lift. That flick plucks the open note below.
rows.translation: Obratno: s prstom na prečki 2 zaigraj s trzalico, nato prst pri dvigu potegni malo vstran. Ta gib ubere spodnji prazni ton.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: Which moves sound a note without the pick?
rows.translation: Kateri gibi ustvarijo ton brez trzalice?
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: All three sound a second note with the fretting hand. The pick plays only the first.
rows.translation: Vsi trije ustvarijo drugi ton z roko na ubiralki. Trzalica zaigra le prvega.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: Fiddle tunes come alive with small ornaments. Here the two plain A notes that open Old Joe Clark become A, B, A: a hammer-on and a pull-off.
rows.translation: Ljudske viže oživijo z drobnimi okraski. Tu se začetna navadna tona A v Old Joe Clark spremenita v A, B, A: hammer-on in pull-off.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: In A, B, A, how many times do you pick?
rows.translation: Kolikokrat udariš s trzalico v A, B, A?
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: Pick the first A, hammer on to B and pull off back to A. One pick, three notes.
rows.translation: Prvi A zaigraj s trzalico, s hammer-onom pojdi na B in s pull-offom nazaj na A. En udarec, trije toni.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: Crosspicking picks single notes across three pairs in a repeating pattern, so a chord sounds like a ripple. Eight notes split three, three and two.
rows.translation: Pri križnem ubiranju igraš posamezne tone čez tri pare v ponavljajočem se vzorcu, da akord zveni kot valovanje. Osem tonov razdeliš na tri, tri in dva.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: How are the eight notes of a crosspicking bar grouped?
rows.translation: Kako je razvrščenih osem tonov takta pri križnem ubiranju?
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: A three-note pattern repeated across a bar of eight makes the accent shift each time. That is the rolling feel.
rows.translation: Ponavljanje tritonskega vzorca čez takt osmih tonov vsakič premakne poudarek. To ustvari občutek tekočega valovanja.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: Ripple through G, C and D
rows.translation: Valovanje skozi G, C in D
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: Slides, hammer-ons, chops and crosspicking. Take each one at your own pace, and keep the beat steady above all.
rows.translation: Slidi, hammer-oni, kratki dušeni udarci in križno ubiranje. Vsakega se loti v svojem tempu, predvsem pa ohrani enakomerno dobo.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: Which beats does the chop land on?
rows.translation: Na katere dobe pade kratki dušeni udarec?
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: Five-string, open G: rolls, old-time tunes and clawhammer
rows.translation: Pet strun, odprti G: vzorci ubiranja, starinske viže in clawhammer
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: Meet the five strings, tune to open G, find the drone string and play a song.
rows.translation: Spoznaj pet strun, jih uglasi v odprti G, poišči bordunsko struno in zaigraj pesem.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: A banjo has four full-length strings and a fifth that starts partway up the neck, at its own little tuning peg. That short string is the banjo's signature sound.
rows.translation: Bendžo ima štiri strune polne dolžine in peto, ki se začne del poti po vratu, pri svojem majhnem ključu. Ta kratka struna daje bendžu značilen zvok.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1
