rows.source: A bar can mix values, as long as they add up. A half note plus two quarter notes fills four beats: 2 + 1 + 1.
rows.translation: V taktu lahko mešaš vrednosti, če je vsota pravilna. Polovinka in dve četrtinki zapolnijo štiri dobe: 2 + 1 + 1.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: An eighth note lasts half a beat, so two fit in each beat. Count them 1 and 2 and 3 and 4 and, saying and between the beats.
rows.translation: Osminka traja pol dobe, zato gresta dve v vsako dobo. Štej jih 1 in 2 in 3 in 4 in, z besedo in med dobami.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: An eighth note lasts half a beat.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: A sixteenth note lasts a quarter of a beat, so four fit in each beat. Count them 1 e and a, 2 e and a.
rows.translation: Šestnajstinka traja četrt dobe, zato gredo štiri v vsako dobo. Štej jih 1 e in a, 2 e in a.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: How many sixteenth notes equal one quarter note?
rows.translation: Koliko šestnajstink je enako eni četrtinki?
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: A quarter note is one beat, and four sixteenths fit in a beat.
rows.translation: Četrtinka je ena doba, v dobo pa gredo štiri šestnajstinke.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: How many eighth notes fill a bar of four beats?
rows.translation: Koliko osmink zapolni takt s štirimi dobami?
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: Two per beat, four beats: eight eighth notes.
rows.translation: Dve na dobo, štiri dobe: osem osmink.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: A dot after a note adds half its value. A half note lasts two beats, so a dotted half lasts three. A dotted quarter lasts one and a half.
rows.translation: Pika za noto doda polovico njene vrednosti. Polovinka traja dve dobi, zato polovinka s piko traja tri. Četrtinka s piko traja dobo in pol.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: Half of two is one, so the dot adds one beat: 2 + 1 = 3.
rows.translation: Polovica dveh je ena, zato pika doda eno dobo: 2 + 1 = 3.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: A rest is a measured silence. Each note value has a matching rest: a quarter rest lasts one beat, a half rest two. Keep counting through them.
rows.translation: Pavza je odmerjena tišina. Vsaka notna vrednost ima ustrezno pavzo: četrtinska traja eno dobo, polovinska dve. Tudi med njimi štej.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: A quarter is one beat; the dot adds half of that.
rows.translation: Četrtinka je ena doba; pika doda polovico tega.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: A four-beat bar has a half note and a quarter note. What fills the gap?
rows.translation: Takt s štirimi dobami ima polovinko in četrtinko. Kaj zapolni vrzel?
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: 2 + 1 = 3, so one beat is left: a quarter rest.
rows.translation: 2 + 1 = 3, zato ostane ena doba: četrtinska pavza.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: The two stacked numbers at the start of a piece are the time signature. The top number counts beats per bar. The bottom shows which note gets one beat: 4 means a quarter note.
rows.translation: Števili druga nad drugo na začetku skladbe označujeta taktovski način. Zgornje šteje dobe v taktu. Spodnje pove, katera nota dobi eno dobo: 4 pomeni četrtinko.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: In 4/4, how many quarter-note beats are in a bar?
rows.translation: Koliko četrtinskih dob je v taktu 4/4?
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: The top 4 means four beats; the bottom 4 makes each one a quarter note.
rows.translation: Zgornja 4 pomeni štiri dobe; spodnja 4 določi, da je vsaka četrtinka.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: In 3/4, each bar holds three quarter-note beats. Count 1, 2, 3, with the weight on 1. It's the lilt of a waltz.
rows.translation: V 3/4 ima vsak takt tri četrtinske dobe. Štej 1, 2, 3, s poudarkom na 1. To je zibanje valčka.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: Which time signature is a waltz usually in?
rows.translation: V katerem taktovskem načinu je običajno valček?
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: In 6/8, each bar holds six eighth notes in two groups of three. It feels like two big beats, each split in three: 1 2 3, 4 5 6.
rows.translation: V 6/8 ima vsak takt šest osmink v dveh skupinah po tri. Čutimo dve veliki dobi, vsako razdeljeno na tri: 1 2 3, 4 5 6.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: Two beats, each split in three
rows.translation: Dve dobi, vsaka razdeljena na tri
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: Three beats, each split in two
rows.translation: Tri dobe, vsaka razdeljena na dve
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: The eighths group 1 2 3, 4 5 6, so you feel two strong pulses per bar.
rows.translation: Osminke se združijo v 1 2 3, 4 5 6, zato čutiš dva močna utripa na takt.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: In 3/4, which single note fills a whole bar?
rows.translation: Katera posamezna nota zapolni ves takt 3/4?
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: Three beats: a half note (2) plus its dot (1).
rows.translation: Tri dobe: polovinka (2) in njena pika (1).
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: Note values, dots, rests and time signatures together. Count out loud as you tap; your voice keeps your hands honest.
rows.translation: Notne vrednosti, pike, pavze in taktovski načini skupaj. Med trkanjem štej na glas; glas ohranja roke natančne.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: How many beats does a whole note last in 4/4?
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: How many sixteenth notes fit in one beat?
rows.translation: Koliko šestnajstink gre v eno dobo?
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: What does a dot add to a note?
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: A bar of 3/4 has a quarter note and a quarter rest. What's missing?
rows.translation: Takt 3/4 ima četrtinko in četrtinsko pavzo. Kaj manjka?
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: 3/4 holds three beats; 1 + 1 = 2, so one beat remains.
rows.translation: 3/4 ima tri dobe; 1 + 1 = 2, zato ostane ena doba.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: How many eighth notes are in a bar of 6/8?
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: The whole-and-half-step recipe, four major keys, and their key signatures.
rows.translation: Recept celih tonov in poltonov, štiri durove tonalitete in njihovi stalni predznaki.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: A scale is a set of notes climbing in order from a home note to the same note an octave up. C major uses only white keys: C, D, E, F, G, A, B, C.
rows.translation: Lestvica je niz tonov, ki se po vrsti vzpenja od domačega tona do istega tona oktavo višje. C-dur uporablja le bele tipke: C, D, E, F, G, A, B, C.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: How many different letters are in a major scale?
rows.translation: Koliko različnih črk je v durovi lestvici?
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: Seven letters, then the first one returns an octave higher.
rows.translation: Sedem črk, nato se prva vrne oktavo višje.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: Is this scale going up or down?
rows.translation: Gre ta lestvica navzgor ali navzdol?
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: In C major, most neighbors are a whole step apart. Only E to F and B to C are half steps. That uneven spacing gives the scale its sound.
rows.translation: V C-duru je med večino sosedov cel ton. Le od E do F in od B do C sta poltona. Ti neenaki razmiki dajejo lestvici njen zvok.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: In C major, which steps are half steps?
rows.translation: Kateri koraki v C-duru so poltoni?
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: C to D and F to G
rows.translation: Od C do D in od F do G
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: E to F and B to C
rows.translation: Od E do F in od B do C
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: D to E and A to B
rows.translation: Od D do E in od A do B
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: E and F, and B and C, have no black key between them.
rows.translation: Med E in F ter med B in C ni črne tipke.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: What's the home note of C major?
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: The home note, called the tonic, gives the scale its name.
rows.translation: Domači ton, imenovan tonika, daje lestvici ime.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: Play or sing the C major scale, up from middle C.
rows.translation: Zaigraj ali zapoj C-durovo lestvico navzgor od srednjega C.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: Every major scale follows one recipe of steps: whole, whole, half, whole, whole, whole, half. Start on any note, follow it, and you build a major scale.
rows.translation: Vsaka durova lestvica sledi istemu receptu korakov: cel ton, cel ton, polton, cel ton, cel ton, cel ton, polton. Začni na katerem koli tonu, sledi receptu in sestaviš durovo lestvico.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: Which is the major scale recipe? (W = whole, H = half)
rows.translation: Kateri je recept durove lestvice? (W = cel ton, H = polton)
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: W W H W W W H
rows.translation: W W H W W W H
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: W H W W H W W
rows.translation: W H W W H W W
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: W W W H W W H
rows.translation: W W W H W W H
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: Whole, whole, half, whole, whole, whole, half.
rows.translation: Cel ton, cel ton, polton, cel ton, cel ton, cel ton, polton.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: Number the scale's notes 1 to 8. Where are the half steps?
rows.translation: Tone lestvice oštevilči od 1 do 8. Kje so poltoni?
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: Whole, whole, then half from 3 to 4; whole, whole, whole, then half from 7 to 8.
rows.translation: Cel ton, cel ton, nato polton od 3 do 4; cel ton, cel ton, cel ton, nato polton od 7 do 8.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: Starting on G, a whole step up lands on...
rows.translation: Če začneš na G, prideš cel ton višje na ...
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: G to A skips one key, G♯.
rows.translation: Od G do A preskočiš eno tipko, G♯.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: Play or sing the first four notes of D major: whole, whole, half.
rows.translation: Zaigraj ali zapoj prve štiri tone D-dura: cel ton, cel ton, polton.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: Start on G and follow the recipe: G, A, B, C, D, E, then a whole step to F♯ and a half step home to G. G major has one sharp: F♯.
rows.translation: Začni na G in sledi receptu: G, A, B, C, D, E, nato cel ton do F♯ in polton domov do G. G-dur ima en višaj: F♯.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: Why does G major need F♯ instead of F?
rows.translation: Zakaj G-dur potrebuje F♯ namesto F?
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: F is too low to sing
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: E to F is only a half step
rows.translation: Od E do F je le polton
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: The recipe needs a whole step from note 6 to 7, then a half step from 7 up to G.
rows.translation: Recept potrebuje cel ton od tona 6 do 7, nato polton od 7 navzgor do G.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: Which note is in G major?
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: G major's seventh note is F♯.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: How many sharps are in G major?
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: Play or sing the G major scale. Remember the F♯.
rows.translation: Zaigraj ali zapoj G-durovo lestvico. Ne pozabi na F♯.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: From D, the recipe gives D, E, F♯, G, A, B, C♯, D. D major has two sharps: F♯ and C♯.
rows.translation: Od D recept da D, E, F♯, G, A, B, C♯, D. D-dur ima dva višaja: F♯ in C♯.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: Which two sharps are in D major?
rows.translation: Katera dva višaja sta v D-duru?
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: Following the recipe from D lands on F♯ as note 3 and C♯ as note 7.
rows.translation: Če slediš receptu od D, je F♯ ton 3, C♯ pa ton 7.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: From F, the recipe needs a half step from A to the fourth note, so it's B♭, not B. F major: F, G, A, B♭, C, D, E, F. One flat: B♭.
rows.translation: Od F recept potrebuje polton od A do četrtega tona, zato je to B♭, ne B. F-dur: F, G, A, B♭, C, D, E, F. En nižaj: B♭.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: Which note is in F major?
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: F major's fourth note is B♭, a half step above A.
rows.translation: Četrti ton F-dura je B♭, polton nad A.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: Which major key has two sharps?
rows.translation: Katera durova tonaliteta ima dva višaja?
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: D major has F♯ and C♯.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: Play or sing up F major from F to C. The fourth note is B♭.
rows.translation: Zaigraj ali zapoj F-dur navzgor od F do C. Četrti ton je B♭.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: Rather than writing F♯ every time, music in G major puts one sharp at the start of each line. That's the key signature: it lists the notes that are always sharp or flat.
rows.translation: Namesto vsakokratnega zapisovanja F♯ ima glasba v G-duru en višaj na začetku vsake vrstice. To so stalni predznaki: navedejo tone, ki so vedno zvišani ali znižani.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: A key signature has one sharp, F♯. Which major key is it?
rows.translation: Med stalnimi predznaki je en višaj, F♯. Katera durova tonaliteta je to?
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: G major is the major key with just F♯.
rows.translation: G-dur je durova tonaliteta s samo F♯.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: A key signature has one flat, B♭. Which major key is it?
rows.translation: Med stalnimi predznaki je en nižaj, B♭. Katera durova tonaliteta je to?
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: F major is the major key with just B♭.
rows.translation: F-dur je durova tonaliteta s samo B♭.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: Sharps always appear in the same order: F♯, C♯, G♯, and so on. The last sharp is a half step below the key's name. One sharp, F♯: G major.
rows.translation: Višaji se vedno pojavijo v istem vrstnem redu: F♯, C♯, G♯ in tako naprej. Zadnji višaj je polton pod imenom tonalitete. En višaj, F♯: G-dur.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: A key signature has two sharps, F♯ and C♯. Which major key is it?
rows.translation: Med stalnimi predznaki sta dva višaja, F♯ in C♯. Katera durova tonaliteta je to?
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: The last sharp, C♯, is a half step below D.
rows.translation: Zadnji višaj, C♯, je polton pod D.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: Which major key has no sharps or flats?
rows.translation: Katera durova tonaliteta nima višajev ali nižajev?
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: C major uses only white keys.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: The key signature shows B♭. Which Bs are played as B♭?
rows.translation: Stalni predznaki kažejo B♭. Kateri toni B se igrajo kot B♭?
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: A key signature applies to every B in every octave, unless the music marks otherwise.
rows.translation: Stalni predznak velja za vsak B v vsaki oktavi, razen če je v notah označeno drugače.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: Play or sing D major, with its two sharps: F♯ and C♯.
rows.translation: Zaigraj ali zapoj D-dur z njegovima višajema: F♯ in C♯.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: The recipe, four keys and their signatures. When unsure, build the scale from its home note: whole, whole, half, whole, whole, whole, half.
rows.translation: Recept, štiri tonalitete in njihovi predznaki. Če nisi prepričan, lestvico sestavi od domačega tona: cel ton, cel ton, polton, cel ton, cel ton, cel ton, polton.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: Which note belongs in G major?
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: G major's only sharp is F♯.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: Which major key has one flat?
rows.translation: Katera durova tonaliteta ima en nižaj?
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: F major's one flat is B♭.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: Which scale has the notes D, E, F♯, G, A, B, C♯?
rows.translation: Katera lestvica ima tone D, E, F♯, G, A, B, C♯?
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: In every major scale, which step is a half step?
rows.translation: Kateri korak je polton v vsaki durovi lestvici?
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: Whole, whole, half: the first half step falls between notes 3 and 4.
rows.translation: Cel ton, cel ton, polton: prvi polton je med tonoma 3 in 4.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: Which key signature belongs to G major?
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: Play or sing F major, with its B♭.
rows.translation: Zaigraj ali zapoj F-dur z njegovim B♭.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: Name the distance between two notes by number and quality, and measure it in half steps.
rows.translation: Poimenuj razdaljo med tonoma po številu in vrsti ter jo izmeri v poltonih.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: An interval's number comes from counting letter names, including both ends. C up to E counts C, D, E: three letters, so it's a third.
rows.translation: Število intervala dobimo s štetjem črkovnih imen, vključno z obema koncema. Od C navzgor do E štejemo C, D, E: tri črke, torej terca.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: C up to G is a...
rows.translation: Od C navzgor do G je ...
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: C, D, E, F, G: five letters.
rows.translation: C, D, E, F, G: pet črk.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: E, F, G, A: four letters.
rows.translation: E, F, G, A: štiri črke.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: Sharps and flats don't change an interval's number. C to E♭ and C to E are both thirds: C, D, E either way. They differ in size, which comes next.
rows.translation: Višaji in nižaji ne spremenijo števila intervala. Od C do E♭ in od C do E sta obe terci: v obeh primerih C, D, E. Razlikujeta se po velikosti, kar sledi.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: F up to D is a...
rows.translation: Od F navzgor do D je ...
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: F, G, A, B, C, D: six letters.
rows.translation: F, G, A, B, C, D: šest črk.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: A up to E♭ is a...
rows.translation: Od A navzgor do E♭ je ...
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: A, B, C, D, E: five letters. The flat doesn't change the count.
rows.translation: A, B, C, D, E: pet črk. Nižaj ne spremeni štetja.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: G up to the next G is a...
rows.translation: Od G navzgor do naslednjega G je ...
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: G, A, B, C, D, E, F, G: eight letters, an octave.
rows.translation: G, A, B, C, D, E, F, G: osem črk, oktava.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: Two intervals with the same number can differ in size. To measure exactly, count half steps. C up to E is four; C up to E♭ is three.
rows.translation: Dva intervala z istim številom se lahko razlikujeta po velikosti. Za natančno meritev preštej poltone. Od C navzgor do E so štirje; od C navzgor do E♭ trije.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: How many half steps from D up to F?
rows.translation: Koliko poltonov je od D navzgor do F?
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: D, D♯, E, F: three moves.
rows.translation: D, D♯, E, F: trije premiki.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: A third of four half steps is a major third, like C to E. A third of three is a minor third, like C to E♭ or A to C.
rows.translation: Terca s štirimi poltoni je velika terca, kot od C do E. Terca s tremi je mala terca, kot od C do E♭ ali od A do C.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: E up to G♯ is a...
rows.translation: Od E navzgor do G♯ je ...
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: E to G♯ spans four half steps.
rows.translation: Od E do G♯ so štirje poltoni.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: A up to C is a...
rows.translation: Od A navzgor do C je ...
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: A to C spans three half steps.
rows.translation: Od A do C so trije poltoni.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: G up to B♭ is a...
rows.translation: Od G navzgor do B♭ je ...
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: G to B♭ spans three half steps.
rows.translation: Od G do B♭ so trije poltoni.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: Unisons, fourths, fifths and octaves are called perfect. A perfect fourth spans five half steps, a perfect fifth seven, and an octave twelve.
rows.translation: Prime, kvarte, kvinte in oktave imenujemo čisti intervali. Čista kvarta obsega pet poltonov, čista kvinta sedem, oktava pa dvanajst.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: How many half steps are in a perfect fifth?
rows.translation: Koliko poltonov je v čisti kvinti?
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: C up to G: seven half steps.
rows.translation: Od C navzgor do G: sedem poltonov.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: C up to F is a...
rows.translation: Od C navzgor do F je ...
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: C to F spans five half steps.
rows.translation: Od C do F je pet poltonov.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: Watch out for B and F
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: Most white-key fifths are perfect, but B up to F spans only six half steps. It's called a diminished fifth. When in doubt, count half steps.
rows.translation: Večina kvint na belih tipkah je čistih, toda od B navzgor do F je le šest poltonov. Temu pravimo zmanjšana kvinta. Ko si v dvomih, preštej poltone.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: Which of these fifths is smaller than perfect?
rows.translation: Katera od teh kvint je manjša od čiste?
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: B to F spans six half steps; a perfect fifth needs seven.
rows.translation: Od B do F je šest poltonov; čista kvinta jih potrebuje sedem.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: A up to D is a...
rows.translation: Od A navzgor do D je ...
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: A, B, C, D: four letters, five half steps.
rows.translation: A, B, C, D: štiri črke, pet poltonov.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: Seconds, thirds, sixths and sevenths come in major and minor sizes. Minor is always one half step smaller than major.
rows.translation: Sekunde, terce, sekste in septime so velike ali male. Mali interval je vedno polton manjši od velikega.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: Minor second 1, major second 2. Minor third 3, major third 4. Minor sixth 8, major sixth 9. Minor seventh 10, major seventh 11.
rows.translation: Mala sekunda 1, velika sekunda 2. Mala terca 3, velika terca 4. Mala seksta 8, velika seksta 9. Mala septima 10, velika septima 11.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: C up to A is a...
rows.translation: Od C navzgor do A je ...
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: C to A spans nine half steps.
rows.translation: Od C do A je devet poltonov.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: C up to B♭ is a...
rows.translation: Od C navzgor do B♭ je ...
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: C to B♭ spans ten half steps.
rows.translation: Od C do B♭ je deset poltonov.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: E to F is a single half step.
rows.translation: Od E do F je en sam polton.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: How many half steps are in a major seventh?
rows.translation: Koliko poltonov je v veliki septimi?
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: One half step short of an octave.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: E up to C is a...
rows.translation: Od E navzgor do C je ...
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: E, F, G, A, B, C makes a sixth. It spans eight half steps, so it's minor.
rows.translation: E, F, G, A, B, C sestavlja seksto. Obsega osem poltonov, zato je mala.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: Count letters for the number. Count half steps for the size. Together they name any interval.
rows.translation: Za število preštej črke. Za velikost preštej poltone. Skupaj poimenujeta vsak interval.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: F up to A is a...
rows.translation: Od F navzgor do A je ...
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: F, G, A is a third, and four half steps makes it major.
rows.translation: F, G, A je terca, štirje poltoni pa jo naredijo veliko.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: D up to A is a...
rows.translation: Od D navzgor do A je ...
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: D to A spans seven half steps.
rows.translation: Od D do A je sedem poltonov.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: B up to D is a...
rows.translation: Od B navzgor do D je ...
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: B, C, D is a third of three half steps: minor.
rows.translation: B, C, D je terca s tremi poltoni: mala.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: How many half steps are in a major sixth?
rows.translation: Koliko poltonov je v veliki seksti?
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: G up to F is a...
rows.translation: Od G navzgor do F je ...
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: G to F covers seven letters and ten half steps: a minor seventh.
rows.translation: Od G do F je sedem črk in deset poltonov: mala septima.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: Stack thirds into triads, build major and minor chords, and number the chords of a key.
rows.translation: Zloži terce v trozvoke, sestavi durove in molove akorde ter oštevilči akorde tonalitete.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: A triad is three notes stacked in thirds. Start on any note, skip a letter, take the next, skip again. C, skip D, E, skip F, G: C E G.
rows.translation: Trozvok so trije toni, zloženi v tercah. Začni na katerem koli tonu, preskoči črko, vzemi naslednjo, spet preskoči. C, preskoči D, E, preskoči F, G: C E G.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: Which notes make a triad built on G?
rows.translation: Kateri toni sestavljajo trozvok na G?
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: G, skip A, B, skip C, D.
rows.translation: G, preskoči A, B, preskoči C, D.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: The note a triad is built on is its root. The middle note is the third and the top note is the fifth, named for their distance above the root.
rows.translation: Ton, na katerem je zgrajen trozvok, je njegov osnovni ton. Srednji je terca, zgornji pa kvinta, poimenovana po razdalji nad osnovnim tonom.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: In the triad F A C, which note is the root?
rows.translation: Kateri ton je osnovni ton v trozvoku F A C?
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: F is the bottom note the triad is built on.
rows.translation: F je spodnji ton, na katerem je zgrajen trozvok.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: In the triad D F A, which note is the fifth?
rows.translation: Kateri ton je kvinta v trozvoku D F A?
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: D up to A is a fifth: D, E, F, G, A.
rows.translation: Od D navzgor do A je kvinta: D, E, F, G, A.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: Using only white keys, which triad is built on E?
rows.translation: Kateri trozvok na E dobiš samo z belimi tipkami?
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: E, skip F, G, skip A, B.
rows.translation: E, preskoči F, G, preskoči A, B.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: Play or sing the C triad one note at a time: C, E, G.
rows.translation: Zaigraj ali zapoj C-trozvok po en ton: C, E, G.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: A major triad has a major third on the bottom, four half steps, then a minor third on top. C E G is major. So are F A C and G B D.
rows.translation: Durov trozvok ima spodaj veliko terco, štiri poltone, nato zgoraj malo terco. C E G je durov. Prav tako F A C in G B D.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: Flip the thirds and you get minor: a minor third on the bottom, then a major third. Lower the middle note of C major and you get C minor: C E♭ G.
rows.translation: Obrni terci in dobiš mol: spodaj mala terca, nato velika. Znižaj srednji ton C-dura in dobiš C-mol: C E♭ G.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: D to F is a minor third; F to A is a major third.
rows.translation: Od D do F je mala terca; od F do A je velika terca.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: E to G♯ is a major third; G♯ to B is a minor third.
rows.translation: Od E do G♯ je velika terca; od G♯ do B je mala terca.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: Is A C E major or minor?
rows.translation: Je A C E durov ali molov?
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: A to C is a minor third, three half steps.
rows.translation: Od A do C je mala terca, trije poltoni.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: Play or sing A minor one note at a time: A, C, E.
rows.translation: Zaigraj ali zapoj A-mol po en ton: A, C, E.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: Build a triad on each note of a scale, using only that scale's notes, and you get the key's family of chords. C major has seven, one per note.
rows.translation: Na vsakem tonu lestvice sestavi trozvok samo iz njenih tonov in dobiš družino akordov tonalitete. C-dur jih ima sedem, po enega na ton.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: Using only C major notes, what triad is built on D?
rows.translation: Kateri trozvok na D dobiš samo s toni C-dura?
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: D F A: a minor third, then a major third.
rows.translation: D F A: mala terca, nato velika terca.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: Using only C major notes, what triad is built on G?
rows.translation: Kateri trozvok na G dobiš samo s toni C-dura?
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: G B D: a major third, then a minor third.
rows.translation: G B D: velika terca, nato mala terca.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: The triad on B is different: B D F. Both thirds are minor, so it's a diminished triad. It sounds tense and wants to move.
rows.translation: Trozvok na B je drugačen: B D F. Obe terci sta mali, zato je zmanjšani trozvok. Zveni napeto in se želi premakniti.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: In C major, which chords are major?
rows.translation: Kateri akordi so durovi v C-duru?
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: C E G, F A C and G B D each have a major third on the bottom.
rows.translation: C E G, F A C in G B D imajo vsi spodaj veliko terco.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: Using only C major notes, what triad is built on A?
rows.translation: Kateri trozvok na A dobiš samo s toni C-dura?
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: A C E: a minor third, then a major third.
rows.translation: A C E: mala terca, nato velika terca.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: Play or sing the diminished triad on B: B, D, F.
rows.translation: Zaigraj ali zapoj zmanjšani trozvok na B: B, D, F.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: Musicians number a key's chords with Roman numerals: I for the chord on note 1, up to vii for note 7. Uppercase means major, lowercase minor, and ° diminished.
rows.translation: Glasbeniki akorde tonalitete številčijo z rimskimi številkami: I za akord na tonu 1, do vii za ton 7. Velike črke pomenijo dur, male mol, ° pa zmanjšani akord.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: Every major key follows one pattern: I, ii, iii, IV, V, vi, vii°. In C major that's C, D minor, E minor, F, G, A minor and B diminished.
rows.translation: Vsaka durova tonaliteta sledi vzorcu: I, ii, iii, IV, V, vi, vii°. V C-duru so to C, D-mol, E-mol, F, G, A-mol in zmanjšani B.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: In C major, which chord is IV?
rows.translation: Kateri akord je IV v C-duru?
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: The fourth note of C major is F.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: In C major, which chord is vi?
rows.translation: Kateri akord je vi v C-duru?
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: The sixth note is A, and lowercase vi means minor.
rows.translation: Šesti ton je A, vi z malimi črkami pa pomeni mol.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: In G major, which chord is V?
rows.translation: Kateri akord je V v G-duru?
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: Count up from G: G, A, B, C, D. The fifth note is D, and V is major.
rows.translation: Štej navzgor od G: G, A, B, C, D. Peti ton je D, V pa je durov.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: Why is ii written in lowercase?
rows.translation: Zakaj je ii zapisan z malimi črkami?
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: In G major, which chord is IV?
rows.translation: Kateri akord je IV v G-duru?
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: G, A, B, C: the fourth note is C.
rows.translation: G, A, B, C: četrti ton je C.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: Spell it, hear it, number it
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: Stack thirds, check their sizes, then place the chord in its key: major on I, IV and V, minor on ii, iii and vi, diminished on vii°.
rows.translation: Zloži terce, preveri njihovo velikost, nato akord umesti v tonaliteto: durovi na I, IV in V, molovi na ii, iii in vi, zmanjšani na vii°.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: In C major, which chord is ii?
rows.translation: Kateri akord je ii v C-duru?
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: In F major, which chord is V?
rows.translation: Kateri akord je V v F-duru?
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: F, G, A, B♭, C: the fifth note is C.
rows.translation: F, G, A, B♭, C: peti ton je C.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: B to D and D to F are both minor thirds.
rows.translation: Od B do D in od D do F sta obe mali terci.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: Play or sing the G major triad: G, B, D.
rows.translation: Zaigraj ali zapoj G-durov trozvok: G, B, D.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: How chords move in songs: I–IV–V, the pop loop, ii–V–I, the 12-bar blues and cadences.
rows.translation: Kako se akordi premikajo v pesmih: I–IV–V, popovski krog, ii–V–I, 12-taktni blues in kadence.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: Countless folk, rock and country songs use just three chords: I, IV and V. In C major, that's C, F and G. Together they hold every note of the scale.
rows.translation: Nešteto ljudskih, rockovskih in country pesmi uporablja le tri akorde: I, IV in V. V C-duru so to C, F in G. Skupaj vsebujejo vsak ton lestvice.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: In G major, what are I, IV and V?
rows.translation: Kateri akordi so I, IV in V v G-duru?
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: Count up from G: note 1 is G, note 4 is C, note 5 is D.
rows.translation: Štej navzgor od G: ton 1 je G, ton 4 je C, ton 5 je D.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: Does this end on the home chord?
rows.translation: Se to konča na domačem akordu?
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: I feels like home. IV moves away. V builds tension that pulls back to I. That trip, out and back again, shapes a huge number of songs.
rows.translation: I se zdi kot dom. IV gre stran. V gradi napetost, ki vleče nazaj k I. Ta pot, stran in spet nazaj, oblikuje ogromno pesmi.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: Which chord pulls most strongly back to I?
rows.translation: Kateri akord najmočneje vleče nazaj k I?
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: V builds tension that resolves to I.
rows.translation: V gradi napetost, ki se razreši v I.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: In D major, which chord is IV?
rows.translation: Kateri akord je IV v D-duru?
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: D, E, F♯, G: the fourth note is G.
rows.translation: D, E, F♯, G: četrti ton je G.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: Play or sing the roots of I, IV, V, I in C: C, F, G, C.
rows.translation: Zaigraj ali zapoj osnovne tone I, IV, V, I v C: C, F, G, C.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: This four-chord loop runs under a huge number of pop songs. In C major it's C, G, A minor, F. The minor vi adds a touch of shade before IV lifts back toward home.
rows.translation: Ta krog štirih akordov je podlaga ogromno pop pesmim. V C-duru je C, G, A-mol, F. Molov vi doda malo sence, preden IV dvigne pot nazaj proti domu.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: In G major, what is I–V–vi–IV?
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: In G: I is G, V is D, vi is E minor, IV is C.
rows.translation: V G: I je G, V je D, vi je E-mol, IV je C.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: Start the same loop on vi and you get vi–IV–I–V: A minor, F, C, G. The chords are identical, but beginning on minor makes it sound more serious.
rows.translation: Isti krog začni na vi in dobiš vi–IV–I–V: A-mol, F, C, G. Akordi so enaki, a začetek v molu zveni resneje.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: In F major, which chord is vi?
rows.translation: Kateri akord je vi v F-duru?
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: F, G, A, B♭, C, D: the sixth note is D, and vi is minor.
rows.translation: F, G, A, B♭, C, D: šesti ton je D, vi pa je molov.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: Play or sing the roots of I–V–vi–IV in C: C, G, A, F.
rows.translation: Zaigraj ali zapoj osnovne tone I–V–vi–IV v C: C, G, A, F.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: ii–V–I is the most common progression in jazz. In C major: D minor, G, C. Each root falls a fifth to the next, so the move feels like coming home.
rows.translation: ii–V–I je najpogostejše akordno zaporedje v jazzu. V C-duru: D-mol, G, C. Vsak osnovni ton se do naslednjega spusti za kvinto, zato premik deluje kot prihod domov.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: In C major, what is ii–V–I?
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: ii is D minor, V is G, and I is C.
rows.translation: ii je D-mol, V je G in I je C.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: Jazz players usually add sevenths: Dm7, G7, Cmaj7. The extra notes make each move even smoother. The roots and the trip home stay the same.
rows.translation: Jazzisti običajno dodajo septime: Dm7, G7, Cmaj7. Dodatni toni naredijo vsak premik še bolj gladek. Osnovni toni in pot domov ostanejo enaki.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: In F major, what is ii–V–I?
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: F, G, A, B♭, C: ii is G minor and V is C.
rows.translation: F, G, A, B♭, C: ii je G-mol in V je C.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: In ii–V–I, how do the roots move?
rows.translation: Kako se premikajo osnovni toni v ii–V–I?
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: D down to G, then G down to C: a fifth each time.
rows.translation: Od D navzdol do G, nato od G navzdol do C: vsakič kvinta.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: Play or sing the roots of ii–V–I in C: D, down to G, up to C.
rows.translation: Zaigraj ali zapoj osnovne tone ii–V–I v C: D, navzdol do G, navzgor do C.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: The 12-bar blues is a chord plan, twelve bars long, behind countless blues, rock and jazz tunes. It uses I, IV and V, often all as dominant seventh chords for a bluesy edge.
rows.translation: 12-taktni blues je dvanajst taktov dolg akordni načrt, na katerem temelji nešteto bluesovskih, rockovskih in jazzovskih viž. Uporablja I, IV in V, pogosto vse kot dominantne septakorde za bluesovski pridih.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: Four bars of I. Two of IV, two of I. One of V, one of IV, two of I. Then it repeats. In A: A7 four times, D7 twice, A7 twice, E7, D7, A7 twice.
rows.translation: Štirje takti I. Dva IV, dva I. En V, en IV, dva I. Nato se ponovi. V A: A7 štirikrat, D7 dvakrat, A7 dvakrat, E7, D7, A7 dvakrat.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: How many bars of I open the 12-bar blues?
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: Four bars of I, then IV arrives in bar 5.
rows.translation: Štirje takti I, nato v taktu 5 pride IV.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: In the 12-bar blues, which chord is in bar 9?
rows.translation: Kateri akord je v taktu 9 pri 12-taktnem bluesu?
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: Bar 9 is the one bar of V, before IV in bar 10.
rows.translation: Takt 9 je edini takt V, pred IV v taktu 10.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: In the key of E, what are the three blues chords?
rows.translation: Kateri so trije bluesovski akordi v tonaliteti E?
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: In E, I is E, IV is A and V is B.
rows.translation: V E je I E, IV A in V B.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: Play or sing the roots of the blues in A: A, D, E, back to A.
rows.translation: Zaigraj ali zapoj osnovne tone bluesa v A: A, D, E, nazaj na A.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: A cadence is the chord move that ends a phrase, like punctuation. V to I is the strongest, a full stop. It's called an authentic cadence.
rows.translation: Kadenca je akordni premik, ki konča frazo, kot ločilo. Od V do I je najmočnejši, kot pika. Imenuje se avtentična kadenca.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: IV to I is a plagal cadence, the soft amen at the end of many hymns. Stopping on V is a half cadence, like a comma. V to vi is deceptive: you expect home and get a surprise.
rows.translation: Od IV do I je plagalna kadenca, nežni amen na koncu mnogih cerkvenih pesmi. Ustavitev na V je polkadenca, kot vejica. Od V do vi je varljiva: pričakuješ dom in dobiš presenečenje.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: Which cadence ends a phrase on V?
rows.translation: Katera kadenca konča frazo na V?
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: A half cadence pauses on V, like a comma.
rows.translation: Polkadenca se ustavi na V, kot vejica.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: Which cadence is called the amen cadence?
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: IV to I is the soft amen at the end of many hymns.
rows.translation: Od IV do I je nežni amen na koncu mnogih cerkvenih pesmi.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: Home, away and back again. Name the progression, then the cadence that ends it. Listen for where the music wants to rest.
rows.translation: Doma, stran in spet nazaj. Poimenuj akordno zaporedje, nato kadenco, ki ga konča. Poslušaj, kje želi glasba počivati.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: In D major, what is I–V–vi–IV?
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: In D: I is D, V is A, vi is B minor, IV is G.
rows.translation: V D: I je D, V je A, vi je B-mol, IV je G.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: In which bar does the 12-bar blues first move to IV?
rows.translation: V katerem taktu 12-taktni blues prvič preide na IV?
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: V to I is the full stop of music.
rows.translation: Od V do I je glasbena pika.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: Play or sing the roots of I–IV–V–I in G: G, C, D, G.
rows.translation: Zaigraj ali zapoj osnovne tone I–IV–V–I v G: G, C, D, G.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: Feel the beat, count it, and tap it in time
rows.translation: Začuti dobo, jo preštej in potrkaj v ritmu
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: Find the pulse, count to four, and tap in time.
rows.translation: Poišči utrip, štej do štiri in trkaj v ritmu.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: The beat is a steady pulse
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: The beat is the steady pulse you tap your foot to. It never rushes or drags, like footsteps on an easy walk. Every rhythm sits on top of it.
rows.translation: Doba je enakomeren utrip, ob katerem udarjaš s stopalom. Nikoli ne hiti in ne zaostaja, kot koraki med lahkotnim sprehodom. Vsak ritem temelji na njej.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: Hold your fingertip just above the screen and tap each time the click sounds. Let it bounce off the glass like a drumstick. Aim to land with the click, not after it.
rows.translation: Konico prsta drži tik nad zaslonom in potrkaj ob vsakem kliku. Naj se odbije od stekla kot bobnarska palica. Meri na klik, ne za njim.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: A beat keeps the same space between pulses, like a clock ticking.
rows.translation: Doba ohranja enak razmik med utripi, kot tiktakanje ure.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: How many clicks did you hear?
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: Most music groups beats in fours. Count 1, 2, 3, 4 out loud with the click, then start again at 1. Saying the numbers helps your hands keep time.
rows.translation: Večina glasbe združuje dobe po štiri. S klikom na glas štej 1, 2, 3, 4, nato spet začni pri 1. Izgovarjanje številk pomaga rokam ohraniti ritem.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: A bar is one group of beats. Here each bar holds four beats, written 4/4. Beat 1 starts every bar, so lean on it a little as you count.
rows.translation: Takt je skupina dob. Tu ima vsak takt štiri dobe, zapisane kot 4/4. Doba 1 začne vsak takt, zato jo med štetjem malo poudari.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: The strong click is beat 1. How many beats are in each bar?
rows.translation: Močan klik je doba 1. Koliko dob je v vsakem taktu?
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: Counting starts again at 1 at the top of every bar.
rows.translation: Na začetku vsakega takta začneš znova šteti pri 1.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: A note that lasts one beat is a quarter note. Four of them fill a bar of 4/4, so tapping on every beat means tapping quarter notes.
rows.translation: Nota, ki traja eno dobo, je četrtinka. Štiri zapolnijo takt 4/4, zato trkanje na vsako dobo pomeni trkanje četrtink.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: Now tap only on 1 and 3. Each tap is a half note, two beats long. Keep counting all four; the beats you skip still happen.
rows.translation: Zdaj potrkaj le na 1 in 3. Vsak trk je polovinka, dolga dve dobi. Štej vse štiri; dobe, ki jih preskočiš, še vedno tečejo.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: You tap on 1 and 3. What happens on 2 and 4?
rows.translation: Trkaš na 1 in 3. Kaj se zgodi na 2 in 4?
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: The beat never stops. You count through the beats you don't tap.
rows.translation: Doba se nikoli ne ustavi. Šteješ tudi dobe, na katere ne potrkaš.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: A whole note lasts all four beats. Tap once on 1 and count 2, 3, 4 under your breath so the next 1 lands on time.
rows.translation: Celinka traja vse štiri dobe. Enkrat potrkaj na 1 in potiho štej 2, 3, 4, da naslednja 1 pride pravočasno.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: Tempo is the speed of the beat
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: Tempo is how fast the beat goes, counted in beats per minute, or bpm. At 60 bpm the beat comes once a second, like a clock.
rows.translation: Tempo pove, kako hitro teče doba; merimo ga v dobah na minuto ali bpm. Pri 60 bpm pride doba enkrat na sekundo, kot ura.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: At 60 bpm, how often does the beat come?
rows.translation: Kako pogosto pride doba pri 60 bpm?
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: 60 beats in 60 seconds is one beat each second.
rows.translation: 60 dob v 60 sekundah pomeni eno dobo vsako sekundo.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: Faster tempos need less effort, not more. Keep your hand loose and tap from the knuckle, not the wrist or shoulder.
rows.translation: Hitrejši tempi potrebujejo manj napora, ne več. Roka naj bo sproščena, trkaj pa iz členka, ne iz zapestja ali rame.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: The tempo goes up. What should your taps do?
rows.translation: Tempo se zviša. Kakšni naj bodo tvoji trki?
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: Wait a little behind the click
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: Small, relaxed motions are quicker and easier to keep even.
rows.translation: Majhni, sproščeni gibi so hitrejši in jih lažje ohraniš enakomerne.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: This challenge mixes beats, bars, longer notes and tempo. Count out loud the whole way, and keep your taps small and relaxed.
rows.translation: Ta izziv meša dobe, takte, daljše note in tempo. Ves čas štej na glas ter trkaj z majhnimi, sproščenimi gibi.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: Which note lasts a whole bar of 4/4?
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: A whole note lasts four beats, the full bar of 4/4.
rows.translation: Celinka traja štiri dobe, ves takt 4/4.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: bpm counts beats per minute, so 90 bpm is one and a half beats each second.
rows.translation: bpm šteje dobe na minuto, zato 90 bpm pomeni dobo in pol vsako sekundo.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: Split each beat in two and count "and."
rows.translation: Vsako dobo razdeli na dve in štej »in«.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: An eighth note lasts half a beat, so two fit in every beat. Eight of them fill a bar of 4/4.
rows.translation: Osminka traja pol dobe, zato gresta dve v vsako dobo. Osem jih zapolni takt 4/4.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: Say the number on each beat and "and" exactly halfway between: 1 and 2 and 3 and 4 and. Tap on every word.
rows.translation: Na vsako dobo izgovori številko, točno na sredini med dobami pa »in«: 1 in 2 in 3 in 4 in. Potrkaj na vsako besedo.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: An eighth note is half a beat, so two fill each beat.
rows.translation: Osminka je pol dobe, zato dve zapolnita vsako dobo.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: The strong clicks are the beats. How many beats did you hear?
rows.translation: Močni kliki so dobe. Koliko dob si slišal?
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: Now some beats get one tap and some get two. Keep saying every "and," even the ones you don't tap.
rows.translation: Zdaj nekatere dobe dobijo en trk, druge dva. Izgovarjaj vsak »in«, tudi tistega, na katerega ne potrkaš.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: How do you count this pattern?
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: Beat 1 has two taps, 1 and. Beats 2, 3 and 4 get one tap each.
rows.translation: Doba 1 ima dva trka, 1 in. Dobe 2, 3 in 4 dobijo po en trk.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: In eighths, each tap lands on a number or an "and." Before you tap a new pattern, say its counts once out loud.
rows.translation: Pri osminkah vsak trk pade na številko ali »in«. Preden potrkaš nov vzorec, enkrat na glas izgovori njegovo štetje.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: Beats 1 and 3 have two taps each; beats 2 and 4 have one.
rows.translation: Dobi 1 in 3 imata po dva trka; dobi 2 in 4 po enega.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: Beat 1 has one tap, beats 2 and 3 have two, and beat 4 has one.
rows.translation: Doba 1 ima en trk, dobi 2 in 3 po dva, doba 4 pa enega.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: The "and" should land exactly halfway between beats. If your eighths sound like a gallop, slow down and say the counts as you tap.
rows.translation: »In« naj pade točno na sredino med dobama. Če osminke zvenijo kot galop, upočasni in med trkanjem izgovarjaj štetje.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: Your eighths sound uneven. What helps most?
rows.translation: Tvoje osminke zvenijo neenakomerno. Kaj najbolj pomaga?
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: Slow down and count out loud
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: Speed up until it smooths out
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: Slowing down gives you time to place each "and" in the middle. Counting keeps it there.
rows.translation: Upočasnitev ti da čas, da vsak »in« postaviš na sredino. Štetje ga ohrani tam.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: Hover just above the glass between taps. A short, light motion is easier to keep even at faster tempos.
rows.translation: Med trki lebdi tik nad steklom. Kratek, rahel gib je lažje ohraniti enakomeren pri hitrejših tempih.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: This challenge mixes quarters and eighths. Say each pattern's counts once, then tap it with every "and" right in the middle.
rows.translation: Ta izziv meša četrtinke in osminke. Enkrat izgovori štetje vsakega vzorca, nato ga potrkaj z vsakim »in« točno na sredini.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: Leave space on purpose, then tap between the beats.
rows.translation: Namenoma pusti prostor, nato trkaj med dobami.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: A rest is a silence with a set length. You still count it; you just don't tap. A quarter rest lasts one beat.
rows.translation: Pavza je tišina z določeno dolžino. Še vedno jo šteješ; le potrkaš ne. Četrtinska pavza traja eno dobo.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: What do you do on a rest?
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: A rest takes up time just like a note. Counting it keeps your place.
rows.translation: Pavza vzame čas prav tako kot nota. S štetjem ohraniš svoje mesto.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: Leaving beat 1 empty is the hardest rest. Nod your head on 1 so you feel it without tapping, then come in on 2.
rows.translation: Prazna doba 1 je najtežja pavza. Na 1 pokimaj, da jo začutiš brez trkanja, nato vstopi na 2.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: An eighth rest lasts half a beat. Count 1 and 2 and, rest on 2, and tap its "and" instead. It feels like a small push into beat 3.
rows.translation: Osminska pavza traja pol dobe. Štej 1 in 2 in, na 2 počivaj in namesto nje potrkaj na njen »in«. Deluje kot majhen potisk v dobo 3.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: It sits halfway between beats 2 and 3, on the "and" of 2.
rows.translation: Je na sredini med dobama 2 in 3, na »in« za 2.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: Syncopation puts a strong note between the beats, where your ear doesn't expect one. It makes a rhythm lean forward.
rows.translation: Sinkopa postavi močan ton med dobe, kjer ga uho ne pričakuje. Zaradi nje se ritem nagne naprej.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: This pattern lands on 1, the "and" of 2, and 4. Count 1 and 2 and 3 and 4 and, and tap only those three spots.
rows.translation: Ta vzorec pade na 1, »in« za 2 in 4. Štej 1 in 2 in 3 in 4 in ter potrkaj le na teh treh mestih.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: Count the clicks from 1 to 8. Where do the strong ones fall?
rows.translation: Štej klike od 1 do 8. Kam padejo močni?
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: Syncopation shifts the weight off the beat, onto an "and" or a weak beat.
rows.translation: Sinkopa premakne težo z dobe na »in« ali na šibko dobo.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: Offbeats are the "and" between beats. Nod on the numbers and tap only the ands, like the chop of a reggae guitar.
rows.translation: Vmesni utripi so »in« med dobami. Na številke kimaj, trkaj pa samo na in, kot kratki udarci kitare v reggaeju.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: The first click is beat 1. Are the strong clicks on the numbers or the ands?
rows.translation: Prvi klik je doba 1. So močni kliki na številkah ali na in?
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: Offbeats fall halfway between the beats, on every "and."
rows.translation: Vmesni utripi padejo na sredino med dobami, na vsak »in«.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: This challenge mixes rests, the "and" on its own, syncopation and offbeats. Count every eighth out loud, even when you don't tap.
rows.translation: Ta izziv meša pavze, samostojni »in«, sinkope in vmesne utripe. Vsako osminko štej na glas, tudi ko ne trkaš.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.translation: Kateri od teh vzorcev je sinkopiran?
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: Tapping the "and" of 2 and skipping 3 moves the weight off the beat.
rows.translation: Trkanje na »in« za 2 in izpustitev 3 premakneta težo z dobe.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: Hold notes across the beat with ties and dotted rhythms.
rows.translation: Z ligaturami in punktiranimi ritmi drži tone čez dobo.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: A tie is a curved line joining two notes. You play the first and hold it through the second, so the tied note gets no new tap.
rows.translation: Ligatura je ukrivljena črta, ki poveže dve noti. Prvo zaigraš in jo držiš skozi drugo, zato vezana nota ne dobi novega trka.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: Beat 2 is tied to beat 3. What do you do on 3?
rows.translation: Doba 2 je vezana na dobo 3. Kaj narediš na 3?
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: A tie stretches one note. You count 3, but the note from beat 2 keeps sounding.
rows.translation: Ligatura podaljša eno noto. Šteješ 3, a ton iz dobe 2 zveni naprej.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: Tie the "and" of 2 into beat 3. Tap on the "and," then let beat 3 pass while the note rings. It's syncopation, written another way.
rows.translation: Poveži »in« za 2 z dobo 3. Potrkaj na »in«, nato pusti dobi 3 miniti, medtem ko ton zveni. To je sinkopa, zapisana drugače.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: A dot after a note adds half its length. A half note lasts two beats, so a dotted half lasts three. Tap 1, count 2 and 3, tap 4.
rows.translation: Pika za noto doda polovico njene dolžine. Polovinka traja dve dobi, zato polovinka s piko traja tri. Potrkaj na 1, štej 2 in 3, potrkaj na 4.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: A quarter note lasts one beat. How long is a dotted quarter?
rows.translation: Četrtinka traja eno dobo. Kako dolga je četrtinka s piko?
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: Half of one beat is a half beat. Add it and you get one and a half.
rows.translation: Polovica ene dobe je pol dobe. Dodaj jo in dobiš dobo in pol.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: A dotted quarter lasts one and a half beats, so the next note lands on an "and." Count 1 and 2 and: tap 1, then the "and" of 2.
rows.translation: Četrtinka s piko traja dobo in pol, zato naslednja nota pade na »in«. Štej 1 in 2 in: potrkaj na 1, nato na »in« za 2.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: You tapped this pattern with a rest in Unit 3. What changes with a dot?
rows.translation: Ta vzorec si v enoti 3 trkal s pavzo. Kaj se spremeni s piko?
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: The taps land in the same places. Only the length of the first note changes.
rows.translation: Trki padejo na ista mesta. Spremeni se le dolžina prvega tona.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: A dotted quarter plus an eighth fills two beats: long, short. Count 1 and 2 and; tap 1 and the "and" of 2.
rows.translation: Četrtinka s piko in osminka zapolnita dve dobi: dolgo, kratko. Štej 1 in 2 in; potrkaj na 1 in na »in« za 2.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: A dotted quarter and an eighth together last how long?
rows.translation: Kako dolgo skupaj trajata četrtinka s piko in osminka?
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: One and a half plus a half is two.
rows.translation: Ena in pol plus pol je dve.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: Which lasts as long as a dotted quarter?
rows.translation: Kaj traja enako dolgo kot četrtinka s piko?
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: A quarter tied to an eighth
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: The tie adds half a beat to the quarter, just like the dot does.
rows.translation: Ligatura četrtinki doda pol dobe, prav tako kot pika.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: This challenge mixes ties and dots. Count every eighth out loud; a held note still takes up its full time.
rows.translation: Ta izziv meša ligature in pike. Vsako osminko štej na glas; zadržani ton še vedno zavzame ves svoj čas.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: How long is a dotted half note?
rows.translation: Kako dolga je polovinka s piko?
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: A half note is two beats; the dot adds one more.
rows.translation: Polovinka traja dve dobi; pika doda še eno.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: A tie connects two notes. How many times do you tap?
rows.translation: Ligatura poveže dve noti. Kolikokrat potrkaš?
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: You tap the first note and hold through the second.
rows.translation: Potrkaš prvo noto in jo držiš skozi drugo.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: Split the beat in three, then swing your eighths.
rows.translation: Dobo razdeli na tri, nato osminke zaigraj s swingom.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: Triplets split the beat in three
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: A triplet fits three even notes into one beat. Count 1-trip-let, 2-trip-let, with each syllable the same length.
rows.translation: Triola v eno dobo postavi tri enakomerne note. Štej 1-tri-la, 2-tri-la, vsak zlog enako dolgo.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: How many triplet notes fit in one beat?
rows.translation: Koliko not triole gre v eno dobo?
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: Triplets split each beat into three equal parts.
rows.translation: Triole vsako dobo razdelijo na tri enake dele.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: Are the clicks in groups of two or three?
rows.translation: So kliki v skupinah po dva ali tri?
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: Eighths split the beat in two; triplets split it in three. The beat itself stays put. Only the way you divide it changes.
rows.translation: Osminke razdelijo dobo na dve; triole na tri. Doba sama ostane ista. Spremeni se le njena delitev.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: You count 1-trip-let, 2-trip-let. What are you tapping?
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: Three syllables per beat means three notes per beat: triplets.
rows.translation: Trije zlogi na dobo pomenijo tri note na dobo: triole.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: In swing, each pair of eighths turns long-short. The "and" moves late, onto the last part of a triplet. Think doo-ba, doo-ba.
rows.translation: Pri swingu vsak par osmink postane dolg-kratek. »In« pride pozneje, na zadnji del triole. Predstavljaj si du-ba, du-ba.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: Count 1-trip-let and tap only on "1" and "let." The gap in the middle is the swing.
rows.translation: Štej 1-tri-la in potrkaj samo na »1« in »la«. Vrzel na sredini je swing.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: In swing, where does the "and" land?
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: Swing delays the "and" to the last triplet, which gives the long-short lilt.
rows.translation: Swing zamakne »in« na zadnjo noto triole, kar ustvari dolgo-kratko zibanje.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: Jazz drummers play this on the ride cymbal: 1, 2, a swung "and," 3, 4, a swung "and." It sounds like ding, ding-a ding.
rows.translation: Jazzovski bobnarji na čineli ride igrajo: 1, 2, swingovski »in«, 3, 4, swingovski »in«. Zveni kot ding, ding-a ding.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: How do you tap a swung "and"?
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: A swung "and" waits for the last triplet of the beat.
rows.translation: Swingovski »in« počaka na zadnjo noto triole v dobi.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: Straight eighths split the beat evenly; swung eighths go long-short. Tap one, then the other, and feel the difference.
rows.translation: Ravne osminke dobo razdelijo enakomerno; swingovske gredo dolgo-kratko. Potrkaj ene, nato druge in začuti razliko.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: This challenge mixes triplets, straight eighths and swing. Keep the beat steady while the way you split it changes.
rows.translation: Ta izziv meša triole, ravne osminke in swing. Ohrani enakomerno dobo, medtem ko se spreminja njena delitev.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: Swing turns each pair of eighths into what?
rows.translation: V kaj swing spremeni vsak par osmink?
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: The first eighth stretches and the "and" arrives late.
rows.translation: Prva osminka se podaljša in »in« pride pozneje.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: Waltz in three, march in two, rock in 6/8, and place the accents.
rows.translation: Valček v treh, koračnica v dveh, zibanje v 6/8 in postavljanje poudarkov.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: In 3/4 time each bar has three beats: ONE, two, three. It's the waltz. Count 1, 2, 3 and lean on 1.
rows.translation: V 3/4 ima vsak takt tri dobe: ENA, dve, tri. To je valček. Štej 1, 2, 3 in poudari 1.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: A half note fills two of the three beats. Tap 1, count 2, tap 3. It feels like the big step and small step of a waltz.
rows.translation: Polovinka zapolni dve od treh dob. Potrkaj na 1, štej 2, potrkaj na 3. Občutek je kot velik in majhen korak valčka.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: How many beats are in a bar of 3/4?
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: The top number of a time signature tells you how many beats are in each bar.
rows.translation: Zgornja številka taktovskega načina pove, koliko dob je v vsakem taktu.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: 2/4 has two beats per bar: ONE, two, like marching feet. The bars go by quickly, so beat 1 comes around often.
rows.translation: 2/4 ima dve dobi na takt: ENA, dve, kot korakanje. Takti hitro minevajo, zato se doba 1 pogosto vrača.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: Which meter feels like a march?
rows.translation: Kateri taktovski način deluje kot koračnica?
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: Two beats per bar match left, right, left, right.
rows.translation: Dve dobi na takt se ujemata z levo, desno, levo, desno.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: In 6/8 each bar holds six eighth notes in two groups of three: ONE two three FOUR five six. It feels like two big, rocking beats.
rows.translation: V 6/8 ima vsak takt šest osmink v dveh skupinah po tri: ENA dve tri ŠTIRI pet šest. Občutek je kot dve veliki, zibajoči se dobi.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: The six eighths fall into two groups of three, so you feel two big beats.
rows.translation: Šest osmink pade v dve skupini po tri, zato čutiš dve veliki dobi.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: A favorite 6/8 pattern goes long-short, long-short: tap 1, 3, 4 and 6. It rocks like a lullaby or a sea shanty.
rows.translation: Priljubljen vzorec 6/8 gre dolgo-kratko, dolgo-kratko: potrkaj na 1, 3, 4 in 6. Ziblje se kot uspavanka ali mornarska pesem.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: Six clicks per bar. Which meter is this?
rows.translation: Šest klikov na takt. Kateri taktovski način je to?
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: An accent is a note played stronger than the ones around it. Move the accents and the feel changes, even when every note stays the same.
rows.translation: Poudarek je ton, zaigran močneje od sosednjih. Premakni poudarke in občutek se spremeni, tudi če vsaka nota ostane enaka.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: Count all eight eighths and tap just the accents: 1, the "and" of 2, and 4. This 3-3-2 pattern drives a lot of pop and Latin music.
rows.translation: Štej vseh osem osmink in potrkaj samo poudarke: 1, »in« za 2 in 4. Ta vzorec 3-3-2 poganja veliko popa in latinskoameriške glasbe.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: An accent is about weight, not length. The note is simply played stronger.
rows.translation: Poudarek je stvar teže, ne dolžine. Ton je preprosto zaigran močneje.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: Rock, pop and soul put the accent on beats 2 and 4. This is the backbeat. Count all four and tap only 2 and 4, like a snare drum.
rows.translation: Rock, pop in soul postavijo poudarek na dobi 2 in 4. To je poudarek na šibkih dobah. Štej vse štiri in trkaj le na 2 in 4, kot mali boben.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: The first click is beat 1. Where are the strong clicks?
rows.translation: Prvi klik je doba 1. Kje so močni kliki?
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: This challenge moves between meters and accents. Before each tap step, count one bar under your breath to find beat 1.
rows.translation: Ta izziv prehaja med taktovskimi načini in poudarki. Pred vsako vajo trkanja potiho preštej en takt, da najdeš dobo 1.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: Six eighth notes per bar, felt in two groups of three.
rows.translation: Šest osmink na takt, občutenih v dveh skupinah po tri.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: Find your voice and sing in tune
rows.translation: Poišči svoj glas in poj čisto
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: Stand tall, breathe low, hold your first steady note and sing a song.
rows.translation: Stoj vzravnano, dihaj nizko, zadrži prvi enakomeren ton in zapoj pesem.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: Stand with your feet hip-width apart and knees soft. Let your shoulders drop and your head float up, as if a string lifts it. Keep your jaw loose.
rows.translation: Stoj s stopali v širini bokov in mehkimi koleni. Ramena naj padejo, glava pa se lahkotno dvigne, kot da jo vleče nit. Čeljust naj bo sproščena.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: Rest a hand on your belly and breathe in slowly. Your belly and lower ribs widen while your shoulders stay still. That low breath powers your voice.
rows.translation: Roko položi na trebuh in počasi vdihni. Trebuh in spodnja rebra se razširijo, ramena pa mirujejo. Ta nizki vdih poganja tvoj glas.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: When you breathe in to sing, what should move?
rows.translation: Kaj naj se premakne, ko vdihneš za petje?
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: A low breath widens your ribs and belly. Lifting your shoulders tightens your neck and throat.
rows.translation: Nizki vdih razširi rebra in trebuh. Dvigovanje ramen napne vrat in grlo.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: Timbre listens for the note's name, so a C sung low or high both count. Pick the octave that feels easy, never strained.
rows.translation: Timbre posluša ime tona, zato štejeta tako nizko kot visoko zapeti C. Izberi oktavo, ki je lahkotna, nikoli naporna.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: Breathe low, then sing C on "ah" in a comfortable octave. Hold it steady.
rows.translation: Vdihni nizko, nato na »a« zapoj C v udobni oktavi. Drži ga enakomerno.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: Once more: stand tall, breathe low, and let the note ring.
rows.translation: Še enkrat: stoj vzravnano, vdihni nizko in pusti tonu zveneti.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: To sustain is to hold a note at one steady pitch. Let the air out slowly and evenly, like fogging a mirror without stopping.
rows.translation: Vzdrževati ton pomeni držati ga na eni enakomerni višini. Zrak spuščaj počasi in enakomerno, kot da brez premora rosiš ogledalo z dihom.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: Sing C on "ah" and hold it steady until it locks in.
rows.translation: Zapoj C na »a« in ga drži enakomerno do potrditve.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: Your note wobbles and fades. What helps most?
rows.translation: Tvoj ton niha in zamira. Kaj najbolj pomaga?
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: Steady air makes a steady note. Extra volume and tension make it harder to control.
rows.translation: Enakomeren zrak ustvari enakomeren ton. Večja glasnost in napetost otežita nadzor.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: Now E. Same low breath, same easy "ah."
rows.translation: Zdaj E. Isti nizki vdih, isti lahkotni »a«.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: Sing "ah" with your jaw dropped and the tip of your tongue resting behind your lower teeth. The sound flows out instead of getting squeezed.
rows.translation: Poj »a« s spuščeno čeljustjo in konico jezika za spodnjimi zobmi. Zvok steče ven, namesto da bi ga stiskal.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: G this time. Drop your jaw and keep the "ah" open.
rows.translation: Tokrat G. Spusti čeljust in ohrani »a« odprt.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: Matching pitch means singing the same note you hear. Listen, imagine the note for a moment, then sing softly and adjust until it settles.
rows.translation: Ujemanje višine pomeni peti isti ton, ki ga slišiš. Poslušaj, si ton za trenutek predstavljaj, nato tiho zapoj in prilagajaj, dokler se ne ustali.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: Sing E softly, then adjust until it settles.
rows.translation: Tiho zapoj E, nato ga prilagajaj, dokler se ne ustali.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: Flat means under the target pitch; sharp means over it. If you're flat, lift a little. If you're sharp, ease down. Small moves work best.
rows.translation: Prenizko pomeni pod ciljno višino; previsoko nad njo. Če si prenizko, se malo dvigni. Če si previsoko, se rahlo spusti. Najbolje delujejo majhni premiki.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: Timbre says you're flat. What do you do?
rows.translation: Timbre pravi, da si prenizko. Kaj narediš?
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: Flat means under the note, so lift the pitch slightly.
rows.translation: Prenizko pomeni pod tonom, zato višino rahlo dvigni.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: Two notes this time: D, then G. Take a breath between them.
rows.translation: Tokrat dva tona: D, nato G. Vmes vdihni.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: Humming with your lips closed is a gentle warm-up. You should feel a light buzz on your lips and nose. Keep it soft and easy.
rows.translation: Mrmranje z zaprtimi ustnicami je nežno ogrevanje. Na ustnicah in nosu naj začutiš rahlo vibriranje. Naj bo tiho in lahkotno.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: Hum C, E and G, one at a time. Keep it light.
rows.translation: Zamrmraj C, E in G, enega za drugim. Lahkotno.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: Close your lips loosely and blow so they flutter like a motorboat, then add your voice. It keeps your throat relaxed while your voice wakes up.
rows.translation: Ustnici rahlo skleni in pihni, da zavibrirata kot motorni čoln, nato dodaj glas. Grlo ostane sproščeno, medtem ko se glas prebuja.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: Lip trill on G, E, then C. If your lips stop, press your cheeks lightly.
rows.translation: Ustnični trilček na G, E, nato C. Če se ustnici ustavita, rahlo pritisni na lica.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: A note feels tight or scratchy. What do you do?
rows.translation: Ton deluje napet ali praskajoč. Kaj narediš?
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: Stop, rest, and try it softer
rows.translation: Ustaviš se, počiješ in poskusiš tiše
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: Strain is a signal to ease off. Rest, sip some water, and come back lighter.
rows.translation: Naprezanje je znak, da popustiš. Počij, popij malo vode in se vrni lahkotneje.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: Stand tall, breathe low, and start each note softly. Rest between steps if your voice feels tired.
rows.translation: Stoj vzravnano, dihaj nizko in vsak ton začni tiho. Če je glas utrujen, med koraki počij.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: E, then G. Hear each one before you sing it.
rows.translation: E, nato G. Vsakega najprej zasliši, nato zapoj.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: Sharp is over the target pitch; flat is under it.
rows.translation: Previsoko je nad ciljno višino tona; prenizko pod njo.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: Sing D softly, then adjust until it settles.
rows.translation: Tiho zapoj D, nato ga prilagajaj, dokler se ne ustali.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: Mary Had a Little Lamb needs three notes: E, D and C, each a step from the next. Sing it where it feels easy; Timbre hears the right note in any octave.
rows.translation: Mary Had a Little Lamb potrebuje tri tone: E, D in C, vsak korak od naslednjega. Poj tam, kjer je lahkotno; Timbre prepozna pravi ton v vsaki oktavi.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: E, D, C: three steps down to home.
rows.translation: E, D, C: trije koraki navzdol domov.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: Ma-ry had a lit-tle lamb: E D C D E E E.
rows.translation: Ma-ry had a lit-tle lamb: E D C D E E E.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: Hear a note, sing it back, and move by small steps.
rows.translation: Sliši ton, ga zapoj nazaj in se premikaj v majhnih korakih.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: Before you sing, hear the note in your head for a second. That pause lets your voice aim for the pitch instead of hunting for it.
rows.translation: Preden zapoješ, za trenutek zasliši ton v mislih. Ta premor glasu omogoči ciljati višino, namesto da jo išče.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: Hear D in your head, then sing it.
rows.translation: V mislih zasliši D, nato ga zapoj.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: Hear F in your head, then sing it.
rows.translation: V mislih zasliši F, nato ga zapoj.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: Your first try lands flat. What next?
rows.translation: Prvi poskus je prenizek. Kaj sledi?
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: Small changes find the note fastest. Lift gently and let it settle.
rows.translation: Majhne spremembe najhitreje najdejo ton. Nežno dvigni in pusti, da se ustali.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: Hear A in your head, then sing it.
rows.translation: V mislih zasliši A, nato ga zapoj.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: Three notes in a row: D, F, A.
rows.translation: Trije toni zapored: D, F, A.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: Unison means two sounds on exactly the same pitch. When they match, they blend into one; when they're slightly off, you hear a wobble.
rows.translation: Unisono pomeni dva zvoka na povsem isti višini. Ko se ujemata, se zlijeta v enega; ko sta malo narazen, slišiš nihanje.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: Sing E and hold it in tune.
rows.translation: Zapoj E in ga drži čisto.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: To sing the same note twice, stop the air for a moment, then start again on a soft "da." Don't slide between them.
rows.translation: Če želiš isti ton zapeti dvakrat, za hip ustavi zrak, nato znova začni z mehkim »da«. Ne drsi med tonoma.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: Sing E three times on "da," with a tiny gap each time.
rows.translation: Trikrat zapoj E na »da«, vsakič z drobnim presledkom.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: A step is the next note
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: A step moves to the next note of a scale, up or down. Steps are the smallest, easiest moves to sing in tune.
rows.translation: Korak gre do naslednjega tona lestvice, navzgor ali navzdol. Koraki so najmanjši premiki, ki jih je najlažje zapeti čisto.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: Did it go up or down?
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: A half step is the smallest step, like E to F, with no note between. Most neighboring scale notes, like C and D, are a whole step apart: two half steps.
rows.translation: Polton je najmanjši korak, kot od E do F, brez vmesnega tona. Večino sosednjih tonov lestvice, kot C in D, loči cel ton: dva poltona.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: E, up a half step to F, and back.
rows.translation: E, polton navzgor do F in nazaj.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1
