rows.source: Hear each note in your head first, start softly, and adjust in small moves. Give repeated notes a fresh start.
rows.translation: Vsak ton najprej zasliši v mislih, začni tiho in prilagajaj z majhnimi premiki. Ponovljene tone začni sveže.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: Hear G in your head, then sing it.
rows.translation: V mislih zasliši G, nato ga zapoj.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: B, up a half step to C, and back.
rows.translation: B, polton navzgor do C in nazaj.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: E to F has no note between them. C to D and G to A are whole steps.
rows.translation: Med E in F ni tona. Od C do D in od G do A sta cela tona.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: Sing do-re-mi, the major scale, and five-note patterns.
rows.translation: Poj do-re-mi, durovo lestvico in pettonske vzorce.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: Solfege gives each step of the scale a syllable: do, re, mi, fa, sol, la, ti, do. Do is home, wherever the scale starts.
rows.translation: Solmizacija vsaki stopnji lestvice da zlog: do, re, mi, fa, sol, la, ti, do. Do je dom, kjer koli se lestvica začne.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: Sing do, re, mi on C, D, E.
rows.translation: Zapoj do, re, mi na C, D, E.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: Which syllable is home, the first step of the scale?
rows.translation: Kateri zlog je dom, prva stopnja lestvice?
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: Do is the first step and the note a scale comes back to.
rows.translation: Do je prva stopnja in ton, h kateremu se lestvica vrne.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: Now back down: mi, re, do.
rows.translation: Zdaj nazaj navzdol: mi, re, do.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.translation: Pet stopenj: od do do sol
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: Do, re, mi, fa, sol: the first five steps carry many simple tunes. Sing them up and back down on one breath if it feels easy.
rows.translation: Do, re, mi, fa, sol: prvih pet stopenj nosi mnogo preprostih melodij. Zapoj jih navzgor in nazaj navzdol z enim vdihom, če je lahkotno.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: Do, re, mi, fa, sol: C up to G.
rows.translation: Do, re, mi, fa, sol: od C navzgor do G.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: Between which two steps is there a half step?
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: Mi to fa (E to F) is a half step. The other steps from do to sol are whole steps.
rows.translation: Od mi do fa (od E do F) je polton. Drugi koraki od do do sol so celi toni.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: Sol back down to do: G down to C.
rows.translation: Od sol nazaj navzdol do do: od G navzdol do C.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: The major scale runs from do up to the next do: eight notes. Mi to fa and ti to do are half steps; every other step is a whole step.
rows.translation: Durova lestvica gre od do navzgor do naslednjega do: osem tonov. Od mi do fa in od ti do do sta poltona; vsak drug korak je cel ton.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: Do to do: C up to the next C.
rows.translation: Od do do do: od C navzgor do naslednjega C.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: Where are the half steps in a major scale?
rows.translation: Kje so poltoni v durovi lestvici?
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: Mi-fa and ti-do are half steps. That pattern gives the major scale its sound.
rows.translation: Mi-fa in ti-do sta poltona. Ta vzorec daje durovi lestvici njen zvok.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: Take a low breath before you start so you don't run out near the top. Let high notes get lighter, not louder, and keep your jaw loose.
rows.translation: Pred začetkom nizko vdihni, da ti pri vrhu ne zmanjka zraka. Visoki toni naj postanejo lahkotnejši, ne glasnejši, čeljust pa naj bo sproščena.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: Back down from C to C. Keep each lower note bright so it doesn't sag flat.
rows.translation: Nazaj navzdol od C do C. Vsak nižji ton ohrani svetel, da ne zdrsne prenizko.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: Short patterns like do-re-mi-re-do build accuracy fast. Sing one, then start it a step higher and let the scale guide you.
rows.translation: Kratki vzorci, kot do-re-mi-re-do, hitro razvijajo natančnost. Zapoj enega, nato ga začni korak višje in se pusti voditi lestvici.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: Do up to sol and back: C to G to C.
rows.translation: Od do navzgor do sol in nazaj: od C do G do C.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: Sing C-D-E-D-C, then the same shape one step higher. What's the top note now?
rows.translation: Zapoj C-D-E-D-C, nato isti vzorec korak višje. Kateri je zdaj najvišji ton?
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: One step higher, the shape becomes D, E, F, E, D.
rows.translation: Korak višje vzorec postane D, E, F, E, D.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: Breathe low before each scale, keep the top light, and keep lower notes bright on the way down.
rows.translation: Pred vsako lestvico nizko vdihni, vrh ohrani lahkoten, nižje tone pa svetle med spuščanjem.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: How many notes are in a major scale, do to do?
rows.translation: Koliko tonov je v durovi lestvici od do do do?
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: Do, re, mi, fa, sol, la, ti, do: eight notes, with do at both ends.
rows.translation: Do, re, mi, fa, sol, la, ti, do: osem tonov, z do na obeh koncih.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: Leap by thirds, fifths and octaves, and land in tune.
rows.translation: Skači v tercah, kvintah in oktavah ter pristani čisto.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: An interval is the distance between two notes. Skip one scale step and you get a third, like do to mi. Hear mi in your head before you leave do.
rows.translation: Interval je razdalja med tonoma. Preskoči eno lestvično stopnjo in dobiš terco, kot od do do mi. V mislih zasliši mi, preden zapustiš do.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: Do to mi and back: C, E, C.
rows.translation: Od do do mi in nazaj: C, E, C.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.translation: Še ena terca: D, F, D.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: C to E skips over D, so it spans three scale notes: a third.
rows.translation: Od C do E preskočiš D, zato obsega tri lestvične tone: terco.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: Do to sol spans five scale notes, a fifth. It sounds open and strong. Picture the steps in between, then jump straight to sol.
rows.translation: Od do do sol je pet lestvičnih tonov, kvinta. Zveni odprto in močno. Predstavljaj si vmesne stopnje, nato skoči naravnost na sol.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: Do to sol and back: C, G, C.
rows.translation: Od do do sol in nazaj: C, G, C.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: Do, mi, sol: two thirds stack up to a fifth.
rows.translation: Do, mi, sol: dve terci se zložita v kvinto.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: Counting both ends, how many scale notes from do to sol?
rows.translation: Koliko lestvičnih tonov je od do do sol, če šteješ oba konca?
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: Do, re, mi, fa, sol: five notes, so it's a fifth.
rows.translation: Do, re, mi, fa, sol: pet tonov, torej kvinta.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: An octave leaps from do to the next do, eight scale notes up. The two notes share a name and blend so well they almost sound like one.
rows.translation: Oktava skoči od do do naslednjega do, osem lestvičnih tonov navzgor. Tona imata isto ime in se tako dobro zlijeta, da skoraj zvenita kot eden.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: Before an octave leap, breathe low and keep your chin level. Think of the top note as light and easy, not a stretch upward.
rows.translation: Pred oktavnim skokom nizko vdihni in brado ohrani ravno. Zgornji ton si predstavljaj kot lahkoten in preprost, ne kot raztezanje navzgor.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: C, then G, then the high C. Use the G as a stepping stone.
rows.translation: C, nato G, nato visoki C. G uporabi kot vmesno oporo.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: Why do the two notes of an octave blend so well?
rows.translation: Zakaj se tona oktave tako dobro zlijeta?
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: The top one vibrates twice as fast
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: The top note vibrates exactly twice as fast as the bottom one, so their waves line up.
rows.translation: Zgornji ton niha točno dvakrat hitreje od spodnjega, zato se njuni valovanji ujemata.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: Hear each leap in your head before you sing it. Land lightly on the top note, then step home.
rows.translation: Vsak skok najprej zasliši v mislih, nato ga zapoj. Lahkotno pristani na zgornjem tonu, nato stopaj domov.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: High do, sol, mi, do: back down.
rows.translation: Visoki do, sol, mi, do: nazaj navzdol.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: What is the interval from do to the next do?
rows.translation: Kateri interval je od do do naslednjega do?
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: Do to the next do spans eight scale notes: an octave.
rows.translation: Od do do naslednjega do je osem lestvičnih tonov: oktava.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: Five public-domain tunes, melody only, at an easy pace.
rows.translation: Pet melodij v javni domeni, samo melodija, v lahkotnem tempu.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: This traditional melody leaps up, then steps back down home. Sing it on "loo" and give each repeated note a fresh start.
rows.translation: Ta tradicionalna melodija skoči navzgor, nato po korakih nazaj domov. Poj jo na »lu« in vsak ponovljeni ton začni sveže.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: The opening leap: C up to G, step to A, back to G.
rows.translation: Začetni skok: od C navzgor do G, korak do A, nazaj na G.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: The middle phrase: does it go up or down?
rows.translation: Srednja fraza: gre navzgor ali navzdol?
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: This melody from Beethoven's Ninth Symphony moves almost entirely by step. Keep it smooth and even, like walking up and down a staircase.
rows.translation: Ta melodija iz Beethovnove Devete simfonije se premika skoraj samo po korakih. Ohrani jo gladko in enakomerno, kot hojo gor in dol po stopnicah.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: The five notes the tune lives on: F up to C.
rows.translation: Pet tonov, na katerih živi melodija: od F navzgor do C.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: The first phrase ends with a dotted note. How does it feel?
rows.translation: Prva fraza se konča z noto s piko. Kakšen je občutek?
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: The dotted note is held longer, then a short note leads into the last one.
rows.translation: Nota s piko traja dlje, nato kratka nota vodi v zadnjo.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: This traditional Scottish melody starts with a pickup, a note before the first full bar. Sing it lightly, then lean on the next note.
rows.translation: Ta tradicionalna škotska melodija se začne s predtaktom, noto pred prvim polnim taktom. Zapoj jo lahkotno, nato poudari naslednji ton.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: The climb in the third bar: F, A, C, up to D.
rows.translation: Vzpon v tretjem taktu: F, A, C, navzgor do D.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: The loudest note of a song
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: A note before the first full bar
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: A pickup leads into beat 1 of the first full bar.
rows.translation: Predtakt vodi v dobo 1 prvega polnega takta.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: This American hymn tune from the early 1800s is in 3/4: count 1, 2, 3. Long notes often turn into a quick pair, so keep the pair light.
rows.translation: Ta ameriška cerkvena melodija iz začetka stoletja po letu 1800 je v 3/4: štej 1, 2, 3. Dolgi toni pogosto preidejo v hiter par, zato naj bo par lahkoten.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: The quick turn: F, up to A, back to F.
rows.translation: Hitri obrat: F, navzgor do A, nazaj na F.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: How many beats are in each bar of this hymn?
rows.translation: Koliko dob je v vsakem taktu te cerkvene pesmi?
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: It's in 3/4: three beats per bar, with the weight on 1.
rows.translation: Je v 3/4: tri dobe na takt, s poudarkom na 1.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: This American folk song from the 1800s moves slowly, with wide leaps. Breathe at each rest, and hear every leap before you sing it.
rows.translation: Ta ameriška ljudska pesem iz stoletja z začetkom leta 1800 se premika počasi, z velikimi skoki. Vdihni pri vsaki pavzi in vsak skok zasliši, preden ga zapoješ.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: The opening leap: low G up to C. Any octave counts.
rows.translation: Začetni skok: od nizkega G navzgor do C. Vsaka oktava šteje.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: The big leap: G up to high C, then step down.
rows.translation: Veliki skok: od G navzgor do visokega C, nato po korakih navzdol.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: Where should you breathe in this song?
rows.translation: Kje naj vdihneš v tej pesmi?
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: Never; sing it in one breath
rows.translation: Nikoli; zapoj jo z enim vdihom
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: The rests mark the ends of phrases. Breathe there so each line has full support.
rows.translation: Pavze označujejo konce fraz. Tam vdihni, da ima vsaka vrstica polno oporo.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: Five tunes back to back, one phrase each. Breathe at every rest, and give repeated notes a fresh start.
rows.translation: Pet melodij druga za drugo, po ena fraza iz vsake. Vdihni pri vsaki pavzi in ponovljene tone začni sveže.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: Which of these songs is in 3/4?
rows.translation: Katera od teh pesmi je v 3/4?
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: Amazing Grace counts 1, 2, 3 in every bar.
rows.translation: V Amazing Grace vsak takt šteje 1, 2, 3.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: Hold notes steady, shape loud and soft, and warm up well.
rows.translation: Drži tone enakomerno, oblikuj glasno in tiho ter se dobro ogrej.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: Pitch drifts when the air behind it changes. Keep a low, even breath and watch the note stay centered from start to finish.
rows.translation: Višina tona odtava, ko se zrak za njim spremeni. Ohrani nizek, enakomeren dih in opazuj, kako ton od začetka do konca ostaja na sredini.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: Hold G and keep it centered.
rows.translation: Drži G in ga ohrani na sredini.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: Notes often sag flat as your air runs out. Stop a little before you're empty, then take a fresh low breath.
rows.translation: Toni pogosto zdrsnejo prenizko, ko zmanjkuje zraka. Ustavi se malo prej, nato znova nizko vdihni.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: Your long notes go flat at the end. What helps?
rows.translation: Tvoji dolgi toni so na koncu prenizki. Kaj pomaga?
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: End the note sooner and breathe
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: Pitch sags when you run low on air. Ending a bit early keeps the whole note in tune.
rows.translation: Višina zdrsne, ko zmanjkuje zraka. Če končaš malo prej, ves ton ostane čist.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: Vibrato is a gentle, regular wave in pitch, around five to seven times a second. It grows out of a relaxed throat and steady breath, not out of shaking.
rows.translation: Vibrato je nežno, pravilno valovanje višine, približno pet- do sedemkrat na sekundo. Razvije se iz sproščenega grla in enakomernega diha, ne iz tresenja.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: Where does healthy vibrato come from?
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: A relaxed throat and steady breath
rows.translation: Iz sproščenega grla in enakomernega diha
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: Vibrato appears when the voice is free and supported. Forcing it from the jaw or belly makes a wobble.
rows.translation: Vibrato se pojavi, ko je glas svoboden in podprt. Siljenje iz čeljusti ali trebuha ustvari nihanje.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: Learn to hold a straight, steady note before you chase vibrato. When your voice is relaxed and supported, vibrato often appears on its own.
rows.translation: Nauči se držati raven, enakomeren ton, preden iščeš vibrato. Ko je glas sproščen in podprt, se vibrato pogosto pojavi sam.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: A straight, steady A. No wave, just a clear line.
rows.translation: Raven, enakomeren A. Brez valovanja, le čista črta.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: What's the best first goal for a new singer?
rows.translation: Kateri je najboljši prvi cilj za pevca začetnika?
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: A steady tone is the foundation. Vibrato that grows from it sounds natural.
rows.translation: Enakomeren ton je temelj. Vibrato, ki se razvije iz njega, zveni naravno.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: Dynamics are how loud or soft you sing. Get louder with more breath energy, not by squeezing your throat. The pitch should stay put.
rows.translation: Dinamika pomeni, kako glasno ali tiho poješ. Glasnost povečaj z več energije diha, ne s stiskanjem grla. Višina tona naj ostane ista.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: Sing E softly, then louder on the same pitch.
rows.translation: Zapoj E tiho, nato glasneje na isti višini.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: As you get louder, what can happen to pitch?
rows.translation: Kaj se lahko zgodi z višino tona, ko poješ glasneje?
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: Extra push tends to raise the pitch, and very soft notes can sag flat. Watch the note either way.
rows.translation: Večji pritisk pogosto zviša ton, zelo tihi toni pa lahko zdrsnejo prenizko. V obeh primerih spremljaj ton.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: A swell grows from soft to louder and back on one breath. Start quietly, grow gently, then fade, all on the same pitch.
rows.translation: Pri naraščanju ton z enim vdihom preide iz tihega v glasnejšega in nazaj. Začni tiho, nežno naraščaj, nato pojemaj, ves čas na isti višini.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: Swell on G: soft, louder, soft. Keep it centered.
rows.translation: Oblikuj G: tiho, glasneje, tiho. Ohrani ga na sredini.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: A short warm-up eases your voice in: breathe low, hum, lip trill, then sing a scale. Start in the middle of your range and stay comfortable.
rows.translation: Kratko ogrevanje nežno pripravi glas: dihaj nizko, mrmraj, naredi ustnični trilček, nato zapoj lestvico. Začni na sredini svojega obsega in ostani pri udobnem.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: Your voice feels tired after practice. What's best?
rows.translation: Po vadbi je glas utrujen. Kaj je najbolje?
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.translation: Dati mu počitek in piti vodo po požirkih
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: Rest helps a tired voice recover. If hoarseness lingers for a few weeks, check with a doctor.
rows.translation: Počitek pomaga utrujenemu glasu okrevati. Če hripavost traja nekaj tednov, se posvetuj z zdravnikom.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: Warm up first. Then hold each note steady, shape it soft and loud, and breathe before you run out.
rows.translation: Najprej se ogrej. Nato vsak ton drži enakomerno, ga oblikuj tiho in glasno ter vdihni, preden zmanjka zraka.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: Vibrato is a gentle, even wave around the note, a few times a second.
rows.translation: Vibrato je nežno, enakomerno valovanje okoli tona, nekajkrat na sekundo.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: To sing louder, what do you add?
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: Breath energy makes a bigger sound without strain.
rows.translation: Energija diha ustvari večji zvok brez naprezanja.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: Play the melody, or strum the chords and sing
rows.translation: Igraj melodijo ali brenkaj akorde in poj
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: Six famous tunes, one note at a time, on the top strings. Slow tempos, big wins.
rows.translation: Šest znanih melodij, po en ton na zgornjih strunah. Počasni tempi, veliki uspehi.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: In 1877, Thomas Edison recited this rhyme to test his new phonograph. The tune uses C and D on string 2, then open E, and G at fret 3 on string 1.
rows.translation: Leta 1877 je Thomas Edison recitiral to pesmico, da bi preizkusil novi fonograf. Melodija uporablja C in D na struni 2, nato prazni E in G pri prečki 3 na struni 1.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: E D C D E E E: open string 1, then string 2 at frets 3 and 1, and back.
rows.translation: E D C D E E E: prazna struna 1, nato struna 2 pri prečkah 3 in 1 ter nazaj.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: D D D at fret 3 on string 2. Then open E, and G at fret 3 on string 1.
rows.translation: D D D pri prečki 3 na struni 2. Nato prazni E in G pri prečki 3 na struni 1.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: This melody was first printed in France in 1761, and Mozart later wrote twelve variations on it. It leaps up, then steps down across strings 2 and 3.
rows.translation: Ta melodija je bila prvič natisnjena v Franciji leta 1761, Mozart pa je pozneje nanjo napisal dvanajst variacij. Skoči navzgor, nato se po korakih spušča čez struni 2 in 3.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: Open G, a leap up to D at fret 3 on string 2, open E, and back to D.
rows.translation: Prazni G, skok navzgor do D pri prečki 3 na struni 2, prazni E in nazaj do D.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: Step down in pairs: C at fret 1, open B, A at fret 2 on string 3, open G.
rows.translation: Spuščaj se v parih: C pri prečki 1, prazni B, A pri prečki 2 na struni 3, prazni G.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: Which other song uses this same tune?
rows.translation: Katera druga pesem uporablja isto melodijo?
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: The alphabet song and Baa, Baa, Black Sheep both borrow this French melody.
rows.translation: Abecedna pesem in Baa, Baa, Black Sheep si obe izposodita to francosko melodijo.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: Beethoven finished his Ninth Symphony in 1824, and this melody is now the anthem of the European Union. Here you'll play the whole tune, middle section included.
rows.translation: Beethoven je Deveto simfonijo dokončal leta 1824, ta melodija pa je danes himna Evropske unije. Tu zaigraš celotno melodijo, vključno s srednjim delom.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: The opening: E E F G G F E D, one step at a time.
rows.translation: Začetek: E E F G G F E D, po en korak.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: In the middle section, E and F share a single beat. Count one, two-and, three, four, and play E on two and F on the and.
rows.translation: V srednjem delu si E in F delita eno dobo. Štej ena, dve-in, tri, štiri ter igraj E na dve in F na in.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: The middle: quick E F pairs on string 1, then down to open G on string 3.
rows.translation: Sredina: hitri pari E F na struni 1, nato navzdol do praznega G na struni 3.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: Frère Jacques is a French round, first printed around 1780: a second player starts the same tune two bars later, and the parts fit together.
rows.translation: Frère Jacques je francoski kanon, prvič natisnjen okoli leta 1780: drugi glasbenik začne isto melodijo dva takta pozneje in parta se ujameta.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: In a round, the second player…
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: Everyone plays the same melody, each starting a little later. The phrases are built to fit on top of each other.
rows.translation: Vsi igrajo isto melodijo, vsak začne malo pozneje. Fraze so sestavljene tako, da se prilegajo druga nad drugo.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: The quick part: D E D C on strings 2 and 1, then B and G.
rows.translation: Hitri del: D E D C na strunah 2 in 1, nato B in G.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: The ending dips from open G to open D on string 4, then comes back.
rows.translation: Konec se spusti s praznega G na prazni D na struni 4, nato se vrne.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: James Lord Pierpont published this song in 1857 as One Horse Open Sleigh. You'll play its famous chorus, all on strings 1 and 2.
rows.translation: James Lord Pierpont je pesem leta 1857 objavil kot One Horse Open Sleigh. Igral boš njen slavni refren, v celoti na strunah 1 in 2.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: Open E, G at fret 3, down to C and D on string 2, then home to E.
rows.translation: Prazni E, G pri prečki 3, navzdol do C in D na struni 2, nato domov na E.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: In that phrase, C rings for a beat and a half and D slips in on the and of four. Count one, two, three, four-and.
rows.translation: V tej frazi C zveni dobo in pol, D pa zdrsne noter na in za štiri. Štej ena, dve, tri, štiri-in.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: The second line sits on F at fret 1, then settles onto open E.
rows.translation: Druga vrstica obstane na F pri prečki 1, nato se umiri na praznem E.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: This traditional spiritual became a jazz standard after Louis Armstrong recorded it in 1938. It uses C, D, E, F and G on strings 2 and 1.
rows.translation: Ta tradicionalni spiritual je postal jazzovski standard, potem ko ga je leta 1938 posnel Louis Armstrong. Uporablja C, D, E, F in G na strunah 2 in 1.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: The opening: C on string 2, then E, F and G climbing string 1.
rows.translation: Začetek: C na struni 2, nato E, F in G navzgor po struni 1.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: No new notes here: all six tunes from this unit, each a little faster than before. Name the opening by ear, then play.
rows.translation: Tu ni novih tonov: vseh šest melodij iz te enote, vsaka malo hitreje kot prej. Po posluhu prepoznaj začetek, nato igraj.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: Campfire songs and a sea song, with easy chords to strum on the simplest ones.
rows.translation: Pesmi ob tabornem ognju in mornarska pesem, z lahkimi akordi za brenkanje pri najpreprostejših.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: Stephen Foster published this song in 1848, and gold seekers heading to California made it their anthem. The verse sits on strings 3, 2 and 1.
rows.translation: Stephen Foster je pesem objavil leta 1848, iskalci zlata na poti v Kalifornijo pa so jo vzeli za svojo himno. Kitica se igra na strunah 3, 2 in 1.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: Open B, D at fret 3, open E, then back down to open G and A at fret 2.
rows.translation: Prazni B, D pri prečki 3, prazni E, nato nazaj navzdol do praznega G in A pri prečki 2.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: The last bar: B B A A, then home to open G.
rows.translation: Zadnji takt: B B A A, nato domov na prazni G.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: G sounds like home, and D7 pulls back toward it. The verse is three bars of G, one of D7, two of G, then D7 and G.
rows.translation: G zveni kot dom, D7 pa vleče nazaj k njemu. Kitica ima tri takte G, enega D7, dva G, nato D7 in G.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: Stephen Foster wrote this racing song in 1850, two years after Oh! Susanna. It uses the same notes and the same two chords.
rows.translation: Stephen Foster je to pesem o dirkah napisal leta 1850, dve leti po Oh! Susanna. Uporablja iste tone in ista dva akorda.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: D D B D, up to open E, then D and B. Strings 2 and 1.
rows.translation: D D B D, navzgor do praznega E, nato D in B. Struni 2 in 1.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: Twice in the first line, a quick B leads into an A that rings for three beats. Pick the A once and let it ring.
rows.translation: Dvakrat v prvi vrstici hitri B vodi v A, ki zveni tri dobe. A uberi enkrat in ga pusti zveneti.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: This farmyard song was first printed in 1917, but people sang versions of it long before. Its tune reaches down to D and E on string 4.
rows.translation: Ta pesem o kmetiji je bila prvič natisnjena leta 1917, a ljudje so njene različice peli že dolgo prej. Melodija sega navzdol do D in E na struni 4.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: Open G three times, down to open D, E at fret 2 on string 4, back to D.
rows.translation: Trikrat prazni G, navzdol do praznega D, E pri prečki 2 na struni 4, nazaj na D.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: Then up: open B twice, A at fret 2 on string 3, and home to open G.
rows.translation: Nato navzgor: dvakrat prazni B, A pri prečki 2 na struni 3 in domov na prazni G.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: Here each chord lasts two beats, so the strum counts one, two. The order is G, G, C, G, then G, D7, G, G. Change early.
rows.translation: Tu vsak akord traja dve dobi, zato brenkanje šteje ena, dve. Vrstni red je G, G, C, G, nato G, D7, G, G. Menjaj zgodaj.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: British soldiers first sang this tune to mock American colonists. By the end of the Revolution, the Americans had made it their own.
rows.translation: Britanski vojaki so to melodijo sprva peli za posmeh ameriškim kolonistom. Do konca revolucije so jo Američani vzeli za svojo.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: C C D E, C E D, then a drop to open G on string 3.
rows.translation: C C D E, C E D, nato spust na prazni G na struni 3.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: The first half ends on B. How does that feel?
rows.translation: Prva polovica se konča na B. Kakšen je občutek?
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: B sits just below C and leans toward it. The second half answers by landing on C.
rows.translation: B je tik pod C in teži k njemu. Druga polovica odgovori s pristankom na C.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: The last line: down from F on string 1, dip to open G, then climb back to C.
rows.translation: Zadnja vrstica: navzdol od F na struni 1, spust do praznega G, nato vzpon nazaj do C.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: The chorus sits low: A at fret 2 on string 3, open B, then F and E on string 4 and C on string 5.
rows.translation: Refren je nizko: A pri prečki 2 na struni 3, prazni B, nato F in E na struni 4 ter C na struni 5.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: George Poulton published this ballad in 1861. Nearly a century later, its melody became the tune of Love Me Tender.
rows.translation: George Poulton je to balado objavil leta 1861. Skoraj stoletje pozneje je njena melodija postala napev pesmi Love Me Tender.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: Up to C, down to open B and back, then D, a dip to A, and D again.
rows.translation: Navzgor do C, navzdol do praznega B in nazaj, nato D, spust do A in spet D.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: Aura Lee is a slow ballad. Keep each finger down until the next note sounds, so the notes join smoothly.
rows.translation: Aura Lee je počasna balada. Vsak prst pusti spodaj, dokler ne zazveni naslednji ton, da se toni gladko povežejo.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: The high part: open E, F at fret 1, then down to D, A, and D again.
rows.translation: Visoki del: prazni E, F pri prečki 1, nato navzdol do D, A in spet D.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: This song from the north of England is about Bobby Shafto, gone to sea. Its words were in print by 1805, and fiddlers played its tune for dances by 1770.
rows.translation: Ta pesem iz severne Anglije govori o Bobbyju Shaftu, ki je odšel na morje. Besedilo je bilo natisnjeno že do leta 1805, violinisti pa so melodijo za plese igrali že do leta 1770.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: Open B, D at fret 3, back to B and open G, then B, D and B again.
rows.translation: Prazni B, D pri prečki 3, nazaj do B in praznega G, nato B, D in spet B.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: The second line dips to F sharp: string 4, fret 4, with your little finger. Keep your hand over the first four frets so it's ready.
rows.translation: Druga vrstica se spusti do F z višajem: struna 4, prečka 4, z mezincem. Roko ohrani nad prvimi štirimi prečkami, da bo pripravljena.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: A at fret 2 on string 3, C at fret 1 on string 2, A, down to F sharp, and back up.
rows.translation: A pri prečki 2 na struni 3, C pri prečki 1 na struni 2, A, navzdol do F z višajem in nazaj navzgor.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: The first three lines end the same way: two notes of one beat, then one of two beats. Gone to sea, on his knee, marry me.
rows.translation: Prve tri vrstice se končajo enako: dve enodobni noti, nato ena dvodobna. Gone to sea, on his knee, marry me.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: The verse needs only the two chords from Oh! Susanna: two bars of G, two of D7, two of G, then D7 and G.
rows.translation: Kitica potrebuje le akorda iz Oh! Susanna: dva takta G, dva D7, dva G, nato D7 in G.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: No new notes or chords: all six songs from this unit, one after another, each a little faster than before.
rows.translation: Brez novih tonov ali akordov: vseh šest pesmi iz te enote, ena za drugo, vsaka nekoliko hitreje kot prej.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: Famous themes by Pachelbel, Dvořák, Brahms, Petzold, Grieg and Beethoven, in first position.
rows.translation: Znamenite teme Pachelbla, Dvořáka, Brahmsa, Petzolda, Griega in Beethovna v prvi legi.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: Johann Pachelbel wrote this canon over 300 years ago. Its bass repeats the same eight notes the whole way through while violins weave melodies above.
rows.translation: Johann Pachelbel je ta kanon napisal pred več kot 300 leti. Bas ves čas ponavlja istih osem tonov, violine pa nad njim prepletajo melodije.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: The bass, moved up an octave: D, A, B, F sharp, G, D, G, A.
rows.translation: Bas, prestavljen oktavo više: D, A, B, F z višajem, G, D, G, A.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: What does the bass do all through the Canon?
rows.translation: Kaj počne bas skozi ves Kanon?
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: Plays a new tune each time
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: A repeating bass like this is called a ground. Everything else in the piece is built on top of it.
rows.translation: Tak ponavljajoči se bas imenujemo ostinatni bas. Vse drugo v skladbi je zgrajeno nad njim.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: A sharp is one fret above its letter. The melody uses C sharp on string 2, fret 2, and F sharp on string 4, fret 4. Reach that one with your little finger.
rows.translation: Ton z višajem je eno prečko nad tonom brez predznaka. Melodija uporablja C z višajem na struni 2, prečki 2, in F z višajem na struni 4, prečki 4. Tega dosezi z mezincem.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: The first violin line: down from F sharp on string 1, then back up to C sharp.
rows.translation: Prva violinska melodija: navzdol od F z višajem na struni 1, nato nazaj navzgor do C z višajem.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.translation: Largo iz simfonije Iz novega sveta
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: Antonín Dvořák wrote this theme for English horn in 1893, in his Symphony From the New World, while he was living in New York.
rows.translation: Antonín Dvořák je to temo za angleški rog napisal leta 1893 v svoji simfoniji Iz novega sveta, ko je živel v New Yorku.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: Open E, G at fret 3 on string 1, back to E, then D and C on string 2.
rows.translation: Prazni E, G na prečki 3 strune 1, nazaj na E, nato D in C na struni 2.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: Most bars open with a long note and a quick one. Count one, two-and, three: the quick note lands on the and of two.
rows.translation: Večina taktov se začne z dolgim in kratkim tonom. Štej ena, dve-in, tri: kratki ton pride na in druge dobe.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: The ending: D, E, D, then settle on C and let it ring.
rows.translation: Zaključek: D, E, D, nato se ustavi na C in pusti, da zveni.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: Johannes Brahms wrote this lullaby in 1868 for a friend's newborn son. It sways in three, like a cradle: a long note, then two quick ones.
rows.translation: Johannes Brahms je to uspavanko napisal leta 1868 za prijateljičinega novorojenega sina. Ziblje se v treh dobah kakor zibelka: dolg ton, nato dva kratka.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: The opening rocks between open B and D at fret 3 on string 2.
rows.translation: Začetek niha med praznim B in D na prečki 3 strune 2.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: Open G on string 3, then the same note an octave higher: G at fret 3 on string 1.
rows.translation: Prazni G na struni 3, nato isti ton oktavo više: G na prečki 3 strune 1.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: This minuet appears in a 1725 notebook Bach gave his wife, Anna Magdalena. Scholars now credit it to his fellow composer Christian Petzold.
rows.translation: Ta menuet je v zvezku iz leta 1725, ki ga je Bach podaril ženi Anni Magdaleni. Raziskovalci ga danes pripisujejo njegovemu skladateljskemu kolegu Christianu Petzoldu.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: D at fret 3 on string 2, then climb from open G: A, B, C, D. Then two open Gs.
rows.translation: D na prečki 3 strune 2, nato navzgor od praznega G: A, B, C, D. Nato dva prazna tona G.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: A minuet is a dance in three. Most bars start with a long beat, then quick pairs: one, two-and, three-and.
rows.translation: Menuet je ples v treh dobah. Večina taktov se začne z dolgim tonom, nato sledijo hitri pari: ena, dve-in, tri-in.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: Open E, back to C and D on string 2, then E, F sharp and G on string 1.
rows.translation: Prazni E, nazaj na C in D na struni 2, nato E, F z višajem in G na struni 1.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: The ending: A B A G, then F sharp at fret 4 on string 4, and home to G.
rows.translation: Zaključek: A B A G, nato F z višajem na prečki 4 strune 4 in domov na G.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: The second section starts low: open B, A, open D, then C sharp at fret 4 and B at fret 2 on string 5, and open A.
rows.translation: Drugi del se začne nizko: prazni B, A, prazni D, nato C z višajem na prečki 4 in B na prečki 2 strune 5 ter prazni A.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: In the Hall of the Mountain King
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: Grieg wrote this for the play Peer Gynt in 1875. It pictures trolls in their king's hall, and it starts quietly and keeps speeding up.
rows.translation: Grieg je to napisal za igro Peer Gynt leta 1875. Prikazuje trole v kraljevi dvorani, začne se tiho in postaja vse hitrejše.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: Climb from open string 6: F sharp at fret 2, G at fret 3, open A, B at fret 2.
rows.translation: Od prazne strune 6 navzgor: F z višajem na prečki 2, G na prečki 3, prazni A, B na prečki 2.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: The creeping part: A sharp at fret 1 on string 5, then open A with F at fret 1 on string 6.
rows.translation: Prikradljivi del: A z višajem na prečki 1 strune 5, nato prazni A s F na prečki 1 strune 6.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: Where is A sharp on string 5?
rows.translation: Kje je A z višajem na struni 5?
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: A sharp is one fret above A, and A is open string 5. So A sharp is fret 1.
rows.translation: A z višajem je eno prečko nad A, A pa je prazna struna 5. Zato je A z višajem na prečki 1.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: Beethoven wrote this piano piece in 1810, but it wasn't published until 1867, forty years after he died. This simplified version keeps the famous opening.
rows.translation: Beethoven je to klavirsko skladbo napisal leta 1810, objavljena pa je bila šele leta 1867, štirideset let po njegovi smrti. Ta poenostavljena različica ohranja znameniti začetek.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: Rock between open E and D sharp at fret 4 on string 2, then walk down B, D, C to A.
rows.translation: Izmenjuj prazni E in D z višajem na prečki 4 strune 2, nato se spusti prek B, D, C do A.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: Each bar has three beats. After the long A comes a short rest, then three quick notes climb: C, E, A. Lift your finger for the rest, but keep counting.
rows.translation: Vsak takt ima tri dobe. Dolgemu A sledi kratka pavza, nato se vzpnejo trije kratki toni: C, E, A. Med pavzo dvigni prst, a štej naprej.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: A, then C on string 5, E and A. Then B, E, G sharp at fret 1 on string 3, and B.
rows.translation: A, nato C na struni 5, E in A. Nato B, E, G z višajem na prečki 1 strune 3 in B.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: The middle: each phrase dips to a low note, then steps down. E G F E, D F E D, C E D C.
rows.translation: Srednji del: vsaka fraza se spusti na nizek ton, nato gre po stopnjah navzdol. E G F E, D F E D, C E D C.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: No new notes: the six themes from this unit, from Pachelbel to Beethoven, each a little faster than before.
rows.translation: Brez novih tonov: šest tem iz te enote, od Pachelbla do Beethovna, vsaka nekoliko hitreje kot prej.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: Which of these pieces is in three?
rows.translation: Katera od teh skladb ima tri dobe v taktu?
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: A minuet is a dance in three. The Canon and the trolls' march both count in four.
rows.translation: Menuet je ples v treh dobah. Kanon in koračnica trolov imata po štiri dobe v taktu.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: A Gold Rush ballad, two beloved hymns and a Shaker song from America's songbook.
rows.translation: Balada iz časa zlate mrzlice, dve priljubljeni hvalnici in pesem shakerjev iz ameriškega pesemskega izročila.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: This American song was published in 1884 and looks back to the California Gold Rush of 1849. It's in three, on strings 3, 2 and 1.
rows.translation: Ta ameriška pesem je bila objavljena leta 1884 in se ozira na kalifornijsko zlato mrzlico leta 1849. Ima tri dobe v taktu, igraš pa jo na strunah 3, 2 in 1.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: Clementine starts with two quick notes before beat one. What are they called?
rows.translation: Clementine se začne z dvema kratkima tonoma pred prvo dobo. Kako ju imenujemo?
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: A pickup is a few notes that lead into the first strong beat. Here they fall on the and of beat three.
rows.translation: Predtakt je nekaj tonov, ki vodijo v prvo poudarjeno dobo. Tukaj prideta na in tretje dobe.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: The turn in the middle: G at fret 3 on string 1, down to D, then back up to F.
rows.translation: Obrat na sredini: G na prečki 3 strune 1, navzdol do D, nato nazaj navzgor do F.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: John Newton wrote the words in 1779. The tune, called New Britain, was first printed in 1829 and joined to his words in 1835.
rows.translation: John Newton je besedilo napisal leta 1779. Melodija New Britain je bila prvič natisnjena leta 1829, z njegovim besedilom pa združena leta 1835.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: The high line: up to D at fret 3 on string 2, then B G, B A, G E D.
rows.translation: Visoka melodija: navzgor do D na prečki 3 strune 2, nato B G, B A, G E D.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: Samuel Francis Smith wrote these American words in 1831, to a tune Britain already sang as God Save the King.
rows.translation: Samuel Francis Smith je to ameriško besedilo napisal leta 1831 na melodijo, ki so jo v Britaniji že peli kot God Save the King.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: A dot makes a note half again as long. In bar two, F sharp rings for a beat and a half, G slips in on the and of two, and A lands on three.
rows.translation: Pika podaljša noto za polovico njene vrednosti. V drugem taktu F z višajem zveni dobo in pol, G pride na in druge dobe, A pa na tretjo.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: The last line: B C B A G, then B C D, up to open E, and down C B A G.
rows.translation: Zadnja vrstica: B C B A G, nato B C D, navzgor do praznega E in navzdol C B A G.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: Joseph Brackett wrote Simple Gifts in 1848 for the Shakers, who danced as they sang. Aaron Copland later built part of his ballet Appalachian Spring around it.
rows.translation: Joseph Brackett je leta 1848 napisal Simple Gifts za shakerje, ki so med petjem plesali. Aaron Copland je pozneje okoli nje zgradil del baleta Apalaška pomlad.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: The second part starts high: G at fret 3 on string 1, then E D, and E F E D C.
rows.translation: Drugi del se začne visoko: G na prečki 3 strune 1, nato E D in E F E D C.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: Two notes share each beat in this tune. How do you count them?
rows.translation: V tej melodiji si vsako dobo delita dva tona. Kako ju šteješ?
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: Two even notes per beat are eighth notes. Say the number on the first and "and" on the second.
rows.translation: Dva enakomerno dolga tona na dobo sta osminki. Na prvi reci številko, na drugi pa »in«.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: No new ideas: the four songs from this unit, each a little faster than before. Three of them sway in three. Simple Gifts dances in four.
rows.translation: Brez novih zamisli: štiri pesmi iz te enote, vsaka nekoliko hitreje kot prej. Tri se zibljejo v treh dobah. Simple Gifts pleše v štirih.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: What does a dot after a note do?
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: Makes it half again as long
rows.translation: Podaljša jo za polovico njene vrednosti
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: A dotted quarter lasts a beat and a half. The note after it is usually quick, to fill out the beat.
rows.translation: Četrtinka s piko traja dobo in pol. Naslednji ton je navadno kratek, da dopolni dobo.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: Carols and a New Year's song, in two, three, four and six.
rows.translation: Božične pesmi in novoletna pesem v dveh, treh, štirih in šestih dobah.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: This tune was printed in 1582 in Piae Cantiones, a songbook from Finland, as a song about spring. John Mason Neale gave it Christmas words in 1853.
rows.translation: Ta melodija je bila leta 1582 natisnjena kot pomladna pesem v finski pesmarici Piae Cantiones. John Mason Neale ji je leta 1853 dodal božično besedilo.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: The last line climbs from open D on string 4: E, F sharp at fret 4, open G, then A.
rows.translation: Zadnja vrstica se vzpne od praznega D na struni 4: E, F z višajem na prečki 4, prazni G, nato A.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: Then from D at fret 3 on string 2, step down to G, touch C, and land on G.
rows.translation: Nato se od D na prečki 3 strune 2 spusti do G, dotakni se C in pristani na G.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: Deck the Halls comes from Nos Galan, a Welsh New Year's Eve song from the 1700s. The English words came in 1862.
rows.translation: Deck the Halls izvira iz Nos Galan, valižanske silvestrske pesmi iz stoletja z začetkom leta 1700. Angleško besedilo je nastalo leta 1862.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: The third line climbs: C sharp at fret 2 on string 2, D, then E, F sharp and G on string 1.
rows.translation: Tretja vrstica se vzpne: C z višajem na prečki 2 strune 2, D, nato E, F z višajem in G na struni 1.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: A7 needs two fingers on fret 2: finger 1 on string 4, finger 3 on string 2. Start your strum on string 5. That C sharp on string 2 is the one the melody climbs through.
rows.translation: Za A7 potrebuješ dva prsta na prečki 2: prst 1 na struni 4, prst 3 na struni 2. Udarec začni na struni 5. Ta C z višajem na struni 2 je isti ton, prek katerega se vzpne melodija.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: We Wish You a Merry Christmas
rows.translation: We Wish You a Merry Christmas
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: This carol comes from England's West Country, where singers went door to door on winter nights and hoped for a treat in return.
rows.translation: Ta božična pesem izvira iz jugozahodne Anglije, kjer so pevci v zimskih nočeh hodili od vrat do vrat in v zameno upali na priboljšek.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: D at fret 3 on string 2 and open string 4 are both D. How far apart are they?
rows.translation: D na prečki 3 strune 2 in prazna struna 4 sta oba D. Kako daleč sta narazen?
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: An octave is the same letter, eight steps higher or lower. The two Ds blend, but one sounds brighter.
rows.translation: Oktava ima isto črkovno ime, osem stopenj više ali niže. Oba tona D se zlijeta, vendar eden zveni svetleje.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: B A G, then leap from D at fret 3 on string 2 down to open D. Then E, A, F sharp, G.
rows.translation: B A G, nato skoči od D na prečki 3 strune 2 navzdol na prazni D. Nato E, A, F z višajem, G.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: Auld lang syne is Scots for old long since, meaning days gone by. Robert Burns sent the words to a songbook in 1788, and this melody was printed with them in 1799.
rows.translation: Auld lang syne v škotščini pomeni davno minule čase. Robert Burns je besedilo leta 1788 poslal pesmarici, ta melodija pa je bila z njim natisnjena leta 1799.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: The chorus reaches up: B, D, open E, then G at fret 3 on string 1. Back down: D, B B G.
rows.translation: Refren se vzpne: B, D, prazni E, nato G na prečki 3 strune 1. Nazaj navzdol: D, B B G.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: Lowell Mason arranged this tune in 1839, borrowing phrases from Handel's Messiah. It opens with a G major scale, straight down from G to G.
rows.translation: Lowell Mason je to melodijo priredil leta 1839 in si izposodil fraze iz Händlovega Mesije. Začne se z G-durovo lestvico naravnost navzdol od G do G.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: This carol counts in two. In bar one, G fills beat one, F sharp takes most of beat two, and E slips in at the very end.
rows.translation: To božično pesem šteješ v dveh dobah. V prvem taktu G zapolni prvo dobo, F z višajem večino druge, E pa pride čisto na koncu.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: The middle repeats open B and steps up to D, then repeats A at fret 2 on string 3 and steps up to C.
rows.translation: Srednji del ponavlja prazni B in se vzpne do D, nato ponavlja A na prečki 2 strune 3 in se vzpne do C.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: Franz Xaver Gruber wrote Silent Night in 1818 for Christmas Eve in Oberndorf, Austria. At its first performance, the only accompaniment was a guitar.
rows.translation: Franz Xaver Gruber je Sveto noč napisal leta 1818 za božični večer v avstrijskem Oberndorfu. Ob prvi izvedbi jo je spremljala samo kitara.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: Silent Night is in 6/8: six quick counts per bar, grouped one-two-three, four-five-six. Each group sways like one slow beat.
rows.translation: Sveta noč je v 6/8: šest hitrih enot na takt, združenih v ena-dve-tri, štiri-pet-šest. Vsaka skupina se ziblje kot ena počasna doba.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: The ending climbs to G at fret 3 on string 1, rings on F sharp, then walks down to open D.
rows.translation: Zaključek se vzpne do G na prečki 3 strune 1, zazveni na F z višajem, nato se spusti do praznega D.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: D uses the top four strings. Finger 1 on string 3, fret 2; finger 2 on string 1, fret 2; finger 3 on string 2, fret 3. Strum from open string 4.
rows.translation: D uporablja štiri najtanjše strune. Prst 1 na struni 3, prečki 2; prst 2 na struni 1, prečki 2; prst 3 na struni 2, prečki 3. Udari od prazne strune 4.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: Joseph Mohr (1818), English by John Freeman Young (1859)
rows.translation: Joseph Mohr (1818), angleško besedilo John Freeman Young (1859)
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: No new ideas: six songs in two, three, four and six, each a little faster than before. Feel where every bar begins.
rows.translation: Brez novih zamisli: šest pesmi v dveh, treh, štirih in šestih dobah, vsaka nekoliko hitreje kot prej. Začuti začetek vsakega takta.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.translation: Katera božična pesem se začne tako?
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: Silent Night is in 6/8. How are its six counts grouped?
rows.translation: Sveta noč je v 6/8. Kako je združenih šest enot?
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: 6/8 sways in two big beats, each split into three: one-two-three, four-five-six.
rows.translation: 6/8 se ziblje v dveh velikih dobah, vsaka se deli na tri: ena-dve-tri, štiri-pet-šest.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: Two Mozart themes and two old airs: rests, minor keys, a wide range and third position.
rows.translation: Dve Mozartovi temi in dva stara napeva: pavze, molove tonalitete, širok obseg in tretja lega.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: Mozart finished this serenade for strings in 1787. Its opening leaps up through the notes of a G chord, then answers with the notes of D7.
rows.translation: Mozart je to serenado za godala dokončal leta 1787. Začetek skače navzgor po tonih akorda G, nato odgovori s toni D7.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: A rest is a silent beat. Touch the string with your fretting fingers so the silence is crisp, then come back in exactly on time.
rows.translation: Pavza je tiha doba. S prsti na ubiralki se dotakni strune, da se zvok jasno prekine, nato se vrni natančno ob pravem času.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: The answer: C at fret 1 on string 2, A at fret 2 on string 3, F sharp at fret 4 on string 4, then open D.
rows.translation: Odgovor: C na prečki 1 strune 2, A na prečki 2 strune 3, F z višajem na prečki 4 strune 4, nato prazni D.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: The opening climbs through a chord. Major or minor?
rows.translation: Začetek se vzpenja po akordu. Durov ali molov?
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: Greensleeves was sung in England by the 1580s, and Shakespeare mentions it in The Merry Wives of Windsor. Here it's in E minor, low and dark.
rows.translation: Greensleeves so v Angliji peli že v desetletju z začetkom leta 1580, Shakespeare pa jo omenja v Veselih ženah windsorskih. Tukaj je v E-molu, nizka in temna.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: In E minor, D sharp sits one fret below E and pulls toward it. Find D sharp at string 4, fret 1, and C sharp at string 5, fret 4.
rows.translation: V E-molu je D z višajem eno prečko pod E in teži proti njemu. Poišči D z višajem na struni 4, prečki 1, in C z višajem na struni 5, prečki 4.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: Each half ends: G, F sharp, E, then D sharp, C sharp, D sharp, and home to E.
rows.translation: Vsaka polovica se konča: G, F z višajem, E, nato D z višajem, C z višajem, D z višajem in domov na E.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: The chorus starts high: D at fret 3 on string 2, C sharp at fret 2, open B, then down to open D.
rows.translation: Refren se začne visoko: D na prečki 3 strune 2, C z višajem na prečki 2, prazni B, nato navzdol do praznega D.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: Greensleeves is built on this chord. Major or minor?
rows.translation: Greensleeves temelji na tem akordu. Durov ali molov?
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: This melody was first printed in George Petrie's collection of Irish music in 1855. The words of Danny Boy were set to it much later, in 1913.
rows.translation: Ta melodija je bila prvič natisnjena leta 1855 v zbirki irske glasbe Georgea Petrieja. Besedilo Danny Boy je bilo uglasbeno nanjo veliko pozneje, leta 1913.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: The high point: three As, up to F sharp at fret 2 on string 1, then E E D B D, A F sharp D.
rows.translation: Vrh: trije toni A, navzgor do F z višajem na prečki 2 strune 1, nato E E D B D, A F z višajem D.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: This tune runs from string 5 to string 1. What keeps every string in reach?
rows.translation: Ta melodija sega od strune 5 do strune 1. Kaj pomaga doseči vse strune?
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: With your thumb low behind the neck, your fingers arch and reach from string 5 to string 1 without straining.
rows.translation: Če je palec nizko za vratom, se prsti usločijo in brez naprezanja dosežejo od strune 5 do strune 1.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: Mozart finished his Symphony No. 40 in 1788. It's one of only two symphonies he wrote in a minor key, and it opens with this restless, sighing theme.
rows.translation: Mozart je Simfonijo št. 40 dokončal leta 1788. Je ena od samo dveh simfonij, ki ju je napisal v molovi tonaliteti, začne pa se s to nemirno, vzdihujočo temo.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: Slide your hand up so finger 1 rests at fret 3. Each finger now covers one fret: 3, 4, 5 and 6. Move your thumb up too, behind finger 2.
rows.translation: Roko pomakni navzgor, da prst 1 počiva na prečki 3. Vsak prst zdaj pokriva eno prečko: 3, 4, 5 in 6. Tudi palec pomakni navzgor, za prst 2.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: In third position, which finger plays fret 3?
rows.translation: Kateri prst v tretji legi igra prečko 3?
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: A position is named for where finger 1 sits. In third position, finger 1 plays fret 3 and finger 4 reaches fret 6.
rows.translation: Lega je poimenovana po mestu prsta 1. V tretji legi prst 1 igra prečko 3, prst 4 pa doseže prečko 6.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: E flat at fret 4 and D at fret 3 on string 2, then finger 4 up to B flat at fret 6 on string 1.
rows.translation: E z nižajem na prečki 4 in D na prečki 3 strune 2, nato prst 4 navzgor do B z nižajem na prečki 6 strune 1.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: The last phrase: F sharp, reaching finger 1 back to fret 2. Then E flat, D, C at fret 5 on string 3, and B flat.
rows.translation: Zadnja fraza: F z višajem, prst 1 iztegni nazaj na prečko 2. Nato E z nižajem, D, C na prečki 5 strune 3 in B z nižajem.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: No new ideas: two Mozart themes, two old airs and third position, each a little faster than before. Breathe between pieces.
rows.translation: Brez novih zamisli: dve Mozartovi temi, dva stara napeva in tretja lega, vse nekoliko hitreje kot prej. Med skladbami zadihaj.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: In E minor, which note leans up into E?
rows.translation: Kateri ton v E-molu teži navzgor proti E?
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: D sharp sits one fret below E. That half step pulls hard toward home, which is why Greensleeves uses it at every cadence.
rows.translation: D z višajem je eno prečko pod E. Ta polton močno vleče proti domu, zato ga Greensleeves uporablja v vsaki kadenci.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: Five new songs on the open chords you know: campfire pop, a ballad, stomp-folk, reggae and country.
rows.translation: Pet novih pesmi z znanimi odprtimi akordi: pop ob ognju, balada, folk z udarjanjem z nogo, reggae in country.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: Kite Weather is bright, easy pop: four chords on a loop, G, D, E minor and C, at a relaxed 88 beats per minute. Listen for the hook jumping up to F sharp in its second bar.
rows.translation: Vreme za zmaje je vedri, lahkotni pop: štirje akordi v krogu, G, D, E-mol in C, pri sproščenih 88 dobah na minuto. Poslušaj, kako značilni motiv v drugem taktu skoči na F z višajem.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: Does the hook climb or fall at first?
rows.translation: Ali se značilni motiv na začetku vzpenja ali spušča?
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: D at fret 3 on string 2, open B and back, then open E and F sharp at fret 2 on string 1.
rows.translation: D na prečki 3 strune 2, prazni B in nazaj, nato prazni E in F z višajem na prečki 2 strune 1.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: Porchlight drifts along at 70 beats per minute. A ballad is a slow song that tells a story, so give every chord room to ring. Listen for the long note that closes each line.
rows.translation: Luč na verandi teče pri 70 dobah na minuto. Balada je počasna pesem, ki pripoveduje zgodbo, zato daj vsakemu akordu prostor, da zazveni. Poslušaj dolgi ton, ki konča vsako vrstico.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: Does this phrase end at home?
rows.translation: Ali se ta fraza konča doma?
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: The chorus climbs string 1: open E, F sharp at fret 2, G at fret 3, then steps back down to D.
rows.translation: Refren se vzpne po struni 1: prazni E, F z višajem na prečki 2, G na prečki 3, nato se po stopnjah spusti do D.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.translation: Folk z udarci nog in ploskanjem
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: Moth and Ember is the kind of song a whole room stomps along to: heavy downstrokes, a chant of a hook, 96 beats per minute. It starts dark in A minor and brightens on D.
rows.translation: Vešča in žerjavica je pesem, ob kateri vsa soba udarja z nogami: težki udarci navzdol, vzklikajoč značilni motiv, 96 dob na minuto. Začne se temno v A-molu in se razvedri na D.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: Climb A minor: A at fret 2 on string 3, C at fret 1 on string 2, open E. Then step back down.
rows.translation: Vzpenjaj se po A-molu: A na prečki 2 strune 3, C na prečki 1 strune 2, prazni E. Nato se po stopnjah vrni navzdol.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: The hook's second bar copies the first, a few notes higher. What is that called?
rows.translation: Drugi takt značilnega motiva ponovi prvega nekaj tonov više. Kako to imenujemo?
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: A sequence repeats a melodic shape from a new starting note. It makes a hook easy to remember.
rows.translation: Sekvenca ponovi melodično obliko z novim začetnim tonom. Tako si značilni motiv laže zapomnimo.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: Low Tide Radio is laid-back reggae at 80 beats per minute. The guitar plays only on the and of each beat, a short chop called a skank, while bass and drums hold the beat.
rows.translation: Radio ob oseki je sproščen reggae pri 80 dobah na minuto. Kitara igra le na in vsake dobe, kratek udarec, imenovan skank, medtem ko bas in bobni držijo dobo.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: Strum down on each and, then ease your fretting fingers off the strings so the chord stops. Chk, chk, chk, chk. The silence between chops is half the groove.
rows.translation: Udari navzdol na vsak in, nato popusti pritisk prstov na strune, da akord utihne. Čk, čk, čk, čk. Tišina med udarci je polovica ritmičnega občutka.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: Open E, D at fret 3 on string 2, C sharp at fret 2, open B, then A at fret 2 on string 3.
rows.translation: Prazni E, D na prečki 3 strune 2, C z višajem na prečki 2, prazni B, nato A na prečki 2 strune 3.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: Dust on the Dashboard rolls along at 100 beats per minute. Country players split the bar: boom, a bass note on beats one and three, then chick, a strum on two and four.
rows.translation: Prah na armaturi se kotali pri 100 dobah na minuto. Country glasbeniki razdelijo takt: bum, basovski ton na prvi in tretji dobi, nato čik, udarec čez strune na drugi in četrti.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.translation: Uberi osnovni ton, nato udari čez strune
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: On boom, pick only the chord's lowest note, its root: open string 5 for A, open string 4 for D, open string 6 for E. On chick, brush the thinner strings.
rows.translation: Na bum uberi le najnižji ton akorda, njegov osnovni ton: prazno struno 5 za A, prazno struno 4 za D, prazno struno 6 za E. Na čik oplazi tanjše strune.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: Which string is the boom for a D chord?
rows.translation: Katera struna je bum pri akordu D?
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: D's root is open string 4, the same string a D strum starts from.
rows.translation: Osnovni ton D je prazna struna 4, ista struna, na kateri se začne udarec akorda D.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: A at fret 2 on string 3, open B, C sharp at fret 2 on string 2, then open E and F sharp at fret 2.
rows.translation: A na prečki 2 strune 3, prazni B, C z višajem na prečki 2 strune 2, nato prazni E in F z višajem na prečki 2.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: No new chords or notes: the five songs from this unit, each a touch faster. Name each hook by ear, then play.
rows.translation: Brez novih akordov ali tonov: pet pesmi iz te enote, vsaka malenkost hitreje. Po posluhu prepoznaj vsak značilni motiv, nato ga zaigraj.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: Which song's hook starts like this?
rows.translation: Značilni motiv katere pesmi se začne tako?
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: In reggae, where does the guitar chop?
rows.translation: Kje v reggaeju kitara igra kratke udarce?
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: On the and of each beat
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: The skank lands between the beats, while bass and drums hold the downbeats.
rows.translation: Skank pride med dobe, medtem ko bas in bobni držijo glavne utripe.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: Five songs on three chords each: a campfire chorus, a country two-step, a waltz, easy reggae and bedroom pop.
rows.translation: Pet pesmi s po tremi akordi: refren ob tabornem ognju, country two-step, valček, lahkoten reggae in domači pop.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: Lantern Hill is a campfire song on three chords, G, C and D, at 92 beats per minute. The chorus is made for a crowd, so by the second time around, sing it out.
rows.translation: Grič svetilk je pesem za taborni ogenj s tremi akordi, G, C in D, pri 92 dobah na minuto. Refren je namenjen množici, zato ga ob drugi ponovitvi zapoj na glas.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: Open E, D at fret 3 on string 2, open E again, then G at fret 3 on string 1 and back down.
rows.translation: Prazni E, D na prečki 3 strune 2, spet prazni E, nato G na prečki 3 strune 1 in nazaj navzdol.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: Gravel Road Two-Step is dance-hall country in A at 116 beats per minute. Pick the root on one and three, strum on two and four, and add a quick up after each strum.
rows.translation: Two-step po makadamu je plesni country v A-duru pri 116 dobah na minuto. Na prvi in tretji dobi uberi osnovni ton, na drugi in četrti udari čez strune, po vsakem udarcu pa dodaj hiter udarec navzgor.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: In a two-step, where do the bass notes fall?
rows.translation: Na katerih dobah v two-stepu zazvenijo basovski toni?
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: The bass walks with the dancers' feet on one and three; the strums fill two and four.
rows.translation: Bas sledi korakom plesalcev na prvi in tretji dobi; udarci čez strune zapolnijo drugo in četrto.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: F sharp at fret 2 on string 1, open E, D at fret 3 on string 2, then C sharp at fret 2 and A on string 3.
rows.translation: F z višajem na prečki 2 strune 1, prazni E, D na prečki 3 strune 2, nato C z višajem na prečki 2 in A na struni 3.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: First Frost counts in three at 108 beats per minute: one, two, three, with the weight on one. D, G and A carry it all, and every line ends on a long, held note.
rows.translation: Prva slana ima tri dobe v taktu pri 108 dobah na minuto: ena, dve, tri, s poudarkom na prvi. Vse nosijo D, G in A, vsaka vrstica pa se konča z dolgim, zadržanim tonom.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: G at fret 3 on string 1, D at fret 3 on string 2, twice. Then E, F sharp at fret 2, E, D and A.
rows.translation: G na prečki 3 strune 1, D na prečki 3 strune 2, dvakrat. Nato E, F z višajem na prečki 2, E, D in A.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.translation: Reggae na drugi in četrti dobi
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: Hammock Season is easy reggae in C at 76 beats per minute. The guitar plays only on beats two and four: one short, bright upstroke on the top strings, then silence.
rows.translation: Čas visečih mrež je lahkoten reggae v C-duru pri 76 dobah na minuto. Kitara igra le na drugi in četrti dobi: en kratek, svetel udarec navzgor po tankih strunah, nato tišina.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: Brush up across strings 1 to 3, then relax your fretting hand so the chord stops at once. Chk on two, chk on four. The quiet beats are what make it sway.
rows.translation: Oplazi strune od 1 do 3 navzgor, nato sprosti roko na ubiralki, da akord takoj utihne. Čk na drugi, čk na četrti dobi. Tihe dobe ustvarijo zibanje.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: Glow-in-the-Dark Stars is soft bedroom pop at 84 beats per minute: E minor, C and G, strummed light. Most lines start just after the beat, so let them float in.
rows.translation: Pesem Zvezde, ki svetijo v temi je nežen domači pop pri 84 dobah na minuto: E-mol, C in G z lahkimi udarci. Večina vrstic se začne tik po dobi, zato naj mehko priplavajo.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: Open E twice, G at fret 3 on string 1, open E, G again, then D at fret 3 on string 2.
rows.translation: Dvakrat prazni E, G na prečki 3 strune 1, prazni E, spet G, nato D na prečki 3 strune 2.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: E minor, C and G share one note. Which?
rows.translation: E-mol, C in G imajo en skupni ton. Katerega?
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: E minor is E, G and B; C is C, E and G; G is G, B and D. G sits in all three, so the changes feel smooth.
rows.translation: E-mol sestavljajo E, G in B; C sestavljajo C, E in G; G sestavljajo G, B in D. G je v vseh treh, zato menjave zvenijo gladko.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: In reggae, where does the guitar play?
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: Reggae's guitar answers the beat: a short upstroke on two and four, silence in between.
rows.translation: Kitara v reggaeju odgovarja dobi: kratek udarec navzgor na drugi in četrti dobi, vmes tišina.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: The four-chord loop five ways: two summer anthems, a roller-rink bop, a pop song in 6/8 and a stadium chorus.
rows.translation: Krog štirih akordov na pet načinov: dve poletni himni, uspešnica za kotalkališče, pop pesem v 6/8 in stadionski refren.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: Sparkler Season rides the most famous loop in pop: C, G, A minor and F, the one, five, six and four of C. Hundreds of hits share these chords; a new tune and new words make each one its own.
rows.translation: Čas iskric jezdi na najbolj znanem krogu v popu: C, G, A-mol in F, prvi, peti, šesti in četrti stopnji C-dura. Te akorde uporablja na stotine uspešnic; nova melodija in novo besedilo vsaki dasta lastni značaj.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: The mini F covers strings 4 to 1: finger 1 flat across strings 2 and 1 at fret 1, finger 2 on string 3, fret 2, finger 3 on string 4, fret 3.
rows.translation: Mali F pokriva strune od 4 do 1: prst 1 položi čez struni 2 in 1 na prečki 1, prst 2 na struno 3, prečko 2, prst 3 pa na struno 4, prečko 3.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: Roller Rink is bright dance pop at 120 beats per minute: G, E minor, C and D, the one, six, four and five. Strum even eighths and feel the kick drum land on every beat.
rows.translation: Kotalkališče je vedri plesni pop pri 120 dobah na minuto: G, E-mol, C in D, prva, šesta, četrta in peta stopnja. Igraj enakomerne osminke in začuti veliki boben na vsaki dobi.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: D at fret 3 on string 2, open E, G at fret 3 on string 1 three times, F sharp at fret 2, open E.
rows.translation: D na prečki 3 strune 2, prazni E, trikrat G na prečki 3 strune 1, F z višajem na prečki 2, prazni E.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: Echo Canyon plays E minor, C, G and D at 80 beats per minute. Big strum on one, let it ring, then build on three and four. The half-time beat makes it feel huge.
rows.translation: Kanjon odmevov igra E-mol, C, G in D pri 80 dobah na minuto. Močan udarec na prvi dobi, pusti ga zveneti, nato stopnjuj na tretji in četrti. Občutek polovičnega tempa mu daje mogočnost.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: Kite Weather plays G, D, E minor and C. Echo Canyon plays E minor, C, G and D. What changed?
rows.translation: Vreme za zmaje igra G, D, E-mol in C. Kanjon odmevov igra E-mol, C, G in D. Kaj se je spremenilo?
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: Same four chords, same key. Starting on E minor puts the sad chord first, so the loop sounds darker.
rows.translation: Isti štirje akordi, ista tonaliteta. Začetek z E-molom postavi žalostni akord na prvo mesto, zato krog zveni temneje.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: G at fret 3 on string 1 and open E, twice. Then G again and D at fret 3 on string 2, twice.
rows.translation: G na prečki 3 strune 1 in prazni E, dvakrat. Nato spet G in D na prečki 3 strune 2, dvakrat.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: Open Windows sways in 6/8 at 120 counts a minute: six quick counts felt as two big swings. C, F, A minor and G roll under a chorus that opens wide.
rows.translation: Pesem Odprta okna se ziblje v 6/8 pri 120 enotah na minuto: šest hitrih enot občutiš kot dva velika zamaha. C, F, A-mol in G tečejo pod refrenom, ki se na široko odpre.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: C at fret 1 on string 2, D at fret 3, open E, F at fret 1 on string 1, E, G at fret 3, E, G, then C.
rows.translation: C na prečki 1 strune 2, D na prečki 3, prazni E, F na prečki 1 strune 1, E, G na prečki 3, E, G, nato C.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: Scoreboard Lights is a stadium anthem in D at 100 beats per minute: D, A, B minor and G, the same one, five, six, four loop in a new key. Drive steady eighths.
rows.translation: Pesem Luči na semaforju je stadionska himna v D-duru pri 100 dobah na minuto: D, A, B-mol in G, isti krog prve, pete, šeste in četrte stopnje v novi tonaliteti. Vzdržuj enakomerne osminke.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: This B minor uses the top four strings only: fret 4 on strings 4 and 3, fret 3 on string 2, fret 2 on string 1. The full barre comes later.
rows.translation: Ta B-mol uporablja le štiri najtanjše strune: prečko 4 na strunah 4 in 3, prečko 3 na struni 2, prečko 2 na struni 1. Polni bare pride pozneje.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: A at fret 2 on string 3, open B, D at fret 3 on string 2, then G at fret 3 on string 1, F sharp, open E.
rows.translation: A na prečki 2 strune 3, prazni B, D na prečki 3 strune 2, nato G na prečki 3 strune 1, F z višajem, prazni E.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: Which of these is the four-chord loop in C?
rows.translation: Kateri od teh nizov je krog štirih akordov v C-duru?
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: The one, five, six and four of C are C, G, A minor and F.
rows.translation: Prva, peta, šesta in četrta stopnja C-dura so C, G, A-mol in F.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: Blues, a waltz, 6/8 folk, lo-fi and funk, with seventh chords, sus chords and swung rhythms.
rows.translation: Blues, valček, folk v 6/8, lo-fi in funk s septakordi, akordi sus in swingovskimi ritmi.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: Rust Belt Shuffle is a blues at 80 beats per minute: twelve bars of E7, A7 and B7, strummed long-short. The melody swings the same way, so lean into every long note.
rows.translation: Shuffle rjastega pasu je blues pri 80 dobah na minuto: dvanajst taktov E7, A7 in B7 z udarci dolgo-kratko. Tudi melodija niha tako, zato poudari vsak dolg ton.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: Open B, D at fret 3, open E and back. Then G and G sharp on string 3, sliding into open B.
rows.translation: Prazni B, D na prečki 3, prazni E in nazaj. Nato G in G z višajem na struni 3, s prehodom do praznega B.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: Carousel at Closing Time turns in three, like a fairground ride winding down: oom-pah-pah at 96 beats per minute. Count one, two, three, with the weight on one.
rows.translation: Vrtiljak ob zapiranju se vrti v treh dobah kakor sejemska naprava, ki se ustavlja: um-pa-pa pri 96 dobah na minuto. Štej ena, dve, tri, s poudarkom na prvi.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: D at fret 3 on string 2, A on string 3, then C sharp at fret 2, open E and G at fret 3 on string 1.
rows.translation: D na prečki 3 strune 2, A na struni 3, nato C z višajem na prečki 2, prazni E in G na prečki 3 strune 1.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: Cedar Smoke sways in 6/8: six quick counts per bar, felt as two big beats, one-two-three, four-five-six. At 100 counts a minute it rocks like a slow boat.
rows.translation: Cedrov dim se ziblje v 6/8: šest hitrih enot v taktu občutiš kot dve veliki dobi, ena-dve-tri, štiri-pet-šest. Pri 100 enotah na minuto se ziblje kot počasen čoln.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: Bar four holds Dsus4: a D chord with your little finger on string 1, fret 3. It hangs in the air. Bar eight drops to plain D, and the song lands.
rows.translation: Četrti takt zadrži Dsus4: akord D z mezincem na struni 1, prečki 3. Obvisi v zraku. Osmi takt preide na navadni D in pesem pristane.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: D at fret 3 on string 2, open B and back, then open E on string 1, and down again.
rows.translation: D na prečki 3 strune 2, prazni B in nazaj, nato prazni E na struni 1 in spet navzdol.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: Rain on the Skylight is lo-fi: soft seventh chords over a lazy, swung beat at 72 beats per minute. Strum down on one, then down-up on three, the up a little late.
rows.translation: Dež na strešnem oknu je lo-fi: mehki septakordi nad lenobnim swingovskim ritmom pri 72 dobah na minuto. Udari navzdol na prvi dobi, nato navzdol-navzgor na tretji, navzgor nekoliko pozneje.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: Am7 is A minor with finger 3 lifted. Cmaj7 is C with finger 1 lifted. For Dm7, finger 2 goes on string 3, fret 2, and finger 1 lies flat across strings 2 and 1 at fret 1.
