rows.translation: Am7 je A-mol z dvignjenim prstom 3. Cmaj7 je C z dvignjenim prstom 1. Pri Dm7 gre prst 2 na struno 3, prečko 2, prst 1 pa leži čez struni 2 in 1 na prečki 1.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: Neon Laundromat stays on one chord, A7, the whole way through. A vamp like this lives on rhythm: tight, choppy strums at 96 beats per minute and a hook that dodges the beat.
rows.translation: Neonska pralnica ves čas ostaja na enem akordu, A7. Takšna ponavljajoča se spremljava živi od ritma: kratki, odsekani udarci pri 96 dobah na minuto in značilni motiv, ki se izmika dobi.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: Funk players call beat one the one. Hit it hard, keep your strumming hand swinging in eighths, and ease your fingers off after each strum so it goes chk.
rows.translation: Funk glasbeniki prvi dobi pravijo »ena«. Močno jo poudari, roko za udarjanje ohranjaj v gibanju v osminkah, po vsakem udarcu pa popusti prste, da zazveni čk.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: A at fret 2 on string 3, C and C sharp at frets 1 and 2 on string 2, open E, G at fret 3, then back down.
rows.translation: A na prečki 2 strune 3, C in C z višajem na prečkah 1 in 2 strune 2, prazni E, G na prečki 3, nato nazaj navzdol.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: How many quick counts fill a bar of 6/8?
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: 6/8 has six eighth-note counts, felt as two groups of three.
rows.translation: 6/8 ima šest osminskih enot, ki jih občutimo kot dve skupini po tri.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: Lo-fi, one-drop reggae, funk, a 6/8 slow dance and bedroom pop, on seventh chords that make a groove glow.
rows.translation: Lo-fi, reggae one-drop, funk, počasni ples v 6/8 in domači pop na septakordih, ki ritmu dodajo sijaj.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: Late Checkout is lo-fi at 72 beats per minute: Dm7, G7, Cmaj7 and Am7 on a loop. Strum down on one, then down-up on three with the up a little late, and swing the tune the same way.
rows.translation: Pozna odjava je lo-fi pri 72 dobah na minuto: Dm7, G7, Cmaj7 in Am7 v krogu. Udari navzdol na prvi dobi, nato navzdol-navzgor na tretji, navzgor nekoliko pozneje, in enako zanihaj melodijo.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: G7 is G with string 1 at fret 1 instead of fret 3: fingers 3 and 2 on strings 6 and 5, finger 1 on string 1. It leans hard toward C.
rows.translation: G7 je G s struno 1 na prečki 1 namesto na prečki 3: prsta 3 in 2 na strunah 6 in 5, prst 1 na struni 1. Močno teži proti C.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: Saltwater Sunday is reggae in A minor at 76 beats per minute. The guitar plays a double chop on two and four, chk-a, chk-a, while the drums drop their weight on three.
rows.translation: Nedelja ob morju je reggae v A-molu pri 76 dobah na minuto. Kitara igra dvojni kratki udarec na drugi in četrti dobi, čk-a, čk-a, bobni pa glavni poudarek postavijo na tretjo.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: D7: finger 2 on string 3, fret 2, finger 1 on string 2, fret 1, finger 3 on string 1, fret 2. Am7 to D7 and back is the sunny, minor-but-bright sound of the whole song.
rows.translation: D7: prst 2 na struni 3, prečki 2, prst 1 na struni 2, prečki 1, prst 3 na struni 1, prečki 2. Am7 v D7 in nazaj je sončen, molov, a svetel zvok celotne pesmi.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: Pocket Change is funk at 100 beats per minute: a vamp on Em7, with A7 for the chorus. Your strumming hand never stops moving in eighths; only some strokes ring.
rows.translation: Drobiž v žepu je funk pri 100 dobah na minuto: ponavljajoča se spremljava na Em7, z A7 v refrenu. Roka za udarjanje se ves čas giblje v osminkah; le nekateri udarci zazvenijo.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: Between the strokes that ring, lay your fretting fingers lightly across the strings and keep strumming: the muted strokes go chk. Press down only for the hits.
rows.translation: Med zvenečimi udarci narahlo položi prste čez strune in udarjaj naprej: dušeni udarci zazvenijo čk. Pritisni le za zveneče udarce.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: A at fret 2 on string 3, then C and C sharp at frets 1 and 2 on string 2. Twice.
rows.translation: A na prečki 2 strune 3, nato C in C z višajem na prečkah 1 in 2 strune 2. Dvakrat.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: Kitchen Slow Dance is a soul ballad in 6/8 at 108 counts a minute, two slow sways a bar. Cmaj7, Am7, Dm7 and G7 carry the verse; Fmaj7 and Em7 open up the chorus.
rows.translation: Počasni ples v kuhinji je soul balada v 6/8 pri 108 enotah na minuto, z dvema počasnima zamahoma v taktu. Cmaj7, Am7, Dm7 in G7 nosijo kitico; Fmaj7 in Em7 odpreta refren.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: Fmaj7 is the mini F with string 1 left open. Em7 takes one finger: finger 2 on string 5, fret 2, every other string open.
rows.translation: Fmaj7 je mali F s prazno struno 1. Em7 potrebuje en prst: prst 2 na struni 5, prečki 2, vse druge strune so prazne.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: Open E, G at fret 3 on string 1, E, D at fret 3 on string 2, open E again, then open B.
rows.translation: Prazni E, G na prečki 3 strune 1, E, D na prečki 3 strune 2, spet prazni E, nato prazni B.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: Houseplants is soft bedroom pop at 88 beats per minute: Gmaj7, Em7, Cmaj7 and D. Seventh chords make it dreamy. Strum once on one, then brush soft ups on the ands.
rows.translation: Pesem Sobne rastline je nežen domači pop pri 88 dobah na minuto: Gmaj7, Em7, Cmaj7 in D. Septakordi ji dajejo sanjavost. Enkrat udari na prvi dobi, nato mehko oplazi strune navzgor na vsak in.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: Gmaj7 is G with string 1 at fret 2 instead of fret 3. Bm7 puts three fingers at fret 2, on strings 5, 3 and 1, and lets strings 4 and 2 ring open.
rows.translation: Gmaj7 je G s struno 1 na prečki 2 namesto na prečki 3. Bm7 postavi tri prste na prečko 2, na strune 5, 3 in 1, struni 4 in 2 pa pusti zveneti prazni.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: G at fret 3 on string 1 and open E, twice, then D at fret 3 on string 2 and F sharp at fret 2 on string 1.
rows.translation: G na prečki 3 strune 1 in prazni E, dvakrat, nato D na prečki 3 strune 2 in F z višajem na prečki 2 strune 1.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: Which chord has a major seventh?
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: Cmaj7 adds B, a half step under C. G7 and Am7 add a flat seventh, a whole step under the root.
rows.translation: Cmaj7 doda B, polton pod C. G7 in Am7 dodata malo septimo, cel ton pod osnovnim tonom.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.translation: Riffi, kvintni akordi in retro zvoki
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: Punk, garage rock, doo-wop, surf and heartland rock, with power chords, a riff and sus chords.
rows.translation: Punk, garažni rock, doo-wop, surf in ameriški rock s kvintnimi akordi, riffom in akordi sus.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: Static on Channel Nine is punk: four power chords, palm-muted eighths, 104 beats per minute. The verse mutters on low notes; the chorus is a gang shout, so dig in.
rows.translation: Šum na devetem kanalu je punk: štirje kvintni akordi, z dlanjo dušene osminke, 104 dobe na minuto. Kitica mrmra na nizkih tonih; refren je skupinski vzklik, zato zaigraj odločno.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: G at fret 3 on string 1, down to D at fret 3 on string 2, then F sharp at fret 2 and D again.
rows.translation: G na prečki 3 strune 1, navzdol do D na prečki 3 strune 2, nato F z višajem na prečki 2 in spet D.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: Basement Weather is garage rock at 92 beats per minute: a riff on the low strings, then power chords that punch back. Rest your palm at the bridge to keep the riff tight.
rows.translation: Kletno vreme je garažni rock pri 92 dobah na minuto: riff na debelih strunah, nato kvintni akordi, ki mu odločno odgovorijo. Dlan nasloni ob kobilici, da bo riff kratek in natančen.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: Open string 5, C at fret 3 on the same string, then open string 4, and back.
rows.translation: Prazna struna 5, C na prečki 3 iste strune, nato prazna struna 4 in nazaj.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: G at fret 3 on string 6, open A, G again, then open low E.
rows.translation: G na prečki 3 strune 6, prazni A, spet G, nato prazni nizki E.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: Answer the riff with power chords on one, the and of two, and four: A5, G5, C5, D5. Between hits, ease your fretting fingers off so the chords stop short.
rows.translation: Riffu odgovori s kvintnimi akordi na prvi dobi, na in druge in na četrti: A5, G5, C5, D5. Med udarci popusti pritisk prstov, da akordi hitro utihnejo.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: Jukebox Moon is a slow dance in 1950s doo-wop style: C, A minor, F and G7, around and around, at 72 beats per minute. Strum every beat, with a quick swung up into each new bar.
rows.translation: Luna iz džuboksa je počasni ples v slogu doo-wopa iz desetletja z začetkom leta 1950: C, A-mol, F in G7, vedno znova, pri 72 dobah na minuto. Udari na vsako dobo in s kratkim swingovskim udarcem navzgor vstopi v vsak nov takt.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: Open G, C at fret 1 on string 2, open E, then D and C. Next, A at fret 2 on string 3 and back up.
rows.translation: Prazni G, C na prečki 1 strune 2, prazni E, nato D in C. Zatem A na prečki 2 strune 3 in nazaj navzgor.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: Boardwalk Comet is surf rock: a twangy melody over A minor, G, F and E, galloping along at 104 beats per minute. Picture reverb, salt spray and a wave about to break.
rows.translation: Komet na obalni promenadi je surf rock: zveneča melodija nad A-molom, G, F in E galopira pri 104 dobah na minuto. Predstavljaj si odmev, slano pršenje in val tik pred lomom.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: A on string 3, C at fret 1, open E and back down. Then open B, D at fret 3, and up to G on string 1.
rows.translation: A na struni 3, C na prečki 1, prazni E in nazaj navzdol. Nato prazni B, D na prečki 3 in navzgor do G na struni 1.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: Over the E chord the tune plays G sharp, not G. Where is G sharp on string 3?
rows.translation: Nad akordom E melodija igra G z višajem, ne G. Kje je G z višajem na struni 3?
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: G is open string 3, so G sharp is one fret up. It leans hard toward A, the home note.
rows.translation: G je prazna struna 3, zato je G z višajem eno prečko više. Močno teži proti A, domačemu tonu.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: Mile Marker Zero is open-road rock at 100 beats per minute: big ringing chords and a chorus for driving with the windows down. Listen for D lifting to Dsus4 and back.
rows.translation: Miljnik nič je rock za odprto cesto pri 100 dobah na minuto: mogočni zveneči akordi in refren za vožnjo z odprtimi okni. Poslušaj, kako se D dvigne v Dsus4 in vrne nazaj.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: Asus4 is A with your little finger added on string 2, fret 3. Like Dsus4, it leans forward and wants to fall back home.
rows.translation: Asus4 je A z dodanim mezincem na struni 2, prečki 3. Tako kot Dsus4 teži naprej in se želi vrniti domov.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: F sharp at fret 2 and G at fret 3 on string 1, then down to D at fret 3 on string 2.
rows.translation: F z višajem na prečki 2 in G na prečki 3 strune 1, nato navzdol do D na prečki 3 strune 2.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: Which of these styles swings, long-short?
rows.translation: Kateri od teh slogov niha dolgo-kratko?
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: Doo-wop rides a gentle swing. Punk and surf drive on straight, even eighths.
rows.translation: Doo-wop nosi nežen swing. Punk in surf poganjajo ravne, enakomerne osminke.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.translation: Punk in rock s kvintnimi akordi
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: Punk-pop, riff rock, dark 6/8 rock, an indie anthem and desert rock, on power chords and low-string riffs.
rows.translation: Punk pop, rock z riffi, temni rock v 6/8, indie himna in puščavski rock s kvintnimi akordi in riffi na debelih strunah.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: Last Bell is punk-pop at 152 beats per minute: C5, G5, A5 and F5, the four-chord loop as power chords. All downstrokes in steady eighths, palm resting on the strings by the bridge.
rows.translation: Zadnji zvonec je punk pop pri 152 dobah na minuto: C5, G5, A5 in F5, krog štirih akordov v obliki kvintnih akordov. Sami udarci navzdol v enakomernih osminkah, dlan počiva na strunah ob kobilici.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: F5 is the G5 shape two frets lower: finger 1 on string 6, fret 1, fingers 3 and 4 on strings 5 and 4 at fret 3.
rows.translation: F5 je oblika G5 dve prečki niže: prst 1 na struni 6, prečki 1, prsta 3 in 4 na strunah 5 in 4 na prečki 3.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: G at fret 3 on string 1 and open E, twice. Then D at fret 3 on string 2, twice, open E and D.
rows.translation: G na prečki 3 strune 1 in prazni E, dvakrat. Nato dvakrat D na prečki 3 strune 2, prazni E in D.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: Copper Wire is built on a riff: a short, catchy line on the low strings that the whole band locks onto. It runs at 112 beats per minute in E, with power chords in the chorus.
rows.translation: Bakrena žica temelji na riffu: kratki, privlačni frazi na debelih strunah, na katero se uskladi ves bend. Teče pri 112 dobah na minuto v E-duru, s kvintnimi akordi v refrenu.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: Open string 6 twice, G at fret 3, open E, open string 5, G again, then open E.
rows.translation: Dvakrat prazna struna 6, G na prečki 3, prazni E, prazna struna 5, spet G, nato prazni E.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: The second bar turns around: B at fret 2 on string 5, open A, G at fret 3 on string 6, open A.
rows.translation: Drugi takt se obrne: B na prečki 2 strune 5, prazni A, G na prečki 3 strune 6, prazni A.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: Cold Lake is dark alternative rock in 6/8 at 120 counts a minute: E5, C5, G5 and D5. Keep the verse quiet and low so the chorus can open up.
rows.translation: Hladno jezero je temni alternativni rock v 6/8 pri 120 enotah na minuto: E5, C5, G5 in D5. Kitico ohrani tiho in nizko, da se lahko refren odpre.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: G at fret 3 on string 1, open E, G again, then D at fret 3 on string 2. Let each ring.
rows.translation: G na prečki 3 strune 1, prazni E, spet G, nato D na prečki 3 strune 2. Vsakega pusti zveneti.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: Parking Lot Cathedral is indie rock at 128 beats per minute: D5, A5, B5 and G5, the four-chord loop again, now as power chords. Big, open, driving eighths.
rows.translation: Katedrala na parkirišču je indie rock pri 128 dobah na minuto: D5, A5, B5 in G5, spet krog štirih akordov, tokrat kot kvintni akordi. Mogočne, odprte, prodorne osminke.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: B5 is the A5 shape moved up two frets: finger 1 on string 5, fret 2, fingers 3 and 4 on strings 4 and 3 at fret 4.
rows.translation: B5 je oblika A5 dve prečki više: prst 1 na struni 5, prečki 2, prsta 3 in 4 na strunah 4 in 3 na prečki 4.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: D at fret 3 on string 2, twice, F sharp at fret 2 on string 1, open E, G at fret 3, open E.
rows.translation: Dvakrat D na prečki 3 strune 2, F z višajem na prečki 2 strune 1, prazni E, G na prečki 3, prazni E.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: Halogen is desert rock in D minor at 104 beats per minute: a hypnotic riff on strings 4 and 5, a low, steady voice, then F5, C5 and G5 opening up the chorus.
rows.translation: Halogen je puščavski rock v D-molu pri 104 dobah na minuto: hipnotičen riff na strunah 4 in 5, nizek, enakomeren glas, nato F5, C5 in G5, ki odprejo refren.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: Open string 4 twice, F at fret 3, open D, open string 3, F again, then open D.
rows.translation: Dvakrat prazna struna 4, F na prečki 3, prazni D, prazna struna 3, spet F, nato prazni D.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: F at fret 1 on string 1, open E, C at fret 1 on string 2, then G at fret 3 on string 1, E and C.
rows.translation: F na prečki 1 strune 1, prazni E, C na prečki 1 strune 2, nato G na prečki 3 strune 1, E in C.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: Which song's riff starts like this?
rows.translation: Riff katere pesmi se začne tako?
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: A power chord is a root and its fifth, with no third, so it is neither major nor minor.
rows.translation: Kvintni akord ima osnovni ton in njegovo kvinto, brez terce, zato ni niti durov niti molov.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: A ballad, a sea story in 6/8, a music-box waltz, a bright folk strummer and a dark song in A minor.
rows.translation: Balada, morska zgodba v 6/8, valček glasbene skrinjice, vedra folk pesem z udarci čez strune in temna pesem v A-molu.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: Letters in a Shoebox tells a story in C at 72 beats per minute. The verse walks C, G, A minor, E minor, F, C, F and G, a chain of chords that has carried ballads for centuries.
rows.translation: Pesem Pisma v škatli za čevlje pripoveduje zgodbo v C-duru pri 72 dobah na minuto. Kitica gre skozi C, G, A-mol, E-mol, F, C, F in G, niz akordov, ki že stoletja nosi balade.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: C at fret 1 on string 2, D at fret 3, open E, F at fret 1 on string 1, G at fret 3, then D again.
rows.translation: C na prečki 1 strune 2, D na prečki 3, prazni E, F na prečki 1 strune 1, G na prečki 3, nato spet D.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: Keeper's Daughter is a story song in 6/8 at 120 counts a minute: E minor, D, C and B7. Three verses tell the story, and the chorus answers each one.
rows.translation: Svetilničarjeva hči je pripovedna pesem v 6/8 pri 120 enotah na minuto: E-mol, D, C in B7. Tri kitice povedo zgodbo, refren pa odgovori vsaki.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: Open B, open E, G at fret 3 on string 1, open E, then C at fret 1 on string 2, E and C.
rows.translation: Prazni B, prazni E, G na prečki 3 strune 1, prazni E, nato C na prečki 1 strune 2, E in C.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: Snow Globe Town is a quick waltz in G at 120 beats per minute, like a music box: one strong beat, two light ones. G, D, E minor and C, with B7 in the bridge.
rows.translation: Mesto v snežni krogli je hiter valček v G-duru pri 120 dobah na minuto, kot glasbena skrinjica: ena močna doba, dve lahki. G, D, E-mol in C, z B7 v mostu.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: Open E, D at fret 3 on string 2, C at fret 1, D, C, then open B: a slow fall, like snow.
rows.translation: Prazni E, D na prečki 3 strune 2, C na prečki 1, D, C, nato prazni B: počasno padanje kot sneg.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: Thistle and Thread is a bright folk strummer in A at 116 beats per minute. Asus4 and Asus2 decorate the A chord: change one finger and the chord sparkles.
rows.translation: Osat in nit je vedra folk pesem v A-duru pri 116 dobah na minuto. Asus4 in Asus2 okrasita akord A: spremeni en prst in akord se zaiskri.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: From A, put finger 4 on string 2, fret 3 for Asus4. Lift the finger off string 2 and let it ring open for Asus2. Both fall back to A.
rows.translation: Iz A postavi prst 4 na struno 2, prečko 3 za Asus4. Za Asus2 dvigni prst s strune 2 in jo pusti zveneti prazno. Oba se vrneta na A.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: F sharp at fret 2 on string 1, open E, D at fret 3 on string 2, E twice, C sharp, open B, then A.
rows.translation: F z višajem na prečki 2 strune 1, prazni E, D na prečki 3 strune 2, dvakrat E, C z višajem, prazni B, nato A.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: Ghost Light is a slow, dark ballad in A minor at 70 beats per minute. The verse sinks from A minor through F and C to E major, which pulls hard back to A minor.
rows.translation: Luč za duhove je počasna, temna balada v A-molu pri 70 dobah na minuto. Kitica se od A-mola spusti prek F in C do E-dura, ki močno vleče nazaj v A-mol.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: E major in A minor brings one new note. Which?
rows.translation: E-dur v A-mol prinese en nov ton. Katerega?
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: A minor's own notes have G. E major needs G sharp, a half step under A, so it leans hard toward home.
rows.translation: A-mol med svojimi toni vsebuje G. E-dur potrebuje G z višajem, polton pod A, zato močno teži domov.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: F at fret 1 on string 1, open E, G at fret 3, then D at fret 3 on string 2. Hold each long.
rows.translation: F na prečki 1 strune 1, prazni E, G na prečki 3, nato D na prečki 3 strune 2. Vsakega dolgo zadrži.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: How many beats fill a bar of 3/4?
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: 3/4 counts one, two, three, with the weight on one: the waltz.
rows.translation: 3/4 šteje ena, dve, tri, s poudarkom na prvi: valček.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: Indie pop, a power ballad, highlife, neo-soul and an anthem with a key change, with F and B minor barres.
rows.translation: Indie pop, mogočna balada, highlife, neo-soul in himna z menjavo tonalitete, z barejema F in B-mol.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: Late Bus Home is indie pop for the ride back through a sleeping city: D, B minor, G and A at 100 beats per minute. Each line starts just after the beat, so wait a breath.
rows.translation: Pozni avtobus domov je indie pop za vožnjo skozi speče mesto: D, B-mol, G in A pri 100 dobah na minuto. Vsaka vrstica se začne tik po dobi, zato počakaj za en dih.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: Play the full B minor barre at fret 2 if you can. If not, use the top four strings: fret 4 on strings 4 and 3, fret 3 on string 2, fret 2 on string 1.
rows.translation: Če zmoreš, zaigraj polni bare B-mola na prečki 2. Sicer uporabi štiri najtanjše strune: prečko 4 na strunah 4 in 3, prečko 3 na struni 2, prečko 2 na struni 1.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: A at fret 2 on string 3, D at fret 3 on string 2, then open E and F sharp at fret 2 on string 1.
rows.translation: A na prečki 2 strune 3, D na prečki 3 strune 2, nato prazni E in F z višajem na prečki 2 strune 1.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: Glass Satellites is a slow, soaring ballad at 76 beats per minute: A minor, F, C and G. Strum big on one and let it ring, then build on three and four.
rows.translation: Pesem Stekleni sateliti je počasna, vznesena balada pri 76 dobah na minuto: A-mol, F, C in G. Močno udari na prvi dobi in pusti zveneti, nato stopnjuj na tretji in četrti.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: Lay finger 1 flat across all six strings at fret 1 and build an E shape in front of it. Not there yet? Use the mini F on the top four strings for now.
rows.translation: Prst 1 položi čez vseh šest strun na prečki 1 in pred njim sestavi obliko E. Še ne gre? Za zdaj uporabi mali F na štirih najtanjših strunah.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: C at fret 1 on string 2, open E twice, D at fret 3, C again, then A at fret 2 on string 3.
rows.translation: C na prečki 1 strune 2, dvakrat prazni E, D na prečki 3, spet C, nato A na prečki 2 strune 3.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: Market Day borrows from highlife, the bright guitar pop of Ghana and Nigeria: G, B minor, C and D at 104 beats per minute. The hook bounces off the beat, so keep your body moving.
rows.translation: Tržni dan črpa iz highlifa, vedrega kitarskega popa Gane in Nigerije: G, B-mol, C in D pri 104 dobah na minuto. Značilni motiv poskakuje med dobami, zato se ves čas gibaj.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: D at fret 3 on string 2, open B, D again, open E, then back to D and B.
rows.translation: D na prečki 3 strune 2, prazni B, spet D, prazni E, nato nazaj na D in B.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: Bar two keeps bar one's rhythm but swaps one note. Why?
rows.translation: Drugi takt ohrani ritem prvega, a zamenja en ton. Zakaj?
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: Bar two moves E up to F sharp, a note of B minor. Same rhythm, new chord, new note.
rows.translation: Drugi takt premakne E navzgor na F z višajem, ton B-mola. Isti ritem, nov akord, nov ton.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: Velvet Hour is neo-soul at 74 beats per minute: four lush seventh chords stepping down, Fmaj7, Em7, Dm7 and Cmaj7. Strum once on one, then brush soft ups on the ands.
rows.translation: Žametna ura je neo-soul pri 74 dobah na minuto: štirje bogati septakordi po stopnjah navzdol, Fmaj7, Em7, Dm7 in Cmaj7. Enkrat udari na prvi dobi, nato mehko oplazi strune navzgor na vsak in.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: Fmaj7 is the mini F with string 1 left open. Em7 takes one finger: finger 2 on string 5, fret 2, every other string open. Dm7 and Cmaj7 you know from Rain on the Skylight.
rows.translation: Fmaj7 je mali F s prazno struno 1. Em7 potrebuje en prst: prst 2 na struni 5, prečki 2, vse druge strune so prazne. Dm7 in Cmaj7 poznaš iz pesmi Dež na strešnem oknu.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: The chords walk down F, E, D. Where does the loop land?
rows.translation: Akordi se spuščajo F, E, D. Kje pristane krog?
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: Each chord sits one step below the last, and the walk ends on C, the home chord.
rows.translation: Vsak akord je stopnjo pod prejšnjim, pot pa se konča na C, domačem akordu.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: An anthem with a key change
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: Rooftop Choir is a stadium-sized anthem at 92 beats per minute. You play the chorus in C, then one bar of A lifts everything a whole step, and the chorus returns in D.
rows.translation: Zbor na strehi je himna stadionskih razsežnosti pri 92 dobah na minuto. Refren zaigraš v C-duru, nato en takt A dvigne vse za cel ton in refren se vrne v D-duru.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: A key change up a whole step moves every note up…
rows.translation: Menjava tonalitete za cel ton navzgor premakne vsak ton za …
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: A whole step is two half steps, and each fret is a half step. C becomes D, and G becomes A.
rows.translation: Cel ton sta dva poltona, vsaka prečka pa je polton. C postane D, G pa A.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: Which chord lifts Rooftop Choir from C into D?
rows.translation: Kateri akord dvigne Zbor na strehi iz C-dura v D-dur?
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: A leads home to D. Landing on it turns the whole song toward the new key.
rows.translation: A vodi domov v D. Pristanek na njem obrne celotno pesem proti novi tonaliteti.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: Synth-pop, gospel-pop, dark pop, indie pop and a 6/8 finale, with five new barre chords.
rows.translation: Sintetični pop, gospel pop, temni pop, indie pop in finale v 6/8 s petimi novimi bare akordi.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: Slow Motion Strobe is synth-pop at 118 beats per minute: F sharp minor, D, A and E. The strum is pushed: two of its hits land on the and, just before the beat.
rows.translation: Pesem Stroboskop v počasnem posnetku je sintetični pop pri 118 dobah na minuto: mol na F z višajem, D, A in E. Udarci prehitevajo dobo: dva prideta na in, tik pred dobo.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.translation: Mol na F z višajem, bare
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: Barre finger 1 across all six strings at fret 2, then put fingers 3 and 4 on strings 5 and 4 at fret 4: the E minor shape, moved up two frets.
rows.translation: Prst 1 položi v bare čez vseh šest strun na prečki 2, nato prsta 3 in 4 na struni 5 in 4 na prečki 4: oblika E-mola, premaknjena dve prečki više.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: Bright Side of the Block is a gospel-pop sing-along in D at 100 beats per minute: D, F sharp minor, G and A. Clap on two and four and sing the chorus like the whole street joins in.
rows.translation: Svetla stran soseske je gospel pop za skupno petje v D-duru pri 100 dobah na minuto: D, mol na F z višajem, G in A. Ploskaj na drugi in četrti dobi ter poj refren, kot da se ti pridruži vsa ulica.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: Barre finger 1 across strings 5 to 1 at fret 2, then build an A minor shape two frets up with fingers 2, 3 and 4. Leave string 6 silent.
rows.translation: Prst 1 položi v bare čez strune od 5 do 1 na prečki 2, nato s prsti 2, 3 in 4 sestavi obliko A-mola dve prečki više. Struna 6 naj bo tiha.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: D at fret 3 on string 2, open E, G at fret 3 on string 1, F sharp at fret 2, E, G, then E.
rows.translation: D na prečki 3 strune 2, prazni E, G na prečki 3 strune 1, F z višajem na prečki 2, E, G, nato E.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: Over You Soon is dark pop in B minor at 84 beats per minute: B minor, G, D and A. Strum once on one, then soft ups on the ands, and keep it hushed.
rows.translation: Kmalu te prebolim je temni pop v B-molu pri 84 dobah na minuto: B-mol, G, D in A. Enkrat udari na prvi dobi, nato mehko navzgor na vsak in, vse pridušeno.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: G at fret 3 on string 1, F sharp at fret 2, D at fret 3 on string 2, then F sharp, open E and D.
rows.translation: G na prečki 3 strune 1, F z višajem na prečki 2, D na prečki 3 strune 2, nato F z višajem, prazni E in D.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: Spray Paint Sunrise is indie pop at 124 beats per minute: E, B, C sharp minor and A, the four-chord loop with two barres. Drive steady eighths and let it run.
rows.translation: Zora iz spreja je indie pop pri 124 dobah na minuto: E, B, mol na C z višajem in A, krog štirih akordov z dvema barejema. Vzdržuj enakomerne osminke in pusti pesmi teči.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.translation: B in mol na C z višajem
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: B is an A shape barred at fret 2: finger 1 across strings 5 to 1, three fingers at fret 4. C sharp minor is an A minor shape barred at fret 4.
rows.translation: B je oblika A z barejem na prečki 2: prst 1 čez strune od 5 do 1, trije prsti na prečki 4. Mol na C z višajem je oblika A-mola z barejem na prečki 4.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: G sharp at fret 4 on string 1, F sharp, open E, open B, then D sharp at fret 4 on string 2, C sharp, D sharp.
rows.translation: G z višajem na prečki 4 str. 1, F z višajem, prazni E in B; D z višajem na prečki 4 str. 2, C z višajem, D z višajem.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: Constellation Prize closes the course: an anthem in 6/8 at 126 counts a minute, in F. F and B flat are both barres, with C and D minor between them.
rows.translation: Ozvezdje za nagrado konča tečaj: himna v 6/8 pri 126 enotah na minuto, v F-duru. F in B z nižajem sta oba bareja, med njima pa sta C in D-mol.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.translation: B z nižajem, bare v obliki A
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: Barre finger 1 across strings 5 to 1 at fret 1, then put fingers 2, 3 and 4 on strings 4, 3 and 2 at fret 3. Leave string 6 silent.
rows.translation: Prst 1 položi v bare čez strune od 5 do 1 na prečki 1, nato prste 2, 3 in 4 na strune 4, 3 in 2 na prečki 3. Struna 6 naj bo tiha.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: D at fret 3 on string 2, F at fret 1 on string 1 twice, G at fret 3, F twice, open E, then F.
rows.translation: D na prečki 3 strune 2, dvakrat F na prečki 1 strune 1, G na prečki 3, dvakrat F, prazni E, nato F.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: F sharp minor is which shape, barred at fret 2?
rows.translation: Katero obliko z barejem na prečki 2 ima mol na F z višajem?
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: Barre at fret 2 and the E minor shape sits in front of your first finger: F sharp minor.
rows.translation: Bare na prečki 2, pred prvim prstom pa oblika E-mola: mol na F z višajem.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: Famous tunes everyone knows, start to finish
rows.translation: Znamenite melodije, ki jih vsi poznajo, od začetka do konca
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: Folk songs and a spiritual everyone can sing, with simple chord charts to strum.
rows.translation: Ljudske pesmi in spiritual, ki jih lahko poje vsak, s preprostimi akordnimi zapisi za spremljavo.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: This tune began as a spiritual. In the 1890s railroad crews in the Midwest gave it new words, and Carl Sandburg printed it in 1927. It climbs from low B up to D on string 2.
rows.translation: Ta melodija je nastala kot spiritual. V desetletju z začetkom leta 1890 so ji železničarji ameriškega Srednjega zahoda dodali novo besedilo, Carl Sandburg pa jo je objavil leta 1927. Vzpne se od nizkega B do D na struni 2.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: The first line: open D, E, four open Gs, a dip to B on string 5, then home to G.
rows.translation: Prva vrstica: prazni D, E, štirje prazni toni G, spust do B na struni 5, nato domov na G.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: The words She'll be come before beat one. What are they?
rows.translation: Besedi She'll be prideta pred prvo dobo. Kaj sta?
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: A pickup is a few notes that lead into the first strong beat. Here they run up to the word com-.
rows.translation: Predtakt je nekaj tonov, ki vodijo v prvo poudarjeno dobo. Tukaj vodijo do zloga com-.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: Three chords: G, C and D7
rows.translation: Trije akordi: G, C in D7
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: Most of the song sits on G. D7 comes at the end of the second line, and C colors the fourth. Change on the word that starts the bar.
rows.translation: Večina pesmi ostane na G. D7 pride na koncu druge vrstice, C pa obarva četrto. Akord zamenjaj na besedi, ki začne takt.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: This African American spiritual is older than the Civil War and was first printed in 1918. Its line ain't gonna study war no more became a song of the peace movement.
rows.translation: Ta afroameriški spiritual je starejši od ameriške državljanske vojne in je bil prvič natisnjen leta 1918. Vrstica ain't gonna study war no more je postala pesem mirovnega gibanja.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: Lay down my burden: open B, a drop to open D, then up through E, G and A to B.
rows.translation: Lay down my burden: prazni B, spust na prazni D, nato navzgor prek E, G in A do B.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: A sharp sits between A and B, at fret 3 on string 3. It slides up into open B, the bluesy lift that gives gospel its sound.
rows.translation: A z višajem leži med A in B, na prečki 3 strune 3. Dvigne se do praznega B, bluesovsko obarvanega vzpona, ki daje gospelu značilni zvok.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: Down by the riverside: B, B, A sharp at fret 3, B, then A and G.
rows.translation: Down by the riverside: B, B, A z višajem na prečki 3, B, nato A in G.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: The high road and the low road
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: This Scottish song was first printed in 1841. The low road is often heard as the road a soldier's spirit takes home, faster than the living on the high road.
rows.translation: Ta škotska pesem je bila prvič natisnjena leta 1841. Nizko pot pogosto razumemo kot pot, po kateri se vojakov duh vrne domov hitreje kot živi po visoki poti.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: By yon bonnie banks: open D, then G, G, A, B and back down to G.
rows.translation: By yon bonnie banks: prazni D, nato G, G, A, B in nazaj navzdol do G.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: This tune moves in quarter notes and pairs of eighths. Count one, two-and, three, four-and, and the lilt comes by itself.
rows.translation: Ta melodija se giblje v četrtinkah in parih osmink. Štej ena, dve-in, tri, štiri-in in zibanje pride samo od sebe.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: This song was printed in 1876 and credited in 1884 to James Yorkston of Edinburgh. It is now Dublin's unofficial anthem, and Molly and her cart stand as a statue in the city.
rows.translation: Ta pesem je bila natisnjena leta 1876, leta 1884 pa pripisana Jamesu Yorkstonu iz Edinburga. Danes je neuradna dublinska himna, Molly in njen voziček pa v mestu stojita kot kip.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: In Dublin's fair city: open D, four open Gs, up to open B and back to G.
rows.translation: In Dublin's fair city: prazni D, štirje prazni toni G, navzgor do praznega B in nazaj do G.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: Count one, two, three and lean on one. In many bars the middle note is long: one, two, and a quick note just before the next one.
rows.translation: Štej ena, dve, tri in poudari prvo. V številnih taktih je srednji ton dolg: ena, dve, nato kratek ton tik pred naslednjo prvo dobo.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: Cecil Sharp collected and published this ballad in 1906, from verses that go back to the 1700s. Play it slowly and let every long note ring.
rows.translation: Cecil Sharp je to balado zbral in objavil leta 1906 iz kitic, ki segajo v stoletje z začetkom leta 1700. Igraj jo počasi in pusti vsak dolg ton zveneti.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: The water is wide, I cannot get o'er: up from open D to B, then gently back down to D.
rows.translation: The water is wide, I cannot get o'er: od praznega D navzgor do B, nato nežno nazaj navzdol do D.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: Wide rings for two beats and two for two and a half. Keep counting while the string rings, so the next word lands on time.
rows.translation: Wide zveni dve dobi, two pa dve in pol. Štej tudi, ko struna zveni, da naslednja beseda pride pravočasno.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: Which word holds over two notes in the first verse?
rows.translation: Katera beseda v prvi kitici traja čez dva tona?
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: Fly starts on C and slides down to a long A. Singers call one syllable over several notes a melisma.
rows.translation: Fly se začne na C in se spusti do dolgega A. Petju enega zloga na več tonih pevci pravijo melizma.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: No new notes: the five songs from this unit, one after another, a little faster than before. Name each one from its first notes.
rows.translation: Brez novih tonov: pet pesmi iz te enote, ena za drugo, nekoliko hitreje kot prej. Vsako prepoznaj po prvih tonih.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: A Welsh lullaby, a Highland boat song and three carols, in German, Latin and English.
rows.translation: Valižanska uspavanka, čolnarska pesem iz škotskega višavja in tri božične pesmi v nemščini, latinščini in angleščini.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: The tune Ar Hyd y Nos was printed in Wales in 1784, and Harold Boulton wrote these English words in 1884. One phrase comes three times, with a higher one in the middle.
rows.translation: Melodija Ar Hyd y Nos je bila natisnjena v Walesu leta 1784, Harold Boulton pa je to angleško besedilo napisal leta 1884. Ena fraza se pojavi trikrat, na sredini pa je višja.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: Sleep, my child, and peace attend thee: open G, down to F sharp and E, then G, A, G, F sharp and D.
rows.translation: Sleep, my child, and peace attend thee: prazni G, navzdol do F z višajem in E, nato G, A, G, F z višajem in D.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: Which phrase of the verse climbs highest?
rows.translation: Katera fraza kitice se vzpne najviše?
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: The third phrase, soft the drowsy hours, rises to C, D and E. The other three phrases share one tune.
rows.translation: Tretja fraza, soft the drowsy hours, se vzpne do C, D in E. Preostale tri fraze imajo isto melodijo.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: Harold Boulton set these words in 1884 to a Highland rowing tune collected by Anne MacLeod. They tell of Bonnie Prince Charlie escaping to the Isle of Skye in 1746.
rows.translation: Harold Boulton je leta 1884 to besedilo prilagodil veslaškemu napevu iz škotskega višavja, ki ga je zbrala Anne MacLeod. Pripoveduje o begu princa Bonnieja Charlieja na otok Skye leta 1746.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: This song rocks in six-eight: two big beats a bar, each split in three. Count one-two-three, four-five-six, like oars pulling and coming back.
rows.translation: Ta pesem se ziblje v šest-osminskem taktu: dve veliki dobi v taktu, vsaka razdeljena na tri. Štej ena-dve-tri, štiri-pet-šest, kot vesla, ki zaveslajo in se vrnejo.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: Speed, bonnie boat, like a bird on the wing: open D, E, D, three open Gs, then A, B, A and up to D.
rows.translation: Speed, bonnie boat, like a bird on the wing: prazni D, E, D, trije prazni toni G, nato A, B, A in navzgor do D.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: Ernst Anschütz wrote these words in Leipzig in 1824, to a much older folk tune. You'll sing them in German, the language they were written in.
rows.translation: Ernst Anschütz je to besedilo napisal v Leipzigu leta 1824 na veliko starejšo ljudsko melodijo. Pel ga boš v nemščini, jeziku, v katerem je bilo napisano.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: O Tannenbaum, o Tannenbaum: open D, three open Gs, then A at fret 2 and three open Bs.
rows.translation: O Tannenbaum, o Tannenbaum: prazni D, trije prazni toni G, nato A na prečki 2 in trije prazni toni B.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: Tan-nen is a dotted note and a very short one, then baum rings on. Say the words as you tap, and the rhythm follows.
rows.translation: Tan-nen je nota s piko in zelo kratka nota, nato baum zveni naprej. Med trkanjem izgovarjaj besedilo in ritem mu bo sledil.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: The Latin hymn Adeste Fideles was printed with this tune in 1751, and Frederick Oakeley's English words followed in 1841. You'll sing a verse in each language.
rows.translation: Latinska hvalnica Adeste Fideles je bila s to melodijo natisnjena leta 1751, angleško besedilo Fredericka Oakeleyja pa je sledilo leta 1841. Zapel boš po eno kitico v vsakem jeziku.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: O come, all ye faithful: open G twice, down to open D, back to G, A, and D again.
rows.translation: O come, all ye faithful: dvakrat prazni G, navzdol do praznega D, nazaj na G, A in spet D.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: How many times does the refrain sing O come, let us adore him?
rows.translation: Kolikokrat refren zapoje O come, let us adore him?
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: Three times, each a little higher, before Christ the Lord brings the tune home.
rows.translation: Trikrat, vsakič nekoliko više, preden Christ the Lord pripelje melodijo domov.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: Latin hymn (1751); English words Frederick Oakeley (1841)
rows.translation: Latinska hvalnica (1751); angleško besedilo Frederick Oakeley (1841)
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: This carol was first printed in 1823, in a collection of old Christmas carols. Its tune walks up the scale and back, which is why it is so easy to remember.
rows.translation: Ta božična pesem je bila prvič natisnjena leta 1823 v zbirki starih božičnih pesmi. Njena melodija hodi po lestvici navzgor in nazaj, zato si jo je tako lahko zapomniti.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: Up the D scale: F sharp and E, open D, then E, F sharp, open G, A, open B, C sharp at fret 2 and D.
rows.translation: Po D-lestvici navzgor: F z višajem, E, prazni D, E, F z višajem, prazni G, A, prazni B, C z višajem na prečki 2, D.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: The tune starts with two quick notes, F sharp and E, before beat one. Then a long D and a run of eighths climb to A.
rows.translation: Melodija se začne z dvema kratkima tonoma, F z višajem in E, pred prvo dobo. Nato se dolg D in niz osmink vzpneta do A.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: Five songs from this unit: two ballads and three carols. No new notes, just one after another, each a little faster than before.
rows.translation: Pet pesmi iz te enote: dve baladi in tri božične pesmi. Brez novih tonov, le ena za drugo, vsaka nekoliko hitreje kot prej.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: Which of these counts in six?
rows.translation: Katero od teh štejemo v šestih enotah?
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: The Skye Boat Song rocks in six-eight. O Christmas Tree is in three, and All Through the Night in four.
rows.translation: The Skye Boat Song se ziblje v šest-osminskem taktu. O smrečica ima tri dobe, All Through the Night pa štiri.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: A pipe march, a Russian folk dance, the Blue Danube and the can-can.
rows.translation: Koračnica za dude, ruski ljudski ples, Na lepi modri Donavi in kankan.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: This Scottish march was in print by 1878, and pipe bands play it all over the world. Pipers play it without words, and so will you.
rows.translation: Ta škotska koračnica je bila natisnjena že leta 1878, godbe z dudami pa jo igrajo po vsem svetu. Dudarji jo igrajo brez besedila in tudi ti jo boš.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: A dotted note and a quick one give a march its snap: long, then short. In the first bar, the second D is long and E slips in just before beat two.
rows.translation: Nota s piko in kratka nota dajeta koračnici odsekan ritem: dolgo, nato kratko. V prvem taktu je drugi D dolg, E pa pride tik pred drugo dobo.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: Up the D chord: open D twice, E, F sharp at fret 4, D, F sharp, A, then D on string 2.
rows.translation: Navzgor po akordu D: dvakrat prazni D, E, F z višajem na prečki 4, D, F z višajem, A, nato D na struni 2.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: Nikolay Nekrasov's poem about traveling peddlers was printed in 1861, and this folk tune was published with it in 1898. A video game made it famous worldwide almost a century later.
rows.translation: Pesem Nikolaja Nekrasova o potujočih krošnjarjih je bila natisnjena leta 1861, ta ljudska melodija pa z njo objavljena leta 1898. Skoraj stoletje pozneje jo je videoigra proslavila po vsem svetu.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: The opening: open B, down to F sharp at fret 4 on string 4, up G and A, then G, F sharp, E.
rows.translation: Začetek: prazni B, navzdol do F z višajem na prečki 4 strune 4, navzgor G in A, nato G, F z višajem, E.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: The second half reaches higher: A, C at fret 1 on string 2, open E, then down D, C, B and G.
rows.translation: Druga polovica seže više: A, C na prečki 1 strune 2, prazni E, nato navzdol D, C, B in G.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: This tune is in E minor. Which note sounds like home?
rows.translation: Ta melodija je v E-molu. Kateri ton zveni kot dom?
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: Both halves end on E, the home note of E minor. You hear it as the place the tune settles.
rows.translation: Obe polovici se končata na E, domačem tonu E-mola. Slišiš ga kot mesto, kjer se melodija umiri.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: Johann Strauss II first performed this waltz in Vienna in 1867, and Vienna still plays it every New Year's Day. Its tune climbs a chord, then answers with two high notes.
rows.translation: Johann Strauss II je ta valček prvič izvedel na Dunaju leta 1867, Dunaj pa ga še vedno igra vsako novo leto. Melodija se vzpne po akordu, nato odgovori z dvema visokima tonoma.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: G at fret 3 on string 6 twice, B on string 5, open D, then leap up to D at fret 3 on string 2 and down to open B.
rows.translation: Dvakrat G na prečki 3 strune 6, B na struni 5, prazni D, nato skok do D na prečki 3 strune 2 in navzdol do praznega B.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: Each phrase starts low on the bass strings and leaps up an octave. Look at the high note before you play the low ones, so your hand knows where it's going.
rows.translation: Vsaka fraza se začne nizko na basovskih strunah in skoči oktavo navzgor. Poglej visoki ton, preden zaigraš nizke, da roka ve, kam gre.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: Jacques Offenbach wrote this galop for his 1858 operetta Orpheus in the Underworld. Paris dance halls later made it the music of the can-can.
rows.translation: Jacques Offenbach je ta galop napisal za opereto Orfej v podzemlju iz leta 1858. Pariška plesišča so ga pozneje spremenila v glasbo za kankan.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: A long open G, then A, C, B, A, and two Ds at fret 3 on string 2.
rows.translation: Dolg prazni G, nato A, C, B, A in dva tona D na prečki 3 strune 2.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: Most of the tune runs in eighth notes. Keep the pick small and alternate down and up, so you never fall behind.
rows.translation: Večina melodije teče v osminkah. Trzalico premikaj z majhnimi gibi, izmenično navzdol in navzgor, da ne zaostaneš.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: The big run: open G, leap to G at fret 3 on string 1, then step all the way down to A.
rows.translation: Velika pasaža: prazni G, skok do G na prečki 3 strune 1, nato po stopnjah vse do A.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: Four tunes from this unit: a pipe march, a Russian folk song, a Viennese waltz and a French galop. Each one a little faster than before.
rows.translation: Štiri melodije iz te enote: koračnica za dude, ruska ljudska pesem, dunajski valček in francoski galop. Vsaka nekoliko hitreje kot prej.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: Which of these is a waltz, in three?
rows.translation: Katera od teh skladb je valček v treh dobah?
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: A waltz counts one, two, three. The can-can and the pipe march both count in four.
rows.translation: Valček šteje ena, dve, tri. Kankan in koračnica za dude imata oba štiri dobe v taktu.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: Joplin, Sousa, Bizet and Grieg: syncopation, six-eight and key changes.
rows.translation: Joplin, Sousa, Bizet in Grieg: sinkopiranje, šest-osminski takt in menjave tonalitete.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: Scott Joplin published The Entertainer in 1902, and a 1973 film made it famous again. In ragtime the tune leans off the beat while the bass keeps steady time.
rows.translation: Scott Joplin je The Entertainer objavil leta 1902, film iz leta 1973 pa ga je znova proslavil. V ragtimu se melodija nagiba med dobe, bas pa drži enakomeren ritem.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: Open D, D sharp at fret 1, E at fret 2 on string 4, then leap to C at fret 1 on string 2 and back, three times.
rows.translation: Prazni D, D z višajem na prečki 1, E na prečki 2 strune 4, nato skok do C na prečki 1 strune 2 in nazaj, trikrat.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: Syncopation puts the accent between the beats. In the opening, each C lands on an and. Count one-and-two-and and feel the C pull ahead.
rows.translation: Sinkopiranje postavi poudarek med dobe. Na začetku vsak C pride na in. Štej ena-in-dve-in in začuti, kako C vleče naprej.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: The ending run circles C, D and E on strings 2 and 1, then lands through B and D on C.
rows.translation: Zaključna pasaža kroži okrog C, D in E na strunah 2 in 1, nato prek B in D pristane na C.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: John Philip Sousa published The Liberty Bell in 1893, and a British TV comedy later made it its theme. It's in six-eight: two big beats a bar, like left, right.
rows.translation: John Philip Sousa je The Liberty Bell objavil leta 1893, britanska televizijska komedija pa jo je pozneje uporabila za svojo temo. Je v šest-osminskem taktu: dve veliki dobi v taktu, kot leva, desna.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: Many beats start with a short silence. Stop the string with your fretting hand, then come back in on the next eighth.
rows.translation: Številne dobe se začnejo s kratko tišino. Struno ustavi z roko na ubiralki, nato se vrni na naslednji osminki.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: Open B three times, A sharp at fret 3 on string 3, B again, then up to G on string 1 and down D, D, B.
rows.translation: Trikrat prazni B, A z višajem na prečki 3 strune 3, spet B, nato navzgor do G na struni 1 in navzdol D, D, B.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: Georges Bizet's opera Carmen opened in Paris in 1875. Its prelude starts with this festive march, then plays the tune of the famous Toreador Song.
rows.translation: Opera Carmen Georgesa Bizeta je bila premierno uprizorjena v Parizu leta 1875. Njena predigra se začne s to praznično koračnico, nato zaigra melodijo znamenite Toreadorjeve pesmi.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: Four As at fret 2 on string 3, then down to E at fret 2 on string 4, open D and E.
rows.translation: Štirje toni A na prečki 2 strune 3, nato navzdol do E na prečki 2 strune 4, prazni D in E.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: The march is in A major, with C sharp and G sharp. The Toreador tune moves to F major, with B flat at fret 3 on string 3. Watch for the change.
rows.translation: Koračnica je v A-duru s C z višajem in G z višajem. Toreadorjeva melodija preide v F-dur z B z nižajem na prečki 3 strune 3. Bodi pozoren na menjavo.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: What happens at the end of the Toreador tune?
rows.translation: Kaj se zgodi na koncu Toreadorjeve melodije?
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: It climbs to a long E
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: It climbs to a long high E, the note that leads back home to A major for the march.
rows.translation: Vzpne se do dolgega visokega E, tona, ki za koračnico vodi nazaj domov v A-dur.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: Edvard Grieg wrote Morning Mood in 1875 for the play Peer Gynt. The flute plays the theme, the oboe answers, and the music climbs like the rising sun.
rows.translation: Edvard Grieg je Jutranje razpoloženje napisal leta 1875 za igro Peer Gynt. Flavta igra temo, oboa odgovarja, glasba pa se vzpenja kakor vzhajajoče sonce.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: The theme uses just G, A, B, D and E. A five-note scale like this is called pentatonic, and it sounds calm and open.
rows.translation: Tema uporablja le G, A, B, D in E. Takšni pettonski lestvici pravimo pentatonična; zveni mirno in odprto.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: D at fret 3 on string 2, open B, A at fret 2 on string 3, open G, then back up A and B.
rows.translation: D na prečki 3 strune 2, prazni B, A na prečki 2 strune 3, prazni G, nato nazaj navzgor A in B.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: How many different notes does the theme use?
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: G, A, B, D and E: a pentatonic scale. There is no C and no F sharp in the whole theme.
rows.translation: G, A, B, D in E: pentatonična lestvica. V vsej temi ni niti C niti F z višajem.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: The four pieces from this unit, back to back: ragtime, a march, an opera prelude and a sunrise. Each a little faster than before.
rows.translation: Štiri skladbe iz te enote, ena za drugo: ragtime, koračnica, operna predigra in sončni vzhod. Vsaka nekoliko hitreje kot prej.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: Which of these pieces uses only five notes in its theme?
rows.translation: Katera od teh skladb v temi uporablja le pet tonov?
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: Morning Mood's theme is pentatonic: G, A, B, D and E. The others use many more.
rows.translation: Tema Jutranjega razpoloženja je pentatonična: G, A, B, D in E. Druge jih uporabljajo veliko več.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: Four Christmas carols to sing by candlelight: Wesley and Mendelssohn, a lullaby, and two tunes from America.
rows.translation: Štiri božične pesmi za petje ob svečah: Wesley in Mendelssohn, uspavanka in dve melodiji iz Amerike.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: Charles Wesley wrote the words in 1739. In 1856 an English organist set them to a tune from a choral piece by Felix Mendelssohn, and the carol has been sung that way since.
rows.translation: Charles Wesley je besedilo napisal leta 1739. Leta 1856 ga je angleški organist uglasbil na melodijo iz zborovske skladbe Felixa Mendelssohna in odtlej se božična pesem poje tako.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: Open D, open G twice, F sharp at fret 4 on string 4, G, then open B twice and A at fret 2 on string 3.
rows.translation: Prazni D, dvakrat prazni G, F z višajem na prečki 4 strune 4, G, nato dvakrat prazni B in A na prečki 2 strune 3.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: Her-ald is long-short: her- lands on three and holds, and -ald slips in on the and of four. Count one, two, three, four-and.
rows.translation: Her-ald je dolgo-kratko: her- pride na tretjo dobo in traja, -ald pa na in četrte. Štej ena, dve, tri, štiri-in.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: The chorus moves C, A minor, D7 and G. Change on the word that starts each half bar, and keep the strum light under the high E.
rows.translation: Refren gre skozi C, A-mol, D7 in G. Menjaj na besedi, ki začne vsako polovico takta, pod visokim E pa ohrani lahke udarce.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.translation: Charles Wesley (1739), po natisu iz leta 1861
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: These words first appeared in an American children's book in 1885, and James R. Murray gave them this gentle tune in 1887. It rocks in three, like a cradle.
rows.translation: To besedilo se je prvič pojavilo v ameriški otroški knjigi leta 1885, James R. Murray pa mu je leta 1887 dodal to nežno melodijo. Ziblje se v treh dobah kot zibelka.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: It starts high: D at fret 3 on string 2, then steps down C, B, A, G and F sharp all the way to open D.
rows.translation: Začne se visoko: D na prečki 3 strune 2, nato po stopnjah navzdol C, B, A, G in F z višajem vse do praznega D.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: The first line walks down from high D to low D. How far is that?
rows.translation: Prva vrstica se spusti od visokega D do nizkega D. Kako daleč je to?
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: D down to D is an octave: eight steps of the scale, the same note name, one register lower.
rows.translation: Od D navzdol do D je oktava: osem lestvičnih stopenj, isto ime tona, en register niže.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: Hold G for most of a line, C for crib for a bed, and D7 to lead home. In three, strum down on one and lightly on two and three.
rows.translation: G zadrži večino vrstice, C pri crib for a bed, D7 pa za vrnitev domov. V treh dobah udari navzdol na prvi, na drugi in tretji pa lahkotno.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.translation: Neznani avtor (1885); kitica 3 John T. McFarland (1892)
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: Phillips Brooks wrote these words in 1868 for the children of his Philadelphia church, and its organist, Lewis Redner, wrote the tune for their Christmas service.
rows.translation: Phillips Brooks je to besedilo leta 1868 napisal za otroke svoje filadelfijske cerkve, njen organist Lewis Redner pa je napisal melodijo za božično bogoslužje.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: Open B three times, A sharp at fret 3 on string 3, B again, then D, C and a drop to E on string 4.
rows.translation: Trikrat prazni B, A z višajem na prečki 3 strune 3, spet B, nato D, C in spust do E na struni 4.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: A sharp at fret 3 on string 3 leans into open B, a half step up. It gives O little town its gentle sway.
rows.translation: A z višajem na prečki 3 strune 3 teži k praznemu B, polton više. Besedam O little town daje nežno zibanje.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: Which word dips down to the low D in the first verse?
rows.translation: Katera beseda v prvi kitici se spusti do nizkega D?
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: Thee, in how still we see thee lie
rows.translation: Thee v how still we see thee lie
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: How still we see thee lie: the tune falls to open D on thee, then lifts to B on lie.
rows.translation: How still we see thee lie: melodija se na thee spusti do praznega D, nato se na lie dvigne do B.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: It Came Upon the Midnight Clear
rows.translation: It Came Upon the Midnight Clear
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: Edmund Sears wrote these words in Massachusetts in 1849, and Richard Storrs Willis wrote the tune a year later. It swings in two big beats a bar, each split in three.
rows.translation: Edmund Sears je to besedilo napisal v Massachusettsu leta 1849, Richard Storrs Willis pa melodijo leto pozneje. Niha v dveh velikih dobah v taktu, vsaka je razdeljena na tri.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: In six-eight a quarter and an eighth make one big beat: long, short. Count one-two-three, four-five-six, and play on one, three, four and six.
rows.translation: V šest-osminskem taktu četrtinka in osminka tvorita eno veliko dobo: dolgo, kratko. Štej ena-dve-tri, štiri-pet-šest in igraj na ena, tri, štiri in šest.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: Open G, a leap to open E on string 1, then B, D, C, A, and back to G with a turn through A.
rows.translation: Prazni G, skok do praznega E na struni 1, nato B, D, C, A in nazaj na G z obratom prek A.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: The middle of the verse drops to low E and climbs through G sharp, at fret 1 on string 3, to A. Under it the chord moves from E7 to A minor.
rows.translation: Sredina kitice se spusti do nizkega E in se prek G z višajem na prečki 1 strune 3 vzpne do A. Pod njo akord preide iz E7 v A-mol.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: The four carols from this unit, one after another, each a little faster. Keep the chords soft and let the tune sing.
rows.translation: Štiri božične pesmi iz te enote, ena za drugo, vsaka nekoliko hitreje. Akordi naj bodo mehki, melodija pa naj poje.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: Which of these carols counts in three?
rows.translation: Katera od teh božičnih pesmi ima tri dobe v taktu?
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: Away in a Manger is a waltz: one, two, three. The other two count in four.
rows.translation: Away in a Manger je valček: ena, dve, tri. Preostali dve imata štiri dobe.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: King's College's opening carol, Holst's midwinter carol, a folk carol and a grand processional.
rows.translation: Uvodna božična pesem s King's Collegea, Holstova pesem o sredi zime, ljudska pesem in veličastna procesijska pesem.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: Cecil Frances Alexander wrote these words for children in 1848. Since 1919 a single young voice has sung the first verse to open the Christmas Eve carols at King's College, Cambridge.
rows.translation: Cecil Frances Alexander je to besedilo za otroke napisala leta 1848. Od leta 1919 en sam mladi glas poje prvo kitico ob začetku božičnih pesmi na božični večer na King's Collegeu v Cambridgeu.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: Open D, F sharp at fret 4 on string 4, open G, then a turn: G, F sharp, G, A, A, G.
rows.translation: Prazni D, F z višajem na prečki 4 strune 4, prazni G, nato obrat: G, F z višajem, G, A, A, G.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: Da-vid's spreads each syllable over two eighth notes. Play both, but sing them as one smooth sound.
rows.translation: Da-vid's vsak zlog razporedi čez dve osminki. Zaigraj obe, zapoj pa ju kot en gladek zvok.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: Where is the highest note of the carol?
rows.translation: Kje je najvišji ton božične pesmi?
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: Mary was that mother mild starts on open E, the top of the tune.
rows.translation: Mary was that mother mild se začne na praznem E, vrhu melodije.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: A poem and a quiet tune
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: Christina Rossetti wrote this poem in 1872, and Gustav Holst set it to music for a hymn book in 1906. Its lines are short and calm, like snow falling.
rows.translation: Christina Rossetti je to pesem napisala leta 1872, Gustav Holst pa jo je leta 1906 uglasbil za pesmarico hvalnic. Njene vrstice so kratke in mirne kot padajoči sneg.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: Open B twice, C at fret 1 and D at fret 3 on string 2, then back down B, A and G.
rows.translation: Dvakrat prazni B, C na prečki 1 in D na prečki 3 strune 2, nato nazaj navzdol B, A in G.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: Many words land on half notes: -ter in mid-winter, i-ron. Let each ring for two full beats before you move on.
rows.translation: Številne besede pridejo na polovinke: -ter v mid-winter, i-ron. Vsako pusti zveneti dve polni dobi, preden greš naprej.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: Long ago stretches three syllables over how many notes?
rows.translation: Čez koliko tonov Long ago raztegne tri zloge?
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: Long takes two notes, a- takes two, and go takes one: five notes for three syllables.
rows.translation: Long ima dva tona, a- dva, go pa enega: pet tonov za tri zloge.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: Under frost-y wind made moan the chords move A minor to D7, a lean that pulls the line back to G.
rows.translation: Pod frost-y wind made moan akordi preidejo iz A-mola v D7, kar vrstico vleče nazaj na G.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: This carol is centuries old. The song collector Cecil Sharp heard it sung in a Cotswold town and printed this tune in 1911. It dances in three.
rows.translation: Ta božična pesem je stara več stoletij. Zbiralec pesmi Cecil Sharp jo je slišal peti v mestecu v Cotswoldsu in to melodijo objavil leta 1911. Pleše v treh dobah.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: Four open Gs, then a leap to open E on string 1, down to D at fret 3 on string 2 and open B.
rows.translation: Štirje prazni toni G, nato skok do praznega E na struni 1, navzdol do D na prečki 3 strune 2 in praznega B.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: From open G to open E is a sixth. Keep your pick close to the strings and cross from string 3 to string 1 in one move.
rows.translation: Od praznega G do praznega E je seksta. Trzalico drži blizu strun in z enim gibom preidi s strune 3 na struno 1.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: Angels from the Realms of Glory
rows.translation: Angels from the Realms of Glory
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: James Montgomery printed these words in his Sheffield newspaper on Christmas Eve, 1816. Henry Smart's tune, from 1867, gives it a grand, marching sound.
rows.translation: James Montgomery je to besedilo objavil v svojem sheffieldskem časopisu na božični večer leta 1816. Melodija Henryja Smarta iz leta 1867 mu daje veličasten, koračniški zvok.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: A on string 3, F sharp at fret 4 on string 4, D at fret 3 on string 2, A, then F sharp at fret 2 on string 1, E and D.
rows.translation: A na struni 3, F z višajem na prečki 4 strune 4, D na prečki 3 strune 2, A; F z višajem na prečki 2 strune 1, E in D.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: This key has two sharps, F sharp and C sharp. C sharp sits at fret 2 on string 2.
rows.translation: Ta tonaliteta ima dva višaja, F z višajem in C z višajem. C z višajem je na prečki 2 strune 2.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: Where is the highest note of the chorus?
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: Worship Christ starts on G at fret 3 on string 1, the top of the whole carol.
rows.translation: Worship Christ se začne na G na prečki 3 strune 1, vrhu celotne božične pesmi.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: The carols from this unit, back to back. Most move in long notes: let each one ring full length before the next.
rows.translation: Božične pesmi iz te enote, ena za drugo. Večina teče v dolgih tonih: vsak naj odzveni v celoti, preden pride naslednji.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: Which of these counts in three?
rows.translation: Katero od teh štejemo v treh dobah?
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: The Holly and the Ivy is in three. The other two count in four.
rows.translation: The Holly and the Ivy ima tri dobe. Preostali dve imata štiri.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: Five great hymns in long, singing notes, from 1708 to 1861.
rows.translation: Pet velikih hvalnic v dolgih, pojočih tonih, od leta 1708 do 1861.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: O God, Our Help in Ages Past
rows.translation: O God, Our Help in Ages Past
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: William Croft wrote this tune, St Anne, in 1708, and Isaac Watts's words were first printed in 1719. Each verse is four short lines, the plainest hymn shape there is.
rows.translation: William Croft je to melodijo, St Anne, napisal leta 1708, besedilo Isaaca Wattsa pa je bilo prvič natisnjeno leta 1719. Vsaka kitica ima štiri kratke vrstice, najpreprostejšo obliko hvalnice.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: Open G, E at fret 2 on string 4, A at fret 2 on string 3, G, then C at fret 1 on string 2, C, open B and C.
rows.translation: Prazni G, E na prečki 2 strune 4, A na prečki 2 strune 3, G, nato C na prečki 1 strune 2, C, prazni B in C.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: Every line starts on the beat before the bar: O, our, our, and. Count four, then sing the first word on it.
rows.translation: Vsaka vrstica se začne na dobi pred taktom: O, our, our, and. Preštej do štiri in na tej dobi zapoj prvo besedo.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: The chart leans on A minor, F and G7. God, our sits on A minor, and a-ges past moves from G7 to C.
rows.translation: Akordni zapis se opira na A-mol, F in G7. God, our je na A-molu, a-ges past pa preide iz G7 v C.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: Reginald Heber wrote these words, printed in 1826, and John Bacchus Dykes wrote the tune in 1861. Its first line climbs the notes of a G major chord.
rows.translation: Reginald Heber je napisal to besedilo, natisnjeno leta 1826, John Bacchus Dykes pa melodijo leta 1861. Prva vrstica se vzpne po tonih G-durovega akorda.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: Up the G chord: open G twice, open B twice, then D at fret 3 on string 2, held long.
rows.translation: Navzgor po akordu G: dvakrat prazni G, dvakrat prazni B, nato dolgo zadržan D na prečki 3 strune 2.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: Holy, holy, holy climbs which notes?
rows.translation: Po katerih tonih se vzpenja Holy, holy, holy?
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.translation: D, E in F z višajem
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: G, B and D are the notes of a G major chord, so the tune climbs the chord itself.
rows.translation: G, B in D so toni G-durovega akorda, zato se melodija vzpne po samem akordu.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: This hymn moves in long notes: halves of two beats and a whole note of four at the end. Count every beat, even while a note rings.
rows.translation: Ta hvalnica teče v dolgih notah: polovinkah z dvema dobama in celinki s štirimi na koncu. Štej vsako dobo, tudi ko ton zveni.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: Henry Francis Lyte wrote these words in 1847, and William Henry Monk wrote the tune Eventide for them in 1861. Football crowds in England have sung it before the cup final since 1927.
rows.translation: Henry Francis Lyte je to besedilo napisal leta 1847, William Henry Monk pa mu je leta 1861 dodal melodijo Eventide. Nogometni navijači v Angliji jo pred pokalnim finalom pojejo od leta 1927.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: Open B twice, A at fret 2 on string 3, open G, then D at fret 3 and E on string 1, back through D and C to B.
rows.translation: Dvakrat prazni B, A na prečki 2 strune 3, prazni G, nato D na prečki 3 in E na struni 1, nazaj prek D in C do B.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: Every note here is a quarter, a half or a whole. Count four steady beats a bar and let the long notes ring.
rows.translation: Vsaka nota je tu četrtinka, polovinka ali celinka. Štej štiri enakomerne dobe v taktu in pusti dolge tone zveneti.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: Which note leads into the D at the end of the second line?
rows.translation: Kateri ton vodi v D na koncu druge vrstice?
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: C sharp, at fret 2 on string 2, rises a half step into D, the way a leading note does.
rows.translation: C z višajem na prečki 2 strune 2 se dvigne za polton do D, kot to stori vodilni ton.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: Sarah Flower Adams wrote these words in London in 1841, and Lowell Mason, an American music teacher, gave them this tune in 1856.
rows.translation: Sarah Flower Adams je to besedilo napisala v Londonu leta 1841, Lowell Mason, ameriški učitelj glasbe, pa mu je leta 1856 dodal to melodijo.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: Open B, A at fret 2 on string 3, open G twice, then E at fret 2 on string 4 twice.
rows.translation: Prazni B, A na prečki 2 strune 3, dvakrat prazni G, nato dvakrat E na prečki 2 strune 4.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: Each line has a long-short pair: a dotted quarter, then a quick eighth, as in -er, my and God, to. Let the long note lean into the short one.
rows.translation: Vsaka vrstica ima par dolgo-kratko: četrtinko s piko, nato kratko osminko, kot v -er, my in God, to. Naj se dolgi ton nasloni na kratkega.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: For the Beauty of the Earth
rows.translation: For the Beauty of the Earth
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: Folliott Pierpoint wrote these words in 1864, on a spring day in the English countryside. They are sung to Dix, a German tune from 1838.
rows.translation: Folliott Pierpoint je to besedilo napisal leta 1864 na pomladni dan na angleškem podeželju. Poje se na Dix, nemško melodijo iz leta 1838.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: Open G, F sharp at fret 4 on string 4, G, A at fret 2 on string 3, G, then C at fret 1 on string 2 twice and open B.
rows.translation: Prazni G, F z višajem na prečki 4 strune 4, G, A na prečki 2 strune 3, G; dvakrat C na prečki 1 strune 2 in prazni B.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: For the starts with two eighth notes on the: F sharp and G, one syllable sung over both. Play them evenly inside one beat.
rows.translation: For the se začne z dvema osminkama na the: F z višajem in G, en zlog prek obeh. Zaigraj ju enakomerno znotraj ene dobe.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: The hymns from this unit, back to back, from the oldest tune to the newest. Let the long notes ring and the chords change on the word.
rows.translation: Hvalnice iz te enote, ena za drugo, od najstarejše melodije do najnovejše. Dolgi toni naj zvenijo, akordi pa naj se menjajo na besedah.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: Which of these tunes is the oldest?
rows.translation: Katera od teh melodij je najstarejša?
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: William Croft wrote St Anne in 1708, almost 150 years before the other two.
rows.translation: William Croft je St Anne napisal leta 1708, skoraj 150 let pred preostalima dvema.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: Three songs families sang around the piano, then Holst's Jupiter.
rows.translation: Tri pesmi, ki so jih družine pele ob klavirju, nato Holstov Jupiter.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: Henry Bishop wrote this tune for a London opera in 1823, to words by the American actor John Howard Payne. Within a few years it was one of the best-loved songs in the world.
rows.translation: Henry Bishop je to melodijo napisal za londonsko opero leta 1823 na besedilo ameriškega igralca Johna Howarda Payna. V nekaj letih je postala ena najbolj priljubljenih pesmi na svetu.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: Open G, A at fret 2 on string 3, open B, C at fret 1 and D at fret 3 on string 2, then back to B.
rows.translation: Prazni G, A na prečki 2 strune 3, prazni B, C na prečki 1 in D na prečki 3 strune 2, nato nazaj na B.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: The verse starts just before beat one, on a dotted eighth and a sixteenth. Count four-e-and-a: 'Mid lands on four, and its short turn on a.
rows.translation: Kitica se začne tik pred prvo dobo, z osminko s piko in šestnajstinko. Štej štiri-e-in-a: 'Mid pride na štiri, njen kratki obrat pa na a.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: The chorus begins on one long note. How long is it?
rows.translation: Refren se začne z enim dolgim tonom. Kako dolg je?
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: Home! is a whole note: hold D at fret 3 on string 2 for the whole bar.
rows.translation: Home! je celinka: D na prečki 3 strune 2 zadrži ves takt.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: Hard Times Come Again No More
rows.translation: Hard Times Come Again No More
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: Stephen Foster published this song in 1854. It asks the listener to stop and think of people who have less, and singers still return to it today.
rows.translation: Stephen Foster je to pesem objavil leta 1854. Poslušalca prosi, naj se ustavi in pomisli na ljudi, ki imajo manj, pevci pa se k njej vračajo še danes.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: Open D, E and F sharp on string 4, three more F sharps, then A at fret 2 on string 3 and back to F sharp.
rows.translation: Prazni D, E in F z višajem na struni 4, še trije F z višajem, nato A na prečki 2 strune 3 in nazaj na F z višajem.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: The verse sings several words on one note. Keep each F sharp short and even, and let the words carry the line.
rows.translation: Kitica poje več besed na enem tonu. Vsak F z višajem naj bo kratek in enakomeren, vrstico pa naj nosijo besede.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: The chorus lifts to G under the long note on wear-y, then rests on D for hard times. A7 brings each line home.
rows.translation: Refren se pod dolgim tonom na wear-y dvigne na G, nato pri hard times počiva na D. A7 vsako vrstico pripelje domov.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: Thomas Moore set these words to an old Irish air and printed them in 1813. Later, Mendelssohn wrote a fantasia on the tune, and Flotow put it in his opera Martha.
rows.translation: Thomas Moore je to besedilo prilagodil staremu irskemu napevu in ga objavil leta 1813. Pozneje je Mendelssohn na melodijo napisal fantazijo, Flotow pa jo je vključil v opero Marta.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: Open D, E and F sharp on string 4, then a leap to D at fret 3 on string 2, and down C sharp, B and A.
rows.translation: Prazni D, E in F z višajem na struni 4, nato skok do D na prečki 3 strune 2 in navzdol C z višajem, B in A.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: Most beats split long-short: a dotted eighth and a sixteenth. Play the long note full and let the short one lead into the next beat.
