rows.translation: Večina dob se deli na dolgo-kratko: osminko s piko in šestnajstinko. Dolgi ton zaigraj v celoti, kratki pa naj vodi v naslednjo dobo.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: In the middle, no rosebud is nigh climbs through A sharp to B. The chord turns to B minor there, the saddest moment of the song.
rows.translation: Na sredini se no rosebud is nigh prek A z višajem vzpne do B. Akord tam preide v B-mol, najbolj žalostni trenutek pesmi.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: Gustav Holst wrote The Planets between 1914 and 1916. This broad tune is the heart of Jupiter. In 1921 he made it a hymn tune and named it Thaxted, after the town where he lived.
rows.translation: Gustav Holst je Planete napisal med letoma 1914 in 1916. Ta široka melodija je srce Jupitra. Leta 1921 jo je spremenil v melodijo hvalnice in jo po mestu, kjer je živel, poimenoval Thaxted.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: E at fret 2 on string 4, open G, A at fret 2, then C at fret 1 on string 2, open B, G, and up C, D, C, B.
rows.translation: E na prečki 2 strune 4, prazni G, A na prečki 2, nato C na prečki 1 strune 2, prazni B, G in navzgor C, D, C, B.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: The middle of the tune dips to C at fret 3 on string 5. Reach for it with your third finger, then come straight back up to string 4.
rows.translation: Sredina melodije se spusti do C na prečki 3 strune 5. Dosezi ga s tretjim prstom, nato se vrni naravnost navzgor na struno 4.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: Like a slow waltz: one, two, three. Each phrase starts with two eighth notes before beat one.
rows.translation: Kot počasen valček: ena, dve, tri. Vsaka fraza se začne z dvema osminkama pred prvo dobo.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: Before records, families sang these songs around the piano at home. Here they are back to back, with Holst's big tune to finish.
rows.translation: Pred gramofonskimi ploščami so družine te pesmi pele doma ob klavirju. Tukaj so ena za drugo, za konec pa Holstova velika melodija.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: Which two of these count in three?
rows.translation: Kateri dve od teh skladb imata tri dobe v taktu?
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: The Last Rose of Summer and Jupiter
rows.translation: The Last Rose of Summer in Jupiter
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: Hard Times and The Last Rose of Summer
rows.translation: Hard Times in The Last Rose of Summer
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: The Last Rose of Summer and Jupiter are both in three. Home! Sweet Home! and Hard Times count in four.
rows.translation: The Last Rose of Summer in Jupiter imata oba tri dobe. Home! Sweet Home! in Hard Times imata štiri.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: Vivaldi's Spring, Mozart's Turkish rondo and Sousa's best-known march.
rows.translation: Vivaldijeva Pomlad, Mozartov turški rondo in najbolj znana Sousova koračnica.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: Antonio Vivaldi published four violin concertos called The Four Seasons in 1725. Spring opens with this bright tune, then the solo violin plays birdsong and running brooks.
rows.translation: Antonio Vivaldi je leta 1725 objavil štiri violinske koncerte z naslovom Štirje letni časi. Pomlad se začne s to vedro melodijo, nato solo violina igra ptičje petje in žuborenje potokov.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: E at fret 2 on string 4, G sharp at fret 1 on string 3 three times, F sharp at fret 4 on string 4, E, then open B.
rows.translation: E na prečki 2 strune 4, trikrat G z višajem na prečki 1 strune 3, F z višajem na prečki 4 strune 4, E, nato prazni B.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: The key of E has four sharps. In first position G sharp is at fret 1 on string 3, D sharp at fret 1 on string 4, and C sharp at fret 2 on string 2.
rows.translation: E-dur ima štiri višaje. V prvi legi je G z višajem na prečki 1 strune 3, D z višajem na prečki 1 strune 4, C z višajem pa na prečki 2 strune 2.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: Each beat can split into four sixteenths. In the theme, the quick F sharp, E pair falls in the second half of beat two.
rows.translation: Vsako dobo lahko razdelimo na štiri šestnajstinke. V temi hitri par F z višajem, E pride v drugo polovico druge dobe.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: Mozart published this rondo in 1784 as the last movement of a piano sonata. Its march copies the sound of Turkish military bands, which Vienna loved at the time.
rows.translation: Mozart je ta rondo objavil leta 1784 kot zadnji stavek klavirske sonate. Njegova koračnica posnema zvok turških vojaških godb, ki so jih tedaj na Dunaju oboževali.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: B at fret 2 on string 5, open A, G sharp at fret 4 on string 6, A, then C at fret 3 on string 5, open D, C, B and C.
rows.translation: B na prečki 2 strune 5, prazni A, G z višajem na prečki 4 strune 6, A, nato C na prečki 3 strune 5, prazni D, C, B in C.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: The theme circles A: B, A, G sharp, A. Each circle is four sixteenths. Then it climbs a step and circles again.
rows.translation: Tema kroži okrog A: B, A, G z višajem, A. Vsak krog ima štiri šestnajstinke. Nato se vzpne za stopnjo in spet zakroži.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: The march moves from A minor to A major: C becomes C sharp, at fret 2 on string 2. The tune sounds suddenly bright.
rows.translation: Koračnica preide iz A-mola v A-dur: C postane C z višajem na prečki 2 strune 2. Melodija nenadoma zveni svetlo.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: John Philip Sousa wrote this march at the end of 1896, and it was published in 1897. It is the official national march of the United States. This is its big trio tune.
rows.translation: John Philip Sousa je to koračnico napisal konec leta 1896, objavljena pa je bila leta 1897. Je uradna nacionalna koračnica Združenih držav. To je njena mogočna melodija tria.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: D at fret 3 on string 2, C at fret 1, open B, then a dip to A sharp at fret 3 on string 3 and back to B.
rows.translation: D na prečki 3 strune 2, C na prečki 1, prazni B, nato spust do A z višajem na prečki 3 strune 3 in nazaj na B.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: The trio holds notes across the bar line. Keep counting through them: one, two, three, four, then on into the next bar.
rows.translation: Trio zadržuje tone čez taktnico. Štej tudi med njimi: ena, dve, tri, štiri, nato naprej v naslednji takt.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: The tune keeps dipping a half step below B. Which note is that?
rows.translation: Melodija se ves čas spušča za polton pod B. Kateri ton je to?
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: A sharp, at fret 3 on string 3, sits a half step below open B and leans right back into it.
rows.translation: A z višajem na prečki 3 strune 3 je polton pod praznim B in teži naravnost nazaj k njemu.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: Vivaldi, Mozart and Sousa, back to back: a violin concerto, a piano rondo and a band march, each arranged for your guitar.
rows.translation: Vivaldi, Mozart in Sousa, eden za drugim: violinski koncert, klavirski rondo in koračnica za godbo, vsak prirejen za tvojo kitaro.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: Which of these pieces was written for a band?
rows.translation: Katera od teh skladb je bila napisana za godbo?
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: Sousa wrote his marches for a military band. Spring is for violin and strings, and the rondo is for piano.
rows.translation: Sousa je svoje koračnice pisal za vojaško godbo. Pomlad je za violino in godala, rondo pa za klavir.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: The whole songbook in ukulele keys, start to finish
rows.translation: Celotna pesmarica v tonalitetah za ukulele, od začetka do konca
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: The tunes everyone learns first: slow tempos, short phrases, big wins.
rows.translation: Melodije, ki se jih vsi naučijo najprej: počasni tempi, kratke fraze, veliki uspehi.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: This edition is in C. Your fourth string is tuned high, so the tune stays on strings 1 to 3, and every chord in the chart is a ukulele shape.
rows.translation: Ta različica je v C-duru. Četrta struna je uglašena visoko, zato melodija ostaja na strunah od 1 do 3, vsak akord v zapisu pa ima obliko za ukulele.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: This edition is in F. Your fourth string is tuned high, so the tune stays on strings 1 to 3, and every chord in the chart is a ukulele shape.
rows.translation: Ta različica je v F-duru. Četrta struna je uglašena visoko, zato melodija ostaja na strunah od 1 do 3, vsak akord v zapisu pa ima obliko za ukulele.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: Campfire and folk songs with easy chord charts, to play or to sing over.
rows.translation: Pesmi za taborni ogenj in ljudske pesmi s preprostimi akordnimi zapisi za igranje ali spremljavo petja.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: This edition is in G. Your fourth string is tuned high, so the tune stays on strings 1 to 3, and every chord in the chart is a ukulele shape.
rows.translation: Ta različica je v G-duru. Četrta struna je uglašena visoko, zato melodija ostaja na strunah od 1 do 3, vsak akord v zapisu pa ima obliko za ukulele.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: New songs on open chords: campfire pop, a ballad, stomp-folk, reggae and country.
rows.translation: Nove pesmi z odprtimi akordi: pop ob tabornem ognju, balada, folk z udarjanjem z nogo, reggae in country.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: This edition is in D minor. Your fourth string is tuned high, so the tune stays on strings 1 to 3, and every chord in the chart is a ukulele shape.
rows.translation: Ta različica je v D-molu. Četrta struna je uglašena visoko, zato melodija ostaja na strunah od 1 do 3, vsak akord v zapisu pa ima obliko za ukulele.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: Campfire folk songs everyone can sing, with simple chord charts to strum.
rows.translation: Ljudske pesmi ob tabornem ognju, ki jih lahko poje vsak, s preprostimi akordnimi zapisi za spremljavo.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: This edition is in A. Your fourth string is tuned high, so the tune stays on strings 1 to 3, and every chord in the chart is a ukulele shape.
rows.translation: Ta različica je v A-duru. Četrta struna je uglašena visoko, zato melodija ostaja na strunah od 1 do 3, vsak akord v zapisu pa ima obliko za ukulele.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: This edition is in D. Your fourth string is tuned high, so the tune stays on strings 1 to 3, and every chord in the chart is a ukulele shape.
rows.translation: Ta različica je v D-duru. Četrta struna je uglašena visoko, zato melodija ostaja na strunah od 1 do 3, vsak akord v zapisu pa ima obliko za ukulele.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: Old favorites from America's songbook, to strum and to sing.
rows.translation: Stare priljubljene pesmi iz ameriškega izročila za spremljavo in petje.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: This edition is in A minor. Your fourth string is tuned high, so the tune stays on strings 1 to 3, and every chord in the chart is a ukulele shape.
rows.translation: Ta različica je v A-molu. Četrta struna je uglašena visoko, zato melodija ostaja na strunah od 1 do 3, vsak akord v zapisu pa ima obliko za ukulele.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: Lullabies, ballads and carols to play slowly and let ring.
rows.translation: Uspavanke, balade in božične pesmi za počasno igranje in dolgo zvenenje.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: Famous classical themes, from a Baroque canon to a Romantic lullaby.
rows.translation: Znamenite klasične teme, od baročnega kanona do romantične uspavanke.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: Punk-pop, riff rock, dark 6/8 rock, an indie anthem and desert rock, on power chords.
rows.translation: Punk pop, rock z riffi, temni rock v 6/8, indie himna in puščavski rock s kvintnimi akordi.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: Two Mozart themes and two old airs, with minor keys and a wide range.
rows.translation: Dve Mozartovi temi in dva stara napeva z molovimi tonalitetami in širokim obsegom.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: This edition is in E minor. Your fourth string is tuned high, so the tune stays on strings 1 to 3, and every chord in the chart is a ukulele shape.
rows.translation: Ta različica je v E-molu. Četrta struna je uglašena visoko, zato melodija ostaja na strunah od 1 do 3, vsak akord v zapisu pa ima obliko za ukulele.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: A ballad, a sea story in 6/8, a music-box waltz, a bright folk strummer and a dark song in a minor key.
rows.translation: Balada, morska zgodba v 6/8, valček glasbene skrinjice, vedra folk spremljava in temna pesem v molovi tonaliteti.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: Indie pop, a power ballad, highlife, neo-soul and an anthem with a key change.
rows.translation: Indie pop, mogočna balada, highlife, neo-soul in himna z menjavo tonalitete.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: Synth-pop, gospel-pop, dark pop, indie pop and a 6/8 finale, full of syncopation.
rows.translation: Sintetični pop, gospel pop, temni pop, indie pop in finale v 6/8, polni sinkopiranja.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: Folk songs, carols and classical themes in mandolin keys
rows.translation: Ljudske pesmi, božične pesmi in klasične teme v tonalitetah za mandolino
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: This edition is in C, in first position: two frets to a finger across the four pairs, and every chord in the chart is a mandolin shape.
rows.translation: Ta različica je v C-duru, v prvi legi: po dve prečki na prst čez štiri pare strun, vsak akord v zapisu pa ima obliko za mandolino.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: This edition is in G, in first position: two frets to a finger across the four pairs, and every chord in the chart is a mandolin shape.
rows.translation: Ta različica je v G-duru, v prvi legi: po dve prečki na prst čez štiri pare strun, vsak akord v zapisu pa ima obliko za mandolino.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: This edition is in D, in first position: two frets to a finger across the four pairs, and every chord in the chart is a mandolin shape.
rows.translation: Ta različica je v D-duru, v prvi legi: po dve prečki na prst čez štiri pare strun, vsak akord v zapisu pa ima obliko za mandolino.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: This edition is in E minor, in first position: two frets to a finger across the four pairs, and every chord in the chart is a mandolin shape.
rows.translation: Ta različica je v E-molu, v prvi legi: po dve prečki na prst čez štiri pare strun, vsak akord v zapisu pa ima obliko za mandolino.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: This edition is in A minor, in first position: two frets to a finger across the four pairs, and every chord in the chart is a mandolin shape.
rows.translation: Ta različica je v A-molu, v prvi legi: po dve prečki na prst čez štiri pare strun, vsak akord v zapisu pa ima obliko za mandolino.
rows.author: sl drafting AI 1

rows.source: Roots and fifths, as a bass player first backs a band: the chord's root where it starts, its fifth between, low in first position. The song stays in C, where the band plays it.
rows.translation: Osnovni toni in kvinte, kot pri prvi basovski spremljavi benda: osnovni ton ob začetku akorda, njegova kvinta vmes, nizko v prvi legi. Pesem ostane v C-duru, kjer jo igra bend.
